title: The Joy of Mapping 3: Mandatory Joy
description: The Joy of Mapping 3: Mandatory Joy is a communal mapping session which took place on January 28th, 2017. It is the third of such sessions held under the guidance of James Paddock (Jimmy) and a few assistants, where mappers were talked through the basics of mapping, such as creating connected areas, interesting layouts, and using thing placement sensibly.

title: The Joy of Mapping 4: Summer School
description: The Joy of Mapping 4: Summer School is a communal mapping session which took place between the 1st and the 10th of July, 2017. It is the fourth of such mapping sessions held by James Paddock (Jimmy), and while it respects most of the same rules, it marks a number of differences for the series going forward, such as maps being split under multiple episodes, and the presence of a central hub map from which other levels can be selected.

title: The Joy of Mapping 5: Winter Weekend
description: The Joy of Mapping 5: Winter Weekend is a communal mapping session which took place between the 1st and the 4th of December, 2017. It is the fifth Joy of Mapping session held by James Paddock (Jimmy), and continues its predecessor's usage of a central hub map and maps being split into multiple episodes.

title: The Joy of Mapping 6: Joy Eternal
description: The Joy of Mapping 6: Joy Eternal is a communal mapping session which took place between the 17th and 20th of December 2018. It is the sixth Joy of Mapping session held by James Paddock (Jimmy), and to date, also the last. It is also the largest project coming from the series, with a total of 72 maps.

title: Spell Card Collection
description: A Touhou Project fangame featuring 102 unique spell cards, created using the Danmakufu shooting game engine.

title: Shallow World
description: A "reimagination" of Doom 2 episode 1 (11 maps). + 2 early/reused maps

title: Bellatrix: Tales of Orionis
description: Bellatrix: Tales of Orionis is an episode of 11 vanilla maps compatible. You wake up next to your survival pod, not knowing what planet you’re on. You don’t remember anything, and a version of yourself remained in hyper hibernation. By tapping on the control screens, you quickly understand that you are on a planet that was part of the former colonization of the UAC, Orionis. You then decide to take the path to the nearest town, but the inhabitants of the surrounding area seem hostile.

title: Mysterious Mayan Madness
description: Mysterious Mayan Madness is a 20 map megawad (2 of which being an intro and a credits map) created as the fifteenth edition of the Pineapple Under the Sea speedmapping series and our first event of 2022. Hailing as a spiritual successor to Clandestine Castle Crashing, each map was made with an 8 hour time limit with the requirements that mappers make a jungle temple with a minimum of 4 traps of various types and 6 secrets within. After escaping the famous PUSS dev hell, these jungle temples are here to perplex and stun you as you inspect every single brick for a soulsphere.

title: I.H.N.I.
description: I.H.N.I. is a 3 maps long mapset that's making some heavy use of GZDoom-specific features.

title: Elementalism
description: An ambitious 15-level mapset with extensive, detailed maps split across three episodes: The Realm of Earth, The Realm of Water, and the Realm of Fire for GZDoom. The God of Entropy stirs. Travel to the elemental planes and retrieve the imprisoning runes before it is too late!

title: Malevolence: Shutdown
description: Continue the story of Malevolence after the events of episode one, shut down Malevolence for good after your lunar crash landing.

title: The Smoking Dog
description: set of 5 levels for doom2

title: Shady Trial
description:
The most-terrible-ever Patchouli presents a hilarious "court game"!
Dance battles occur in the court! By the way, let's play baseball.

title: Plutonia 1024: The Plutinya Exeriment
description: Plutonia 1024: The Plutinya Experiment is a megawad for The Plutonia Experiment and Boom compatible source ports that was released on March 8, 2015. In the vein of Congestion 1024 and similar projects, the playable area in the maps is restricted to 1024×1024 map units. The project was led by Jon Vail (40oz).

title: Hypno Tetris
description: Kinky hypnosis fun with Tetris.

title: Final Fantasy 2.0
description: "Final Fantasy 2.0" is a turn-based RPG inspired by the renowned Final Fantasy franchise. Explore a fantastical world, choose from a variety of unique classes, and engage in strategic battles. Dive into an epic adventure where imagination and strategy come together to create a captivating gaming experience. Moreover, you'll have the opportunity to traverse the worlds of other beloved franchises. This is a fan-made game, crafted with passion and admiration for the original series.

title: Resonite
description: Enter a novel digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you resonate with people around the world in a casual conversation, playing games and socializing or you riff off each other when creating anything from art to programming complex games, you'll find your place here.

title: Amelia Watson Case File no.420
description: Finding the answer is about asking the right question.

title: Demonic Episode
description: In this 4 player first person online co-op horror game, play as a group of content creators who are on a mission to banish a demon back to hell. The advanced, randomized game mechanics offer you and your friends a high replay value.

title: Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood
description: Party-based rogue-lite RPG set in Earthial, a fantasy world. Hire various races of mercenaries, equip them, create battle formations, and grab the loot! Kill tens of thousands of enemies using steel and spells!

title: Baryoland
description: Baryoland is a whimsical rage platformer starring baryo, a cluster of atoms shaped like a cat. He must collect the quarks and avoid the antiquarks.

title: GunViper
description: A freeware 2.5D vertical scrolling shoot 'em up developed by M.Nagahashi from Japan.

title: Madness Project Nexus: Legacy of the S-3LF Eater
description: Legacy of the S-3LF Eater: a new Story Campaign update! Investigate the origins of the Cyber Bandits and their enigmatic creator, Dr. Gonne, while evading the pursuit of a relentless nightmare. Rumor has it that the doctor's laboratory below the Science Tower has recently opened up again...

title: Mystery Channel
description: Slapdash and frankly unintelligible halloween anthology game. Made for a 9-day contest on saltworld.net

title: Dusk HD
description: A full visual remaster of DUSK.

title: Twisted Tower
description: Blast your way through an abandoned 1950s theme park crawling with fairy-tale mascots, twisted puzzles, and deadly traps. Uncover the dark secrets of your past as you race to the top to win back the love of your life.

title: Nobunaga's Ambition: Shouseiroku
description: Nobunaga's Ambition (Nobunaga no Yabou) is a turn-based strategy video game series first released in Japan in 1983. It is a series of loosely adapted historical simulations produced by the Japanese video game developer Koei. It features a predominately Japanese voice track though English dubs appear during movie cutscenes. It debuted before Romance of the Three Kingdoms but it hasn't been localized as often. Nobunaga's Ambition takes place during the Japanese Warring States period. As the title suggests, The player is tasked with achieving the ultimate goal of warlord Oda Nobunaga; the conquest and unification of Japan. Selecting Nobunaga is optional, however, as the player is also able to choose from a variety of other regional daimyo of the time. Nobunaga no Yabou - Shouseiroku is the seventh title in the series, released March 1997 for Windows 95. This game introduces a new map, portraying the entire country on a grid. Releases for Macintosh, PlayStation, Sega Saturn, Dreamcast, PlayStation Portable, and mobile phones were made subsequently.

title: Red Zero
description:
A horror visual novel where you play as a sleep deprived university student and their anxious adventure with exams, Halloween and... zombies?

Created in a month by Nova SWARM

title: Pluk van de Petteflet
description: An edutainment game for the Nintendo DS.

title: NostalDoom
description: A full Doom I E1 replacement that gimmick the original one BUT also take its own way, the theme stay mainly "Romero Tech" and retake the mains landmarks of the original maps to build another layout around it, but also take soft inspiration of E2. The main goal of this project was to catch a jovial tune for the sake of nostalgia.

title: Hommage 25
description: Originally this was part of NaNoWADMo 2018 but has been released as 6 maps inspired by doom 2 on it's 25th birthday.

title: Reach Charon
description:
Your ship has made an emergency landing at the Charon base, and you have fainted from the crash. When you wake up, your pilot is dead, and no one is answering the radio. Luckily, you've brought your trusty shotgun with you on the ship.
Reach Charon is an MBF21 map that will test your nerves. An adventure in a forgotten and abandoned base in the most remote area of the solar system, where no one can help you.

title: Pumpkin Jam
description: Pretty large very Halloween-themed map for Doom 2 for limit-removing ports. Features new spooky appearances for some of the enemies, although they are all functionally the same. The only exception is arachnotron who has smaller hitbox to fit his new sprites and also slower movement speed to compensate for that.

title: Venturous in the Footsteps of the Fallen
description: Drawing inspiration from Indianan Jones, Tomb Raider and The Mummy, Venturous is a Doom total conversion mod that follows an Indy-esque adventurer on an epic adventure. It takes place in the 1930’s and sees you on the trail of Nazis who are attempting to unlock the gate to the fabled city of Atlantis. You will explore ancient ruins in Mesoamerica and Egypt while also battling Nazis and mythical monsters.

title: Bella Sara
description: The Bella Sara games will immerse players in an interactive world of fantasy horses. Players will be able to ride, care for, accessorise and trade the horses with friends whilst discovering secret items and exclusive cards to activate on the official website.

title: Yorigami Market
description:
This game is a derivative work of Touhou Project.
In short, it is a short RPG in which HP has been replaced by money.

title: The Bikini Bottom Massacre
description: When Squidward is let go of his job at the Krusty Krab, his dissatisfaction with life is at its zenith. After years of torment from his buffoon neighbours, Spongebob and Patrick, Squidward decides to take his life into his own hands. A Spongebob-themed Doom II total conversion parody mod for use with GzDoom.

title: Undead West
description:
Undead West is a western themed roguelite bullet hell where the player uses an array of weapons, whiskey infusions and buffs gained from defeating bosses to complete each stage.

The cowboy you play has been killed in a revolver duel against the Man in Red. Death agrees to resurrect you so that you may carry out your quest for revenge. But there is a catch. Death requests that you pay back your revival debt in souls. Every adversary killed on the road to vengeance grants you a soul that can be used to unlock various new guns to use, as well as whiskey - a mixture used during combat for short boost.

Viewing the action from top down perspective, navigate the hazard filled areas swarming with demons, skeletons and swarms upon swarms of bullets to reach each of the ominous bosses culminating in a fight against the Man in Red.

Shoot your way through enemies, dodge through numerous traps, unlock new guns and whiskey boons as well as colorful outfits in this western noir tinged shooter.

title: Pretty Chaser
description: Arcade style racing game

title: Head North: The Inevitable
description: A contemplative single-player first-person action game, you're thrust into a world where evading relentless enemies is your sole chance at survival. Your lifeline? A flawed survival kit. Prepare for a slow-paced, tension-filled experience as you navigate a challenging terrain.

title: Wing Dog
description: Get ready for an action-packed endless adventure in Wing Dog! Fly through the skies and collect power-ups to fight off the incoming barrage of opponents, consisting of fighter jets, mines, and blimps. Can Wing Dog rescue his city and defeat the evil and corrupt army and their plan to conquer the world?

title: Die 3
description: Die 3 is a story driven game about Dave, a barber who has an obsession to make people kill themselves. After he succeeded making an innocent boy taking his own life, he is on the search for a new victim.

title: Freelancer: HD Edition
description: Freelancer: HD Edition is a mod that aims to improve every aspect of the game Freelancer while keeping the look and feel as close to vanilla as possible. It also serves as a customizable all-in-one package for players so they don't have to worry about installing countless patches and mods to create the perfect HD and bug-free install.

title: Only You: Re-Cross
description: One day an evil mark appears on Magami Yuuji's right arm. To protect the earth from the ancient, world-destroying evil which is honing in on it, the governments send assassins after Yuuji. To protect eight precious girls, and on advice from his Master Tiger Joe, he decides to fight - against the entire world, if necessary.

title: Apassionata: A Passionate Horse-Show - My Show
Mini-Level Megawad
description: The levels are relatively small, hence the name. Other than that, there's no link between them.

title: You Have 1 HP
description: A 32-level megawad full of bite-sized combat puzzles & challenges (and GZDoom gimmicks). As the title suggests, you have only 1 HP. Kill all enemies to progress. ﻿All the levels are designed to be beatable in under a minute, with the majority being beatable in under 30 seconds.

title: Deadly Secret Beneath the Dark Wood
description: A forest-themed single level.

title: The Delirium Dimension
description: The Delirium Dimension is a 13-map experience draped in minimalist classical horror atmosphere complete with an excellent soundtrack assorted from vintage horror bangers.

title: TNT Goes Boom!
description: A 32 map replacement using TNT Evilution aesthetics for each map.

title: Infernovasion
description: An E1 replacement of ultimate doom that focuses on combat, storyline and atmospheric level design.

title: Oculus Malus
description: Sigil inspired map that replaces E3M1. It has a straight forward gameplay with one part being a small puzzle.

title: The Legends of Oz: One Hundred Years of Oz
description: Join the lovable characters in the magic Land of Oz for their new adventures on CD-ROM! Young and old alike will remember Dorothy, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion as their adventures unfold in The Legends of OZ️. Enjoy the complete story of L. Frank Baum's classic, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz, with faithful recreations of W.W. Denslow's original illustrations linked to interactive stories of all the characters you've come to know and love. This full-featured PC/Mac version also includes three entirely new adventures with the SillyOZbul️ of Oz by Roger S. Baum, great-grandson of L. Frank Baum. With interactive animation, narration, a challenging game, and video from the classic movie "The Wizard of Oz"️, The Legends of Oz will delight the child in everyone.

title: Beary the Hatchet
description:
It's Halloween 199X, and you killed someone during your morning shift.

Honestly it's inconvenient. This job was imperfect, sure, but you got to wear a mask with no questions asked and the pay was livable. But now you'll have to keep the body in the backrooms till your shift is done. Bummer.

title: Prison of Husks
description: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

title: What Lies Beneath
description: You have heard rumors of demonic activity in an old gothic mansion. But there's more to it than meets the eye. Time to find out... What lies beneath. What Lies Beneath is a private project made by some of the contributors in Hellevator, Skulltiverse and Solar Struggle community projects. It features 11 maps created.

title: Pina Colada
description:
Pina Colada is a set of 23 maps by a small team of mappers from the Pineapple Under the Sea discord server. These maps were created with the following requirements:
1) No more than 75 monsters per map.
2) Maps should be short, dense, and interconnected.
3) Maps should contain a death exit on Ultra-Violence difficulty

title: Cozy Room Decorator
description: Step into the world of Cozy Room Decorator where you’re the chief curator of cozy and it’s up to you to define what cozy means. Whether that means a lived-in kitchen space filled with sweets, or a tech-laden game room, the combinations are waiting to be explored. Dive into a world of boundless imagination and creativity with a treasure trove of hundreds of items, each brimming with endless possibilities. Equipped with your very own room, this whimsical isometric room design game invites you to unleash your inner interior decorator.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Part 1.5 - Dance of Life and Death
description:
Dance of Life and Death is part 1.5 of HoYoverse's Honkai Impact 3rd. It follows Seele Vollerei and Fu Hua in the aftermath of Project Stigma as a powerful new threat emerges and reveals the fate of a long forgotten Previous Era Project.

Dance of Life and Death spans 7 Main Story Chapters.

title: Systemic\\Rem
description:
A Yume Nikki fangame made by Gali.

"8 comas. 8 of them within the span of a month?"

A quiet Canadian town is faced with a comatose epidemic... one with no clear cause. Doctors scramble to find a cure as quarantine torments the lives of multiple families.

You are a prodigy. A dream witch. Equipped with the means to remove nightmares and sleep paralysis demons, your career picks up when a new gig knocks at your door. You open it, and without knowing it, you have just taken your first step into a world of wonder, bizarreness, and dread, even for dreams.

Will you find and stop the cause of this horrible comatose outbreak in time, or will unseen forces assure you, your friends, and your family never wake up again?

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Part 2 - Extinguished Starlight and Rekindled Fire
description: Follows the Dreamseeker, an engineering student from the cyberpunk-inspired metropolis of Oxia City, as they embark on a journey to explore the Sea of Data through the Anchor of the Apocalypse. Along the way, they will encounter new companions and friends, and uncover the ancient secrets of the Honkai war and the enigmatic Goddess who has long watched over the planet. Their adventures will lead them on a mission to save the Martian bubble universes from falling into the corrupting power of the Sea of Data, eventually leading to the meeting of the people of Earth and Mars.

title: City Panic!
description: Car chasing bird's eye view game.

title: Haunting Hollow
description: Haunting Hollow is a new episode of spooky gothic maps for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports made by various members of Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz.

title: Terrianis
description: Terrianis its a short set of boom maps inspired a bit by Crumpets. These maps follow aesthetics of ruins, castles, temples and overall mystical landscapes. My main goal with these layouts was trying to archive interconectivity, as if the hold level its just one big place where everything its joined together.

title: GridRoad
description: GridRoad is a traffic optimisation simulation game. Build roads, place roadsigns and tweak traffic lights to build the most efficient traffic junction!

title: Battlesmiths: Blade and Forge
description: Battlesmiths is a role-playing strategy game with a deep crafting system and tactical combat

title: Pépito Returned Home
description: Night-based survival horror game about.. Pépito the cat. Featuring internet silly cats!

title: I Love My Follower (Count)
description:
You are an Eldritch horror, summoned to the human realm.

You’re soon to realize, however, that you have more in common with your followers than you thought - they, too, have a longing for The Void.

The Void in their case is, however, mostly something they call ‘y2k’ and ‘retro anime aesthetics’.
But oh well, every god needs clout.

Build your church, gain followers, give away miracles.

Romance your head priest. Or don't.

title: Resident Evil: Containment
description: Resident Evil: Containment is a new total conversion mod for the original 1996 release of Resident Evil. It follows the story of Ghost, a member of the Umbrella Security Service, who was sent into the Arklay Research Facility to investigate a distress call. This mod occurs shortly before the events of Resident Evil 0 and Resident Evil. This mod is a stand-alone release

title: Rip Van Bubsy
description: Bubsy ages 10 years every time he falls asleep. Can you solve the mystery of Bubsy? Unofficial fangame made in 7 days and released September 2009.

title: Twenties Flappers vs. The Mummy
description: A fast talking twenties flapper must take down her political rival, the Mummy.

title: Ghost Voyage
description: A young girl who attempts to remove a Lion from her kitchen gets more than she bargained for. A short adventure game.

title: Veggie Tales 3D
description: Small, irate vegetable RPG.

title: Too Many Kittens
description: There are too many kittens! Can you find all the kittens? There are too many.

title: Dead Signal
description: Monitor camera feeds, report valuable info, and hand-deliver shady packages. An hourly quota of reports will test your keen eye to spot the differences, while timed deliveries will force you outside unexpectedly. Until you clock out for the night almost nowhere is safe.

title: The End is Never the End
description: "The end is never the end" is a visual novel made by Purechito.

title: ST World
description: Discover ST World - the next-generation voxel world! Build stunning high-resolution sandbox worlds with easy-to-use tools and AI features. Explore Riftwalkers' open-world adventures and join a thriving community.

title: Phantom of the Black Rose Revue
description:
1974. Hyogo Prefecture, Japan.

The Black Rose Revue, an all-female musical theater troupe steeped in tradition and high esteem, has a new star on the rise. Twenty-two year old Chihiro Sato has quickly become the newest sensation for fans of the Revue. Sweet yet determined, Chihiro is ready to chase her dream: become the most famous musumeyaku in Japan.

But the theater, a sanctuary of glamour and brilliance, cradles shadows within its embrace. The corridors buzz with whispers of ghostly apparitions and ominous shadows, intensifying backstage tensions. As Chihiro steps deeper into the limelight, mysterious, increasingly obsessive letters begin to adorn her vanity, which grow steadily more obsessive with every message sent.

Will you sculpt a destiny steeped in unparalleled fame? Embark on a romance that will be sung through the ages? Or unearth secrets draped in shadows, whispering of forbidden truths? The threads of fate are in your hands, waiting to be woven into the tapestry of the unknown…

title: Bury Your Gays
description: The teen slasher movie every 80s lesbian deserved.

title: Kill The Monk
description:
This mod is about the story of the struggle of Gordon Freeman against the sinister monk from Ravenholm and leader of the Combine - Father Grigori.

The mod was removed from ModDB sometime between 2021 and 2022.

title: Jolly's Hardcore Mod
description:
Jolly's Hardcore Mod is a single-map mod for Half-Life 2 with increased difficulty.

This mod is loosely inspired by the "Very Hard Mod" by DimeX and created as a challenge for Twitch Streamer JollyWangcore.

title: The Floor is Wet
description: Extremely short horror game where you are a worker of the very popular cleaning company, were sent to clean a place where some kind of incident happend. Just do your job and don't worry! Nobody will try to kill you.

title: Lorraine
description:
"Attend the tale of the diabolical widow, as she pondered and planned the next to be stabbed..."

Lorraine is a bite-sized, blood-curdling, bone-chilling, narrative-driven graphic adventure about a desperate widow in a preternatural situation.

title: Reikai Nikki
description: Reikai Nikki is a Yume Nikki fangame where you explore and collect effects in Otsuki's dreams. Unlike most Yume Nikki fangames, it contains dialogues.

title: Typecast
description: Typecast is a bullet hell where you type to shoot. Get swarmed by enemies, manage the chaos, and climb the leaderboards in this unique arcade experience.

title: SP Football Life 2024
description: Football Life 2024 is a community mod and experimental project that aims to continue the legacy of career modes from the Pro Evolution Soccer (PES) series. It focuses on preserving traditional career mode gameplay and is designed exclusively for offline play

title: Albedo Carta
description: Albedo Carta is Korean indie 2D RPG game, with a story based on cruel fairy tales.

title: Lilithrottle
description: Lilithrottle is a doujin game based on one of the characters from the Darkstalkers (otherwise known as Vampire) series, Lilith Aensland and made by Mount Punch. It is a platformer game where you must collect enough items to exit the stage.

title: Phenomenon User Metropolitan Highway Invincible Legend Second Stage: Clash! Metropolitan Expressway Grand Prix-
description: Neo-retro fighting game.

title: Adventures in the Desert Country: Al and the Underground Labyrinth
description: Neo-retro platform game.

title: Minecraft: Nerf World
description: Gear up for an epic Nerf x Minecraft adventure! Dive into a world of foam-flinging fun as you blast your way through hordes of Minecraft mobs, and unlock dimension-themed arenas. Jump into the blocky chaos and charge towards victory, it's a Nerf battle like never before!

title: Windowkill
description: Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you. Shoot the window edges to push it around your screen as you fight and dodge enemies and bosses in their own windows.

title: Shiba Simulator Supreme
description: Play as a dog (Shiba Inu) and save him from his nightmare. Explore a fever dream landscape to unlock different outfits and abilities. Climb the tower and achieve victory !

title: Magical Lands
description: This is a real-time strategy game where you control soldiers to protect an ancient obelisk from the forces of evil. Call on soldiers for protection. Try to manage your resources correctly!

title: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless - Pleinair Completion Bonus
description: Adds Pleinair as a playable character and save icon.

title: Foxhaven
description: Foxhaven is a gripping 3 vs 1 3D action multiplayer game. Among the four villagers, one is an Impostor, the fox. To avoid getting killed, the villagers must find six keys and escape from the village!

title: Envyus
description: Embark on a journey looking for redemption, truth and your freedom, on a continent filled with challenges to be overcome, with main and side quests that will provide you with various unique and powerful equipments and skills.

title: Alta's Odyssey
description: Alta's Odyssey is a 2D Platform Adventure. After suffering the loss of his beloved rabbit, Alta travels on one final journey with his companion where together they explore the stages of grief through colorful and mysterious landscapes.

title: World League Baseball
description: Enjoy an excitement-filled baseball game rendered in a casual art style! Experience all the fun found only in ball games with simple and easy controls!

title: Infernal Cave
description: A 2D dot action game created by students. Aim for the goal without being discouraged by traps and gimmicks!

title: Find Matt's Cats
description: A scavenger-hunt adventure that spans 80 hand-crafted levels, including beautiful holiday destinations and fantasy themes. Look in buildings, detonate bombs, unlock treasure chests, dig for secrets, and more! Every item is clickable as you search for Hidden Cats & Dogs!

title: Jump4
description: Jump. This is not a suggestion.

title: Hidden World War II: Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Metro Penguin Eutopia
description: Slaughter penguins and feel like a hero. Seriously—it’s the best job ever.

title: V-Monsters: Digital Farm
description: Step into the thrilling world of V-Monsters Digital Farm, a game that brings the essence of classic Tamagotchis into the modern era. In this vibrant digital universe, players get the opportunity to create, nurture, and evolve their own digital creatures. Customize your monsters with a unique style and collect an amazing variety of creatures.

title: Hidden Breaking Bed: Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Parasomnum
description: Minimalist horror experience that offers 25-90 minutes of suspenseful gameplay as you try to escape from this unnerving reality.

title: Punch the Garden
description: Punch the Garden is a 2D action roguelike where you play as a young moustache that is entering a park. Within said park, you battle the merry residents and stop their cheerful dances! Get stronger as you progress and become a better moustache!

title: Cosmic Armada
description: A fleet combat and space exploration game. Pilot ships, control a fleet, build and upgrade colonies, mine resources, craft items, trade, upgrade your ships and fleet, carry out missions, board ships, destroy ships and get revenge on the empire that conquered your home planet.

title: Mayhem’s Adventure
description: The Mini 8-bit game! With lots of secrets...

title: Underrail: Heavy Duty
description: This DLC adds three new weapon types - grenade launchers, machine guns and miniguns, as well as a special high-level side mission that will challenge even the most hardcore Underrail veterans.

title: Exploration: Light
description: Experience large space ship battles. Uncover the secrets of the mysterious alien race. Upgrade your ship or even start a fleet. Survive

title: Happy! The Hippo
description: Welcome to Happy! the Hippo, a previously lost 3D platformer collectathon, now brought to life on modern hardware. Roll, bounce, and dive through a handful of enchanting worlds, tackling quests, rescuing frogs, and embracing the vintage charm of early 2000s gaming.

title: The Path to Memento Mori
description: In 'The Path to Memento Mori,' players explore eerie mazes in a 4-player horror puzzle game, uncovering buried family secrets and facing relentless monsters. Teamwork and puzzle-solving are essential to unveil the haunting truth.

title: Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic
description: A first-person, turn-based journey into the occult. Who will stand with Aleister at the end of days?

title: Arthur's Birthday
description: Arthur's Birthday is adapted from the original storybook into an interactive animated adventure! Interact with the pictures and discover hidden scenes. Many surprising encounters await with your favorite Arthur storybook characters!

title: GeminiFlame: Alpha Dragon
description: You are the one!! Who came to this RPG world during a time of conflict among the local people. You have 4 character to take care and fight with the dragon and more?. What is happen? And What's wrong with them? Adventure to this world and discover it for yourself!!

title: Hide for Cat: All for the Best
description: A talented cat hides "floors and walls" This game is a 2D puzzle action game where you aim to clear the world in a world where the terrain changes exactly as you see it by hiding floors and walls so that they are no longer visible.

title: Arthur's Teacher Trouble
description: Explore Marc Brown's "Arthur’s Teacher Trouble" in an interactive animated adventure. Join Arthur as he tackles homework, spelling quizzes, and school competitions. Relive this cherished classic with animations, voice narration, and hidden bonuses.

title: YetiFree
description: YetiFree is a retro role reversal of the 90's classic SkiFree. Smash, slam, and blast your way down the slopes to rack up the highest score. The Yeti must feed!

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 4
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Broad Sword
description:
Broad Sword is a formation based third-person tactical hack and slash game where you lead formations of troops to face off against a variety of factions in a fantasy realm. Engage in class-based combat as you defeat your foes in conquest, siege and campaign modes.

Fight from a ground level view of large fantasy battles, command your formation of troops, and lead your army through hack-and-slash encounters to claim ultimate victory! Go head to head in objective based conquest mode. Test your defensive skills in a wave based survival mode, or employ grand strategy in a campaign mode. Varied troop types offer distinct fighting styles and weapons, allowing for diverse playstyles and tactics. Will you anchor a battle line with spearmen, shatter defenses with mighty great swords, or rain arrows upon your enemies?

title: Metal Casket
description: Single player simple horror game, inspired by "Iron Lung"

title: AcShooting
description: A 2D action and shooting game created by students. The key is the shape of the main character!

title: Summoners Defense
description: The game features an array of summoning spells, each with distinct strengths and weaknesses. From nimble archers and mighty golems to elemental spirits. As you progress, you'll unlock new spells and master advanced summoning techniques, increasing your arsenal of defenders.

title: Tiny Breakers Camp
description: It is time for true heroes to stop an evil invasion that is spreading across our land. Face enemies from the deepest caves and dungeons in an engaging brick-breaker style of fight. Bring peace and justice to your homeland yet again.

title: The Mouse Game
description: Run from robot vacuums, dodge electric wires and mouse traps, and avoid flames and lasers to secure the cheese! Can you beat all 35 levels of this hardcore maze game?

title: Polygon Fantasy Battle Simulator
description: Welcome to Polygon Fantasy Battle Simulator, the most colorful medieval fantasy battle simulator in existence! Throw tens of thousands of soldiers into battle, enjoy the show, or take direct control of one of them to prove your valor!

title: Atomic Hazard
description: Atomic Hazard is a action puzle platformer. Take advantage of your environment in physics-based movement and combat.

title: Adventurer's Gambit: Dungeons of Fortune
description:
Adventurer's Gambit: Dungeons of Fortune is a fantasy roguelite extraction RPG for PC in which players enter unstable portal dungeons, fight through third-person action encounters, build power during the run, and extract before losing what they found. Each session is built around high-stakes decisions: push deeper for better rewards, or leave early and secure the loot.

Players shape their build as the run unfolds through gear, abilities found during exploration, and stat upgrades discovered in the dungeon. Each player begins with a guaranteed starting ability choice on spawn, while additional abilities can drop from monsters, chests, and destructible objects. Stat upgrades are also found through dungeon interaction, including destructibles such as crates and barrels. The system supports 6 active abilities and 12 passive abilities, letting players assemble aggressive, defensive, utility, or hybrid playstyles from run to run. Up to three players can enter together, creating room for cooperation, tension, and shifting priorities around survival and extraction.

title: Zombie Death Day
description: Battle for survival against zombie hordes. This FPS puts you at the frontline of the battle to repel the hordes, and save the human race. Lead the fight by destroying the infected.

title: Favela Zombie Shooter
description: Favela Zombie Shooter is a wave-based action shooter, where you have to defeat different types of zombies in a Brazilian Favela. Survive zombie waves, earn money and get better weapons to survive longer!

title: Deep Space Tavern
description: Deep Space Tavern is a playful fusion of management and clicker gameplay. Design your tavern, attract patrons from across the system, and master the art of keeping them happy and safe. Experience the joy of management without all the hassle!

title: Windwalker
description: Windwalker is a 3d turn-based RPG where players collect loot from combat and other encounters to cleanse the plague stirring in the fantastical world of Qubis. Fight against unique monsters with thousands of unique items and acquire powerful pets to fight alongside you.

title: Age
description: This is a happy game.

title: The Amnesiac: Final Chapter
description: "The Amnesiac:Final Chapter" is a story-based text game set in a low-magic world. In a crumbling baron's castle, a banquet takes an unexpected turn with the baron's death and everyone's amnesia. Players choose from 10 amnesiacs to uncover their individual stories.

title: Tokeis
description: Tokeis is a board-like real-time city builder about growing your town from a tiny tile to a hexagonal empire. Collect tokens, manage resources, reorganize inefficiencies, and fortify your economy. Handle the harsh weather and defend against raiders trying to steal your riches!

title: Run Ran! Side Scrollers
description: Random stage generation. The length of the stages can be freely determined. You can freely decide the length of each stage, so you can play quickly in your spare time or take your time. Enjoy always fresh play and challenge your own limits in Time Attack.

title: Arthur's Reading Race
description: Arthur’s Reading Race centers around everyone’s favorite Aardvark. Arthur is trying to teach his little sister, D.W, to read. However, she insists that she already knows how!

title: Project Warlock: Lost Chapters
description: Next Chapter of Project Warlock is here. A retro fps shooter that honors the legacy of classic shooters like Doom, Wolfenstein and Hexen picks up the story of Warlock mixing frantic gunplay, with powerful magic spells and perks and skills based character customisation.

title: Bumpkin and Sprout
description: Embark on an unforgettable 3D platformer adventure in "Bumpkin & Sprout," where action, humor, and environmental awareness unite! Join these two whimsical mushrooms on a mission to save not only themselves but also Nature herself from the clutches of the nefarious Pollution Spirit.

title: Beta Max
description: Use four-dimensional thinking to manipulate time and navigate through this mind bending retro inspired realm. Solve puzzles to help Max find his way home in this atmospheric first-person puzzle platformer.

title: Blocks and Bones
description: Blocks and Bones is a zombie wave shooter with endless hordes of the undead in custom maps built by players. Build mode is the sandbox side of the game where you build levels from blocks and publish them online in-game so other players can survive the apocalypse inside your chilling creations.

title: Arthur's Computer Adventure
description: Explore Marc Brown’s classic "Arthur’s Computer Adventure"! Arthur and his friends bring the story alive one word at a time, fully animated and voiced. Increase the challenge and the fun with an interactive at-your-own-pace option with lots of bonuses and secrets to discover!

title: Living Dolls Rebirth Alpha
description: Welcome in this fantasy Adult world. Enjoy and explore this world and its inhabitants freely! This open world for PC will blow your mind!

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2024
description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Football 2024 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite football team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents right down to creating and calling your own plays to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

title: Hell Hunter: Anti-Nomen
description: A story driven adventure horror audiogame in which you have to interact with room elements, survive to environment gimmicks and fight real time battles based only on stereo audio. Learn the enemy patterns and hear where the attacks come from to dodge their attacks in time and then attack.

title: The Soul of Too Birds Game
description: Destroy all art. Free the soul.

title: Marchenkanna
description: A free RPG that lets you travel through a world with a picture book-like ambience. The story takes place in a peaceful world where wizards live. In battle scenes, a unique system allows you to specify the shape of attacks according to the enemy's position. Fun for everyone from beginners to gamers!

title: Incaved Runner
description: Escape a concealed, mutated monster disrupting your scavenging. Master the running, jumping, swinging, shooting and combining upgrades to end up becoming the poweful beast you initially feared, turning the cave system from a nightmarish hollow into a playground.

title: The Wicked Souls
description: The Wicked Souls is a Metroidvania with a strong focus on an exciting and imaginative story. Explore the mysterious tower in the afterlife with the postman Bones and his mischievous companion Dietrich and uncover its secrets.

title: Astral Party
description: 'Astral Party' is a party game supports online multiplayer with up to 4 players. Choose your favorite character, utilize their skills and cards to fight against your friends. A myriad of events lends an air of unpredictability to the game. Come on, join the 'friend' journey with your buddies!

title: Pixel Piracy Online
description: Pirate MMO RPG that has it all. You will play alone or with friends any way you want: build the world, gather resources, farm, socialize, pillage, level up, min-max, loot, craft, survive, etc. One big dynamic, persistent world.

title: Forwards
description: An experiential linear narrative walking sim.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 7 - Rise of the Darkness
description: Get ready for the spookiest event of the year, as Overwatch 2 transforms into a haunted battleground. Halloween Terror is back with your favorite game modes - Junkenstein's Revenge and Wrath of the Bride and a new Events Shop to spend Overwatch Credits on limited-time skins, emotes, and highlight intros.

title: Express Hero
description:
Express Hero is a fun and engaging game that will test your problem-solving and time-management skill

Get ready to embark on the ultimate transportation adventure! In Express Hero, your goal is to navigate an intricate network of taxis, trains, and airplanes to reach your destination as quickly as possible. With each level, the challenge increases as roads, tracks, and air routes twist and turn, making it tricky to figure out the fastest way to travel. Can you master the maze of transportation and become the ultimate Express Hero?

title: Furry Necromancer
description: You died, but I got good news and bad news for you. The good news - you have been resurrected, the bad news - you have been resurrected by a necromancer who has some "special" plans for you (although it might not be "bad news" at all...)

title: Laruaville 9
description: Use your Match 3 skills to build an empire! As usually there are also some optional bonus game and a town to build!

title: Gunslinger Duel
description: Engage in turn-based quick draw battles against increasingly formidable opponents. Choose your next move, then in third person, draw and fire before your opponent does! An arcade-style strategy game in the Wild West. Are you a real gunslinger survivor, or another yellow-belly about to hit the dirt?

title: Many Eyed
description: These dark and desolate woods appear abandoned. Can you still hear the whispers of its missing hikers? They ache for you to investigate.

title: Rich Everyone
description: The game simulates the life restoration of ancient Chinese farmers in scientific farming, vegetable planting, animal husbandry, and various handicraft workshops. Free simulation construction.

title: Intravenous 2
description: Intravenous 2 is the ultimate blend of tactical gameplay and immersive storytelling. Will you embrace the shadows or confront your foes head-on? The choice is yours. Experience a new era of tactical stealth action. Save lives. Uncover secrets. Take vengeance.

title: Partizan
description: Partizan is a brutal and satisfying action-oriented immersive sim set in a brutalist dystopia ruled by a oppressive regime. Rip and tear through militias, bureaucrats and gunked up quarantine zones until the world knows your name.

title: Jennifer's Fragments
description: Jennifer is trying to piece together her fragmented life amidst the games of her mind. Help Jennifer piece together her memories in dark, uncanny and mysterious places. Get ready for a journey of terrible secrets and traumas.

title: Panzer Corps 2: Axis Operations - 1946
description: It is said that every end is a new beginning. And while we all know the Second World War ended in 1945, Panzer Corps 2 is making the unprecedented leap to continue the Axis Operations with one final, grand installment.

title: Delicious: Cooking and Romance
description: Join Emily & her family in a new Delicious Restaurant and Time Management game.

title: The Legend of Ogorets 3: Kikimora
description: An interactive visual novel with choices, lore, and endgames. Reader beware.

title: Hot Noon
description: A local-coop party game that's all about the classical western stand-off. Draw faster than your opponents and prepare to catch their incoming bullets mid-air! Hot Noon is fast-paced and filled with tension. Are you skilled enough to outsmart your friends in this wits-filled stand-off?

title: 100 Rounds
description: A die and retry with 100 levels, simple gameplay and hours of rage quit.

title: Quiz Game Night
description: Quiz Game Night is a multiplayer trivia game for up to 10 players. Grab your friends, get any player-created pack from workshop and have a great game night!

title: Mononoke no Kuni
description: Through free village building and boat trips, this 3D open-world action game adds the fun of discovering and exploring unknown islands, as well as the tension and strategy of roguelite dungeon crawling!

title: GunDeck 100
description: GunDeck 100 is a lightning-fast twin-stick shooter where you’ll build your arsenal from randomly-dealt cards. Weapons fire in a rainbow of elements with unique effects. Dart and dodge to survive the fireworks unleashed against you, and retaliate with your own display! Can you survive to wave 100?

title: Prezzies
description: A colorful retro style matching game. Squash Prezzies and match splatter colors before time runs out.

title: Siege Showdown
description: "Siege Showdown" is an exciting strategy game that will give you the opportunity to defend a majestic fortress and fight with the troops of your opponents in a battle for power and territory. An exciting fantasy era world awaits you, where magic and powerful warriors merge in one battle.

title: Tulip
description: You are a very sad bunny. You cannot stop crying. You might have to drink something gross. You are Tulip. Wander through a storybook countryside, gather ingredients for a strange brew, and get to know your adorable animal neighbors in an odd quest to alleviate your incurable sadness.

title: No Recollection
description: A mystery visual novel following a boy who awoke in a strange building, with no recollection of where he is, how he arrived, why he's here, or how to leave. Discover the answers to these mysteries as you search for a way out. Meet a small but colorful cast in your journey, and escape together!

title: Dreaminal
description: Dreaminal is a 1-4 players surreal backrooms experience. Traverse through immersive and unique backrooms levels, experience anomalies, interact and solve puzzles while hiding from unknown entities in order to escape from the mysterious world of The Backrooms .

title: PastoralPainting
description: PastoralPainting is a casual simulation, placement of hang-up + oil painting style healing system placement game. The breeze is quiet and the sun is fine! Let's get away from the hustle and bustle and enjoy a moment of idyllic beauty in the game.

title: Laruaville 8
description: Play Match 3 levels and build the town to turn anything into gold!

title: Dark Mirror
description: "Dark Mirror" provides a visually stunning and atmospheric experience. The dark and gloomy environments attract players to a deep world of mystery, while the sound design of the game also increases the tension and excitement.

title: Star Racer
description: Compete to be the first, or only, racer to finish and become the fastest in the galaxy. Welcome to Star Racer! Get ready for a journey through time and space, where speed, skill, and sheer radness will determine the ultimate racer. Star Racer awaits - buckle up for the retro ride of a lifetime!

title: ColorCoordination
description: ColorCoordination is a puzzle game where you match colored blocks and spaces by moving them in unison. Explore deep, philosophical topics with your AI Assistant "CoCo" and discover more about its purpose - all while solving a myriad of colorful brainteasers!

title: Sapiens Craft Puzzle
description: Begin as a small stone age tribe. End as a global super power in a future age. Craft your way through history!

title: Infected: Super Soldier Project
description: A police officer goes to investigate an old house where he hears reports of noises and screams, a team was sent before him and they didn't give any feedback, something macabre awaits this police officer.

title: Taking Root: Academic Version
description: Join a stone creature and its loyal plant companion in an emotional journey to escape their once-pristine home, now suffocated by a concrete metropolis. Solve mind-bending puzzles by shifting perspectives as they flee together and find a new sanctuary to forever take root!

title: Interstellar Impact
description: Stylized single player adventure game. Explore the vastness of space, collide with smaller objects, avoid larger objects, grow until you explode and become a black hole and set the fastest time possible.

title: Ultimate Solitaire Collection
description: Over 300 game variants await, from classics favorites like Klondike to exclusive original solitaire creations. Customize your solitaire adventure with card sets, backgrounds, and more. Journey through diverse locations, unlocking treasures along the way. Join now and conquer the world of solitaire!

title: Starheim
description: Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting MMO set in a universe based on Norse mythology. Materials collected by destroying AI ships, other players, and mining asteroids can be used to upgrade your ship, with dozens of models to choose from on your journey from a small fighter to a dreadnought.

title: Zombie Girl
description: This is an extremely thrilling and challenging third-person shooter. If you like shooting games and Zombie Crisis, then this game must not be missed! It will give you an immersive gaming experience, immersing you in a world full of danger and mystery.

title: UnderOneRoof
description: This is a 10 minute short story game adapted from real events. Players will follow the perspective of the female protagonist, click on items or move through the prompts of the scene and tags, and experience this unexpected family upheaval.

title: Sausage vs. Vegetable
description: Sausage vs. Vegetable is a run-based roguelike with bullet heaven elements, following a band of outcast sausages to level up, loot, and fight their way to uncover the truths behind the vegetable invasion.

title: The Consumist Journey
description: The Consumist Journey is a surreal exploration game where you play as a strange character on a quest to explore the capitalist and consumerist paradigms of modern society. Navigate through bizarre and nonsensical environments, solve puzzles, and interact with eccentric characters.

title: Bardic: Quest for Love
description: Having just arrived in the great port city of Deepharbor, humble bards Edmond and Edna are suddenly tasked with running a Tavern. Recruit fellow adventuring heroes, manage your tavern, and possibly find romance? This is your Quest for Love!

title: Protocole: Hedera
description: You embody Hedera, a young test subject imprisoned in an inhumane experiment... Escape, free your fellow test subjects, use logic, draw on your empathy, control your emotions, and above all, use your psychic powers in this completely crazy action game!

title: It Happened Here: Beacon of Truth - Collector's Edition
description: Dive into a cold case of murder and betrayal at a lighthouse!

title: He Escaped
description: A horror roguelike that can be played solo or with up to 4 players locally and online. Find the hidden keys in randomly generated rooms and escape before the time runs out or you find something else...

title: Tanked Out!
description: A local multiplayer tank showdown with multiple maps modes and customization that effects how you play.

title: Underground Defense Force: Sword and Sorcery and Swarm of Insects
description: Swarms of giant insects has appeared in the underground world "Agartha"! Defeat swarms of mutated insect monsters with multicast weapons/spells by your own party of customized characters! This is a casual SLG (SRPG) with a focus on exhilaration and hack-and-slash system.

title: The Leak
description: Wake up, watch tv, make a cup of cofffee and try to bear your own meaningless existence.

title: Escape from Death
description: "Escape from Death" is a 256,000-word interactive horror adventure novel by Tova Näslund. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

title: Portal Puzzle
description: Sand flows and portals glow in this one-of-a-kind puzzle adventure

title: Fallen Seeds
description: As Evod, a special agent of the Earth Empire, you embark on a thrilling adventure to the enigmatic planet of Ulthar, inhabited by the zoomorphic tribe of the Flock, a biotechnological extraterrestrial civilization. Your mission is to unravel an ancient mystery that holds the key to your destiny.

title: Nudel Tag
description: In Nudel Tag, challenge your friends to get the most tips, in a crazy ramen restaurant ! Find up to 4 controllers, to have the most fun, and see who is the best waiter in the house !

title: Treasure Hunt Girl
description: This is a game to find hidden objects, in this cartoon world, there are many hidden props in the world, you need to find a handful of them.

title: DCop
description: Step into the gritty world of law enforcement in DCOP, a groundbreaking full motion video (FMV) police simulator that thrusts players into the heart-pounding action of a newly graduated police officer facing off against a ruthless criminal syndicate.

title: Die, Pablo!
description: The world famous chef Louis is mad! He animates all sorts of inanimate objects to attack the restaurant critic Pablo for an alleged bad review of his restaurant. Luckily, Pablo likes playing tower defense games and knows exactly how to defend himself!

title: Mirrorscape
description: Mirrorscape is bringing the table back to virtual tabletops! Play around the table or around the world using authentic 3D terrain, miniatures, and environmental effects from top companies you know and love. Cross-play on iOS and Android devices using the magic of augmented reality!

title: Daily Thread: The Sewing of Discontent
description: Henrietta is a seamstress in early industrial Manchester, enjoying Victorian age manufactory work. Relive your favorite moments from Dickens, Zola, and Marx, learn about the history of working conditions and worker rights and how they got where they are today, and think of where they could still go!

title: Pirates Odyssey
description: Ahoy, mateys! We are marooned on a series of islands and need to find a way home. Help us explore the environment, build camps and find glorious booty. Join us on an island hopping adventure full of parrot wisdom, pirate mayhem and puzzle glory! Arrr!

title: Singularium
description: Singularium is a High-Speed first person movement game where you create black holes to pull yourself around. Use the movement mechanics to their fullest and beat the levels as fast as possible!

title: Sea of Brave: Aidan Adventure
description: Sea of Brave - Aidan Adventure is an action-adventure platform game, explore the different levels of Figon Island to discover its mysteries, find treasures, challenges and new skills. Confront and defeat Captain Skull's fearsome pirate crew that has enslaved the island.

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 5
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Butterflies
description: I paid artists to hide butterflies and flowers in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Reconnoitre
description: Unending nightfall has swept across the forest, sending all the animals fleeing from monstrous shapes in the dark! Collect and use charms and glyphs of power to make your way through the forest, reconnect villages and help towns-critters as you work to solve the cause of the nightfall.

title: Everbee
description: This is a game about managing a beehive. Collect resources from flowers to raise bees and expand the hive!

title: I Commissioned Some Frogs 2
description: I paid more artists to hide frogs and flies in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Gravity Cab
description: Gravity Cab is a multi-platform 3D action-adventure-puzzler in which players take on the role of a flying taxi driver, transporting passengers and navigating challenging environments influenced by physics.

title: Infection Crisis: Fight For Life
description: Welcome to Infection Crisis : Fight for life. This is without a budget survival game made by a single developer. A zombie apocalypse has happened in your country. Player must survive on this road.

title: Nested Lands
description: A ruthless settlement-survival RPG in a post-plague medieval world full of cruelty and despair. Gather survivors, build a settlement, craft, master your skills, survive, and endure alone or in online co-op.

title: Kwark
description: Kwark is a single player game about a creature that has to go through levels and then something impossible happens at the end! The game can be both from 1 person and from 3!

title: I Commissioned Some Bees 13
description: I paid more artists to hide bees in 6 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Spooky.

title: Two Moon: Space Rabbit
description: I didn't know what you'd like, so I brought six weapons from Earth. The items are as similar to those on Earth as possible. So will you grow stronger for me, or will you defeat me? Whatever you choose, it will play out as I expect.

title: Aethus
description: Explore a vast underground world to mine, refine and craft hundreds of items, then build up your modular surface Outpost to farm hydroponic crops, prospect for gems and automate your resource-gathering in this sci-fi survival-crafter where the story always provides a reason to dig deeper.

title: Peace Breaker
description: Simplistic mecha battling PC game.

title: Spell Slingin' Tower Defense
description: A game that combines the fun of custom spellcrafting with the monotony of a tower defense! Protect your hut with a vast arsenal of spells that you put into varyingly effective combinations.

title: Oberak
description: Oberak is a third-person Action Adventure RPG and Social School Sim mash-up, set in a Sci-Fantasy world with hip-hop influences. As a powerful Qi warrior, nurture your students, master skills from martial arts to crafting, and defend Ti-an from the deadly rogue clans that are on the rise.

title: Space Crab VS
description: Battle against other crabs with time tested arcade action! Form galactic partnerships and starlight rivalries in the story mode, or battle against other players locally with more than 20 unlockable crabs- some strange, some powerful.

title: Halloween Trouble 5
description: Halloween Trouble 5 is a Match 3 game that invites you to enter a spine-tingling world of mystery and excitement. Explore the haunted manor, solve eerie puzzles, and rescue your friends in this captivating match-3 adventure.

title: Marsh
description: Face-off against wacky, cartoony, brought to life objects in this 2D platforming shooter! Challenge your cute squishy self to get the highest of scores, up the difficulties and find the many secrets.

title: Spaceport Trading Company
description: Players take on the role of a spacefaring merchant in a galaxy filled with diverse planets, each with its own economy, resources, and challenges. Amass wealth and reputation by trading goods, negotiating with factions, and navigating the intricacies of interstellar commerce.

title: Stop Burying Me Alive, Beautiful!
description: You wake up to your girlfriend burying you alive, and she won’t be convinced that you aren’t actually dead- one of several problems, it turns out, as you find yourself dealing with rats trying to take a few early bites out of you! And just who is the girl talking to you from underground?

title: Gateworlds
description: Gateworlds is a survival colony sim set in a wilderness shaped by five fickle gods. You begin with a small band of villagers, stranded on a hostile world. Lead your people as they survive, build, craft, hunt, explore, and vie for the favour of the gods. Journey across floating worlds connected by mystical portals, each world bearing the influence of a god’s power.

title: Puma: The Cat
description: Play as Puma, a cat on a quest to find her friend Mia. Explore challenging maps and confront enemies in this thrilling 2D pixel art platform game.

title: Boogeyman 3
description: Carrying a flashlight and water pistol, you must navigate a haunting bedroom to survive each nightmarish encounter. Utilise strategic defence, resource management, and cunning tactics to survive each night.

title: Pickleball Smash
description: Unleash Your Pickleball Fever! Get ready to serve, dink, and smash your way to victory in the thrilling world of Pickleball Smash. Compete across multiple venues, jump into challenging minigames, and play in competitive tournaments to become the best of the best.

title: Kingdom of Fallen: The Last Stand
description: Kingdom of Fallen is inspired by survival and souls-like games. Your mission is to gather clues of your missing daughter, using your own way to defeat fearsome bosses, through crafting or fighting, to reveal the secrets, and get out of this cursed kingdom.

title: Castle Master TD
description: Fortify, Strategize, and Conquer in our dynamic tower defense game. As master of your own castle, you’ll build powerful structures, plan strategic defences, and engage in epic battles against relentless enemies. Each choice you make shapes your kingdom’s destiny.

title: Bug Blazer
description: An Incremental idler/clicker mix with a variety of weapons and traps to achieve your goals. No prestige, and ever increasing progress, watch the numbers get ever larger to the point where the fabric of reality breaks down.

title: Idle Exorcism Hero
description: This is an idle turn-based combat game. While obtaining the best equipment, it doesn’t require too many operations.

title: + Fence
description: Fence is a Crime/Trading RPG set in The Bronx during the early 1990’s. You play as Jimmy, a recently expelled high schooler that’s trying to make ends meet while his alcoholic mother drinks her life away.

title: Lizard Slayer
description: A pixelated adventure RPG set in Slavic mythology. The protagonist is Vodkodav, a legendary warrior who must stop an invasion of ancient lizards who are corrupting nature and stealing souls. The player will journey through forests, villages, and temples, encountering the Leshy, Kolobok, and Baba Yaga, and battling evil lizard-like creatures. Vodkodav's arsenal includes the finest guns in Rus' and a magical potion that will surely help defeat the evil forces. Shoot the horde of evil lizards, for without you, Vodkodav will never succeed!

title: Forest Jump
description: This Game Is Simple. Reach your destination only by jumping and running.

title: The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot
description: A first-person action game that provides various ways for defeating your foes, whether through weaponry, magic, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking into deadly spikes.

title: Transilio
description: Retro-style frenzy awaits as you dash through demon-filled dungeons in this fast-paced top-down dungeon crawler.

title: Raster
description: Raster is a casual puzzle game about space. Here, you can use a variety of spatial abilities to traverse across diverse terrains, all in search of carrots for the bunny.

title: Macho Spinner
description: Spin into action in the arena as a whirlwind macho, sending all your opponents flying! "Macho Spinner" is a 3D arena combat game. Forge your mightiest macho and claim the championship of the Macho Spinner Cup!

title: Demon Island Massacre
description:
DEMON ISLAND MASSACRE is a hyper-8-bit-action platformer in a similar vein to arcade and 8-bit classics such as Ghosts n Goblins and Castlevania. Josh Baron and the crew at Polyanna Video invite you down a rabbit hole of sprawling colorful landscapes and twisted nightmare realms that bend the boundaries between 8-bit and 64-bit sensibilities. The priestess Flower Momogami must run, jump, and utilize an array of holy weaponry to overcome the demons that lurk every corner during the invasion of Tenryu, in the first chapter of this tale of Japanese-style horror.

Only challenge the road ahead if you dare!

title: War Robots Shooting Simulator
description: Join the epic battle in deep space with War Robots Shooting Simulator! Create your robot hero, determine your strategy, and destroy enemies.

title: Etre
description: Enter an ancient alien mind spiraling toward collapse. Explore shifting inner worlds, unlock new abilities, and battle hostile anomalies in a 3D third-person action adventure. Stabilize the mind to forge a new world or let it awaken as something far more terrifying.

title: Mossy Pixels
description: Destroy the mossy cover to reveal ancient drawings underneath! Watch the mysterious patterns get dissolved pixel-by-pixel and just... relax.

title: Glukhovo
description: Sometimes, regrets come too late. When you're over 40, you start to rethink your life. You remember people and events that completely changed you. I will tell you 7 stories that happened to me in childhood, after which I became a different person.

title: Survive: Forgotten and Abandoned
description: Survive: Forgotten and Abandoned is a first-person survival horror experience. Six months have passed since the outbreak. Haunted by his past, Stanley Bell must find a way to survive between hallucinations and monsters.

title: Maze Quest Master
description: "Embark on a thrilling journey in 'Maze Quest Master.' Conquer intricate mazes, collect coins, and master wall-bound movement. Become the ultimate maze explorer!"

title: Buff Huckem Fully Wrecked
description: A humorous action platformer. Fight through standard enemies and bosses using melee and short ranged combat as you platform through a world based in 90's cartoon style. Upgrade your abilities as you progress to become an unstoppable force of...gas.

title: Occultist Girl Magatsuhi
description: Sprite scaling shooting game, in which you play as a flying onmyouji.

title: Fwog
description: Frogs don't walk, and neither do fwogs! Hop, jump and swing your way through each stage in this unforgiving 2D-platformer. Be prepared to fall again and again and again as you slowly learn what it takes to fwog.

title: Days Of My Life
description: What is human destiny? Do our actions decide much in our fate? What if I told you that life can be lived in different ways? What if you had asked that girl out on a date and your life would have been different? Well, nothing can be returned…

title: Shadow Strikers
description: In a city dominated by underworld organizations, street violence gives way to an unusual pact. "The Shadow Tournament". In Shadowhaven each organization chooses a champion to fight on its behalf, where victories bring power and influence. Get ready.

title: Core Keeper: Shimmering Frontier
description: Explore a glimmering new environment and discover a shining new Solarite ore, taking your Core Keeper experience to the next level with powerful new weapons, armour and equipment. Wield the powerful new Obliteration Ray, a destructive laser drill capable of mining through walls faster than any other equipment in the game, upgrade your gear for the very first time with the build-enhancing Upgrade Station, and take the fight to the Atlantean Worm, a colossal new boss lurking deep below the Sunken Sea.

title: ShotGun Exorcist
description: ShotGun Exorcist is a bloody fast-paced retro FPS inspired by the mid-90s classics that defined the genre. Battle through swarms of demon spawn as you hunt down the son of Satan. Use a variety of both outlandish and realistic weapons to demolish everything that stands in your way.

title: Beastwatch: Meat & Mayhem
description: Beastwatch is a retro-style horror shooter in which you play a security guard working his first night in a slaughterhouse.

title: Layover Lovers
description: An unlikely romantic encounter at a turning point in their lives

title: Candy Mountain Massacre
description: 3D shooter Adobe Shockwave adult swim game.

title: Candy Mountain Massacre 2
description: Violence is best when it's sugar-coated. A fun first-person 3D shooter with weird and funny twists.

title: The American Delta Vengeance Action Blood Force Kill Commando
description: Join and play this C64-funsplatter-pixel-massacre! Made for the fans of Wolfenstein, Doom, Duke Nukem, Shadow Warrior and Redneck Rampage!

title: Kill Commando II
description: Kill Commando II is an old-school first-person shooter.

title: Motocross: The Force
description: Motocross The Force is a motocross game featuring advanced physics simulation. Race against the clock, ride your dirt bike as fast as you can, but not too fast or else you may fall and crash. The racing takes place in large outdoor terrain environments.

title: Project Wingman: Frontline 59
description: Project Wingman: Frontline 59 immerses players in exhilarating aerial combat, putting them in the pilot’s seat of a war-ravaged Earth’s most advanced fighter jets—and challenging them to prove they have what it takes to become a true ace. Pilots can engage in intense dogfights and large-scale ground assaults across a variety of fast-paced, action-packed game modes and missions, and they will discover the pure adrenaline rush of dodging railguns and geothermal weapons, striking against mechanized fortresses, and skimming the ground with gatling guns and wing-mounted rocket launchers.

title: Flotsam Song
description:
Selinuntius, the last siren, has long lived apart from her kin after becoming stranded while looking for Persephone. Despite numerous attempts from the village on the shore to slay her, none have succeeded—her song has always reached those who come near her island eventually.

One day, a girl rows towards Selinuntius's island alone with an oar in injured hands and a smile on her face. What Selinuntius first believed was her effortlessly luring another victim morphs into the realization that the girl, Melos, could never hear her song in the first place—

title: Toraware no Shoujo: Caged Girl
description: Toraware no Shoujo is a freeware horror-adventure game. It follows the story of Ai, a girl caged in the attic of her house by her father, and her attempts to escape.

title: The Bunny Graveyard: Chapter 1 - The Bunny Garden
description: The Bunny Garden is the first of 5 chapters planned for the horror adventure game, The Bunny Graveyard.

title: Red Book
description: Red Book is a RPG Maker horror game. Play as Alice, a girl who took refuge in an old house in the forest when it started to rain. However, something darker seems to be hidden in that house...

title: The Bunny Graveyard: Chapter 2 - Terror in Carrot Town
description:
Terror in Carrot Town is the working title for Chapter 2 of the horror adventure game, The Bunny Graveyard.

Chapter 2 has started development and will follow Skye the Bunny with a different moveset and more gameplay options then the previous chapter. Plans are for the story to get darker but still have wacky moments and fun minigames throughout a more connected world map with a less linear path through the story.

title: AdoraBullet
description:
Join Rae Stellaris in an epic quest through the cosmos in this cutesy, Game Boy-inspired bullet hell. As the daughter of legendary Lunaheim galactic soldiers who died protecting the planet in a fight against Emperor Quack, Rae’s destiny is to destroy Emperor Quack to avenge her parents and keep her home planet Lunaheim safe.

Rae Stellaris is the daughter of Legendary Lunaheim galactic soldiers who lost their lives in a fight trying to defeat Emperor Quack. Following in her parents' footsteps, Rae trained for four years in the galactic bootcamp and earned the rank of Corporal. After her promotion, Rae is demanded for the mission to defeat Emperor Quack alone. Her superiors knew it was a suicide mission, but due to Rae’s tenacity and determined righteousness, they let her go with the fate of Lunaheim in her hands.

Made for GBJam 11.

title: D-List Diva
description: A free comedy point-and-click adventure game about a misanthropic tour manager and a washed-up singer's rider demands

title: Disgaea 7: Vows of the Virtueless - Complete Edition
description:
Includes the following:
- Disgaea 7 game
- Cosmetic Set
- Special Weapons Set
- Starter Support Set
- Season Pass

title: Uncontained
description: Uncontained is a online co-op horror game where players will fight to survive against MUT. Strategies plans as a team and execute accordingly, A Random player will be given control of MUT to seek you out and kill you off one by one

title: Monsters of Mican
description: Welcome to Mican! Explore a hand-crafted series of dungeons in this first person party based RPG (Blobber) inspired by classics such as Might and Magic and Wizardry. Can you put a stop to the monsters' mysterious plan and discover the ancient secrets of the Amalgam Anomaly?

title: Extreme Offroad Racing
description: Extreme Offroad Racing is a FREE all-terrain, off-road monster truck racing game featuring hundreds of race challenges. Get behind the wheel and buckle up for the most addictive and FUN physics-based driving experience!

title: Tempus Irae
description: In Tempus Irae the player travels back in time... to Renaissance Italy. Tempus Irae was created to be a FUN scenario to play, filled with mouth watering eye candy, and plenty of ammo to accomplish the tasks at hand.

title: Yuge
description:
Mararthon: Yuge is a 30-level scenario, plus 225 secret levels for extra gameplay.
Full of inside jokes, procedurally generated levels, and minimalist textures, Mararthon: Yuge combines serious Marathon 2-style combat with an irreverent setting.

title: GalaxiA: Pilot Episode
description:
GalaxiA is a space adventure, inspired by classic Sci-Fi series and Japanese Adventure Games. The Pilot Episode is the first instalment of the episodic saga.

Follow the crew of the FSS Helen Thari to all corners of known space to rebuild civilizations, heal baleful wounds and reconnect with those lost in the dark. Explore a brand new universe and unveil forgotten dangers, new conspiracies and future enemies!

title: Anomaly Collapse
description: Command a squad of adorably fierce warriors in Anomaly Collapse, a turn-based Roguelite strategy game that offers a fresh twist to an old formula! Face off against otherworldly beings and uncover the dark secrets of supernatural calamities. Immerse yourself in a story where every move counts!

title: The Lamplighters League: Nocturne
description: Fight darkness with darkness by adding the mysterious Nocturne to your league, a macabre spectrophysicist marooned in an alternate dimension, who returned forever altered. Nocturne manipulates her body’s electric field to inflict Shock Damage on her enemies while also supercharging her cutting-edge suit to enhance her abilities. Count yourself lucky that this mysterious skirmisher is on your side - now you see her, now you’re dead!

title: D.C.5: Da Capo 5
description:
Kagamijima, an island closest to the sky.

Along with the Lake Mikagami waters that reflects the sky like mirror on it's waters, lies a soaring sakura tree in Kagami Gakuen.

Kujou Souma, who attends Kagami Gakuen.
Yasaka Menoa, his queen-like undesired unseparable childhood friend.
Tokisaka Yukina, big sister figure who is the student council president.
Shirawaka Akari, far-beyond-reach ojousama.
Yasaka Kako, Menoa's younger sister who calls Souma big brother.
Suginami, mysterious well-informed friend.
Together, they live a merry fun school life.

On Kagami Gakuen, stands a curious sakura tree called "Hakari no Sakura". It has the ability to help collect student's consensus on choices. Students choose to wear white or black cape on their uniforms, then Hakari no Sakura aggregates the amount of wearer to choose the majority. The latest choose event (called Hakarigoto), student has to decide whether the next school festival would be a cultural festival or sports festival. They get to promote and win sides on whichever festival they feel is the best to enjoy. It's a natural occurence whenever Hakarigoto happens.

Then one day.
Souma visited Lake Mikagami, there's "another sakura tree" whom has never bloom in so many years, blooms dazzlingly.
Looking up to the sky, along with the blooming petals, a young girl decends.

"Yes, you are....", whispers the mystery girl, Sakuragi Mizuha.

Meetings of the boys and girls, the fate begins to move.

While out-of-season sakura blooms, curtain to young boys and girls story opens.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
description: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS roguelite featuring 100% destructible environments and procedurally-generated caves. Join a team of dwarven Reclaimers tasked with reestablishing control over lost deep mining operations on Hoxxes IV.

title: Boobytales
description: A doujin 1v1 fighting game featuring several animal characters, created with 2D Fighter Maker '95. The version available online is labelled "Test Version +", but is unfinished. Most of the fighters are playable, but some (Byufero, Tarshow & Need) are unfinished.

title: Thrall
description: To be enthralled by love is murder on the soul in this paranormal, point-and-click, otome visual novel.

title: Today is the End of the World
description:
Today is The End of the World.
