title: The Dark Portal
description: A remake/remix of DM6 'The Dark Zone': Quake's stock deathmatch level turned into a large, industrial base-style singleplayer map. The map source is included.

title: The Grim Outpost
description: Large Wizard-/Episode 2-themed fortress.

title: The Epoch Turning
description: Large Wizard map with caverns and a Base bit.

title: Ruins of Mazotac
description: Small green Wizard-textured temple ruins with some ancient machinery. The map source is included.

title: Simplex
description: Large green jungle temple with some puzzles involving ancient machinery. Sort of a sequel to Ruins of Mazotac. The map source is included.

title: Mainframe Mayhem
description: Large mountain base. It comes with a custom skybox and a couple of additional props. The map source is included.

title: Biome: Mr. Self Destruct
description: Industrial-themed 1024³ level with a lava-flooded foundry, a humid cave system and an icy outside area; originally started for the Xmas Jam 2019. It uses custom textures from various sources and comes with a new skybox. The map source is included.

title: Waldsterben
description: A medium-to-large sized pine forest / base map for Copper (Not included) with a mix of custom textures and a few id1 texture mashups. Map source is included.

title: The Mountains of Insanity
description: Large level with a secret military research base in the mountains built on top of a runic/metal dungeon. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a few modified models and a custom skybox. The map and QC sources are included.

title: Pain in the Arch
description: Medium-sized underground ruins in Knave style with many tight spaces and initially limited supplies. The map source is included.

title: Down the Gutter
description: Around medium-sized cistern/sewer level. The map source is included.

title: Rubicondom
description: Large Rubicon-style industrial base. A chain map by NotoriousRay, RPG, PuLSaR, Zwiffle, and distrans.

title: A Quick Trip to the Old World
description: Small 768*768 speedmap

title: The Battery
description: Medium-sized military base with an artillery battery. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

title: Forgotten Fortress
description: Large Wizard-textured castle.

title: Greymoor
description: Large medieval castle with several nightly courtyards. It runs on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a few custom models, sounds, a skybox and a music track. The map and qc sources are included.

title: Concrete Meltdown
description: Medium / large base map with lots of lava. Built on progs_dump 3.0 (already included). Custom music is "Scratch My Surface" by Verbum Mentis. Map source is included.

title: The Rust Forge
description: Medium / large runic base map with "void vibes", built on progs_dump 3.0 (already included). Some sounds from Arcane Dimensions, custom music "Yss Éskiuth" by Immorpher. Map source is included.

title: Chthonic Deities
description: Large Knave-textured underground lava fortress. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a few new models, sounds, and a custom music track. The map and qc sources are included.

title: Halls of the Void
description: Medium-sized metal cathedral in the void. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a custom music track. The map source is included.

title: The Edge of Sanity
description: Medium to large abstract metal/industrial-ish level floating in the void. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with a couple of new models and sounds. The map and qc sources are included.

title: Brick Red
description: Medium-sized terracotta/red brick castle based on the Progs_dump mod (included). Comes with a custom skybox and a few new sounds/models. The map and QC sources are included.

title: The Darkstone Halls
description: Large metal/runic fortress. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

title: The Underkeep
description: Large white brick/medieval fortress. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

title: Ancient
description: Ancient is a third person exploration action-adventure game with shooting mechanics

title: Blood Colored Rust
description: Medium-sized dark, orange industrial/military base map using modified idbase textures. Comes with a custom skybox. The map source is included.

title: Gloomier Keep
description: Knave-style remix/remake of E1M5 / Gloom Keep.

title: Red 777
description: Large interconnected red Knave-style castle with excellent construction and an insane number of secrets.

title: I Pity Thee Not
description: Large Metal/ruinic map with a fairly open layout / progression and attention to detail.

title: Skinny Norris
description: "A large tower-like Quoth single player map with an unusual texture theme and independent puzzles/traps routes," originally started for the Vertical Competition (=768*768 base with unlimited vertical height, no player teleportation).

title: Bastion of the Underworld
description: Q3stone/metal styled fortress of epic scale, with a few new monsters in lots of horde combat (about 300 monsters in total) and othe custom gameplay additions.

title: Kelluva Linna
description: Large floating castle using Daiktana E3 textures. Based on an unfinished map for a canceled Nehahra expansion episode from 2005. Comes with a custom skybox.

title: Concentric Devastation
description: Large, professionally constructed mountain base with Q2MP1 textures and some custom monsters.

title: Dead Memories
description: Medium-sized idbase map with many crates and a critical slipgate malfunction.

title: The Isolation
description: Large fortress with four differently-colored/textured areas around a Minecraft-styled courtyard.

title: Mayan
description: Mayan / 4 SP maps / Artistical, Breezeep, JCR, negke impersonating Shambler

title: Ascending & Descending
description: Small medieval puzzle map based on the work of M.C. Escher. Gameplay focuses on finding keys and following hints to discover secret areas, which may prove frustrating for some players. The map source is included.

title: Bad Dark Cistern
description: Medium-sized brick/cistern-themed level for single player and deathmatch, based on Quake's stock levels DM5 and DM6, with an underwater DM4 below. The GPL map source is included.

title: Escape from Actaltraz
description: Medium sized based map, escape from prison theme.

title: Runic Recycling
description: Medium-sized metal/runic style level with classic gameplay, a built-in skill-selection room and an additional alternative game mode.

title: Red Slammer
description: Medium-sized terracotta style map with classic gameplay, a built-in skill selection room and an additional alternative game mode.

title: Lower Forecourt
description: A big, open, twisted, confusing, hard and unconventional coagula map. Sweet id texturing and a lot of fresh gameplay ideas. Can be frustating.

title: Down the Ratbit Hole
description: Medium sized medieval library map using Knave textures - made for the SM100 turtlemap event.

title: LazyTown: Festival
description: LazyTown: Festival is an edutainment game based on the TV show LazyTown

title: Legendary Creatures 2
description: Sequel to the acclaimed Legendary Creatures, created by HideChara, and a fun treat combining both roguelike and auto-battler gameplay. Recruit and evolve a large array of troops, creatures, and an arsenal of weapons, to defeat the demon lord spreading corruption across the land.

title: Slay the Minotaur
description: Slay the Minotaur is a challenging roguelike dungeon crawler set in ancient Greece. Survive the onslaught of the labyrinth. Upgrade your skills, earn ranks, and face the Minotaur in the ultimate game of cat and mouse!

title: Roll Me Home
description: Roll the character with the rudder and jump. As usual, it's a space bar It has simple manipulation, but it's not going to be an easy challenge Understand the physics of things and explore the silhouette.

title: Dragon of Saiyu
description: Dragon of Saiyu retells the classic tale of Journey To The West in Retro 2D platformer style . Play as the young aspiring monk, Sanzang, and defeat strong foes in his quest of attaining the legendary scrolls from the Buddha of far west.

title: The Unlife of Gorlak
description: The Unlife of Gorlak is an RPG Where you play as a dragon who died but got better (or is at least trying to). You have been resurrected as a skeletal dragon by a necromancer. As you returned to the living world you felt the presence of the hero who had slain you has given chase. You have one month to prepare for his arrival so you can tell him how you really feel about him!

title: Correction
description:
The game is a training simulator for shooting. Teaches players the correct aim.

The game has game modes in which there is a battle between players, success points, and music drops. All this in correction

title: Tekken 8: Premium Collector's Edition
description:
The Premium Collector's Edition Includes:
• TEKKEN 8
• Playable Character Year 1 Pass
• Character Costume: Gold Suit Pack
• Avatar Costume (x32)
• Avatar-Skins (x3)
• Burning chain metal plate
• Corporation stickers
• Premium Box
• Special Face-Off Steelbook
• Glossy Collectible Cards (x8)
• Leroy Smith Metal Ring with Velvet Pouch
• Arcade Token
• Exclusive Jin Electrified Figurine (25cm)

title: Head Over Heels: Monster Girl Dating Sim
description: A dullahan goes to a speed-dating event: Will she fall head over heels or trip up on her chances for love?

title: Half-Life 2: MMod - Half-Life 2: Episode One
description:
This mod allows Half-Life 2: Episode One to be run under MMod.

The goal of Half-Life 2: MMod is to enhance and expand gunplay, combat mechanics and the immersion factor by giving the Player more options and combat opportunities as well as refine how the Player handles his arsenal. Half-Life 2: MMod also offers minor AI enhancements, extended abilities for combine soldiers ( dynamic jumping, firing smg1 underbarrel grenades, shotgunner double blast, etc. ), multiple bug fixes, enhanced visuals, VFX re-design, sound redesign and much much more, while keeping nearly every new feature in the mod totally optional.

title: Half-Life 2: MMod - Half-Life 2: Episode Two
description:
This mod allows Episode Two to be run under MMod.

The goal of Half-Life 2: MMod is to enhance and expand gunplay, combat mechanics and the immersion factor by giving the Player more options and combat opportunities as well as refine how the Player handles his arsenal. Half-Life 2: MMod also offers minor AI enhancements, extended abilities for combine soldiers ( dynamic jumping, firing smg1 underbarrel grenades, shotgunner double blast, etc. ), multiple bug fixes, enhanced visuals, VFX re-design, sound redesign and much much more, while keeping nearly every new feature in the mod totally optional.

title: Star Wars: Movie Battles II
description:
Movie Battles II is a fast-paced, action packed mod for the award winning Jedi Knight Jedi Academy game, that lets players play and fight in the most iconic battles seen throughout the entire saga!
Choose from a range of 12 distinct classes, each with their own strengths, weapons, and abilities. Play on over 40 maps from across the Star Wars universe, inspired by scenarios in the movies and legends.

title: Railway: Koko ni Aru Yume
description:
A small port town with mountains on the back and the sea in the front. Main character returns to this town for the first time in 8 years after leaving it because of parents divorce.
Now grandmother invites him to help with the coffee shop "Railway" that got its name due to being set up at an abandoned train locomotive on the outskirts of the town.
Meeting old friends, recovering old memories... it's a place where dreams come true.

title: Hauma: A Detective Noir Story - Prologue
description: Hauma is a deduction visual novel set in Munich. Discover a conspiracy amongst the upper echelons of society alongside former detective Judith, while visiting real locations in a comic-inspired look. This is a free prologue of the full game.

title: Blue-Sky-Blue(s): Sora o Mau Tsubasa
description:
The protagonist's mom passed away 10 years ago and the father-son relationship is a strained one. When poppy's work as a weatherman and new marriage sends them to Hokkaido, the player enters a new school and joins up with a group of student's whose passion is the sky - with the belief that people come from the sky and will eventually return to the sky...

Six girls are available for the romancing including honor student Kasumi Itimatsu, school director's granddaughter Fuuka Mitsuba and assistant teacher Tomomi Shinose.

title: Don't Scream
description:
If you scream, you restart. Don't Scream is an Unreal Engine 5 short horror experience inspired by '90s camcorder found footage. Made by two indie devs. The challenge is simple: explore the mysterious Pineview Forest for 18 minutes without screaming.

Sounds easy, right? But there's a catch. Time only progresses as you move, and you cannot predict the scares. You must calibrate your microphone in-game so that every whimper, jump, or even a minor squeak is registered as a scream, increasing the challenge. With dozens of dynamic scares, each playthrough offers a unique experience.

title: Witcharoo
description: Your life as a cat is turned upside down after being kidnapped by a crazy witch..!

title: Perfect Dark PC Port
description: An unofficial port of the N64 game Perfect Dark to PC using a decompilation of that game.

title: Dorghael Arhlannen
description: Medium-sized ikwhite-themed temple with nice gameplay and a boss-fight.

title: Forgotten Valley
description: Turok-themed levels with custom textures. Comes with a music track and the map source is included.

title: The C.G.L Project
description: Short arena-style map themed and timed to a techno music track.

title: Un Lugar Otro Que El Cielo
description: Large abstract floating ikwhite level. Comes with a new model, sounds, a custom skybox and a music track. The map source is included.

title: The Dreamer's Demesne
description: Medium-sized blue desert castle, made for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+

title: Apinaraivo
description: Large and exessively detailed IKbase level using some SOA entities and the Mega-Enforcer.

title: Arrogant Erratum & The Kuras Stronghold
description: Two medium/large blue-themed maps plus a start map and a battle arena, featuring elements from some of the original Quake levels and certain old custom maps. Comes with three music tracks. The map sources are included.

title: Precipice Continuum
description: A large outdoor/canyon map with temple ruins.

title: Coagula
description: Small Metal space floater. Origin of the well-known Coagula style (tight space maps requiring the player to work his way upward).

title: Coagula2: Flesh
description: Small Metal space level.

title: Avanipaala Praasaada
description:
An elegant map in a unique texture theme (a white version of ikblue) with some nice brushwork and good exploration/secrets.
Memorable primarily for its Taj-Mahal-like ambience, but also fun to play.

title: Chaotic Trinity
description: Around medium-sized level using developer textures; a test map for AD's Chaos mode. The map source and the texture wad are included.

title: The Tenacious Tentacle
description: Small level created in the spirit of the 100b competitions (using not more than 100 world brushes). The map source is included.

title: Metal Monstrosity
description: Medium-sized vertical runic metal structures floating in the clouds. The map features enemies of the Base variety and has an integrated skill selection area. Additionally, it comes with a custom skybox as well as a few new sounds. The map source is included in the PAK.

title: Q-Deck
description: Small, highly-detailed base map. The (expanded) singleplayer version of DMQDeck. The map source is included.

title: The Terracotta Terror
description: Small terracotta-colored Coagula-style space map.

title: The Ivory Tower
description: Medium-sized medieval towers in a mine canyon with many secret areas that allow for somewhat nonlinear gameplay, a built-in skill selection area, and custom medieval-themed items. The map source is included in the pak.

title: Midnight Stalker
description: Medium-sized metal dungeon in E3M6 mashup style with a built-in skill selection room. It also features custom item boxes. The map source is included in the PAK.

title: Retrojam 2
description: Map-Center’s Quake Retrojam 2 contains 19 brand new maps, a beautiful hub and hours of gameplay.

title: Retrojam 3
description: Map-Center’s Quake Retrojam 3 contains 15 maps to play through, a beautiful hub to explore and loads of enemies to kill!

title: Retro Jam 3 DLC
description: Three vertical metal/runic-themed maps - late entries to Retro Jam 3, ironically labeled "DLC". The map sources are included.

title: Castle Kaahoo
description: Small temple map using Kaahoo textures. A touched-up and expanded version of sock's entry from SM175.

title: Castle Zanthu
description: Medium-sized castle using Daikatana E3 textures. Comes with a custom skybox and a poster screenshot.

title: 1024 Units
description: 1024 units / 6 SP maps / Artistical, DraQu, JCR, muk0r, onetruepurple, ww

title: Unknown Kadath
description: Medium-sized 'classic-style' medieval level with a church and lava-filled caverns beneath

title: The Cobalt Palace
description: Small blue Metal map with easy gameplay but a very unique style.

title: Perish the Thoth
description: Large underground Egyptian vault.

title: Malvirta Station
description: Small to medium id-base level with traps. Vanilla Quake version of the SM209 entry.

title: Bunker of Barzai
description: Medium-sized metal/runic dungeon; uses a few custom textures.

title: Off Base
description: Around medium-sized idbase map.

title: The Circulation of Shadows
description: Large underground industrial base with rocket silos and conveyor belts; and a small start map. It was originally started in 2005 for a Nehahra addon episode. It uses Daikatana textures and runs on the Rubicon 2 mod (included), featuring new and modified enemies and effects. Also comes with a music track and a custom skybox.

title: Bug & Seek
description: Catch bugs and clues in this cozy bug-catching simulator, styled like an 8-bit classic. You’ve bought the local bug museum, abandoned after a mysterious robbery. Fill orders, build your collection, and upgrade your skills and equipment while exploring Buggburg and uncovering its secrets.

title: Forza Motorsport: Deluxe Edition
description: Race over 500 real-world cars including modern race cars and more than 100 cars new to Forza Motorsport. Make every lap count across 20 living environments with fan-favorite locations and multiple track layouts to master, each featuring live on-track scoring, fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions that ensure no two laps ever look or play the same.

title: Are you yet Living?
description: Medium sized, somewhat nonlinear map using Knave textures.

title: Moldy Tower
description: A medium-sized vertical map. It starts with a moldy green area from which you ascend into a mechanical exploratory part. After surpassing this you are awarded a tense boss fight. Lots of novel atmospheric effects thanks to the use of Quoth.

title: The Living End & Elder World Waystation
description: Two-map SP unit: a large medieval dungeon in an underground lava cave (using rtGnosis textures), and a medium sized IKbase-themed stargate facility. It comes with a couple of new sounds and a custom skybox.

title: 4 hours
description: Maps made in 4 hours or less / 9 SP maps / dantescanline, Danzadan, dumptruck_ds, ing-ing, JCR, Naitelveni, Newhouse, prengle

title: Nastrond
description: Very large and detailed Knave fortress.

title: Solarfall
description: Large Wizard/Ebon Fortress level. Comes with a start map.

title: The Elder Reality
description: Medium-sized Elder World-style map that features at least one room from each level in the fourth episode of Quake (except for E4M1). An expanded version of the author's Retro Jam 4 entry.

title: The Lair of DOOMestic Animals
description: Small Metal/runic level. A polished and extended version of PuLSaR's SM57 map.

title: Remaster Textures
description: Nine small / medium maps made in a week using MachineGames' new textures for the rerelease. A variety of themes and styles, has something for everyone.

title: The Rats in the Walls
description: Small oldschool brick level with a few DOOM textures.

title: Crescendo Of Dreams + Surmounting Terror
description: Medium sized green DOOM marble/ wood level with a small end battle map.

title: Candles of the Damned
description: Remake of E1M2 from Quake: a medium-sized medieval castle with many candles. The map was previously released as part of Halloween Jam 2. Among other things, this version features even more candles! Comes with a new bat model and some ambient sounds.

title: The Lima Project
description: Medium-sized industrial facility using cr8 and Doom 3 textures. It comes with a custom skybox and a music track.

title: Deep Research
description: Small base map using Speedbase textures. Comes with a new skybox and a custom music track.

title: The Vigil
description: Small Medieval map with focus on arena combat.

title: Subterranean Siege
description: Evolved from a speedmapping session, this is a large-ish Q1SP decked out mainly in IDbase textures with plenty of natural rocky sections. A chain map by Misyu, Vigil, necros and Xen. The map source is included.

title: At the Gates of Midian
description: Two maps: a large Metal/Wood fortress in the mountains and a small end battle arena, featuring some modified Fiends and Shamblers. Conveys a certain DOOM-like atmosphere.

title: The Coagula Contest
description: This contest was run mid-September to mid-November of 2001, with the goal of creating maps in the tradition of Tim Elek's 'Coagula' series of maps - a series of structures floating in the void. There were 5 entries: Tronyn(2), Fat Controller, Dilvish, and Necros. In addition, a start map created by Tronyn is included, as well as the original Coagula series by Tim Elek.

title: Coagula3: Bone
description: Small blue/red space level using Daikatana textures.

title: Corruption Catharsis: Try To Act Normal
description: The ranger has been called to Ranger Station Theta as a precaution as scientists there have reported an anomaly with their slip-tech that would indicate a malevolant force has been trying to exploit the station. They could get a handle on the slip gate interdimensional array and use it as a back-door that would allow them to take control of some of Earth's remote facilities. Your breifing was to investigate the disturbance and eradicate any compromised forces or opposition that you encounter.

title: Stark Monstrosity
description: A rather unlinear huge base map with outdoor parts.

title: Slave to a Machine
description: A large tech/industrial base map using Daikatana, Doom3 and Half-Life textures.

title: The Hand That Feeds You
description: Large, interconnected base in the mountains with a lava cave beneath. It comes with a custom skybox.

title: Three Towers And A Sick Base
description: Large open base map set inside a lava canyon.

title: The Coagula Contest 2
description:
Results of the second Coagula contest
1st: tyrcoag: Outside In - Tyrann
2nd: pushcoag: The Vertical Mile - Pushplay
3rd: nesp10: Embers of Cruelty - necros
4th: jesus: Jesus Wants You - [anon]
4th: discoag2: Usher Recompiled - distrans
6th: chain3: Indigo - Chainer

title: Grendel's Keep
description: Medium-sized dark runic metal/base style biomatter processing facility. A sort of prequel to the Travail missionpack (which is required to play).

title: Ruined Nation
description: Medium-sized base map using Doom 3 textures. It comes with a number of custom ambient sounds and features hard combat.

title: Temple of Teuthis v1
description: Large dark underwater base / temple adventure map with lots of exploration. Textures by Makkon, built on extras_r5 mod by Khreathor (already included) with features like ladders. Make sure to save often, and save powerups until you really need them.

title: White Room
description: Medium sized base map with a unique concept: "keep the usual shapes but take away the textures." A biohazard outbreak at this facility adds lots of blood to the mostly white textures.

title: The Lizard's Trance
description: A remix of id's e2m5 in Q3 gothic textures and bigger scale. Beautiful architecture and solid gameplay.

title: Explore or Die
description: Around medium sized base map with Cr8 textures and somewhat non-linear gameplay relying on exploration (for ammo). Comes with a custom skybox and support for colored lighting.

title: Cogs Of Conflict
description: A nicely designed metal map with experimental gameplay. Instead of fighting the monsters directly, the player has to take a more stealth-based approach and lure them into traps.

title: Evil Exhumed
description: Medium sized Base map with an excarvation site, a library and a secret lab.

title: Dimension of the Doomed
description: Medium-sized base/wizard map where two Quake dimensions clash.

title: Thirteen Tombs of the Brilliant Dynasty
description: Large medieval dark fantasy castle in frozen lands with haunted crypt. A late entry for Twisted Christmas Jam 2022. Built for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+

title: Smells Like Rust
description: A big base map with intense fights... you are a treasure hunter who seeks riches in abandoned places. You heard about a factory that did brutal tests on people and decide to go there to see if there's anything left.

title: Atrocity Arise
description: Large Knave-textured castle with libraries and a courtyard. The map source is included.

title: Disengage the Simulator
description: Smallish slaughter-map "simulation" in a DE_DUST (from Counter Strike) setting, complete with dead terrorists and plantable bombs. Comes with custom textures, models, and sounds. The map source and a texture wad are included.

title: Tomb of Fenrir
description: Medium to large medieval-style dungeon in a subterranean lava cave. The map source and the texture wad are included.

title: The Faults Within
description: Remake/remix of stock Quake map E3M2 - The Vaults of Zin. The map source is included.

title: A Horse Named Quake
description: Small vertical medieval courtyard with a built-in skill selection room. The map source is included.

title: Sunken Fallacy
description: Medium-sized flooded Aztec / Mesoamerican ruins (Koohoo) map with a few puzzles and "cheeky" combat, built on Progs Dump 3 (already included). QuakeC and map source is included. Custom music by Patrick Patrikios.

title: Violent Rumble
description: Community mapping event organized at 4chan's retro videogame board: 11 large levels including a start map and a secret map, following a variety of styles and texture themes. They run on a custom mod that combines enemies, weapons, items and assets from both official mission packs, Quoth, Arcane Dimensions, RMQ and Progs_dump. As such, it comes with many new models, sounds as well as skyboxes and custom music tracks.

title: Somewhere
description: The goal of SOMEWHERE is to survive on the wild island of Esterhull. Gather resources, craft tools, and manage hunger, thirst. Explore mysterious locations, uncover the secrets of a lost civilization, and interact with other players: form alliances or compete for survival in a hostile environment.

title: Root of all Evil: Infernal Science - Part 1
description: Large underground research facility.

title: Root of all Evil: Infernal Science - Part 2
description: Second part of Root of all Evil. A large underground research facility.

title: Cat Detective
description: The plot is based on a main case linked to several unit cases. Fiona's a psychic. She spent over a decade hiding her identity. Living the daily life of a student and as a detective looking for the truth with pets.

title: Veil of Shadows
description: Veil of Shadows is an action-adventure with roguelite elements, echoing the vibes of classics from the past. Explore the surroundings to understand what's happening to Sirene. With the essence of retro games, face monsters, complete quests to gain experience, and evolve, preparing for the journey.

title: Wheels of Duty
description: Fight Against other players online across multiple locations with multiple game modes. Get in your wheelchairs and fulfill your duty as soldiers!

title: Wheels of Duty: Survival Modes
description: Team up with up to 4 people and take on AI attackers in Survival Modes

title: Substitute Priest
description: Welcome to [REDACTED], our lovely village. Get acquainted with our community, pray for a bit, and let's go. Meet our newly acquired priest and get rid of your sins as quickly as possible. PS: We advise you not to stay outside buildings after 9:00 p.m.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Landscapes 4
description: Puzzles of landscapes!

title: Tempest: Tower of Probatio
description: Tempest: Tower of Probatio presents a new standard for those who are bored with card games that use the same deck every time and take more than 10 minutes. The collective card game Tempest: Tower of Probatio, which is incredibly simple and unimaginably strategic! Comming Soon!

title: The Semen Donation Truck!
description: Two succubus invite you to donate your semen using the condoms they provide. If you beat their record in the Whack-O-Mole minigame, they also gladly provide physical help in your endeavor at donating.

title: The Rubro Rose's Castle
description: For centuries, an ancient family has ruled the lands of the morbid and decadent province of Rubro Rose, but with the sudden illness of the lord of Vorkrom Castle, everything falls upon the young princess of pale skin...

title: Temple of the Green Moon
description: Temple of the Green Moon is a psychological thriller that will send you into the heart of a mystical journey full of mysteries and incredible discoveries.

title: This Game Is Easy
description: This Game Is Easy is a game that challenges you. It will test and confuse you. Are you up to the challenge of this super-easy game?

title: The will of space
description: You can freely assemble a spaceship and shoot with a double joystick at the top view angle in the survival Roguelike game! Explore science fiction space and build your strongest battleship!

title: The Unknown Fear
description: The Unknown Fear is about a prisoner, sentenced to death, that had his memory deleted. His only chance of changing his life is by retrieving a file on the main computer of a secret settlement. Will you be able to get a new life or will the imprisoned creature in the settlement devour your body?

title: Curse of the Golden Skull Key
description: Large Wizard-themed level with big open water areas.

title: Godfreys Demesne
description: Medium-sized medieval castle level. It is based on the Progs_dump mod (included) and comes with some custom sounds and models.

title: East Ardougne
description: Medium-sized Knave fortress. It comes with a custom skybox and a music track. The map source is included.

title: Retribution Revisited
description: Small to medium-sized level (albeit with a high monster count). A singleplayer remake of Q3DM7- Temple of Retribution using custom textures. Comes with a music track. The map source is included.

title: Network Unreachable
description: Smallish industrial/base map using socktech textures. It comes with two new sound effects. The map source is included.

title: Secrets of the Keep
description: Huge town at nighttime with a castle and a big cathedral. It uses custom textures and comes with few new models, sounds, a custom skybox as well as a music track. The map source is included.

title: Corrupted Sector
description: Medium-sized base map. Comes with a few new sounds, a custom skybox and a music track. The map source is included.

title: Xala'noth: Part 1
description: Medium-sized level using GothicDM and Knave textures and featuring strong colored lighting. It comes with a start map, a custom skybox and a music track by the author.

title: Diminutive Abyss
description: Small void map with a focus on exploration.

title: Duel, In Towers
description: Small medieval-style level with two towers in a canyon. The map source is included.

title: The Refinery
description: Base level.

title: I commissioned some cats 9
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I commissioned some cats 8
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I commissioned some cats 7
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 6
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I commissioned some cats 10
description: I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Cats 0
description: Play for free! I paid artists to hide cats and wool in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Sinister Nights
description: You are a guard of an abandoned workshop who will have to survive under the onslaught of animatronics. Use doors, tablet and many other things to survive

title: Shoot & Sow
description: Shoot & Sow is a top-down arena shooter roguelite, where players control unique characters and fight vegetables and fruits. Players can plant seeds to grow special items, as well as buy a variety of weapons and items. Complete the talent tree to gain more power. Can you survive on your own farm?

title: Sex Story: Cuckold Life - Episode 8
description: A steamy Visual Novel featuring high-definition graphics and realistic-looking characters set in beautiful decor. The story continues with Nikki and her husband inviting the boss home for another live cuckolding experience. Will Adam find pleasure in tainting their marital bed with another man?

title: Maid Sisters' Service
description: During a business trip, I lived with two newly recruited maid sisters—the considerate Kiyomi and the passionate Shizuki—for a month. Although I had lost my memory, my little thingy was still very energetic!

title: Selfie Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Price of Flight
description: Fight, flight, and steal to survive in PRICE OF FLIGHT, the bird-based bloodsport of the future. Aid the failing Avian Resistance, save yourself, or die on live TV in this board game-inspired RPG.

title: Princess Parent
description: Princess Parent is a love letter to classic life simulation games. Enjoy a new parenting simulation where you schedule her time and make her choices until she's 18. Will she become a housewife or a dragon princess?

title: Pulsars & Crowbars
description: Pulsars and Crowbars is a rogue-like deck builder that combines grid-based tactical gameplay with character-driven storytelling. Unlock cards, craft your deck and save the galaxy!

title: Retro Combat
description: Casual FPS, no microtransactions. Play online or with bots with machine guns, tanks, and planes.

title: Return to Northbury Grove
description: Return to Northbury Grove is a thrilling VR experience and love letter to the slasher horror genre. Centered around immersive escape room gameplay, players are tasked with evading the terrifying Slasher of Specter Forest. Can you survive a horror movie?

title: RoGlass
description: RoGlass is a tile-based roguelite puzzle game where you place unique tiles to score points and unlock new spaces. Reset the board once you're out of tiles but keep progress on achievements, unlocks, etc. Keep expanding the board and try to unlock every achievement!

title: Ruff Ghanor
description: Ruff Ghanor is a Deckbuilder game with Roguelite elements, where each collected card represents a crucial action in your journey. Build the perfect deck, strategize, and create powerful synergies as you progress to face your destiny.

title: Popper Lands Colony
description: A new colony is appearing in popper lands! Skilled works are needed to harvest precious resources and build a friendly and prosperous village!

title: Phantom Patrol
description: A chilling VR co-op game where you investigate a haunted house, race against phantoms, and unravel eerie anomalies. Survival is a test of memory and teamwork!

title: One More Shooter Game
description: Your mission is simple but crucial: you must eliminate a specific number of enemies in each level to advance. The planet relies on your shooting skills to prevent the plague of these enemies from expanding.

title: Myrcella the Meandering Mage
description: “Myrcella the Meandering Mage” is comedic fantasy point-and-click adventure game and yuri dating sim. Follow Myrcella as she travels around the towns of the beautiful Kingdom of Falkenhorn, solves the townsfolks’ problems using her magic and charms the local ladies too! Adventure and romance await!

title: Naga Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Night Pact: Azuru
description: A broken deal will lead you into the depths of a strange cult-like group of moonshiners. Fight through with your loyal revolver, gather knowledge and solve puzzles as you keep advancing into the unknown.

title: MX vs. ATV: Legends - Throwback Tracks
description: Compete on 7 fan favourite tracks from MX vs ATV Reflex, Alive, Encore, Untamed and Unleashed!

title: Little Shrimp: Legend Reborn
description: Little Shrimp：Legend Reborn is a captivating Wuxia idle RPG that offers an open-world concept and an engaging storyline. With its free exploration of the Jianghu, leisurely gameplay, and auto-leveling fun, you'll have a blast with high levels of character involvement.

title: King Kitty Saves The Animals
description: Jump, dash and do general cat things with King Kitty on an adventure to save his friends from the mean Ghost King.

title: Japan Train Models: JR East Edition
description: Build, view, and run realistic reproductions of trains in your own railway space! Japan Train Models is a model train puzzle and layout crafting game for model train fans that allows you to create "Train Models" and "Scenery" just like a puzzle.

title: Mio and the Hot Summer
description: This is an FPS where you fight fire monsters with water guns! Take on the Burning King as the cute sea goddess "Mio".

title: Hyper Tanks
description: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in classic multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

title: Humpi and Hemicube
description: Step into a mind-bending world where gravity dances to your tune! In this 3d puzzle adventure, you'll navigate through a mesmerizing realm where every object possesses its own gravitational pull. Twist, teleport and turn your way through gravity-defying challenges that'll test your wits.

title: Hot Redheads
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Hillbomb
description: An arcade style skateboard racing game against time. Navigate from the top of the mountain all the way to the bottom. If you survive, you'll go down in history for pulling off the greatest hillbomb the world has ever seen.

title: HideNProp
description: Face off against your friends with up to 16 players online, in a chill mode or a competitive mode, where each map contains fun hiding spots.

title: Hentai Rina
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Heartless Corporation
description: Embark on an enthralling journey into the corporate world with "Heartless Corporation," a visual novel dating sim. Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative filled with drama, romance, and ethical dilemmas as you guide Liam through the twists and turns of corporate life.

title: Guild of Rogues
description: Guild of Rogues is a Roguelike Deckbuilder with Autobattler elements. Strategically build your team of minions to create amazing synergies and defeat all enemies!

title: Goblet of Mercy
description: A short interactive psychological horror story in which you meet an egomaniacal empress and must try to survive the encounter.

title: I want to die
description: The main character of the game, named David, goes in search of his missing daughter in a dark and ominous forest. He drives his car along a forest road, immersed in grief and despair. But on the way to his goal, his life turns into a nightmare.

title: In My Brain
description: In My Brain is a science fiction action video game about Nano, a nanoparticle that enters people's minds to combat their illnesses. Based on real events.

title: Infrared
description: You find yourself lost in the middle of nowhere. The only way to leave is to fuel up your car. But to do so, you'll have to venture into this desolate forest to find a way to unlock the gas station. But, every bit of flesh in your body screams that you are not alone...

title: The Dreamlurker
description: The Boy woke up alone in a mysterious forest. Confused he tries to figure out where he is and how he got here.

title: Elowyn and the Stolen Souls
description: Enter the magic world of Elowyn! Evolve with her and discover all the secrets to magic in this metroidvania with incredible characters and scenary. Learn powerful spells, create potions, unravel many riddles and live the entire fantasy!

title: Fool's End
description: Fool's End is a single-player puzzle-platformer mining game. Dig and destroy everything in your path, outsmart monsters and mine your path to complete each level. There's always another way to escape...

title: Fairytale Fables
description: Dive into a fantastical autobattler where fairytales and legends collide! Choose your hero and assemble your team of characters, items and treasures to outwit opponents in strategic battles where positioning matters. Will you be the last one standing in this enchanted PvP arena?

title: Evolution Survival
description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Who knows when Natural Selection is at the wheel!

title: Friends vs. Friends: Wired Wrecks
description: Wired Wrecks is the first Premium Expansion for Friends vs Friends

title: Geometric Brothers
description: Though modes may differ, there is but one objective! Fight through to the end and triumph over all!

title: Geometry Survivor
description: Geometry Survivor is a survival rogue-lite game, where you fight with waves of shapes and trying to find a way from madness.It might be difficult, but also [DATA LOSS]

title: Geotra
description: In this colorful twin-stick shooter inspired by 2000's-era Flash games, survive several waves of uniquely deadly enemies with your wits and skill. Choose wisely from a tree of upgrades after each wave to refine your strategy and bring down your foes. Live to see what lies at the end of the horde.

title: Gloomy Tales: One-Way Ticket - Collector's Edition
description: Investigate the mysterious disappearances plaguing the Halloween party and confront the elusive Allister, the sinister monster responsible for these chilling abductions!

title: Chunky Tomato
description: Chunky Tomato is a platform game in which you'll help a tomato, fortunately equipped with legs, to escape from a chunky tomato factory. All you have to do is cross the road. But watch out for the cars!

title: Children of the Forest
description: Iki and Tika live deep within a mysterious forest. Follow their enchanting journey as they find themselves amidst an imminent new threat. Children of the Forest is a story-driven adventure game about two siblings venturing through a land filled with extraordinary remnants from an ancient past.

title: Chessium: 3D Chess Battle
description: Chessium offers 3D Chess experience where people can play chess and feel themselves in the middle of war!

title: Call fur Help
description: Call for Help immerses you in the exciting world of firecat firefighters. Save the city as a brave feline firefighter! Tackle fires, clear obstacles, and showcase your courage in cooperative mode with friends. Action awaits around every corner!

title: Box Ninja
description: The ninja is trying to get to the door, but there are some annoying boxes in the way. Good thing this ninja has some crazy powerful legs! Those boxes need to be taught a lesson, so it is time to push, kick and break some boxes!

title: Carvival
description: Carvival is a top-down roguelite vehicle combat game. Mission is to destroy enemy vehicles, gather resources, and upgrade your car. Wreck bigger vehicles as you progress. Gain in-game perks. Create powerful combos with auto-trigger weapons. The mantra? Drive, shoot, drift, repeat, and power up!

title: College Sex: Episode 2
description: A visual novel series about the sex lives of two college girls. In this episode, one of them tries to make the other jealous by hitting on her boyfriend.

title: Colored Eyes Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Cozy Village
description: Welcome to the enchanting world of Cozy Village, where tranquility and adventure intertwine in a picturesque setting. Immerse yourself in a heartwarming village exploration game that invites you to uncover hidden treasures and unravel the mysteries of this charming hamlet.

title: Dead Meat
description: Three decent sized challenging maps for Doom 2 requiring a limit removing source port. Each map contains a Cyberdemon.

title: Death Rabbit
description: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

title: Department 14
description: You're a regular employee of department 14. One day, after falling asleep at your desk, you wake up and notice that all the other workers have left early and you are alone in the department.

title: Doggy Up!
description: Embark on an amazing and touching journey with our new game - Doggy Rise. This is an extraordinary story about the friendship between a disabled boy and his faithful dog. Alone or with a friend, help Liam and Ollie to overcome all the difficulties on their way.

title: Alyssa
description: ALYSSA is an adventure horror game, in which you play as a little girl who wakes up in an unfamiliar place… Or rather, she’s awakened by Emily, who has a… strange mask permanently attached to her head. Armed with nothing but a small lighter, Alyssa must attempt to escape from this cursed place. Meanwhile, her tormentors lurk in the shadows, waiting for a single wrong move…

title: Animal Kingdom 2
description: Welcome to Animal Kingdom 2, a hidden animal game where you collect pawprints, cameras and coins while searching animals in fantastic locations!

title: Aqua Pals
description: Dive into the mesmerizing world of aquariums with Aqua Pals, the immersive fish tycoon game where you create your own underwater haven. Transform simple tanks into a thriving aquatic paradise where charming fish flourish. Buy or breed happy fish to compete in dazzling fish pageants for prizes!

title: Apacies: Creatures of the Old West
description: Apacies is a Turn Based Strategy game set in the Old West. Use the varied creatures found in the deputed land as your allies, as they are more powerful and reliable than bullets. The vast expanse of land is yours to explore, it's story yours to mold, and its history, yours to explore.

title: Backstab
description: Players will play as samurai who have been sent to a mysterious island, adventure with other NPCs who have been teleported here, and experience backstabbing together, and former enemies may become allies, and eventually everyone's beliefs will be unified, and a new "Kingdom of Faith" will be born.

title: Bad Guys Good Boys
description: Follow the life of a ringleader of an evil organization who wants to change his evil ways and become good. In an attempt to change his organization, he has to teach and convince his henchmen to get rid of their evil habits and encourage them to do good deed.

title: Big Klondike: Spider Solitaire
description: Support Big Klondike and unlock Spider Solitaire.

title: Abyss Manager Idle
description: Abyss Manager Idle is an incremental tower defence game. Fend off assaults from two worlds, recruit and develop your personnel in an endless cycle of time. Defeat the calamity emerging from the abyss at the year's end to break the endless gyre.

title: Aetherift
description: A difficult co-op dungeon running roguelike for 2-10 players. Gear up and defeat challenging bosses with action combat and team based tactics. Build your character however you like, from nimble tanks to heavy mages.

title: Affectionate Annie
description: Meet Annie, a super-affectionate girl who loves sex. She's the hostess at a small resort where she has playful, casual sex with almost everyone who visits. Her job is to ensure that guests enjoy their stay, and she is very good at her job. Play this interactive erotic story with a very happy ending.

title: Alien Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Blagmoz
description: Dash, cast, and buff your way to the top of Blagmoz Tower in this lightning-fast PVP precision platformer. Power up by drinking potions, getting kills, and sacrificing your friends at the Altar. Become the ultimate glass cannon in this one-hit-kill battle of sorceries!

title: Feng Qi Chang'an: Yu Gu Ren
description: This is a Chinese style otome game！

title: 3D City
description: 3DC offers a vibrant urban sandbox, blending Sim City's strategic city-building, GTA 5's open-world exploration, and Assassin's Creed's parkour narratives. Dive in, shape the metropolis, and embark on thrilling missions in a stunning environment.

title: Ape Squad
description:
New war start Aim, Shoot and Throw.
Advanced Military Actions in Modern Combat.

title: Bohnice: Within the Mind
description: Explore the dark secrets of a closed psychiatric hospital in Prague, Bohnice, as a determined journalist. Uncover chilling experiments, gruesome tortures, and paranormal encounters. Collect clues and photographs to reveal the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.

title: Gangs of Sherwood: Lionheart Edition
description: Pre-purchase Gangs of Sherwood - Lionheart Edition and get the Prestige Skin Set free. Don your golden clothing to give the Sheriff's henchmen a thrashing with style. Also enjoy 72 hrs early access to the game.

title: Kompete
description: Kompete is an all-in-one multiplayer game. Current game modes include Blitz Royale and Kart Race, with more coming soon! Now in Early Access.

title: Baito Fight!!: Part-time Devil Hunter
description:
From the makers of HANA, comes a life sim JRPG for Playdate and PC about living in an apartment complex that's infested with monsters.

Use your sick baseball skills to exterminate monsters from your neighbors' apartments as a part-time devil hunter!!

Save up money for convenience store runs, and to pay off your overdue rent!!

CRANK to use the elevator and baseball bat!!

title: Reunion of Angel
description:
Mai is having an awful day. She just got fired, and suddenly two guys show up claiming to be Angels of Death, saying that she's going to die in seven days.

Not only that, but her soul will be destroyed completely, so she can't even be reincarnated.

The Angels can't prevent her death, but they want to at least help save her soul. They lend her their supernatural powers so she can help people -- just like a superhero.

But can Mai do enough good deeds in the next seven days to change her fate?

title: Crossout: Sky Raiders
description: Crossout goes up in the air! Join the “Sky Raiders” season, unlock all new parts, assemble the flying armoured vehicle of your dreams and battle other survivors in new locations!

title: Askisi Gamma
description: Medium to large terracotta-themed map. The map source is included.

title: Logistics Central
description: Around medium-sized base map. Extended version of the same map from the Q25 Limits Jam. The map source is included.

title: Smells Like Grandma's
description: Medium-large grungy metal sci-fi map with platforming aspects, built for Copper v1.19+

title: Amusement Inferno
description: Medium sized dark fantasy castle map with industrial bits, with textures by Makkon. Map source and custom music is included. Requires Copper v1.19+

title: Dimension of the Diminished
description: Small level that combines one room from each map in Quake's first episode into a cute little summary or reminder of it.

title: Primo
description: Around medium-sized brick/sewer level in Honey-style. Comes with a custom skybox.

title: A Once Glorious City
description: Large temple complex using Egyptian textures from Rogue/Q1MP2, featuring somewhat nonlinear gameplay. The map source and a few texture wads are included.

title: Mission: Escape
description: When I opened my eyes, I stand in a strange place. My last memory is of losing consciousness while preparing for a mission. I don't know where we are, but we have a gun, so let's move. I'm sure I can go back. You become the main character and must rely on one gun to get out of this place.

title: Mírame
description:
Jai Bhagwan, a 57-year-old Indian cyclist, spent 10 hours 44 minutes and 5 seconds cycling non-stop. He covered 202.1km. A pathetic figure that a new rider is set to beat, come what may.
Jai Bhagwan wasn't half the cyborg, nor was he half as divorced as the protagonist of this story is.

title: 10,000 Feet Below
description: Medium-sized underground temple with a unique Persian-like style. Preview/teaser for the upcoming DOM3 episode.

title: Tormentarium
description: Large metal-style industrial facility surrounded by caverns; features a few custom map props.

title: VeniVidiFutzi
description: Large greek-themed medieval town with a venice-style canal and cavern areas beneath. It also features a few new and modified monsters: crossbow knights, skeletons and Granito.

title: Orb's Betrayal
description: Conversion of Quake II's map01, complete with textures and coloured lighting, but different monster placement.

title: The Grand Guignol
description: Originally designed for speedrunning this map is fun for everyone. Dressed in Sock's egyptian textures.

title: Necromanicide
description: A nicely made egyptian remix of Quake's e1m3 - The Necropolis.

title: Lair Of The Dragon Ogre
description: A beautiful id metal castle in a nice style.

title: Temple Of Anubis: Judgement Of The Dead
description: A very nice medium sized egyptian map. It has a somewhat similar vibe like Return to Dust. And it features a fun zombie quad massacre.

title: Return to Dust
description: A fast and brutal (yet well balanced) map in beautiful ancient-temple textures.

title: Acid Worship
description: Small industrial base station inside an underground acid cave.

title: The Shark's Bathhouse
description:
A megaman-like platformer for the strawberry jam 5.
A Fox is on a mission to defeat the big bad shark daddy at his steamy bathhouse.
He'll need to jump, cum and hump his way to victory! And you're here to help him!
Or he can fail at the last minute and face the consequences

title: Forwards Compatible
description: A big rusty metal (rubicon) space station.

title: Wroth
description: A short / medium sized base-themed map with modified grunts and enforcer monsters. Based on progs_dump 2.0 devkit (already included), and inspired by Mountains of Insanity.

title: Runic Warrens
description: Small linear map in a runic style. Uses progs_dump (included) for a couple of enemy tweaks. Map source is included.

title: Mars Base Excavation Incident
description: Large Doom-style level using original Doom textures. It starts out in a remake/conversion of E1M1 and provides a journey through various base and underground/marble temple areas, effectively using a Doom-like layout. Comes with a custom skybox and a music track.

title: The Machinery
description: Large dark industrial map using IKbase textures. Comes with a custom music track by the author. The map source is included.

title: Keeper Of The Hell Gate
description: Medium-sized runic map. It is based on the progs_dump mod (included) and a few extra models and sounds as well as a music track by the author. The map source is included.

title: Rich Mahogany and Human Leather-Bound Books
description: Large castle library in the mountains. It uses some Knave textures and comes with a custom skybox.

title: Industrial Combat
description: Small Rubicon-style industrial level with a mine tunnels section.

title: The End of Solace
description: Large moldy blood dungeon "in the style of E1M3". The map source is included.

title: The Gateway to Hell
description: Small to medium-sized medieval / hell map, the sequel to Castle of the Dark Ages. Uses DKT and Doom3 textures, and comes with a few additional ambient sounds as well as a hell skybox.

title: Fort Driant
description: A huge military base in Half-Life/Doom style. The mission is to disable a reactor within. Comes with a few ambient sounds and a custom skybox.

title: Castle of The Dark Ages
description: Large, dark castle level with DKT3 textures.

title: The Contract
description: Medium-sized Knave-style flying cathedral with a courtyard and a crypt area. It comes with a start map and a custom skybox.

title: Morbidity: 1
description: Medium sized Base/Metal map. Uses some DOOM2 textures and some other custom ones.

title: Morbidity: 2
description: Small to medium custom Metal map with a Base bit at the beginning.

title: Daredevil's Descent & Cryogenic Crypt
description: Two large levels in Medieval/Metal/Wizard/Hipchurch style.

title: Halo Chaotic Edition
description: In this mod, all enemies and allies will multiply once they die, turning small fights into a real battlefield not to mention the amount of explosions that there will be!

title: Hell in a Can
description: A medium sized cargo spacecraft with Zer and IKBase textures and somewhat unusual gameplay. There are three missions to be completed in which you'll face all kinds of problems, from technical difficulties to unruly 'cargo'.

title: The Forgotten Level
description: Medium sized Wizard map

title: The Fierce Livid
description: Large Metal windtunnel map

title: Rust in Peace
description: Medium sized original Metal-style windtunnel base map.

title: The Netherworld
description:
You are Godfrey, a confused spirit who has just arrived at the banks of the River Styx.
There is an underworld after all, but something doesn't feel right (other than being dead).

title: Silhouette of Darkness
description: A medium sized medieval map with new textures, gameplay focuses largely on discovering secrets.

title: Marvel Super Heroes: War Of The Gems
description:
Thanos mounts the six Infinity Gems on his left glove to form the titular Infinity Gauntlet.
Each Gem grants its bearer complete mastery over one aspect of the universe: Time, Space, Mind, Soul, Reality, and Power.
Now all-powerful and desperate to win the affections of Death, Thanos decides to offer the entity a gift of love by completing a task she had given him, erasing half the sentient life in the universe (including most of the X-Men, Daredevil, and the Fantastic Four), quite literally with a snap of his fingers. The surviving heroes on Earth band together guided by the newly-resurrected Adam Warlock to battle Thanos.
In a bid to impress Death, Thanos allows the heroes a slight chance of winning. Can you save the universe?

A War Of The Gems fan game made with OpenBor.

title: Blackish House
description:
Those with individuality, good looks which help to bring this out, as well as talent — however, despite having all these things, none of them think about the other people around them, and are all ‘blackish’ personalities.

The agency they work for, SeiGetsu Production, notices this; gathering all these talents, they present them with a single condition.

Which is... for all of them to live together, cooperate with one another, and successfully produce a musical performance within half a year. If they fail, the agency will end all of their contracts, and make sure they can never be a part of the showbiz again.

Where they are forced to live is a run-down mansion that hardly suits these talented stars. The amount of time given to them is half a year. Gathered are all different kinds people — a mix of actors, dancers, seiyuu, singers, models. Furthermore, all of them possess rather ‘extreme’ quirks in their personalities.

Forced into the midst of this mess is the heroine, an actress who does not possess a ‘self.’ After half a year, what is it that the heroine and these other members, will see?

title: The Rest is Silence
description: Around medium Knave-style fortress. Requires the Lost Chapters pack.

title: Breakfast at Twilight
description: A knave-textured castle built upon scraps by Kell and Drew and the author's speedmap from SM93.

title: The Lost Levels
description: Classic singleplayer campaign made by Gotshun that was never finished or released: Two episodes with 16 levels of various themes including a start map and a secret map. The second episode lacks a conclusion/boss fight due to the unfinished nature of the pack, but it is perfectly playable.

title: Hexameron: Phase One
description: Very large, detailed, professionaly constructed Base map with a few outside areas and three new monsters (modified Enforcers, Scourge).

title: Caves, Canyons & Crevices
description: 14 SP maps set in or around canyons and caves. Two of them use custom skyboxes and a music track. The map sources are included.

title: Quake Condensed
description: Mini episode consisting of five small polished-up speedmaps, each following one of Quake's native texture themes.

title: For Love of Evil
description:
Three independent levels connected by a start map.
Voidscape: Very small rocky island floating in space.
Brownie: Small medieval fortress with an atrium and tower areas.
For The Love Of Evil: Large Metal/runic map with majestic halls and various traps. (On hard difficulty, the map exceeds the max_edicts limit, so it requires a source port with increased limits).

title: Sewage Devastation
description: A big green swampy sewage system. Build in short time in a speedmapping fashion.

title: Cappuccino: The Refill
description: Medium sized gothic fortress with Q3A textures (second version).

title: Sludge Factory
description: Two industrial/slime-themed maps with custom textures and horde-based combat: a large factory in a canyon and a small oil rig on an ocean of slime.

title: Dry Sorrow
description: Small medieval outpost with a unique texture theme and horde-based combat. A touched-up version of an old deathmatch map converted for SP mode. Comes with a custom skybox.

title: Fort Ratsack
description: A fast and frantic base map for Quoth.

title: Binding Tower
description: Large map with a castle in a dark forest. Comes with a custom skybox and the map source is included.

title: House of Spikes
description: Just like Biff's previous map imp1sp1 this one is a beauty.

title: The Corral
description: A beautiful base map that shines with graphical perfection. Gameplay is ok (only grunts and enforcers plus a few rotfish) and very straight-forward (no keys).

title: Well of Lost Souls
description: Small to medium-sized map inspired by E4M2- The Tower of Despair.

title: Unholy Ossuary
description: Medium-sized classic Episode 3-style runic level.

title: Murder at the Disco
description: Medium-sized nightclub level with several dancefloors, bars and VIP areas. Comes with an optional start map, a few external textures as well as a custom skybox, and some music tracks. The map source is included. This map requires the Malice TC.

title: Shifting Planes of Existence
description: Medium-sized Knave-style level with button-operated movable "planes". This is an updated version of the level. The map source is included.

title: Wrath of Ahnkii
description: Large Egyptian-style map. Comes with a custom skybox and a music track. The map source is included.

title: Aftershock for Quake
description: Aftershock for Quake, or simply Aftershock, is a commercial add-on for Quake developed by HeadGames Publishing, Inc. and published by GT Interactive. The add-on was released on November 10, 1996.

title: Barbican Of Hell
description: Small runic level. The map source is included.

title: Wenl Mine
description: Large mine cavern map; a remake of the third level from Descent 2. Exploration-style gameplay and many secrets.

title: Dreary Disposition
description: Large Wizard-themed medieval castle/dungeon level. The map source is included.

title: Cataractnacon & Zeangala
description: Two large abstract base levels, a lengthy journey through a non-linear H.R. Giger-themed flooded scrapyard. The map sources are included.

title: Myworld is Yourworld
description: Medium sized brick/metal map with a Shub boss fight at the end.

title: Jawbreak
description: Fairly large idbase map with a lot of button pressing.

title: War Church
description: Large, spacious military base/stronghold fortifying an old church. The map source is included.

title: Plowing Through
description: Large, spacious base map with industrial machinery. The map source is included.

title: Mayhem Pantera
description: Medium-sized moldy brick level inside a cave. It runs on the SMP mod (included). The map source is included.

title: The Subconscious Fear
description: Large 'techno-dungeon' with many corridors and ambushes.

title: The Citadel of Sinners
description: Very large fortress/citadel with many corridors and ambushes. Comes with a small skill selection map.

title: Seven
description: Best drop number 7 puzzle game!

title: Citadel of Fire
description: Dark oldschool lava temple level, originally made in 2019.

title: Deepest Oblivion
description: Dark oldschool dungeon level, originally made in 2019.

title: Castle Puzzlefort
description: Small medieval / castle themed puzzle level with no enemies for vanilla Quake. Inspired by the Amiga game Castle Master. Also supports deathmatch. Map source is included.

title: Conflagrant Rodent
description: Large Medieval/terracotta-themed temple ruin in a canyon. High monstercount, hard gameplay. The texture resource wad is included.

title: The Katagean Redoubt
description: A big, interconnected, green-wizardish map with well thought-out secrets.

title: Death's Taste
description: Small Wizard castle.

title: Borderlands 3: Director's Cut
description: Director's Cut is the second "upgrade pack" released for Borderlands 3, including behind-the-scenes content and additional missions and items.

title: Open Ocarina
description:
Open Ocarina is a PC port of the decompiled The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time originally for the Nintendo 64.

It supports features such as 30-120 fps, free camera, rumble, gyro aim, and HD texture packs.

title: Hexle
description: A little number-guessing game inspired by Sudoku with hexadecimal numbers and binary restrictions, presented in a minimalist style. Infinite puzzles, daily challenges and weekly megaboards!

title: Paint-a'-Way
description: Paint-a'-Way is a platformer game where you use your brush to paint your way across different obstacles while avoiding the black skunky oil that lies in your way. Make your way to a colorful rift to continue your journey across yodie land.

title: Bog Man Has Had Enough
description:
Bog Man is tired of the noise up above and is ready to do something about it with the help of his faithful axe and trusty shotgun.
A 10-15 minute long Copper map about ascending from the bog and silencing the evil above.

title: Reload Map Jam
description: Map jam run by Slipgate Sightseer in cooperation with Reload Magazine, with the goal of picking 3 entries to write about in an article!​

title: Grisly Grottos
description: 10 speedmaps + start map inspired by e1m4 - The Grisly Grotto. Mappers had 60 hours to create a map using custom progs - based on Copper and featuring the diving gear from Dwell - with no restrictions on texturing or gameplay other than the prompt.

title: Tainted
description:
In your tainted land, an unfathomable cosmic horror takes root. Monstrous abominations sow chaos and despair, while the Rune of Power, pulsating with forbidden energies, is stolen. To restore harmony and repel doom, you must drive back the eldritch creatures and reclaim the Rune of Power...
8 Singleplayer maps made for Copper

title: Rotting Jam
description: Rotting Jam is a collection of seven maps created over a period of two weeks for Arcane Dimensions with the theme "Decay and disrepair".

title: Of Three Plantagenets
description: Three-map mini episode in a dark medieval theme. It has an extra start map and features a few modifications, some new sounds, models and textures.

title: The Hell That's Coming
description: Medium-sized medieval map with fairly linear gameplay and some monster modifications.

title: Symphony of Science
description: Medium-sized dark underground laboratory.

title: Infernal Ascent
description: Small to medium-sized vertical mixed-texture map.

title: The Grinding of Teeth
description: Small Metal level.

title: The Black Fog
description: Small cave tomb / temple map with Makkon textures, built for Arcane Dimensions v1.81+ (NOT included). Some textures and sounds from Thief: The Dark Project. Custom music by MrDetonia. Map source is included.

title: Time to Belong
description: Episode with four medium-sized classic id-themed maps + custom start and end map. Mostly vanilla Quake with a few extras, comes with its own progs.dat. Based on previously released speedmaps (details in included readme).

title: Prison of Hope
description: Large sci-fi gothic mountain prison for vanilla Quake inspired by Dark Souls, with textures by Makkon. Difficulty settings are not implemented. Map source is included.

title: Azure Moon
description: A large base-themed map inspired by Half-Life 1 / Black Mesa with a ton of blue and green lighting, hence the name. The author's first release.

title: Cold Light
description: Four (4) map episode with a variety of medieval / wizard / runic themes in a classic style, made for vanilla Quake. Some levels are rather non-linear and large. Map source is included.

title: What Lies Behind
description: Small metal/runic level. Comes with a custom music track from Quake64. The map source is included.

title: Garden Buddies
description: Unleash your inner gardener and immerse yourself in the serene world of Garden Buddies, cultivating a vibrant flower garden alongside your new friend Mutsy.

title: Temporis Arts
description: Temporis Arts is Pretty Maniac Rhythm game with a circularly rotating Judgement Line! What you have to do in a spinning, sounding world is just - hit the notes in Tempo!

title: FeatherCall
description: FeatherCall is a fast pace, puzzle platformer where you help Luna, a mother blue bird, rescue her lost children. Brave numerous challenges and puzzles by Dashing to new heights, Throwing a guiding feather, and Gliding back to safety!

title: Narcalid
description: Explore a dangerous new world on your own or with up to three friends. Narcalid is a puzzle platformer emphasizing peaceful exploration, a compelling spiritual narrative, and out-of-this-world creatures. Can you open the gateway to Earth before the Narcalid mother becomes unstoppable?

title: Presence Lookout
description: Presence Lookout is an Observation spot the difference Horror game where the player has to spot different "anomalies" through the map. Anomalies can be anything from an object that has been moved to another location, rotated or even an unknown entity that shouldn't be. Report the Anomalies to win!

title: Fowl Damage
description: Fowl Damage is an atmospheric puzzle platformer where your default jump provides enough fall damage to destroy you! Carefully manage your jumps and falls as you adventure through this chilling, beautiful, and occasionally cute world.

title: The Westcoast Drive: Lowrider Simulator
description: Experience 1960s American lowrider culture. Customize your ride, hit the streets, and dominate with iconic hydraulics

title: Short Haired Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: AOA Academy
description: You found a letter from the A.O.A academy, claiming that you have been accepted into their academy. This surprised you, since you've never attempted to enroll in any academy. Not only that, this letter also contained the number of your old friend, Ashley. Determine to face your new future in AOA.

title: Blood & Chaos
description: Blood & Chaos is a roguelike tribute to the golden era of '80s RPG gaming. Create a fellowship of 6 heroes and embark on an epic journey. Explore a thriving world with quests to accomplish, cities to discover and dungeons to explore where your mastering of turn-based combats will keep you alive.

title: Block Strategy
description: Block Strategy is an RTS game where the world is made up of blocks that can be placed or destroyed to change the terrain. Gather materials by exploring or destroying enemies, and use them to expand your base and defend against an onslaught of enemies.

title: I's Long Night
description: A relaxed casual adventure game

title: The Phantom
description: The Ghost Who Walks is back! Comics' very first costumed hero is coming to Steam and console in an all new side scrolling beat-em-up adventure. Take on the Singh brotherhood across the globe with only your physical strength, skill with weapons and fearsome reputation!

title: Kamitsubaki City Regenerate
description: Answer the summons to the parallel world of "Kamitsubaki City" and meet a cast of colorful characters as you set out on a quest to save this city from the brink of destruction in this dark-fantasy sci-fi visual novel!

title: Regular Spacecraft: Defending the Mothership
description: Defeat the enemies. Upgrade the spacecraft. Defend the mothership. Regular Spacecraft - Defending the Mothership is a shoot em'up game with roguelite elements.

title: Naughty Queens
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy ;-)

title: Travelin'
description: Travelin' is a turn-based card game that will test your abilities to make the right decisions. Pack your skills and be prepared for the trials, tribulations and triumphs of a journey across Europe. Are you ready for this journey?

title: Bee Craft Sweet
description: Real-time simulation game of bees Can you survive?

title: I Feel Very Lonely and I Don’t Remember Myself
description: A short sci-fi visual novel about four scientists trapped in an underground lab. Explore their chat records to uncover the mysteries of Inturg Technologies. How can they escape their doom?

title: Woodside
description: Welcome to Woodside, a third-person survival horror adventure. Explore, investigate and survive as Grace as she comes face to face with the supernatural terrors that plague a seemingly quaint British village.

title: Norwegian Jigsaw Puzzles
description: "Explore Norway's beauty through captivating puzzles. From serene fjords to the Northern Lights, discover the magic of Norway!"

title: DaemonClaw: Origins of Nnar
description: Defend humanity from a surprise attack by the mystical creatures of the world of Nnar in this high speed arcade/console style action game coming to modern and classic retro platforms.

title: Music Power Up
description: As a musician in the 1980s, create music for early video games. Make your own sounds and melodies from scratch, or use pre-composed patterns. Play games, upgrade the music app, meet programmers, editors and musicians, find your next music job, in the crazy decade that started the digital revolution.

title: Cosmic Clash
description: Battle your friends for space superiority in this arcade style space shooter. Select your star fighter and jump into Cosmic Clash where you try and eliminate your friends while surviving the perils of space.

title: Roll The Bones
description: Select spell-dice for your loadout, roll them and wreak absolute havoc! This high-paced pixelart roguelite will let you build unique loadouts with extremely interactable spells. Let's roll some bones!

title: Stylish Girls
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts.

title: Night Fear
description: Night Fear is a fast-paced roguelike where you play as a brave knight, the last of a line of liberators. Use the best weapons and skills to defeat enemy units and not die in a dark dungeon. You must give it your all, collect the best weapons, complete all levels of the dungeon and stay alive!

title: Sut
description: A cute 2D platformer where you stick to walls and fight your way out of a hot fireplace. Features environment-based combat and a cozy, retro aesthetic.

title: Sweet Beauties
description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. Enjoy.

title: Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream
description: Teenagers, Dreams, and Drugs. Unveil the secrets of South Jayakarta city, set two years after the ending of the original Troublemaker. The journey of the “Parakacuk” gang continues alongside the “Beyond Dream” band in South Jayakarta city in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game.

title: Lost Princess: Winterland
description: Play this walking simulation. Lost princess are again missing. Collect items and try to find missing Princess in big open snow world

title: Footy Bash
description: Step into the world of Footy Bash, Experience the rush of fast-paced football with 1-4 players. Unleash spectacular speckys to leave your opponents in awe and land devastating hits to thrill your fans. With dynamic gameplay and a classic look, Footy Bash is an electrifying footy spectacle.

title: Hentai Midori
description: What could be more beautiful than hentai?

title: Boki: The Summit
description: Boki is a Metroidvania, Choose your own adventure, Precision platformer in which you play as a young mountain goat, who must climb a mountain in seek of revenge. Dodge, battle and fluidly maneuver through several uniquely crafted areas and biomes and uncover the secrets of a tyrannical kingdom.

title: Astral Tale
description: "ASTRAL TALE"- Myth of the Stars," a classic Japanese MMORPG, is now officially operating worldwide. A brand-new profession has been introduced, allowing players to embark on a unique journey across the stars together!

title: Serpens: Eternal Thievery
