description: The Show is Over It is a challenging platform game with caricatured characters. Players must climb levels filled with quirky obstacles and surprises These unexpected events add excitement to the game.

title: Sligga Trigger
description: Suit up and sling some shells at sadistic, superpowered sci-fi slugs. Snag some secrets, suffer some shrapnel, and shoot the shit out of some Sliggas in this one-of-a-kind twin-stick shooter.

title: Solcialists
description: Solcialists is The Ultimate Operating System for the best Solcialists control experience. Mars 2066.

title: The Good Overlord
description: You're the guardian of the realm's most feared dungeon, now aiding heroes. 'The Good Overlord' is a Roguelike Bag-Builder with monsters, traps, and secrets. Defeat enemies, collect relics, and uncover the reason behind the Overlord's benevolence.

title: SuiCats
description: SuiCats is an engaging puzzle game where you combine kittens to create amazing cat cascades. Diverse physics and a humorous design will keep you smiling while playing SuiCats. Join the feline adventure and break the high score today!

title: Voxile
description: Explore gorgeous raytraced voxel lands, meet the local mutated wild-life, find out what went wrong, and quest, craft, loot, build, destroy and shoot your way to the top of the foodchain! Play alone, or with friends! Assuming you know how to share..

title: Shotgun Recovery
description: A psychological shooter set in a small Nordic town. Take part in robberies, drive-bys and self-medication, all while fighting literal nightmares to survive.

title: Santa's Gift Grab
description: Step into a snowy world with our straightforward collector's game. Featuring clean low-poly graphics and soothing Christmas tunes, your task is to help Santa gather his misplaced gifts. But be quick!

title: Sangi
description: A fast paced and combat oriented 2D platformer. Use multiple weapons and create multiple elemental reactions to efficiently eliminate your enemies. Experience a short story about your origins and try getting the best score possible in the arcade mode.

title: Sailaway III
description: Sailing simulation. Explore the world's oceans or compete in races in the most realistic sailing simulator available. The sailing waters are as big as the real world and circumnavigation will take several months. True weather, true conditions and true sail trim.

title: Sacabambaspis Chronicle
description: As a player, you become Sacabambaspis and live each day with your fellow Sacabambaspis, growing and evolving by swimming in the sea and eating plankton. Progress through the story with your companions in Sacabambaspis, and see what happens in the end.

title: Rulers of Aden
description: A fantasy turn-based indie rpg with character customization and enemies that may leave you struggling.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Haunted Halloween
description: 1 Brand New Table with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Halloween themed table with a focus on gimmicks, randomness and a center play-field spinner! Perfect for the Spooky at heart!

title: Rogue Tactics
description: Rogue Tactics is a turn-based strategy game with RPG elements. Fight, learn new spells, recruit new creatures into your squad and improve them.

title: Pixel Puzzles WW2 Jigsaw: Battle of Leyte
description: Pixel Puzzles World War II, merging history with the definitive jigsaw puzzler on the PC platform.

title: Renovation Plan
description: This is a relaxing and leisurely home decoration game, you need to follow the design map to put all kinds of furniture in the corresponding position. Each room has unique furniture and decoration style, more gorgeous large apartment waiting for you to decorate.

title: Midnight Run
description: Midnight Run is a game where you, the player, is on a mission to get late night snacks for your friend. However, just because it seems like a simple quest to fulfill, the city has a bunch of weird things that happens to you along the way.

title: Methods: The Illusion Murders
description: Detective Red July must stop a serial killer who patterns his murders after optical illusions in this mystery visual novel set in the world of Methods.

title: Soulmask
description: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance. Start from nothing, explore, build, recruit tribesmen to fortify your clan, and ultimately unravel the mysterious truths hidden behind the civilizations of this world.

title: My Academy's Special Place
description: Our hero's homeroom teacher is also his big sister, Yaeka. She's popular with the students, but at home, she's a slobbish drunk. There's Maika, an exchange student and Akiba nerd. She's always asking him to go to Akiba with her. But Maika is told to return home. Two love stories are about to begin!

title: Money Transporter
description: "Money Transporter" is an intense game that puts you in charge of transporting money safely from the bank to the ATM and back.

title: Moci Over It
description: Use simple controls to control "moci" and reach the summit. Climbing is the accumulation of the past, much like life. Here is the future waiting to be piled up for you and the life of moci. Please join us in reaching the summit.

title: Mortisomem
description: Donald Barnes is a successful merchant who one day on his way home, starts being stalked by a dangerous demon from the Colonial Times. Now he has to find a way back home or finally defeat Mortisomem.

title: Outminer
description: Disaster strikes as you're about to complete your most important mission as a captain, forcing your crew and you to adapt to the harsh environment of a forsaken planet. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive?

title: Phosfi
description: Phosfi is an atmospheric, metroidvania style action-platformer. Explore and fight your way through a dark and dangerous coastal world full of mysteries and ancient treasures. Discover long buried temples and fend off Eldritch monstrosities in this beautiful 2D hand drawn and animated adventure.

title: Penguin Hatchery
description: Penguin Hatchery is a game about hatching penguins. Yeah thats pretty much it. With the help of some clicking and some random things that sometimes make sense sometimes don't you can begin to hatch penguin eggs and eventually hatch them at an insane rate!

title: Paradise Road
description: There are too many enemies waiting for you, can you excellently complete the challenge.

title: Maze Quest Master: Cyclist
description: "Embark on a thrilling journey in 'Maze Quest Master - Cyclist.' Conquer intricate mazes, collect coins, and master wall-bound movement. Become the ultimate maze explorer!"

title: Lost Chapter: With You
description: Venture into the abyss once again to find out the protagonist's true identity! This DLC comes with new card system, bosses, events and many more!

title: LineMaze
description: LineMaze is one of the most creative puzzle game for your brain. This brain-stimulating puzzle game, very simple, and enjoyable for all ages.

title: Love Alone Death
description: Build relationship with the characters. Your choices might earn you favor from one character, but disdain from another. Use items to solve problems. Confront various endings. Choose one person and face the end with them.

title: Luna's Light
description: Luna's Light is the story of a young huntress who must leave her village and face a cruel post-apoclyptic world. Explore various biomes, find upgrades, fight bosses and complete quests.

title: Haunted Hotel: Pheonix
description: Uncover the truth behind the legendary fire that destroyed a university.

title: Hotel Renovator: Indoor Garden Room & Furniture Set
description: Escape the daily rush and immerse yourself in a lush, tranquil oasis with our Indoor Garden Room & Furniture Set. Turn your hotel room into a nature lover's paradise!

title: Mercenary Warriors
description: Mercenary Warriors is a Turn Based PVP Strategy Game set in a fantasy world. Create your own team selecting 9 of the multiple warriors available to you and rise to the top.

title: Godly Survivors
description: Face thousands of lost souls in the arena of the gods! Godly Survivors invites you to embark on an epic journey through an action rogue-lite game where you will hunt down the mobs' souls to improve your skills and survive the trial of the gods.

title: Ghost Hunters
description: Ghost Hunters: a game about a hereditary medium who, despite being unable to sense the otherworldly, agrees to a mysterious contract to capture ghosts!

title: Eye of the Void: Unleashed
description: The goblin tribes of the realm have united against you and the power of the Eye of the Void. Build towers, fortify walls, construct gold mines to gather resources, and cast powerful spells to fend off waves of determined goblins and their allies who seek to destroy you.

title: Failure to Launch
description: Failure to Launch is a short physics based platformer where you must reach space with a small space capsule.

title: Fantasy Senate Simulator
description: Create a political party, win elections, respond to events, pass laws, govern, create your version of utopia and even go to war with your neighbors in this senate simulator with a fantasy twist.

title: Flappy Swan
description: Flappy Swan is a casual game where u control a swan to fly and dodge skyscrapers in an stunning synthwave style.100x Steam Achievments (just start the game)Have A Good Flight!

title: Dreaming Dead Dance
description: Survive as long as possible from an onslaught of hundreds hiding in the dark in this rogue-lite survival game. Augment your spells together to create waves of destruction through the horde in the dark.

title: Dungeon Bar: Gachi Puzzles
description: Dungeon Bar is a classic puzzle game in neonoir style. You will have to piece by piece collect pictures of legendary personalities of the Gachimuchi...

title: District XiLin
description: This is a first-person city exploration game similar to a walking simulator. It is an open-world game that takes place in a real Chinese city called XiLin.

title: Elfs From Elsewhere!
description: "Elfs from Elsewhere" invites you to embark on a brief yet captivating visual novel adventure, where mystery and adventure collide in a world teeming with elves and demons.

title: Chapter Wars
description: Immerse yourself in thrilling first-person shooter battles across three unique maps. Confront rival clans, adapt to hostile locals, and face off against relentless alien creatures. Join the eternal struggle for dominance and choose your side in this action-packed battle for supremacy!

title: Conspyration
description: ConSPYration is a spy-themed, LOCAL multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Your goal is to steal the briefcase and reach for the exit, but beware, eveyr stage is full of perils and the rival spies won't let you escape so easy!

title: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzle is not just a game; it's a serene journey that takes you to a world of beauty and peace. Experience the joy of solving puzzles in the coziest way possible. Get ready to lose yourself in the gentle challenge and embrace the art of relaxation.

title: CyVenge
description: CyVenge is a fast paced and action packed rougelite arena shooter. Choose from many upgradable weapons and abilities and help Cy fight against numerous waves of enemies!

title: A-Girl
description: "A-GIRL" is a unique game that combines anime-style, top-down shooting, and multiple adorable beast girls. Come and explore the fascinating game world with these cute beast girls.

title: AFK Chess
description: A PvP chess auto battler! Strategically build your army, use tactics to position your pieces and then watch them fight against your opponents! Can you assemble the strongest force?

title: Aerofly RC 10: RC Flight Simulator
description: Aerofly RC 10 is the ultimate radio controller flight simulator for beginners and experts alike.

title: Bockito
description: In Bockito you'll have to fight against a horde of hostile pine cones and other enemies. To do this, equip yourself with different items, learn abilities and combine them into different builds to survive.

title: Black Mountain Kings
description: You were thrown in a strange world. You are alone, and you got nothing. What to do next? You decide it! Explore, defeat monsters, get riches, learn new abilities, discover secrets, and learn the truth.

title: Birthday Boy and Benny
description: An emotional story-rich game with an emphasis on exploring the unknown, surviving abuse, dealing with inner demons and disabilities, making a ton of cakes, and dealing with the fact that not everything lasts forever.

title: Bemis Wamilton Racing
description: Drive with Bemis Wamilton race in this race game with electronic racing cars against other competitors

title: Betrayal Beach
description: Crashed on a strange island, survivors must forage, craft, and complete objectives to stay alive. But ferocious beasts, harsh weather, and secret saboteurs seek to make sure they never escape. Betray your friends or survive the island in Betrayal Beach, a 4-8 player social deduction survival game.

title: Swordfish
description: An aquatic action game. Swim sword first into the deep to destroy the evil at the heart of the ocean.

title: Five Nights at Treasure Island 2: Original Revamp
description: You're Greg, you've been working on Treasure Island for a good few months, until, one day, your boss signs you up for another position, you're going to work in Treasure Island's main power building which supplies power for the Island's attractions and lights, you're a night guard in there for 5 nights due to recent reports of suspicious activity. Your job is to find out what's happening there. Nothing will go wrong right? On an island of Disney Dreams.

title: The Binding of Isaac: Fall from Grace
description:
Do you have what it takes to keep it cool in the Boiler?

Face off against brand new challenges in this alternate floor to the Downpour! Weave through seas of steam, and slay blistered freaks in this mod, which has been created by some of those who have worked on mods such as Fiend Folio and Revelations!

title: AIV: A-Ressha de Ikou 4 - 15th Anniversary
description: As a celebration of their 15 year anniversary, Artdink re-released a few games as a 15th anniversary edition. This re-release of AIV was programmed to run on Windows 98 as well as previous versions, which hadn't been able to play this game prior.

title: AIV: A-Ressha de Ikou 4 - XP Taiou-ban
description: 2004 reissue of the fourth entry in the A-Train series from 1993, officially compatible with Windows versions up to Windows XP.

title: A-Ressha de Ikou: The 21st Century - Limited Edition
A-Ressha de Ikou: The 21st Century - Perfect Set
Anno 1800: Definitive Annoversary Edition
description: Improve your experience in Anno 1800 with the Definitive Annoversary Edition as part of the brand’s 25th Annoversary celebration!

title: Bionicle: Kanohi Klash
description: A fanmade 1-on-1 fighting game based on the Bionicle toyline from Lego.

title: Freddy in Space 3: Chica in Space
description:
Freddy in Space 3: Chica in Space is the 3rd title in the "Freddy in Space" series. The Game Jolt page is fully themed as a game for the upcoming "Five Nights at Freddy's" film but was just another troll by Scott Cawthon that pokes fun at the different parts of the fandom all the way from memes to Rule 34.

Based on the upcoming Five Nights at Freddy's movie, experience the movie's storyline as an interactive adventure. For those who don't want the movie spoiled for them, I would recommend staying away from this game until after next week! MAJOR SPOILERS AHEAD!

title: Marionetes
description:
Marionetes is a narrative-driven 3D platform adventure game about a discarded marionette.

Painful and sad performances of a brilliant marionette. Trown in the furnace by her creator the poor ballerina has to learn how to live without the strings.

title: Monkey Party
description: Merge balls, unleash adorable monkeys, and build a tower of fun in Monkey Party! Master precision placement for maximum monkey mischief. It's a charming puzzle adventure that's easy to play and hard to put down!

title: Fire on the Mountain
description: Fire on the Mountain is a 5 map limit-removing episode for Doom II and is my first proper mapset. Difficulty is slightly above Doom II, so this WAD should be fairly easy going.

title: Ghost Road
description: “Ghost Road” is the first installment in the Ghost Road series of games, and is a visual novel game about the myth of ghosts and monsters in the Chinese underworld. The player plays the role of the Ghost Detainer in the underworld to investigate the past deeds of the three female leaders.

title: New Leaf Traveler and Youth's Memories
description: New Leaf Traveler and Youth's Memories "is a short story RPG that involves playing the role of a young owner of a forest tavern and trying to run your own business to repay your debts. Meeting various guests and understanding their stories...

title: Young Hearts
description: ‘Young Hearts' is a visual novel in the genres of romance and slice of life, telling stories about the everyday life of a student company living in a warm southern town: stories about their secrets, dreams, love, their problems and ghosts of the past…

title: Xatrom Command
description: Team up and shoot down waves of invading aliens. Single player or multiplayer top-down shooting action

title: War Maze
description: War Maze is a turn based strategy game based on chess! Position yourself and take down the enemy pieces to win!

title: Yeah! Wow! Hey!
description: High difficulty multiplayer 3D platform jumping game. The high requirement for view control plus less tolerance creates more challenging levels.

title: The Raindrop: A Vocal Odyssey
description: Become Poseidon's voice and harness the elemental power of ice, water, and vapor in this enchanting 2D platformer, drawing inspiration from the rich tapestry of Greek mythology. Your voice becomes the key to unlocking intricate puzzles in a visually striking world.

title: Tugboat Terror
description: A frantic and exciting task-management adventure game where you play as Alessandro, a fish with human legs, and pilot a tugboat through a dangerous swamp of radioactive monsters.

title: Ultimate Scroll
description: This is a casual card game set in the backdrop of cultivation-themed Xianxia world. In this game, players control cultivators who challenge demon caves, search for treasures in the treasure pavilion, and overcome tribulations in the heavenly tower to enhance their cultivation levels.

title: Uncle Nook's Survivors
description: Uncle Nook's Survivors is an action rogue-like game. Survive an onslaught of monsters and become the ultimate monster killing machine by upgrading your character with unique weapons and abilities.

title: Sunken Stones
description: A turn based Puzzle-Strategy game about pirates and cursed treasure. Choose a captain, gather your crew and defeat monsters by strategically placing units on a 5x5 grid.

title: Stunt Xpress
description: Become a delivery van driver. The best in the world. Take part in internationally renowned delivery van driving championships. Shoot your parcels (on time) into customer's homes like a marksman while performing gravity-defying stunts and being chased by god knows what.

title: Strange Adventures
description: This is an action adventure game where players need to manipulate the protagonist to traverse the steep canyon, constantly improving their operational skills while exploring unknown terrain and fighting against enemies.

title: Snail Simulator
description: Have you ever wanted to be a snail? Now you can be! Move around (very slowly)! Look at the beautiful (low poly) scenery! MMOS (Massive Multiplayer Online Snails)! BECOME a snail (in a simulation)!

title: Skolly's Adventure
description: Explore a sky filled with floating islands as Skolly, an unusual adventurer in search of all the hidden treasures of this forgotten world.

title: Silkbulb Test
description: Take the test!

title: Spooky Dwellers: Collector's Edition
description: Unleash the power of the talismans of light, cast out lurking spirits, and transform Grandma's haunted house into the ultimate Halloween party destination!

title: Shattered Lands
description: One Game, Three Modes Survivor Mode: Frenetic Combat, Endless Loot Hunts Auto Chess Mode: 280+ Skills, Infinite Strategic Depth Story Mode: Open-World Exploration, Squad-Building Mastery As an indie game, it is of high quality and definitely worth owning.

title: Seed of the Dead: Charm Song
description: Seed of the Dead: Sweet Home expansion has arrived! This time the theme is "Idol"(?) Five new stories and stages have been added, bringing the excitement level to a new high.

title: Prostitute Island
description: Build the best love hotel in the world and have tons of sex every day!

title: Quinn & Flynn
description: A mature queer visual novel, telling the heated and convoluted story of the love triangle between Quinn, an obsessive police detective, Elias, Quinn's direct superior, and Flynn, a poet with a very talented tongue, caught in a criminal case that spirals rapidly out of hand.

title: Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke
description: Romanticized Dreams of a Post-Apocalyptic Cowpoke is a top down action shooter with randomly generated loot, levels, and enemies. Find unique weapons and upgrades to blast, explode, laser, and kick your way through an army of dastardly bandits!

title: Mineblast
description: Destroy whole levels using TNTs and have fun with the physics of Mineblast.

title: Mother's Embrace
description: 'Mother's Embrace' - indie horror game set in a remote Latvian town, where the unforgiving winter serves as the backdrop to a harrowing story. You return here only to find your childhood home eerily deserted, its once welcoming streets now shrouded in a deafening silence.

title: Project Terra
description: In a strange and hostile world, Raka, an exploration robot, finds themselves alone and separated from their friends. Help them reunite with their companions and unravel the mysteries hidden within this new world.

title: Princess Chessboard
description: “Princess Chessboard” is a turn-based casual light strategy card-building game based on dice. As a warrior in the animal kingdom, please go and find the runaway princess.

title: Only Up 2
description: Reach new heights in "Only Up 2," set in a mysterious world above the clouds, brimming with secrets waiting to be unearthed. Embark on an ascent like no other, the only limit is the sky.

title: Orc Survivor
description: Orc Survivor catapults you into a harrowing world where the roar of the crowd is deafening, your adrenaline is pumping, and every step taken could be your last. Survive as an orc warrior imprisoned and thrust into the merciless Colosseum. Will you conquer or become just another forgotten casualty?

title: Pico Topia
description: A tiny citybuilder where you combine islands to gather resources, complete missions, unlock new buildings and increase your build area.

title: Once Upon a Time There was a Twin-Tailed Sister Princess Who Was Very Unfriendly.
Odyssey Island
description: Odyssey Island is a punchy party-based action RPG. Fight dangerous beasts, go fishing, argue about the meaning of family, commit crimes or simply chill on deck with your new-found crew.

title: Nerd Survivors
description: Use explosive pizzas, enchanted fidget spinners or a katamari of monsters to fight countless enemies hordes! Repair the "Forge of Destiny" and craft the ultimate custom weapon in this comedy action rogue-lite survivor.

title: Pumpkin Game
description: "Pumpkin Game" is a falling object puzzle game in which players try to pile up as many vegetables as possible so that they do not overflow from the basket. When two or more vegetables collide with each other, they combine and evolve into a larger vegetable.

title: Mayhem Mail
description: The mail has been scattered! Take on the mail route from hell, recover and deliver the mail to its rightful place! Mayhem Mail is a classic single screen arcade platformer in the vein of Donkey Kong, Bubble Bobble and Mario Bros. with some added puzzle elements.

title: Mareld
description: Mareld is a card-driven Roguelike role-playing game where you play as a traveler lost in the Lost Forest. You will recruit companions, collect resources, craft items, explore the world, defeat enemies, find your way back home, or uncover the secrets of this extraordinary world.

title: Marron's Day
description: Marron's Day is a silly adventure game where you're a bunny! You love your friends but love carrots even more. Explore the town, run errands for your animal friends, and don't let anyone catch you swiping the carrots from the garden (again)!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Bewitched Garden Set - Halloween 2022
description: Host a spellbinding pizza soiree with this set!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Mysterious Antiques Set - Halloween 2022
description: Make your pizzeria frighteningly fantastic!

title: Legend Of Peks: Halloween Horror
description: Welcome to the Haloween Horror DLC Pack!

title: Irritated Mind: Fear of Warehouse
description: After a tragic incident, your relocation to a new city leads you to a warehouse job with chilling twists. Survive 7 grueling work shifts, evade relentless enemy threats, and uncover the mysteries shrouding your character's past, where an intricate narrative unravels amidst retro-inspired graphics.

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Nature
description: Jigsaw Puzzle: Nature offers 30 unique levels in a relaxing atmosphere. Go on a colorful adventure through the seasons and complete beautiful jigsaws!

title: Kana Ka-Boom
description: Kana Ka-Boom is for those interested in starting their journey of learning the Japanese language, and for those looking for a fun way to practice and retain their Katakana and Hiragana skills.

title: Katsl
description: Welcome to Katsl, the island town for cats! Unleash your inner architect and craft cozy nooks for your adorable kittizens. Dive into their world, discover their dreams and quirks, and weave them into your feline tale. Time to unwind and let your paw-some adventure begin!

title: Hell Games
description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this 4 player action arena brawler fallen Olympians, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

title: Heroes de Peronia
description: Save the kingdom by fighting the rats and their cronies, restore the health of the people.

title: Impossible Bunny Challenge
description: Surf the wind as a Bunny and race against three other Bunnies to collect checkpoint balls. The game features a robust racing AI that is very challenging to beat. You’ll have to learn quickly if you want to beat the Impossible Bunny Challenge!

title: Freestyle Studio
description: Rap battle others, practice your freestyling skills, advance in the rapping community. Freestyle Studio is a fun way to practice your rapping skills, whether that be alone or against others.

title: Fresh Story
description: Fresh Story is a visual novel about one girl's difficult journey. She will face difficulties and hard decisions to achieve a peaceful life as she dreamed.Diana came from the suburbs to the big city to achieve success and a happy life with her boyfriend Vlad.

title: Gaula Survival
description: A third-person survival game, explore territories and settle in. Surviving this hostile world is the name of the game.

title: Goblin's Die
description: Goblin’s Die is an Action-Adventure RPG with a hint of 90’s PC games. You, and up to 4 online goblins, are the new worker recruits. Explore, Scavenge, Craft & Eliminate. Loot everything. Be greedy. Contribute only what you dare to part with. Turn your Hive into a force to deal with. Goblins might die in progress.

title: Dino Tower Arena
description: Lets beat'em all! In this dinosaur combat roguelike, you will build and upgrade your own dinosaur with lots of special abilities and fight over enemy dinosaurs while going up the floors of a enormous tower

title: Fifth World
description: This is a very interesting puzzle game.

title: FoMO
description: FoMo is a psychological and first person horror game where inexplicable events throw your boring life off track. Walk between your destroyed neighborhood and bloody workplace, go through labyrinths, be stealthy and avoid the monsters. Struggle to survive as you look for a way out.

title: Data Garden
description: A text-less comic-game hybrid about data, interaction and digital identity playable with only one button.

title: Crystal Comet
description: Team up with your squad & take on the galaxy in this frantic twin stick space shooter "Squad em' up". Play single player with the AI or drop in / drop out local co-op!

title: Cozy Island Idle
description: Cozy Island Idle is a cute and relaxing idle game where you catch all sort of fantasy fishes to showcase them in an Aquarium. You can sell them to turn a profit and customize your island.

title: 100 Pumpkins 2
description: Explore, solve puzzles, and fight your way through over 100 screens and return your pumpkin pals!

title: Alaca
description: Alaca is an action rogue like game with a Top down perspective. While it contains different types of weapons and elements, you must build and master your character by combining them in the most correct way. There is no save point. kill, build character, learn and repeat..

title: Broadsword: Warlord Edition
description: Broadsword: Warlord Edition is a turn-based tactical strategy game set to historical events of medieval conflict. Assemble your armies and put your tactics to the test, in Broadsword: Warlord Edition.

title: Burning Sword: Death Sun
description: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a Wuxia hack n' slash game. Play as the great fighter, Zhāng Yì Xiàn, who seeks revenge for the death of his family at the hands of China's powerful Gāo Tiān Qí. Dive into a tale of revenge, redemption, martial arts, and intense swordplay.

title: Cosmic Cursor
description: Cosmic Cursor is an arcade roguelike that combines kinetic melee-based combat with a dynamic bullet hell. Use the cursor to control a vast array of ships and survive increasingly complex enemy swarms as you battle through the cosmos.

title: Brave and Desire
description: Brave and Desire is a party battle roguelite RPG with a structure and events that change every time you start! Advance through the dungeon using a route selection system and aim to step through the innermost part of the dungeon!

title: Block The Monster
description: The way I make it becomes the way! A round at the square block! Square Block 3D Tower Defense with various routes and strategies! Turn the tide of battle by deploying powerful heroes. How many waves can you hold on until the defense collapses and breaks down?

title: Blacksite Theta
description: A 3D puzzle platformer developed as a project for the 2023 UW-Whitewater Capstone Course. Harness your newfound mutant arm powers to conquer challenging terrain, ultimately unlocking your path to freedom by solving puzzles and navigating treacherous obstacles to escape the facility.

title: Archery Showdown
description: Archery Showdown is a local PvP platformer where you can challange with your friends in an archery-balistic 2D fighting!

title: Arcane Fighters
description: Arcane Fighters is 2D platform PvP where you can fight against your friends using magic, strategy and ... MAGIC! Choose from many unique spells and set up your build to outsmart opponents. Still early access so stay tuned!

title: Aquatia
description: Dive into Aquatia, a third-person anime-action RPG game, where you'll become the master of water magic. Experience the graceful aqua ballet, using water magic to defeat monsters with finesse.

title: Little Problems
description: Little Problems is a Cozy Detective game about solving mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.

title: Minecraft: Star Wars - Path of the Jedi
description: For Minecraft players who want to experience the thrill of being a Jedi Knight, Minecraft Star Wars: Path of the Jedi offers an immersive experience that lets you train as a padawan, battle monsters, duel other Jedi, and master the force. Support the Jedi council during the clone wars and join on a special mission with Yoda to uncover the mysteries of an uncharted planet. The experience is complete with your droid companion by your side and lightsaber at the ready.

title: Plants vs. Zombies: Cubed
description:
Plants vs. Zombies: Cubed is a Quilt-only mod made to bring Plants vs. Zombies content to Minecraft. The objective is to add as many plants, zombies, and references from the PvZ franchise as possible.

Build defenses with your favorite plants, try to survive for as long as possible against the ever-increasing zombie waves in survival mode, stage fights between plants and zombies in creative mode, hypnotize Gargantuars and ride on them, and more...

title: Minecraft Education: Planet Earth III
description: BBC Studios and Minecraft Education are teaming up once again to reimagine Earth’s most intriguing corners (and creatures!) into an explorable, blocky format!

title: Project Michael: The Halloween Nightmare
description: Project Michael: The Halloween Nightmare is a Horror Adventure game which invites the players into an atmospheric adventure nightmare.

title: The Return to Freddy's Classic
description: The Return To Freddy's Classic (formerly known as Five Nights at Freddy's 3 Fan-Made and just Five Nights at Freddy's 3 before that) is the first game in the TRTF SAGA and the first game in Volume 1. The next game in the series is The Return To Freddy's 2, though The Return To Freddy's 3 would chronologically be the next game.

title: Dink Smallwood HD
description:
Dink Smallwood is a humorous role-playing video game. It was first released in 1998 before becoming freeware on October 17, 1999. It was developed by Robinson Technologies, at the time consisting of Seth Robinson, Justin Martin, and Greg Smith. Mitch Brink composed several of the game's music tracks, while others are MIDI forms of classical music such as Debussy's Reverie. The game has a small but dedicated fan following that continues to develop add-ons for the game more than a decade after its release.

The HD version features remastered soundtrack, new quality of life features, built-in mod support, an upgraded engine, and gamepad support.

title: Abandoned: Discovery Island
description: Abandoned: Discovery Island (Five Nights at Treasure Island: Found before V0.8.0) is a fanmade revival of Five Nights at Treasure Island, a fangame based off of Five Nights at Freddy's by Scott Cawthon and Abandoned By Disney by Christopher Howard Wolf.

title: The Lords of Midnight
description: Mike Singleton's '84 classic Adventure Strategy game, brought to and updated for modern platforms.

title: Five Nights at Treasure Island: Room Zero
description: Five Nights at Treasure Island: Room Zero is the upcoming Five Nights at Treasure Island and Five Nights at Freddy's fan-game

title: Minecraft: Tricky Trials
description: Tricky Trials is an update for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition filled with daring adventures and surprising rewards. Hunt for the trial chambers, and take on the challenge that awaits you in this sprawling copper structure. Fight off unfamiliar foes like the bogged and the breeze in your hunt for an elusive trial key! Then unlock your reward from the vault, a block that makes adventuring fun for every player, no matter the size of your party.

title: Amnea 28: Dve Vechnosti
description:
Amnea 28 is a story about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. The purpose of the trip is the old hotel "Amnea", which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago, and now serves as a secluded corner for the professor. During the week of studying, each new day the atmosphere is inexorably changing.

Why did the students suddenly start acting strangely? What are they hiding? The main character will have to figure out the secrets of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel will not let her leave alive.

title: Tree of Ashes
description: Tree of Ashes is a 2D bullet heaven game set in a dark post-apocalyptic fantasy world. You play as an emissary of an ancient AI tree that sends you out onto the banished land in hopes of fighting off the evil, returning the world to its peaceful state.

title: Sylvio: Black Waters
description: Stranded on an alien planet. Witness the past to discover the truth in a game of enthralling atmospheric exploration horror.

title: Bottle Can Float
description: Bottle Can Float is a relaxing casual game. In the game, you will select a bottle to go down the river. It will float freely along the flowing water. You can do You can influence the direction of the bottle by throwing small stones, and there are different small animals hidden in the river. You can make rafting more interesting by looking for these contents. I hope you can relax and have fun in the sound of gurgling water.

title: Vampire Survivors: Whiteout
description: The 1.7.0 patch for Vampire Survivors brings a new snow-inspired special stage, Whiteout, 2 new weapons, 1 new character and 2 new relics, with new achievements about the new content.

title: Super Rare Mixtape: Horror Edition
description: After lying dormant for a while, the Super Rare Mixtape is back! The curator of the Mixtape, Ryan Brown, has once again carefully collated a collection of 30 games and 8 game demos from small developers in the grassroots indie game scene onto a single USB drive, playable on your Windows PC. And this time, they’re all horror-themed!

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip x Cult of the Lamb
description: Embark on a road trip like no other in this co-op narrative survival adventure. Visit fun locations, meet wacky characters, and manage your resources wisely. And yes: you still can date some hot monsters.

title: Repose
description: Repose is an dark exploration/puzzle game. In Repose, explore, fight, and maintain a healthy sleep schedule as you descend the twisted levels of the corporation that hired you for unknown reasons.

title: My Friendly Neighborhood: Neighborhorde
description: Something scary is happening with everyone's favorite Saturday morning puppet show... Fend off puppets and solve puzzles in this survival horror adventure.

title: Dread Delusion: Rise of the Skeletons
description: A new update has been brewed for this especially wicked season. A new isle has appeared! Are you ready to explore and uncover its secrets? We've also added a bevy of combat tweaks, sound, and other general adjustments.

title: Bite Size Terrors: Eye Candy
description: The Other Side of the Screen Shows a Truly Disturbing Truth.

title: Funeral Toll
description: A bloody war has caused the dungeons to explode with an incursion of prisoners, but this has lead to an excess of torture and violence. Now the dungeons are abandoned, and those who are left behind in the darkness are waiting for adventurers to meet their nightmares.

title: Creepshow
description: Get lost in a deliciously dark horror anthology. Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow series, this point-and-click adventure has gone all kinds of wrong.

title: Amanda the Adventurer 2
description: In Amanda the Adventurer 2, the story continues as Riley encounters a mysterious masked figure after destroying the TV in the attic. Travel to the Kensdale Public Library and dig deeper into the mystery of Amanda the Adventurer.

title: Korekiyo's Epic Quest for Pussy
description: Korekiyo Shinguji, everyone’s favorite problematic anthropologist, wakes up one day with an almost irresistible thirst for pussy. Uh-oh! What will he do? What kind of wacky adventures will he have? What kinds of friends and foes will he meet on his journey? Find out in this silly and funny new RPG, Korekiyo’s Epic Quest for Pussy!

title: Cavern
description: Experiment, Explore, and Swap in Cavern, a roguelike sandbox. All objects in the world can be swapped out at will. Swap slimes into harmless pots, turn enemy projectiles into countless health potions, and discover hidden interactions to conquer the ever-changing depths of Mirror Cavern.

title: Cat Fred Evil Pet
description: Care for a cute cat Fred. If the pet is displeased, a horror game will start!

title: Cats Hidden in China
description: Find 100 cats hiding in China in this cute hand-drawn hidden object game

title: Culture Warz: Time's Up Karen!
description: In a world not too dissimilar from ours, social media has rotted minds of the masses turning them into zombies driven by a primal urge to be the most insufferable versions of themselves whilst feasting on brains of the rest of humanity. Who will defeat these social stereotypes? It can only be Chad.

title: Crush Link TD
description: Protect your inbox from spam to find a message from your crush. A Tower Defense game with new mechanics in virtual setting about online dating.

title: Airport CEO: Helicopters
description: Lift your airport to a new standard with helicopters!

title: 14 Minesweeper Variants 2
description: Minesweeper but the rules are changing, again.

title: Tsukumogamis!
description: The not-at-all heartwarming school gag game ”Tsukumogamis!". Sumika, a girl possessed by a half-human Musubi, born of a Tsukumogami god father and a mother of kotodama, is a reclusive and scruffy JK! Will Musubi be able to collect many "good words" and become a man of his own?

title: Coin Toss Rainbow Simulator
description: Coin Toss Rainbow Simulator. Made in Hong Kong. Toss the coin and test your luck. By Unreal Engine 5.3.1.

title: Y. Village: The Visitors
description: Batu, tormented by nightmares, is lured to a nameless village via cryptic letters. Investigating the village's secrets with just one friend, he wakes one night to discover his ally gone. He must now locate his friend and elude the village's dark mysteries.

title: Trouble Magnet
description: Accompany Charlie, who is transported to different times in the universe, in surviving the challenging nature of the ocean and returning to his own time.

title: Yahtzee Girl
description: Let's strip her down with Yahtzee game! Test your skills and dice luck Maybe I'll get a chance to touch her?

title: VoxelScaper
description: Build your perfect diorama.

title: Vlad Voievod Dracula: Dungeons of Edirne
description: While being in the Ottoman capital of Edirne, Vlad Voievod Dracula descends into the dungeons to save a great warrior sentenced to death, so he might join Dracula to take the crown of Wallachia. A casual relaxing game, in the Vlad Voievod Dracula franchise, that takes place before Episode 1.

title: Wizardry: High School Exam
description: Pass your magic exam with flying colors by surviving a final test within our dungeons. No worries, even though there may be numerous, highly resilient, and quite deadly exam golems, there is still time for you to excel, enhance your abilities, and learn a few new spells along the way.

title: West of the Witchlands
description: West of the Witchlands is a twin-stick shooter / roguelike about killing ancient gods with magic and revolvers.

title: Wishbound Desires
description: Embark on a visually stunning 2D roguelike deck-building adventure set in a Japanese-inspired fantasy world. Strategically craft your card deck during battle, enhancing and personalizing the cards with powerful rewards, and embark on an enchanting journey filled with mysteries and romance.

title: Xenos: Cartoon Creature Catcher
description: A retro creature collector/pet battler with a focus on hunting rare variants and making every Xeno unique. All Xenos have random stats and move-sets that vary even within the same species! Delve into a light-hearted world full of parody and fourth wall breaks while learning the world of Xenos!

title: Zorro and Zedd
description: Slay Dragons, collect magical gems, unlock ancient powers, and adventure through the mystical land of Dundalk as Zorro and Zedd. Vanquish the dreaded Dragon Lords, defeat the Dragon King, and retake your Homeland for all Bat-kind!

title: The Dungeon
description: In the dungeon, a legendary endless treasure awaits. Countless brave adventurers have come, but none have unveiled its secrets. Monsters and traps fill the dungeon. Are you courageous enough to conquer them and claim the final treasure?

title: The Knowledge of Hermit
description: Non-Linear Top-down action-adventure-puzzle game with Power Ups & Health Upgrades.

title: The Witch and the Bottle of Concept
description: The meat pigeon game of Demon City, with meta elements, allows you to experience the joy of breaking the fourth wall, a refreshing sense of strike, and difficult battles. Do you want to challenge the thrill of harmless clearance?

title: Transporter
description: Transporter is a platformer racing game. Your goal is to preserve your goods, maintain balance, and overcome obstacles with at least one item left at the finish line. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

title: This Side Up
description: Simultaneously control four players who fall in different directions in this mind-bending puzzle platformer. Together they stand, divided they fall!

title: Towercore: Survivors
description: The dark creatures are coming, and you are the only obstacle to stop them. Survive night by night in those monster-infested lands! Towercore: Survivors is a challenging dark fantasy survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.

title: Two Hour Escape Mystery: A Puzzling Voyage
description: You're trapped on a strange ship! To escape, you must solve puzzles, explore unique rooms, meet a couple interesting characters, and uncover a mystery to figure out why you're here. Who knows, you may even stop something bad from happening along the way… Bon voyage!

title: Trouble In Paradise
description: Dive into an adventure where you unlock characters, control vehicles, and master your weapons. Solve puzzles, relax by beaches, and shop at local markets. Collect 'kilos’ for snacks and health. Enjoy retro visuals, hand-drawn cutscenes with amateur voiceovers, and a groovy original soundtrack.

title: Travel Knight Adventure
description: The Medieval Action Based RPG with guns and magic. Pirates, zombies, wizards and dragons! Catacombs full of treasure and puzzles.

title: Travel Along
description: Travel Along is a hidden object game where you collect stamps, postcards and coins while searching objects around the world!

title: Sporeborn Dark
description: Break out of a labyrinth surrounded by darkness, infested with growths and filled with disgusting monsters. Explore randomly generated locations of the experimental area to find something that will help you delay your demise. Dark, atmospheric, creepy horror roguelike.

title: Starpuffs
description: Your Starpuffs are in trouble! You need to rescue them! Split and merge your way through over 100 increasingly challenging and complex levels in this cute and colourful puzzle game. Can you save all the Starpuffs?

title: Start a Startup with a Legendary Japanese Warlord
description: A short visual novel with quizzes to help you dip your toes into the world of startups.

title: Stellaris: Astral Planes
description: Includes a new core system and technologies. New planes to explore. New branching narratives.

title: Suero Zeus
description: Consigue armas e items que te ayuden a abrirte camino por las regiones infectadas de monstruos sedientos de sangre, ayuda a los pobres sobrevivientes que encuentres en tu camino y encuentra la manera de resolver acertijos que dificultan tu gran escape.

title: Super Picture Cross
description: A casual and stimulating nonogram puzzle game with endless logic puzzles to solve. Uncover a huge variety of 3D objects, and discover new puzzles - never run out of fun.

title: SwapPics: Knights vs Demons
description: Swap pictures of your kingdom around to complete your buildings. Direct the Knights and soldiers from your building to fight demons and capture middle kingdom.

title: The Dollmaker
description: The Dollmaker is a first person horror game, where after being captured, you find yourself searching a mansion for a way to escape. But the Dollmaker and his creations will be searching for you, will you become a part of his collection?

title: Taimanin RPG Extasy
description: Super-popular Taimanin RPG is now available on Steam! The Taimanin take the stage in a classic turn-based RPG! Commander Skills, Formations, and Ultimate Skills... Make good use of them and be victorious! Battle alongside Taimanin whenever you want! From this day forth, you're a Taimanin!

title: Hoover Dam
description: The monsters have taken over one of our most prized national landmarks. The Hoover Dam has been infested with hell-spawn and it's your job to clean house! Battle your way up and down canyon ledges and caves in this very large, very detailed level. You'll want to stop and enjoy the view as you look up at the majestic Hoover Dam. Just don't stand still too long or you'll be toast! Your final objective is to get to the top of the dam and stop the baddies before they blow it up. Are you up to the task?

title: The Bleeding Tower Of Pisa
description: Another piece of human history has been desecrated by those ruthless Hell-spawned monsters. The Bleeding Tower Of Pisa is an affront to everyone on Earth and they've called you in to set things right. First, you must find a way into the tower. Then clean up the mess, floor by floor.When you've collected the keys, and "taken out the trash," head to the basement for the final showdown. Remember: in the Bleeding Tower Of Pisa, blood will flow. Try not to let it be yours!

title: The Villa of Pain
description:
The "Villa of Pain" awaits. The monsters have infested this quaint country villa. The owners called Terminix and Orkin, but the Imps just ate the guys they sent out. Now they've called you in. You begin in the courtyard and must figure out a way into the building. Once inside, your mission is simple: destroy everything in your path.
It's time for you to clean house! And bring a mop, there'll be plenty of blood.

title: Shadows Labyrinth
description: Embark on a journey through the enigmatic realm of shadows, battling countless creatures to unveil the path towards emancipation.

title: Souls Survivors
description: Fight hordes of enemies, face unique bosses, learn powerful abilities, and explore a huge and diverse map. Souls Survivors combines Hack&Slash mechanics with Roguelite elements and gives you a straightforward and easy to understand yet deep and complex Action RPG game.

title: Skies Above
description: When the last Leviathan begins its dangerous escape from the planet, as the leader of a small warrior group, it's your turn to protect it from the robot army of the greedy mega-corporation.

title: Silent Depth 2: Pacific
description: Silent Depth 2: Pacific is a lite sub-sim. You enter the Silent Service at the command of a Gato class submarine on War Patrols during World War 2. How long will you survive, and ultimately how much tonnage you sink is down to skill and cunning.

title: Sex Latex
description: Sex Latex - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Sex Play: Tropical Vacation
description: A quick and dirty game made for your pleasure. Contains visual novel elements and a sex simulation part. Take your girlfriend on a tropical vacation and enjoy complete privacy.

title: Seeing Things
description: SEEING THINGS is full tilt surveillance horror. Keep your eyes locked on security cameras for an outrageous collection of horrific anomalies, suspicious movement, and the occasional T-Rex. Observe, detect, survive!

title: SCP: Bloodwater
description: SCP Bloodwater is a strategy management defense game inspired by the SCP Foundation's SCP-354, also known as the Red Pool. Take the role of a newly appointed Site Director at the Red Pool Containment Zone, harvest valuable organic material, and defend the facility against the Red Pool's attacks.

title: Scarlet Manor: The Heir
description: Unravel the mystery of the Scarlet Manor! Embark on a 2D point and click horror journey, solving complex puzzles and uncovering the secrets hidden behind the walls of the mansion. The Manor awaits you.

title: SaGaS
description: SaGaS is a project based on new Chinese grotesque Cthulhu theme, integrating the old Hong Kong retro style and background settings of the 20th century. It is a fan project based on Scara-Ei character shipping from Genshin Impact. The game uses puzzles and maze solving as its main gameplay.

title: Savage Girls
description: Choose between Kelly a cyborg or Uldra a legendary warrior and fight in this classic style Beat 'em up with spicy rewards.

title: Rodent Rumble
description: Assemble your squad and mark your territory in Rodent Rumble! Level up, scavenge, and scrap with other rodents in a chaotic, all-out team vs. team scuffle to conquer the neighborhood!

title: Rival Goals
description: Set real-life daily goals, unlock more characters, and discover the mystery behind the Space Siren who brought you all together. Drink more water, go for a run, do your homework, or anything you need! Make your dreams come true!

title: Queer Quest: All in a Gay's Work
description: There's a naked bike ride blocking the road. Ryan's selfies suck. Stevie Hix needs some tape for tucking. Oh, and your hot girlfriend is missing.

title: Princess Knight's Mission: Anna's Marvelous Adventures
description: The princess of the kingdom, Anna, received news of the resurrection of the Demon King. Despite her frustration with the demanding duties of governance, she donned the hero's attire blessed with the "Divine Blessing."

title: Pseudo-Haunting
description: Fend off spirits by ripping your spirit off your body. Explore a glitched haunted house. Recall twisted memories. Get out alive.

title: Project Overnet
description: Project Overnet is an exhilarating and immersive digital card game where winning requires strategy and execution. Resolve the pattern challenges and harness the power of your M.I.N.D to prove yourself worthy to become the first OverKnight.

title: Paranormal Files: Trials of Worth - Collector's Edition
description: Paranormal detective Rick Rogers is on the case after two archeologists from the same expedition are found catatonic, but the real mystery has only begun!

title: Poly
description: Simplistic roguelike shooter, Blast your way through countless enemies while earning powerful upgrades which turn you into a shape obliterating machine! 50+ upgrades with countless synergies and stacking effects!, Unique enemies which have unique abilities.

title: Lucky Dungeon
description: Delve through a series of dungeons full of terrors. Fight battles by stopping a board full of your equipment and skills. Press your luck to gain battle resources, but be careful. One bad roll and you can lose everything. This game doesn't contain any real-world currency gambling/microtransactions.

title: Legacy: Witch Island 4
description: - Beautiful enchanted forest landscapes. - Several Logic mini-games - Unusual application of hog-scenes. It is possible to bypass the object search. - The plot is designed to last 5-6 hours.

title: Moonbase Lambda
description: Moonbase Lambda is a horror survival game which you have to escape from a procedurally-generated maze. The premise of the game is that an unidentified creature breaks into the moonbase, which leaves you no choice but to survive and escape from it.

title: Mycelium Guardians
description: Isometric strategy game, you command a collective of fungi in a post-apocalyptic Earth. Utilize mycelium to build structures, manage resources, and mitigate environmental threats. Your choices shape the balance between life and desolation. Engage in strategy to be Earth's final line of defense

title: No.HazedHeart
description: This game is a casual strategy game that requires players to overcome multiple challenges and connect with beautiful girls' hearts. Players need to operate the two sides of the heart and guide them to reach the destination at the same time, in order to win the heart of the girl.

title: Mycelium Heaven
description: It's a cozy yet challenging puzzle game about a mushroom that devours zombies. You'll expand, grow and consume your way through the forest using your wit and reason.

title: Omg! Not Another Isekai
description: Seo literally wakes up in the lap of a beautiful girl from another world. A world filled with sword fighting, magic spells, and legendary beasts. Follow Seo and learn more about this brand new world! Make choices that affect dialogue and the game's ending.

title: Island Ops
description: "Take a step, dive into Island Ops! Unexpected obstacles await you that secret agent Blade must overcome with his skills. Additionally, the secrets of hidden experiments and mutations lie in the depths of this story. Are you ready for this action-packed adventure?"

title: It's Kooky: Land of Aotearoa
description: Welcome to another kooky game! This time, you will explore the lands of Aotearoa and discover all the hidden quirky elements throughout the game which is full of challenges, histories and, most importantly, fun!

title: Knightess in Debt
description: Build your own deck and battle, as you gamble your way to freedom and love.

title: King Static
description: Whoever defeats the king shall be granted a wish. Style your way to the king's tower or die trying in this hack and slash rogue-like game with combat heavily inspired by classic character action games like DMC.

title: Horace Hagfish
description: In Horace Hagfish, players engage in a top-down puzzle game that revolves around color mixing and matching. Plan your moves to mix colors, collect orbs, and unlock the exit without generating the color brown.

title: Hiding Star
description: Single player game with puzzle elements and survival in a mysterious building, where you are chased by a mad attraction - Toothy Jack, who serves Hostess. Use Ball Gun to solve puzzles and move forward.

title: Hidden World 5 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Gem Galaxy
description: Decorate the board by stratetically placing gems to build up your highscore.

title: Fantasy Blacksmith Shop Simulator
description: Step into the enchanting world of 'Fantasy Blacksmith,' where hammers clang, furnaces roar, and raw materials transform into awe-inspiring arms. Forge your destiny today!

title: Emberville
description: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

title: Elements: Path of the Wizard
description: A card game where you will be responsible for the fate of an entire kingdom. Try on the role of a wise court magician, who is able to prevent a catastrophe with just a wave of his hand. At your disposal will be valuable magic items and all the existing elements.

title: Easy Red 2: Ardennes 1940 & 1944
description: Command history in Easy Red 2: Ardennes 1940 & 1944! Blitz through the early chaos of WWII's Invasion of France, then brace for the brutal winter battles of the Ardennes campaign. Will you rewrite the pages of history?

title: Furry Feet 2
description: The long awaited sequel to the hit "Furry Feet" is here, and improved in every conceivable way.

title: Grog
description: Grog is a roguelike game directly inspired by having played the original Rogue on a real PDP-11 during Roguelike Celebration 2018.

title: Ghoul Smash
description: Ghoul Smash is a turn based physics game similar to Graffiti Smash and Monster Strike where you smash into enemies, fight bosses, and loot items. With simplistic click-and-drag controls you can experience the thrill of smashing enemies into dust while gaining dopamine fueled rewards!

title: Goob
description: Embark on an epic journey into the depths of a mysterious and treacherous underground world. This immersive adventure combines exploring vast and mysterious caves teaming with ferocious monsters, mining for precious minerals, and continuously upgrading your abilities to survive.

title: Battle Record: Graizor
description: As a war threatens to engulf the world, a small rebel army with there new mobile weapon, Graizor, may be the world's last hope for peace. Destroy enemy mechs with the combination of a sword and energy rifle on your journey to bring an end to a devastating war.

title: Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude
description: A boy regains his hope and a girl finds herself in solitude. A kinetic novel telling the stories of two young adults overcoming their darkest days.

title: Dragon Bobby: The Story of a Life
description: A uniquely beautiful game with third-person exploration and puzzles that tells the story of a man's life from birth. You control a dragon who is an analogy of this man in the story. A true reflection on life.

title: Dragon Eclipse
description: Choose your Tamer and fight dangerous creatures with the help of your companions - powerful Mystlings! Travel the mysterious world of Dragon Eclipse. Catch and train Mystlings to create your own team! Build a strong card deck and make efficient synergies of three Mystlings to fight your enemies.

title: Diari
description: Arise player, welcome to Diari! Explore the world of Ekrose with Aimacra, giving them insight as she traverses through platforming and puzzles to meet her friend Sirestias. Guided by intuition and emotion, you will shape Aimacra through her journey and how it all ends.

title: DCS World: F-16C First in Weasels Over Syria Campaign by Ground Pounder Sims
description: Strap on the mighty F-16C Viper and enter the world of the Wild Weasels! First In - Weasels Over Syria will immerse you in this legendary mission as you fly head on into the enemies air defenses.

title: DCS World: MAD Black Shark Campaign by Stone Sky
description: The principle of deterrence was founded on the notion that a nuclear attack by one superpower would be met with an overwhelming nuclear retaliation such that both the attacker and the defender would be annihilated.

title: Daemon Sigil
description: Defend your village from an eldritch invasion in this creature collector, turn-based card battler. Train your favourite characters through a Roguelite upgrades system. Assemble a formidable daemon squad and journey to an otherworldly realm to close the last portal!

title: Darkworld
description: In Darkworld, you’re a snailf living your best life in the shop of a blacksmith. Listen to his clients to learn more about their stories, do your best to clean their weapons and improve your snailf’s business in this cosy video game when even hammers are cute!

title: Weapons Factory
description: Quake II's spiritual successor to Team Fortress with jetpacks and grappling hooks; alternate classes, weapons and gadgets.

title: Weapons Factory Arena
description: Remake of Weapons Factory on the Quake III engine.

title: Enemy Territory Fortress
description: Remake of Quakeworld Team Fortress on the Wolfenstein: Enemy Territory engine.

title: Strike Force
description: Strike Force is a realistic team combat simulation in which players take the roles of either the infamous Terrorists or covert Strike Force operatives, in missions that could change the fate of the world forever. You will choose from one of 16 characters, each with his or her own special training and characteristics, and select real-life weapons and gear with which to wage war with your enemies. You will need sound tactics, quick reflexes and solid teamwork in order to prevail.

title: Strike Force 2004
description: Official followup to the tactical shooter Strike Force on the UT2004 engine. A retail release for PC and Xbox 360 named Strike Force: Red Cell was announced in 2005 only to be quietly cancelled.

title: Boost Beginner
description: This game is a modified version of Cave Story, and is targeted at players who have played around with the original and are more experienced.

title: 9-Bit Armies: A Bit Too Far
description: Unleash voxel warfare in 9-Bit Armies: A Bit Too Far. Lead a modern military, build bases, unlock units, and attack in all-out war. Engage on land, sea and air in over 30 missions, online skirmishes, or co-op. Easy to learn, a challenge to master.

title: Alleys
description: The end of the Callisto campaign should have meant well-earnt retirement for you, marine.

title: Wonderful Doom
description: Wonderful Doom is a 2007 megawad for The Ultimate Doom created by Eugene Guschin (Wraith777), containing 36 levels created in the style of the original levels.

title: 2048 Units of /vr/
description: This project contains 32 maps in the main wad, plus an additional 6 that didn't make the cut contained in the extra wad. Inspired by projects like MAYhem 2048 and Congestion 1024, we sought to make a project with similar restrictions: make a boom-compatible map where the playable areas are within a 2048x2048 unit space and optionally use textures from gothictx.

title: Doom 404
description:
DOOM 404 is a 32-level, vanilla-compatible (complevel 2) megawad. Every map was built with 404 lines or fewer, as a nod to the project name, to keep the map design focused on the key concept for each level.

It's a sad life on the Space Marine IT Help Desk. Especially when you're stuck on the graveyard shift. Night after night of "Did you try rebooting?" Not exactly what you expected when you signed up.
You figured this call would be more of the same: some garbled voice mail about "gremlins in the system". Gremlins? Seriously, how old is the guy who left that? Ninety five? He probably remembers vacuum tubes.
Now you're here though, something isn't right. This facility should be busy, but it's silent. Almost desolate. You're starting to feel glad you brought that popgun they issued you with to make you look like a real soldier ...

title: Dark Covenant
description: 12-level episode for Doom 2, with new graphics and music. Starts out in a small suburban neighborhood and takes you from demon-infested cityscapes to deep inside the earth, and finally into space...

title: Demon Plague
description: The only cure for this plague is your trusty shotgun. Your mission is to clean out the demon infestion of a long deserted, slime-encrusted outpost. This level was inspired by the general 'look' of many Quake levels.

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou+: Outbreak
description: A remastered version of Outbreak that was initially included in the PC release of Hou with improved graphics.

title: TGsEE
description: TGsEE, which stands for This Gives some Extra Enlightenment, similar to TBmHC, is a teaser game for the original 1.0 version of Treasure Island.

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou+: Kamikashimashi Chapter
description: A remastered version of Kamikashimashi-hen that was initially included in the PC release of Hou with improved graphics.

title: Path of Trials
description: Save a friend in an exciting platformer with a cat hero! Complete challenges and uncover the story of friendship. Beware of mistakes, plan every jump, and achieve success in this captivating platformer.

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou+: Hinamizawa Bus Stop
description: A remastered version of Hinamizawa Teiryuujo that was initially included in the PC release of Hou with improved graphics.

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou+: Mehagashi Chapter
description: A remastered version of Mehagashi-hen that was initially included in the PC release of Hou with improved graphics.

title: Higurashi When They Cry Hou+
description: The tragedy of Hinamizawa is over. Those held captive within its grip are free from the fate that bound them to June 1983. Yet the tale of Hinamizawa is not truly complete. There are many worlds not yet explored.

title: Ciconia When They Cry: Phase 2
description: Phase 2 will be the second story arc in Ciconia When They Cry. It was originally delayed to an unspecified date in 2020 but has since been delayed indefinitely.

title: Duludubi Star
description: A promotional 3D platformer released in 2008 that ties in to FantaWild's theme parks. The game has you control Duludubi, a blue dinosaur who's one of the company's mascots, as he ventures through 5 themed worlds to save his sister, Duluduni, from the evil Dr. Octopus.

title: Guess The Movie
description: Guess the movies, TV shows & cartoons with the best movie quiz! Great trivia game about movies!

title: Beast Mode: Night of the Werewolf Silver Bullet Edition
description: Unleash your inner beast, rack up epic kills, and dominate the leaderboards in this over-the-top Arcade Action spectacle!

title: JFCBP1
description: JFCBP1 is the first Community Build Project to make use of the extended map limits given by the JonoF/EDuke32 ports - so of course one of either is required to play

title: JFCBP2
description: A community build project utilising Jonof port's new build limits to make a bigger and more detailed map. The aliens have taken over a moon base and it's up to Duke to terminate their occupation with extreme prejudice.

title: Gothams Industrial District
description: From the author of the I.C.E. addon and following in the same hi-tech slash industrial fashion, Gotham's Industrial District is an extensive network of buildings with various industrial purposes - from pumping stations to courtyards, to plain old generic structures full of bleeping computer equipment.

title: Lively Chair Simulator
description: This game has slightly strange controls. By controlling each leg of the chair individually, you can make the chair walk, run, and even jump. It also supports online multiplayer games with 6 types of chairs to choose from and 3 modes.

title: Duet Night Abyss
description: Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom developed by Hero Games' Pan Studio. The game features "multiple weapon loadouts & 3D combat" at its core, and tells the story of "Demons" from dual perspectives.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Flip or Flop
description: Help SpongeBob cook Krabby Patties for his customers all throughout shifts. Watch out for special orders and Patrick, for he is hungry.

title: RTE Worlds
description: Dive into a thrilling multiplayer survival adventure in RTE Worlds. With a dynamically generated world, random dungeons, and limitless replayability. Explore by land, sea, and air, and immerse yourself in a captivating story brimming with quests and unforgettable NPCs. Your epic journey begins here!

title: Total Apocalypse
description: Duke has to kill the Cycloid Emperor, and he go out from Los Angeles, now destroyed and occupied by the aliens. His only intention is to inform the situation to the OTAN and EDF Central Command, and he has leave the heavy guns. He only carries the small pistol. But the situation is seemingly impossible, and he will trip through a dangerous way that he did can't wait, and now is too late! A lot of environments he will see now, and the situations will change through the battle. He has dream that the Total Apocalypse prophecy comes true...

title: American Assault
description: Following the events of "The Birth," aliens come to screw up Duke Nukem's vacation. Now it's up to Duke to travel across the United States of America and stop the alien invasion.

title: 25th Century Duke
description: 25th Century Duke is an add-on episode set in the 25th Century, a time where the global population is exceeding the 300 billion mark. The environment has been depleted so much so that the creation of oxygen now rests in the hands of big industries. The cities of the world reach higher and higher for the clouds. Scenarios not dis-similar to those found in the cult movies BladeRunner and The Fifth Element.

title: Aqua 1
description: Find the Mini Aqua sub and get your ass out of there as soon as possible.

title: Aqua 2
description: You have arrived in the stolen mini-sub and now you must fight your way to gain entrance to the experimental battle sub which will take you to the Island Prison in Aqua3.map

title: Aqua 3
description: Fight your way out of the battle sub and then prepare to take on the Aqua prison which has been overrun by escaped alien maggots. Blow them away and get you butt to the prison shuttle to Io...

title: Bad Weekend
description: A 7 level episode with two secret levels (nine levels total)

title: Burnt
description: Very action packed with a lot of monsters in each of the maps.

title: Leaving L.A.
description: Duke is sitting in a Motel room watching TV. After he defeated the alien invasion, he has been bored for some time. Suddenly someone knocks on the door

title: Holiday Holocaust
description: Duke is up against something far greater and more powerful than your standard army of bloodthirsty aliens. This time, Mother Earth is out to get him !

title: Research Station
description: The EDF had been receiving some radio transmissions from a weather research station at the north pole. The scientists that worked there had been reporting to EDF about strange sounds at night and that some of their sled-dogs had been killed. EDF decided to send in Duke to investigate a few days after the transmissions had stopped.

title: Hasit
description: 'hasit' is Czech for extinguish and in not breaking with tradition accurately describes the theme of the level. You start out in a burning apartment from which you'd do well to escape, which of course requires running through flames in an attempt to sound a fire alarm, which results in a fire truck crashing through a wall. Escape? Not quite - you've now got a half dozen pig cops to contend with.

title: Palace Charitas
description: Palace Charitas is a reasonably small, intermittently detailed gentleman's club of sorts.

title: BJ Shrine
description: This is the first Community Build Project. Instead of creating each section anew, mappers have taken the best bits of their previous levels and joined them together.

title: Community Build Project 2
description: The idea of a CBP is to put some parts from different mappers all together in a single map. In this one, each mapper made a new contribution, a room which was built specially for it.

title: Community Build Project 3
description: A map built by 10 different builders. So 10 different styles everything is SP. Basically same idea as CBP2.

title: Community Build Project 4
description: The fourth CBP is all that you'd expect, although it's focused more on blowing things up than using your head.

title: Community Build Project 5
description: Community build project with a dark, scary, snowy city map

title: Community Build Project 6
description: The aliens have taken over an island base and it's up to Duke to kick their asses out of paradise.

title: Community Build Project 7
description: The seventh CBP was initiated by Supertanker back in January 2006. We decided to work under the old limits and focus on one theme - hitech (the level turned out to be very consistent with its theme)

title: Community Build Project 8: Metropolitan Starlight
description: Duke comes out of the rest room to find his beloved domed city in orbit around the Earth has been overrun by aliens. You must explore the city and find a way to unlock the central spire which contains a nuke button that causes the city to self-destruct, as it's the only way to guarantee wiping out all the alien scum before they make it to Earth.

title: Countdown to Christmas
description: Episode contains 3 independent levels (Snow Battle, Christmas Tree, Christmas Carol), united by small intros. Have new textures, sounds and effects.

title: Crucial Conflict 1: Suspicious Storage
description: During the neverending fight against the alien domination, mankind has seen many strange and shocking things. Women being kidnapped and held in cocoons, average day streetlife being brutally disturbed by the unknown power from outer space... With huge efforts, the Earth Defence Forces (EDF) have been able to stabilize the situation. Now it is time to fight back and stop the invasion.

title: Crucial Conflict 2: Waterworld
description: After a routine flight above Western Europe, Duke Nukem, EDF's best agent, crashed on the roof of a storage facility near Rotterdam mainport, in The Netherlands. Completely dazed he tried to find some help or at least contact the outside world, but none of that worked out. He encountered aliens instead and not one humanbeing seemed to be alive. Only some notes and logs where left.

title: Crucial Conflict 3: Acupa Dylana
description: Duke pursues the aliens, but is too late. Rotterdam has fallen a prey to the alien cruelty. With a totally massacred population, the city looks strangely deserted.

title: DN64 Revisited
description: 3 Duke Nukem 64 Exclusive DM maps morphed into a SP Episode Experience

title: Duke Nukem Is 007
description: While intended to become a James Bond TC, this project was never finished. However, 6 really nice maps remained. You will visit interesting locations like a flying plane, an underwater base or a Russian missile silo.

title: Duke is Ten
description: A group of premier mappers from the community had just three days to create a set of maps centered on the theme "ten" to celebrate DukeNukem3D's 10 year release anniversary.

title: Duke in Los Angeles
description: Duke travels to L.A to clear out remaining aliens, 11 levels, new textures and weapons and many new sounds.

title: Dukeland
description: The aliens stole Disneyland and brought it into space! Duke has to bring it back to Earth in this short (1h) fun ride through 2 detailed levels. Sightseeing and action merge!

title: Escape From San Angelos 2
description: This level takes place in a couple of cityblocks partially destroyed and with heavy earthquake activity.

title: Escape From San Angelos 3
description: Just like map number 2 this level takes place in a couple of cityblocks and rooftops. Even though the level 2 is more navigation friendly than this one.

title: Escape From San Angelos 4
description: Unknown to most, the aliens have a secondary reason for being here; our transporter technology. Our system is closing the gap with their system and they don't like it.

title: Escape From San Angelos 5
description: Having successfully escaped san-angelos, found the transporter to the alien home world ( levels one thru three ), and liberated the clandestine transporter research facility ( level four ), the time has come to deal with the real evil.... the alien sympathizers.

title: Eye of Cul
description: 17 maps for atomic edition with urban setting and some levels inspired by Blood

title: FbSp001
description: Military installation with snowy scenery, similar in style to maps of the BobSP Series.

title: FbSp002
description: Remake of XXX-Stacy from Duke3D ep.4.

title: FbSp003: City Under Siege
