description: FbSp003: City Under Siege is pretty much exactly that, a city in the process of becoming another alien stronghold. As usual it's your job to do the down and dirty, getting in there and clearing out the invaders

title: Hydrostation
description: Duke Nukem, who is a veteran agent of EDF, had a very hard work the last 6 years. And now it was time for vacation :) Duke was on the coast of California for 3 months enjoying that he finally got some free time, and then, he returned to the EDF Headquarters to bring his help again.

title: Incubation: Alien Apocalypse
description: After the killing of the alien queen in "The Birth" Duke rents an apartment in LA so that he can get some rest before he falls apart. However he didn't kill all the aliens in the first campaign and now those remaining have started to regroup. Find the remaining stronghold of the aliens and kick their asses off the planet; for good.

title: Industrial Complex
description: Episode with 6 levels (1 briefing w/o monsters, 1 secret) featuring new textures, sounds and a new shotgun.

title: JJ Duke Nukem 3D
description: Duke crashes down in a stolen alien cruiser but this time he is a little closer to home. Look for the new features. There's a special powerup called the SuperDukePak and a new actors amongst other things.

title: Jungle Tour
description: Duke is sent into a jungle to find a research center overrun by those alien scumbags

title: Jungle Tour 2
description: A canyon styled map with tropical scenery.

title: Jungle Tour 3: Ice Age
description: The sequel to Jungle Tour 2, this level follows very much the same 'fight for survival' pattern as its predecessor. There's no puzzles, just a huge, icy landscape with plateaus, rocky outcroppings and caves.

title: KaiseR Land 01
description: A level which explores the under-exploited aquatic base theme

title: KaiseR Land 02
description: The map begins exactly where its predecessor left and infiltrates even deeper into the deep sea. However, everything gets spicier when you get out of the base and confront a peculiar world of uncertainty.

title: KaiseR Land 03
description: The highly-anticipated sequel to KaiseR Land 02 takes place (unlike its predecessors) in an medieval environment, a theme which has not been stumbled upon too many times, surrounded by lovely decorations and the typical alien vermin afoot.

title: Skola
description: A recreation of what can only be described as a school of sorts

title: Sicilie
description: Short trip to a jailhouse, fire station and adult bookstore.

title: Banka
description: Duke visits a bank to withdraw his funds there

title: Doly
description: Explore an abandoned mine shaft and enter a submarine later to escape

title: Boyard
description: Very puzzle-oriented. Collect six letters for the exit password while opening doors in a fort.

title: Vlak
description: The task in this 2D game is to control the train and collect various objects with it, which will be attached to the train in the form of a wagon. After hitting a wall or wagon, the level is reset. After collecting all the objects, just go through the gate to the next level.

title: Aliens
description: Waking up from deep sleep on a space station, you find the place overrun by aliens; your only option is to destroy the reactor and get the hell out of there in an escape pod.

title: Letiste
description: Fight through an airport and a parked airplane.

title: XXX
description: A visit to a brothel with "recreational" areas

title: Petrin
description: Inspired by the Petřín hill in Prague, you enter a viewing tower full of alien scum.

title: Reichskanzlei
description: You have to visit the Nazi city hall in Berlin, and wipe out the Nazis of the aliens

title: Lost Highway
description: 7 levels (1 secret) with well-designed highway passages, vast canyons, a huge dam and even a cable car (if you find the secret exit).

title: Math-Pak
description: 5 levels (1 secret, 1 for credits without any action)You start in a common city area before entering a desolated factory. The last regular level is set in war-torn Bosnia with great ambient sounds, some traps and destroyed buildings.

title: Mic
description: 3 levels, increasing in difficulty and complexity. First, you go through a prison complex before entering an "Anti-Duke" training center where the aliens learn how to fight against Duke. In the finale, you have to find the power plant to shut down the whole installation.

title: MSSP
description: Features a grandiose storyline with new enemies, music, sounds, textures and sports 8 levels. Defeat the new emperor and stop the alien engineered plague...

title: Operation Blitzkrieg
description: 5 levels in an urban setting with rather small-sized maps that won't take you longer than 10-15min to finish each.

title: Mp Power
description: A map with an airfield and a power plant facility.

title: Mp Weapon
description: A map with lava

title: The Flaming Shipwreck
description: Aliens have decided to grab a beer at a modernised British pub in Lynnchester called The Flaming Shipwreck, slaughtering the local folk and causing all sorts of trouble. Being too much for the local police force, Duke has been assigned to remove their presense from the area.

title: Dark Side: Moonbase Mayhem
description: Reimagination of space map E2L8 "Dark Side"

title: X3 Studios
description: Reimagination of E4L7 "XXX-Stacey", but a lot bigger than the original

title: Bank Roll 2000
description: Reimagination of E3L2 "Bank Roll"

title: Duke Royale Remake
description: Replica of E4L4 for the PSX-exclusive episode "Plug 'n' Pray

title: Shark's Cove
description: Two Caribbean-style maps which were supposed to be the beginning of a full episode that never got finished.

title: Steve Long Episodes
description: This 32 level-pack shows the evolution of the author's mapping skills. Therefore, the first few maps are very basic.

title: Wet Dream
description: 2-level mini episode, consisting of HighWire's "Wet Dream" and "Tropical Alien Massacre". Great design with Caribbean setting, featuring fitting custom art and challenging gameplay.

title: Tam Duke
description: 9 maps (+1 secret) which rely solely on stock Duke3D assets in the making for 10 years. A special feature of this addon are its high-detailed sector-based cars and the fact that the levels are based on real locations (in Tampere, a city in southwest Finland)

title: DukeVR
description: DukeVR's idea is simple: Three episodes, eighteen levels, three colors (blue, green and red) and lots of nasty puzzles. Levels are short - shortest (simplest) levels take about twenty seconds while bigger & more complex ones take more than a minute.

title: The Army of Death
description: Castle Camelot has been taken over by a bunch of skeletons and your mission is to bone 'em to death.

title: The Final Confrontation
description: One of the first episodes (7 SP levels, 1 DM) for Duke3D. Especially famous for its train map "Moving Death".

title: Duke Lost Episodes
description: Contains 40 new levels, The 4 Lost Episodes of Duke Nukem, way back when he was still working for the CIA (see Duke Nukem I). Apparently, before the fight with Dr. Proton, he had fought off an alien invasion of Earth (though more in secrecy), the selfsame ones that tried again later during Duke Nukem 3D.

title: The Prequel To Time
description: 4 maps which are more focused on design and combat. Like in its predecessor "Time", you still have certain things to do, but it's much less like a real mission.

title: Vacation Cove
description: 8 new Caribbean levels (1 secret)! Powered by an awesome soundtrack contributing a lot to the "vacation feeling", you will pay a visit to lagoons, a Mayan temple, a fun park and many more places where shotguns are needed instead of sunglasses! Even features a mini hub to which you return to for about 50% of the episode.

title: Outpost X
description: A two map mini episode: Duke is dropped off on a planet to investigate reports of an alien takeover.

title: MP Research Facility
description: A research facility has found an alien base on another planet. They aliens however fought back. They shot Duke out of they air in combat. Now he's really pissed off!

title: MP Orbit
description: A medium singleplayer level in space

title: Operation Kolpowitz
description: Infiltrate a nuclear arms facility set in the mountains, make a lot of aliens dead, launch a nuclear warhead and be home in time for Emmerdale Farm.

title: Hazardous Chemicals
description: A dark, dank but thoroughly interesting level set in a chemical facility

title: The Railway Station
description: The Railway Station is a short to medium sized level centered around none other than a railway station - and of course it's populated by alien scum

title: Total Infiltration
description: Total Infiltration is a six-level episode which takes exciting gameplay and alienesque design to a whole new level

title: Hijack
description: Duke hitched a ride on an alien shuttle and will try to borrow an alien transport pod so he can infiltrate the alien base.(ie.. the next level)

title: Suburbia
description: It's urban/heavy industrial themed, which contradicts the name of the map, with multi-leveled train track.

title: Hell Station
description: A truly magnificent space station map

title: EDF Overtaken
description: A remake of a bobsp inspired map

title: Q-Red
description: A remake of Red1 (from the Red series)

title: The System: Opposing Facility
description:
A small island with a base has been overtaken by the aliens,
same old story and it's up to Duke to fix the problem. However what is there reason to take over an abandoned area anyway?

title: Simple Minded
description: A challenging maze-like city by which takes the form of the name from our beloved hero

title: Enlighten The Darkness: Again
description: A top-notch romp through a medieval-ish fantasy realm, where dragons be and yon dungeons lie.

title: ARSP1
description: A smallish city map with a few of your basic urban ammenities; movie theatre (entrance, at least), strip club, etcetera.

title: The Spiegul Contest
description: 3 city maps from a contest with the goal to use a small street area with mirroring windows and continue building a map based on that area. Only three entries made it into the final poll, with MRCK's and Taivo's maps both winning and Devastator's one getting the second place.

title: The Starlite Project
description: Starlite takes you to a top secret research facility which is surprisingly devoid of anything to stop you from simply walking in

title: Daemonus
description: A large medieval-ish castle set in the middle of the sea

title: Powerstation 64
description: A moonbase map that was originally only for DM but has SP added retroactively.

title: Babes
description: This is a modified version of babes map which was released a long time ago

title: The Chronic
description: A 5 level episode made by Sanek with help of Zykov Eddy in the first map.

title: Quest for 2Moo
description: The newly-christened Vriskye arrives in a forest.

title: Occult Case Files: Case One
description: Occult Case Files is an homage to the point n' clicks on the NES like Uninvited, Shadowgate and Deja-Vu. This demo was made over the course of 2 months and if reception is well we'll go full steam ahead and make it into a fully fledged game (After The Third Shift of course)
A celebration map for 3000 youtube videos. This was a speedmap and filmed progress.

title: 200 Line Massacre: The Slaughtering
description: 200 Line Massacre: The Slaughtering is a megawad (full 32 maps + 4 bonus) by @Arsinikk and @NinjaDelphox with the goal of making Vanilla slaughter-like maps under 200 lines. It is the sequel to 100 Line Massacre and also features additional mapping by @scwiba and @finnks13.

title: Night on Doom Mountain
description: A lengthy and difficult single level for Boom Compatible ports with a slightly otherworldly and halloween-esque theme.

title: Pony Arcadia
description:
Several pony kingdoms compete for territory, but never battle each other - they live in peace after all.

However, each player also controls an evil villain that will happily cause trouble...

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 10
description: Team up with Guilds of up to 24 pirates, compete with other crews on your server for the Skull of the Siren Song, or take it easy on the Safer Seas,.

title: Godless Night
description: Godless Night is a GZDoom episode with the Supercharge gameplay mod built in. It features very light hub elements, loads of (mostly subtle) Castlevania inspiration, and plenty of secrets to find - especially for challenge-enthusiasts.

title: The Bugs Manor
description: The Bugs Manor is a free 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay, focused on direct interactions with the environment. Can you survive your first night in this haunted house and uncover its mysteries?

title: Clown Meat
description: Clown Meat is a Precision Platformer with an emphasis on speedrunning and replayability. Tumble through a butchered world where humanity is barely a memory on your naïve journey to cheer up the monolithic clown that came from the Depths of Jupiter.

title: Toytopia
description: Explore the abandon ruins of Toytopia experience the wonders that were once seen at this once amusing attraction. Always check behind your back because something is always lurking near you, meet the varying cast members of Toytopia and try your best to survive.

title: Hypercube: Source
description:
Hypercube: Source is a HL2 deathmatch mod. It takes place inside of the same cube that was seen in the moive "Cube 2: Hyperucbe". It has traps from all three cube movies, and has been designed to simulate infinite cubes in a finite number of rooms. The object of the game is to simply, get out of the cube alive.

There are three exits in this cube, and to make it more difficult only one exit is activated at one time. Its not easy to get out don't give up.

title: Iglacia
description: In this drawing-based roguelite, play as a penguin with a stash of powerful crystals to fight off hordes of enemies by drawing and shooting your way to victory!

title: 3D PrintMaster Simulator
description: The ultimate 3D printing simulation and management game! Dive into the world of 3D printing technology, where you'll build, customise, and manage your very own 3D printing workshop!

title: WWE 2K23: Bad Bunny Edition
description: Step back in the ring with international icon Bad Bunny with the WWE 2K23 Bad Bunny Edition*. Featuring a new Bad Bunny playable character based on his Backlash ‘23 appearance in Puerto Rico and more, plus all of the bonus content from the WWE 2K23 Icon Edition!

title: Anno 1800: Gold Edition
description: The path you choose will define your fate! Dive deeper into empire-building with the Anno 1800 Gold Edition.

title: Lost Inca Prophecy 2: The Hollow Island
description: Join Seraphine in this amazing adventure to save the world from its doom in Lost Inca Prophecy 2: The Hollow Island!

title: Early-blooming Black Lily: Itsuki-chan no Obentou
description: It'll be possible to play the new scenario, "Itsuki's Lunch Box!"

title: Shanshui Haven
description: Explore, Build, Prosper — Embark on a tranquil and strategically rich journey of city-building in ancient China.

title: Traveler: Set Sail
description: This is a semi-real-time tactical adventure RPG game. Adventure and battle in a high-freedom fantasy world! Meet different companions and embark on an adventure together. Different regions are inhabited by various types of creatures, awaiting your exploration.

title: Iruka ni Uroko ga Nai Wake
description: Specially to selfish Honey Mustard-chan who stays up until this hour, I think I should explain to her why dolphins don't have scales.

title: 1001 Jigsaw World Tour South Korea
description: An inspiring journey to the land of "morning freshness"! Collect fascinating puzzles, marvel at the beauty of snow-white beaches on the shores of the Pacific Ocean, see unique temples of South Korea and get acquainted with the national Korean cuisine.

title: Alruna and the Necro-Industrialists
description: Alruna is a compact and high-density Metroidvania, with a focus on sequence-breaking and playing things out of order.

title: Astro Planes
description: Astro Planes is a sci- fi fantasy space shooter. Laser blast your way through space and use powerful missiles to neutralize the enemy with explosive chaos and use your dashing ability to evade enemy fire.

title: Australian Maze
description: Are you afraid of spiders?, then this game is not for you. You will feel like a resident of Australia. There are more spiders in this country than stars in the universe. The spiders here are huge and each of them wants to bite you in the ass.

title: Aztec Tiki Talisman
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in Aztek Tiki Talisman! Explore 50 challenging levels in the mystical Aztec jungle, battle foes, solve puzzles, and confront epic bosses. Will you find the blue talisman and unlock the portal to the next level?

title: Back to Hearth
description: A cozy narrative-focused exploration game in which you repair the houses of an abandoned forest settlement to bring the former inhabitants back home after the Calamity has occurred.

title: Ball Hentai Puzzle
description: Ball Hentai Puzzle is a puzzle solving game with the objective of reaching the end with at least one life remaining. This game allows you to have calm and relaxing moments. Enjoy beautiful women while solving your puzzles.

title: Aversion
description: Experience the challenging events Iris faces through her journey.

title: Arsenal Online
description: High-octane 2D shooter. Put your shooting skills to the test with over 200 weapons and attachments. Play game modes solo or co-op online!

title: Baldr's Squid Isekai: A Parody
description: Baldr’s Squid Isekai is adult parody RPG with lots of cartoon violence and sex!

title: Agnostic Requiem
description: An AVG that records the struggles of girls in the melody of the times.

title: Aimcademy
description: Aimcademy is a science-based aim trainer. The combination of sport science and gaming leads to the most efficient way of training in gaming. Unleash your true potential!

title: Underground Waifus TCG
description: Underground Waifus it's a CCG, Deck Builder TCG with PVP Card Battler F2P Game.

title: Body Count
description: Embark upon a cop's gripping journey of vengeance through this bullet hell shooter.

title: Beneath the Backrooms
description: Beneath the Backrooms is an horror and exploration game; Lost in the Backrooms, your character will have to fight his/her mental health problems and monstrous creatures. In the darkness.

title: Blood Orange: Definitive Edition
description: Underwater psychological horror with a shocking, character-driven narrative. Explore ruins beneath the amazon river basin, and converse with their dolphin inhabitants. Skillfully capture and develop photographs with your underwater camera.

title: Cooking Simulator: Sushi
description: Start a new culinary challenge and run your own sushi bar in one of Japan's cozy street food districts.

title: Corgi in the Box
description: You are locked in an unfamiliar room with your beloved dog. Use the items in the room and cooperate with your dog to escape. There is a short story and three different endings. When you reach an ending, a hidden secret will be revealed.

title: Corked
description: A Ski and Snowboard game for skiers and snowboarders. Get Corked.

title: Chicken Done
description: The more stressful anti-stress game that eleven out of ten psychologists advice against. Dangerously addictive for neurodivergent people.

title: Cat Ball: Gravity Maze
description: Help our cat ball find the fish in a gravity controlled maze.

title: Build For Sale Simulator
description: Real estate simulation game. Buy, renovate and sell a house at affordable prices! Build your own real estate empire!

title: Bride into the Cave
description: Myth lingers in a tranquil and remote ancient town in China. In one telling, once a beautiful maiden is chosen by the cave deity, her soul disappears from the mortal realm. A minority girl called Miao Fei embarks on her journey to uncover the truth behind the legend, and rescue herself, perhap.

title: Carprogram
description: An application that lets you lay down roads, this is your future non-fictional story.

title: BrickBounce
description: Hit the right button corrrectly when the ball is upcoming to the brick , play the music with your keyboard.

title: White Wolf: Treasure Hunter 2
description: Free yourself from the Dark Magic of the Mystical Chest?!

title: Wild Seasons
description: Wild Seasons is a roguelike, card battler where deck-building meets base-building. Cultivate a garden that grows mystical cards, orchestrate unique decks as your plants go in and out of season, and coordinate strategic plays across multiple turns to unleash wildly powerful combos!

title: Zombie Rooms
description: The zombie apocalypse takes a hilarious dimension

title: Wound Man
description: Wound Man is your guide on a gruesome adventure through the ages. Piece his epic story together while literally piecing him together. Poke, prod, stab and slice away to reveal his secrets. It's a jigsaw adventure! - but not for the faint of heart.

title: World of Blocks
description: World of Block is a sandbox game where the player has complete freedom to build their own world, using shapes, objects, and textures customized by the player.

title: Welcome to Lightford
description: Dive into Welcome to Lightford, a captivating mystery detective sim set in 1998. Unravel the town's secrets with unique solutions for each challenge, pushing your wits beyond the ordinary. Can you crack the mysteries and navigate the small town of Lightford?

title: WarDoom Wargame
description: 2D Hard core, Hex & Chit, Turn Based Wargame with A.I. or Hotseat. Move units or stacks around, attack using all the info from live database and unit breakdowns. set your battle objectives in the battle report. A detailed Editor effect live game systems

title: Vellum
description: Dive into magic tomes to discover pages of increasing power, sling ink-infused spells, and choose how your foes evolve - as a group or solo!

title: Urban Entrepreneur
description: Manage inventory, staff, prices and more while creating a monopoly!

title: Virtual Rides 3: Northstar
description: A new ride was spotted at the Virtual Rides 3 fairground. The new ride "Northstar" gives its visitors a wild and unique ride with high G-forces.

title: Super Retro Retry
description: 100 levels, some are easy, some not, sometimes flipped horizontally, sometimes flipped vertically, always randomized! And ONE SINGLE LIFE. Customize your experience. Are you ready for the ultimate Retro challenge? Are you ready for Retry?

title: Taken Soul
description: Taken Soul is a survival horror game developed by SOGA Studio. The protagonist play in third-person perspective, he must navigate through dangerous and tense situations, try to survive till the sun rises, and fight against dark forces to investigate the disappearance of his mother and sister.

title: Mutants Ate My Carrots
description: A fairytale forest in decay. A black rabbit ready to fight... and a king lion who only looks out for himself. Unlock new skills and discover who stole your carrots in a humorous adventure full of fun puzzles and mutated kickass moves.

title: Taz Cebula's Brides of Vampira: The Circle of Seven
description: On the moon world Mordain, a suffocating veil of Eternal Darkness emerges. In a cryptic vision, the formidable warrior, Leia Blackthorne, crosses paths with a mysterious being - 'The Watcher' - who impels her towards the town of Grimstead. A foreboding darkness awaits her, veiling untold secrets.

title: Sticky Situations
description: Join the world of Stickman Battles! Dive into exciting gang wars, enjoy easy-to-pick-up gameplay, and have a blast with fun-filled stickman fights. Ready for the showdown?

title: Song Song
description: The story is about a detective This is a psychological puzzle game, The game belongs to the psychological horror genre.

title: Split Polarity: The Science Puzzle Arcade Game!
description: Get ready Scientists, things are about to get crazy! The atoms have become unstable, so it's your job to guide the highly volatile particles into the black holes. Play against friends in local multiplayer in Versus Mode, or attempt a high score in the Labyrinth.

title: Staff Runner
description: Unleash your inner musical maestro with Staff Runner, the captivating educational game that transforms sheet music learning into an exciting adventure. Say goodbye to dull lessons and hello to a fun, interactive way to read sheet music.

title: Uh Oh Calico!
description: Prepare yourself for a challenging, strategic, exciting and fur-strating puzzle game! Inspired by the popular Watermelon Game comes this 3D cat-tastic game of combining growing cats in a confined claw machine. Make combos and get the highest score without letting any cats fall out!

title: The King of Creation
description: This is a shooting game with exquisite game backgrounds and character images.

title: The Elision Effect
description: The Elision Effect is a short surreal puzzle game. The last person finds themselves in an empty office. Not knowing what made everyone abandon these liminal spaces, they look for an exit.

title: The Edibles
description: Play as a creature that woke up on an alien planet and destroy everything around you, picking up genetic information to evolve into the strongest creature you can find. Defeat the bosses hiding in the castle and get your hands on the magical orbs.

title: The Vorezkor Hack
description: Uncover an existential conspiracy, rescue your friend and save the world from mindless drudgery in this irreverent Sci-fi point and click adventure!

title: Roll the Ball
description: Balance, pace and win the race! Embark on a thrilling journey with Roll the Ball! Dive into vibrant visuals across three unique biomes as you race against the clock to reach the finish line. Choose from three engaging game modes, Time Rush, Challenge and Speed Run and try to reach the top!

title: Infestation Sea
description: Infestation is a Survival Horror MMO that immerses players in a zombie-infested, post-apocalyptic world in which a viral outbreak has decimated the human population leaving in its wake, a nightmare of epic proportion.

title: Solitary Cat
description: The ultimate lightweight solitaire featuring simple yet robust rules for hours of dark-mode fun! Based on Klondike, 40 Thieves, and Bakers Game.

title: Solitris
description: Solitaire, Meet Tetris

title: Shadow of Fear
description: In 'Shadow of Fear', your only purpose is to solve puzzles and then escape; You can also continue to survive, whether you can survive until the end depends on yourself

title: Sign Craft: Simulator
description: Sign Craft: Simulator puts you in the steel-toe boots of a Sign Technician! It is a 3D first-person game that allows you to utilize power tools and equipment to construct signs!

title: Skibidi Backrooms
description: Skibidi Backrooms is a cooperative horror game for a group of 4 players. Solo mode is also available. You have to survive among the backrooms and find a way out before you are overtaken by the Skibidi toilet. Updates and various interesting things await you...

title: Shadow of the Depth
description: Shadow of the Depth is a top-down action Roguelite game. Delve into a dungeon world of light and shadow to eradicate the monsters that ravage your home. Be prepared to step into the abyss before you!

title: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure
description: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

title: Robo Rush
description: Robo Rush is a fast-paced action platformer focused on finishing one level as fast as you can!

title: Santa World
description: Join the festive adventure and help Santa Claus in his quest to save Christmas in this captivating platformer game, Santa World!

title: Scent of Greed
description: As a psychology student, you find yourself isolated for an entire summer break in a desolate village. While trying to survive you must manage limited resources, explore, scavenge and unravel a chilling horror story. Yet, in this eerie place, you're never truly alone.

title: OTurret
description: OTurret - is an action tower defense game with elements of engineering and survival where you play as a brave frog defending itself against giant insects. Build various defensive structures, from cannons to magnetic traps, to help the frog survive in a dangerous world.

title: One Week With The Mafia
description: After a misuse of your home address, and the general incompetence of an old friend, you find yourself stuck with the Italian mafia hunting you down. In this parody of Scott Cawthon's "Five Nights at Freddy's", it is up to you to stop the mafia from wasting you.

title: Psychofinger
description: Survive hordes of ghosts in this FPS-roguelite. Become an agent at the Department of Metaphysical Investigations and unveil the mystery of an old church. Choose Aberrant Items that will upgrade your character, fight bosses and unlock new hand gestures.

title: Pizza Spy
description: The secret agent "Ace" represents the latest generation of spies: armed with improbable Pizza Gadgets, he will have to travel the world to thwart a global gastronomic threat. Test your skills in this action-comedy adventure game by the makers of “Detective Gallo”!

title: Pew Pew Squad
description: In Pew Pew Squad, battle zombies in a post-apocalyptic setting. Take out the undead, buy new weapons, and up your odds of survival. Fast-paced action and constant challenges await you in this thrilling game!

title: Pocket Race: Driver
description: Pocket Race: Manager is a miniature race driving game with simple controls, but demanding driving and some strategic elements and lots of different car parts. Push other miniature cars off the track into the void! Don't fall yourself...

title: Rift Survivors
description: Rift Survivors is a 2D survivor-like game where you grow stronger by arranging your inventory. Equip items to unlock hidden powers and create your own unique build. Cross the rifts and survive against endless waves of enemies!

title: Redial: Conundrum
description: Investigator risks it all to a uncovers fragments of the truth in Alaska linked to his best friend's missing daughter. Encountering security hurdles and dark secrets, he unearths forbidden and shocking revelations. Armed and determined, he aims to unveil the truth hidden in a perilous town.

title: Realtor
description: The year is 1998. Step into the shoes of a real estate professional, tasked with photographing a seemingly ordinary house for an upcoming sale. Explore the house, take pictures of each room an-... wait, what’s that in the last photo?

title: Crescent Satsujin Jiken: Hyena no Jijou
Nuclear Gladiators 3000
description: Congratulations, you have been selected to participate in the ultimate TV show! Survive hordes of ruthless mutants, upgrade your arsenal of weapons and skills and win fabulous prizes in this live broadcast action roguelike! Do you have what it takes to survive?

title: Nightmare Side: The Game
description: Indonesian horror game set in Ardan Radio station from Bandung. Don't listen to Nightmare Side alone, or you'll invite the darkness.

title: Nonlinear Door
description: This is the first indie game I've ever made, and it includes puzzle solving, mazes, math and more, and if you're confident in your maze walking and puzzle solving skills, I'm sure this game will help you pass the boring time.

title: Nonogram Nights
description: Nonogram Nights is a spooky puzzler where you use logic to uncover a mysterious picture.

title: Ninja Kato 1
description: First in the Ninja Kato series! Now available in the nostalgic portable game style! Clear all 4 stages and train Kato!

title: _Message:
description: A Korean interactive puzzle game.

title: Momon: Relic Seekers
description: Momon: Relic Seekers is a card battle game with roguelite elements, which takes place in the Tsuki universe. Help Tsuki recover her world, collect the relics, build your deck and fight monsters with the help of your Momons.

title: Midnight Ramen
description: In "Midnight Ramen", you play the role of a ramen stall owner who interacts with customers coming and listens to their troubles. However, amidst helping the customers, there seem to be some matters in your own life as well..

title: Midnight Cemetery
description: A Dark Adventure with Total Freedom and Multiple Endings according to your Acts. Travel by car to a remote Village to investigate Rumors of a Cursed Cemetery that supposedly is Zombifying its dwellers. Explore and Investigate with Total Freedom. Your acts have irreversible consequences.

title: Ikoka Game
description: Dive into a world of puzzles and strategy suitable for all ages and genders. Enjoy simple rules, deep challenges, and a competitive scoring system. Ideal for quick gaming sessions.

title: Imaginary Friend Asylum
description: Imaginary Friend Asylum is a psychological horror game where you play a patient at Hathmoore Children's Asylum. Along the way, you'll befriend 7 other children and their imaginary friends. Together, you will uncover a dark conspiracy where you are to receive a fate worse than death.

title: Infinite White: Hyperbolic Time Chamber Simulator
description: A walking simulator game where you walk in a completely void and empty space, similar to a Hyperbolic Time Chamber.

title: Joy Life 3
description: Joy Life 3 is still a casual flop game. In the game, players need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. If the cards on the flop are inconsistent, the cards will not change. If they are the same picture, they will be eliminated.

title: KunKunNight
description: This is a fictional story in which you will embark on a thrilling escape experience with a man named KunKun.The game contains scare elements. If you lack courage, please exit in a timely manner.

title: Kiken Drive: 2nd Lap
description: Accident and destruction and crash type public roads arcade racing game. Compete for time and damages.

title: Kingsgrave
description: Kingsgrave is an enchanting metroidvania adventure inspired by classic Zelda games. Assume the mantle of a resurrected king on a royal quest to rescue your subjects, restore the ruined kingdom, and rekindle its lost glory. The fate of the realm is in your hands.

title: Mendacium
description: Enter the prehistoric world dominated by primal reptiles. Fight through savage enemies and bosses with the combination of melee & ranged combat and elemental magic. Explore the vast handpainted world and try to prevent the meteor from wiping out all life on the planet.

title: Meet a Married Woman at a Hot Spring
description: This is a click game where you do naughty things with a married woman you meet at a hot spring.

title: Magic Escape
description: Join three adorable doggie companions in our enchanting escape puzzle game. Brew a witch's potion, uncover secrets, and have a spooktacular adventure together!

title: Little Survivors
description: Little Survivors is a short and accessible action rogue-lite, with an emphasis on simple but satisfying combat against monsters. Enter comic books, free animals, then use them to attack the vile Glurks!

title: Let's Be a Mouse
description: Let's Be a Mouse is a fun and engaging game that allows players to experience life through the eyes of a mouse.

title: Last Night Shift
description: Last Night Shift is a first-person horror game that creates a spooky atmosphere and tension. An ordinary night shift at a motel turns into a living nightmare.

title: Ice Fighter
description: Ice Fighter is a fast-paced Tower Defense-like game where you battle enemies, scavenge for resources, manage upgrades, and build defenses. Melt enemies during the night and plan your defense during the day.

title: House of Jigsaw: Vintage Revival
description: Relive the elegance of the past and embark the vintage charm in this expansion.

title: House of Jigsaw: Urban Lifestyle
description: Experience the pulse-pounding thrill of city life with House of Jigsaw: Urban Lifestyle DLC.

title: House of Jigsaw: The Best of Macro Photography
description: Dive into a realm where artistry and puzzle-solving intertwine with the House of Jigsaw: Digital Art Manipulation DLC.

title: House of Jigsaw: The Art of Still Life
description: Unleash your inner art connoisseur and embark on a journey through the captivating world of House of Jigsaw: The Art of Still Life DLC.

title: House of Jigsaw: Fascinating Landscapes
description: Escape into the serene yet treacherous world of natural wonders with the House of Jigsaw: Beautiful Nature DLC.

title: House of Jigsaw: Fantasy
description: Traverse through a variety of imaginative worlds, each offering its own set of magical Fantasy puzzles.

title: House of Jigsaw: A Day at the Park
description: Experience the charm and vibrancy of a leisurely day outdoors with House of Jigsaw: A Day at the Park DLC.

title: House of Jigsaw: Amazing Birds
description: Embark on an exhilarating avian adventure with House of Jigsaw: Amazing Birds DLC! Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant plumage, captivating habitats, and astonishing avian species.

title: House of Jigsaw: Beautiful Flowers
description: This DLC adds a burst of natural splendor to the House of Jigsaw universe, challenging you to test your puzzle-solving prowess in a garden of vibrant hues!

title: House of Jigsaw: Digital Art Manipulation
description: Immerse yourself in the boundless world of digital art manipulation in House of Jigsaw: Digital Art Manipulation DLC.

title: House of Jigsaw: Amazing Colors of the World
description: Unleash your inner puzzle maestro and dive into the multicolored landscapes of House of Jigsaw: Colors of the World DLC.

title: Eschatology
description: This is a snake like game with a pixelated style that is very attractive.

title: Fantasy Temptations
description: Fantasy Temptations is a captivating tile puzzle game set in a mystical anime world. Strategically arrange tiles to uncover enchanting characters and their intriguing stories. With every puzzle, the plot thickens. Dive into this fantastical journey today!

title: Farmieland
description: 3 endings

title: Gem Wizard
description: Gem Wizard: Match gems, cast spells, and collect relics as you venture through a perilous dungeon. Battle fierce foes, build your wizard's power, and face the ultimate boss to save the realm. A fusion of puzzle-solving and RPG action!

title: Futa Tales
description: Futa Tales, Woo-oo! These ladies are packing heat! Explore the depths of Futa City, to uncover hidden tales of the taboo. When the clothes start flying off, prepare to get a whole lot more immersive!

title: Foxingdale: The Magical Stones of Kentaroo
description: Explore the Kingdom of Foxingdale in this retro CD-I action adventure game, 90s Anime aesthetics

title: Flying 'N Frying Popcorn Dude
description: With your trusty frying pan help Popcorn Dude as he embarks on a sky-high escapade to sate his insatiable appetite for candy! But watch out! Mischievous clouds and pesky little devils want to spoil the fun. Can you keep Popcorn Dude soaring high above the threats?

title: Fiora Arc
description: Go through the complex life of B as he struggles to balance his life between the island that calls to him, and fighting his way to the top of the gangs of Cardigan.

title: Fat Goblins
description: Prepare for goblin-packed, hat-stealing, and princess-fattening team based 16v16 combat! Siege the castle walls, rescue your pudgy princess, fatten up the enemy princess with delicious meat, unlock new hats & weapons, and kill each other repeatedly in silly and chaotic PvP war!

title: Genkai: Primal Awakening
description: Combine tactics and strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder, where you must build your deck, train and evolve your team. Step into a mystical world where the Genkai battle in a quest for power and harmony, and prepare for the imminent arrival of the Primal Genkai.

title: House of Jigsaw: Romance
description: Prepare for a puzzle-solving adventure that celebrates the enduring magic of love in a way that is truly unforgettable.

title: Dracoslayer
description: Dracoslayer is a fighting game title with a heavy emphasis on elemental abilities and PvE action.

title: EscapeMono
description: Point & click to interact with strange creatures, find items, and solve puzzles in a dark, locked lab. Then just escape...?

title: Delator
description: Overcome your deepest nightmares and face your unavoidable fate. `Delator´ is a cosmic horror puzzle-platformer where you will play the role of a skittish doctor chosen by the cult of Delator to be the last sacrifice.

title: Dirty Room: Chapter 9
description: After climbing up with a ladder, you finally saw Dr. Q, who seems to be awaiting you. And have made up your mind to go after Dr. Q immediately.

title: Divine Prophecy
description: A simple and refreshing flying shooting game.

title: Definya
description: Easy Start, Endless Challenge: Begin with a beginner-friendly system that ensures a smooth learning curve. From novice to veteran, Definya's balanced gameplay offers a fulfilling experience.

title: DarkLight: Platformer
description: Welcome to the world of DarkLight: Platformer, where adventure and fun await you at every step. This exciting 2D platformer promises you an unforgettable journey through 150 unique levels and five diverse biomes.

title: Danny's Debt is Eternal
description: Danny's Debt is Eternal is a short, humorous adult game with fantastical H-scenes and plenty of eye candy. Help him replay the princess, and see how well he is rewarded!

title: Culture Warz: Time's Up Karen! - War Tagz
description: Kill the zombies and collect their tagz. They won't be needing them after you're through with them!

title: Culture Warz: Time's Up Karen! - CTF
description: Take the flags back from the zombies before the timer runs out! Or you're eaten.

title: Culture Warz: Time's Up Karen! - KOTH
description: Defend The Thinker at all costs! He's the last intelligent creature out there!

title: Death's End
description:
You have died.

Death has some questions for you.

title: Muv-Luv: Teito Moyu - The Imperial Capital Burns
description: A Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse prelude story released alongside the PC version of the Total Eclipse visual novel. It focuses on Takamura Yui's past during her days as a cadet for the Imperial Guard training school. Covering issues such as her interaction with her friends and allies, to her first battle against the BETA and the reason to her attachment to the Type-94C.

title: Crow Country
description: The year is 1990. Edward Crow has disappeared. The owner of 'Crow Country', he has not been seen since he unexpectedly shut down his park two years ago. The silence is broken when a mysterious young woman named Mara Forest ventures into the heart of the abandoned theme park in order to find him.

title: Hanging Gardens
description: Hanging Gardens is a single-level PK3 for Doom II and the GZDoom source port that came out in August 2011. It was designed by Paul DeBruyne (skillsaw) and uses a music track from Epic Pinball. It's set in a lush, walled garden in the middle of a desert.

title: Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed - Free Update #1
description:
The first free update for Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed adds the MOROS Medical Facility map, the Glutton ghost type with 3 new ghosts, 2 new gadgets, the P.K.E. Meter: Ecto-Zapper attachment and the Ghost Swapping option that allows ghosts to change ghost type mid-match.

Alongside the general rebalancing and bug fixes it also adds a set of new customization options with Gear Shells to keep a visual look when using compatible gear, Morph Targets to change a character's face, new suit patches and cork board display in the Firehouse for them.

title: Solve The Case
description: Find out all details of the kidnapping through conversations with various people

title: Westwich Castle
description: Westwich Castle is a short indie horror game, in which you are a prisoner and have to escape the horrors lurking inside this dark abandoned medieval castle.

title: Warphouse
description: Warphouse is a single-level PWAD for Doom II and a source port that supports UDMF. It was released in November 2016 by Edward Cripps (Ed).

title: Prayers of Armageddon
description:
Prayers of Armageddon is a Doom II megawad created by Santtu Pesonen (MFG38). It includes 32 new maps and a hidden bonus map which is only accessible via using cheats. All the levels for the megawad were created entirely by Pesonen.
There was also a remake titled Prayers of Armageddon: Retaliation, and it was released in 2014.

title: Nuclear Bunker
description: Sprawling techbase exploration focused dungeon crawl with mostly low intensity combat (though there are a few set piece battles). This map was finished in 2007, but I hadn't released it because it was supposed to be part of a mini-episode that was never finished.

title: Secret Lab
description: A big level, the secret lab is a level by itself. You are instructed to destroy this enemy complex but there is a rumor that their notorious secret lab is hidden here so you cross your fingers and enter the complex. May God help you to find this lab and destroy it.

title: Fear Station Bravo
description: Tech-base themed map with non-linear design and alternative paths.

title: Temple of the Ancients
description: 5-level hub, set in a variety of environments. You start in a command center, but explore medieval and techno-medieval areas as you uncover the secrets of the Temple of the Ancients.

title: No Brakes
description: A large and difficult map influenced by Plutonia.

title: Nevasca
description: Nevasca is an episode-format wad for zdoom source port, focusing on snow themes among with some ruins, hellish or techbase variants.

title: Twisted Joke
description: A Doom 2006 advent calendar map made by James "Phobus" Cresswell.

title: Smothered Hope
description: Single-player, Boom compatible map

title: Wicked Be The Ways of Men
description: This map is different from most other maps in that the player progresses differently through the map depending on the skill level. Each skill level "starts" the map at a different location, and some of the traps are skill-level specific. Additionally, the keys and weapons are at different locations for the different skill levels, and there are some areas that are only accessible to specific skill levels.

title: Temple of Lust
description: A map designed for Torn's Doom Advent Calendar 2005 day 3

title: Radial Ascension
description: Fairly simple map set in a cave/cavern themed place designed for Torn's Doom Advent Calendar 2005 day 14.

title: Duplex
description: A big split techbase designed for Torn's Doom Advent Calendar 2005 day 7

title: DAC 20
description: Erik Alm's map designed for Torn's Doom Advent Calendar 2005 day 20

title: Políticos Memes Kombat
description: Fight an epic battle for votes, it's anything that goes for power. Fighting game with fictional characters based on the Brazilian electoral war. Select one of the characters from Brazilian politics and embark on this fight full of fun and laughter.

title: South of Hell
description: South of Hell is a horror game that takes place at a gas station in the middle of a desert. twenty miles from the nearest town.

title: Sonic RPG: Episode 7
description: A multi-level RPG-style fighting game. It is really hard, but is very rewarding if you beat the opponent in each level - the game contains a movie that runs between the levels. Passwords are issued for each level so that you can skip them the next time you play if you wish.

title: Song of Horror: One Shot Challenge
description: Song of Horror has already scared half a million Players. Now we bring this new challenge with an even more terrifying experience: we've unleashed the AI, known as The Presence, to the highest difficulty level and it's out for blood! Will you be able to survive?

title: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes
description: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes is a unique blend of strategy, board game mechanics, and autobattler gameplay. Immerse yourself in a sci-fi world where tribes are battling for water, and your tactical decisions will shape the future. As a tribe leader, you’ll use a deck of cards to summon and command animated units round after round, until you come out on top.

title: Mizi No!
description: In this free 2D puzzle game, you must reassemble broken objects that your cat has knocked over.

title: Exquisite Corpse
description: The phrase "exquisite corpse" originates from a surrealist game in which sentences were created by a group of people, each person not knowing what the previous words were. In this WAD, each of the 12 authors was given a block of space 1024x1024 units big and asked to create a part of a larger level. However, all they were given to guide them were small slivers of the previously created pieces adjacent to theirs.

title: Beyond Revival
description: A 7-level episode for Doom 2 taking place in a South American UAC installation overrun by the legions of hell.

title: OHM 1
description: OHM1 is a compilation of 33 maps that have been made in about an hour each. The idea of this "project" was to make a map in one hour, and then record yourself play the previous map that was posted.

title: OHM 2
description: OHM2 is a compilation of 32 maps that have been made in about an hour each. The idea of this "project" was to make a map in one hour, and then record yourself play the previous map that was posted.

title: One Night in Kawami
description: Meet a new friend in the dreamlike City of Rivers. One Night in Kawami is a short visual novel about meeting new friends in an unknown city and possibly reshaping reality as you thought you knew it.

title: Movies Tycoon
description: Movies Tycoon is a tycoon simulation game where you dive into the world of film-making. Start with a humble studio, scout and manage top talent, customize unique characters, and direct blockbuster films.

title: Nebel Geisterjäger: The First Lamb
description: An NTRPG from a male POV. Use tools like heart monitoring and surveillance to shield your girlfriend, Kana, from her scheming boss. With 5 endings and choices shaping interactions, can you keep her safe? Amidst exorcism, intrigue, and personal choices, protect your bond and confront inner desires.

title: Defense Protocol
description: Do you have the resources and upgrades you need to leave the planet in this roguelike genre where you try to defend your base, survive, gather the necessary resources, and upgrade your technology while trying to repair your spaceship on an uncharted planet you crash-landed on?

title: Sex & Blood: Vampires
description: Sex & Blood: Vampires is an engaging adult visual novel set in a mysterious future world. In this realm, humanity contends with vampires who have eerily blended in with ordinary people, concealing their true nature.

title: Night Grove
description: This is a first-person indie horror game. A young deliveryman took an unusual order that led him to Night Grove. This place has a dubious reputation among the townspeople, because for many years it has been sent to live with people that society has long since abandoned.

title: Divine Pig
description: The player is an ordinary warrior who is turned into a pig when defeated by a water monster in battle. In order to become human again, players need to go through different levels Step by step, transform into human form and acquire skills. Defeat demons through ultimate efforts and become humans.

title: Red Head: To The Rescue
description: Rescue the gem stolen by the evil sorcerer Vamooth and restore peace to the kingdom. Prepare yourself to face a wide variety of enemies, such as slimes, evil trees, and giant bosses that occupy almost the entire screen.

title: Hex Cats
description: Twist and move hex pieces to connect yarn threads for playful felines. A charming twist on classic hex pipes puzzle!

title: Architectural Madman
description: This is a classic puzzle game.

title: Alchemy Origin
description: Alchemy: Origins is a classic alchemy game that starts you with 4 basic elements and allows to connect them to create more and more elaborate items - all the way to reaching the stars.

title: Untitled Rougelike Arcade Game
description: A short arcade roguelike.

title: Arcana Outcasts
description: Switch between multiple arcane Shards to outwit and obliterate your enemies in this top-down shooter roguelike. Plan your path with a unique skill tree levelling system, and fight for survival against enemies wielding the same powers as you.

title: DesperaDrops
description: A crime-romance set in Summer 2028, Italy where exchange student Mika Amamine finds herself embroiled in murder case and she is a suspect. While being escorted to be further interrogated, she is freed when her vehicle gets overturned in an incident–on top of all this there is a mysterious assailant who is after Mika’s “powers” and she finds herself trying to escape both the police and the assailant with 6 other people who all have a criminal past.

title: Black Beacon Hill
description: Follow the story of the [Phantoms] as forces beyond their control drag them back into a vendetta in the streets, the Ulstanian-Kostakovian war they left behind rages on in the distance, and an existential threat looms over all. A visual novel with a unique design minimalistic top-down shooter game.

title: Herosbine: The Unknown Island
description: A story-driven open world, action-adventure RPG set on a mysterious island where the player takes on the role of Tim. Tim is living a normal life as a geeky, introverted boy. He is struggling with his identity and the loss of his best friends, and feels out of place.

title: Coffee Caravan
description: Fuel your coffee passion in Coffee Caravan! As a cafe manager, brew, experiment with delicious recipes, and build your dream coffee business on wheels. Serve customers, unlock new flavors, purchase appliances, and enjoy your procedurally generated road trip in this roguelite experience.

title: Inspector Waffles: Early Days
description: A top-down detective adventure with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by classic Game Boy games. Follow Waffles in his first days as an inspector who wants to prove to everyone that he is more than just a rookie. But beware… Your future worst enemy is hiding in the shadows.

title: Jabuti Adventures
description: Jabuti Adventures is a platform game about a turtle, whose basket of eggs disappeared due to a brief oversight, and now she needs your help to get them back.

title: C.A.R.D.S. RPG: The Misty Battlefield
description: This game combines roguelike-style deckbuilding with SRPGs to create an all-new experience! Follow Vel as she leads the Clausewitz Battalion into battle against Fahftania and the Hellmuth Brigade. Collect 50 different cards to build the strongest deck and fight enemies on a map shrouded in mist.

title: Ad Fundum
description: Take control of a giant mech and embark on a riveting dieselpunk adventure in a vast subterranean world. Dig deep, collect minerals, upgrade smartly, explore diverse locations, unfold ancient secrets, and try not to explode! Will you save the world or vanish in the depths below?

title: Colony Defense
description: Atmospheric unique minimalist tower base defense game. Highly addictive.

title: Dusky Depths
description: After a routine expedition gone awry, you are stranded on an uncharted planet inhabited by odd creatures and rundown machinery. Upgrade your ship, scavange for rare loot and unlock ancient mechanisms to survive on this strange and hostile place – alone or together with your friends.

title: There's No Easter Eggs
description: There's no Easter eggs is a casual hidden object game with over 500 Easter eggs to find.

title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations - Winter 2023
description: Puzzles of Winter!

title: Spread Out! Hold Naar' Havok
description: Easy and deep wargame. Choose your army (the Elves or the Orcs), win the war by controlling 5 of the 9 territories or by killing the enemy king. Deploy reinforcements.

title: LA Hollywood Zombies
description: Survive the horror of Anubis`s army of dead with Death the Reaper spawning the dead to destroy eat the living because of the sin greed by mankind design there hell!?

title: Command Center Earth
description: Save Earth from total annihilation by drifting a missile through a variety of unique and punishingly difficult asteroid fields.

title: Kamitsubaki City Ensemble
description: Kamitsubaki City Ensemble is a rhythm game in the world of destruction.

title: Dyschronia: Chronos Alternate - Dual Edition
description: As the Clocktower bell tolls, your fate hangs in the balance. Solve an impossible murder case in the far-flung future in this VR & Non-VR investigation action adventure!

title: Ruins To Fortress
description: Explore a post-apocalyptic island, craft, build, tear down enemy bases, defend and nuke your rivals! Life's about surviving in this multiplayer game, no matter what it takes!

title: AnarchyField: Infinite Euphoric Level Destruction
description: Tired of boring AAA games? Ever imagined a world where you could destroy everything with your friends? Experience a new cutting-edge technology which lets you experience a destructible world like no other game does. Destroy everything! No walls will remain unscathed.

title: War of Gods Athena
description: WarOfGods Athena is 3D RPG Metaverse game using Voice recognition. User can talk with NPC for mission or play game by voice commands for various avatar's actions. This game is based on Greek Mythology. This is the open world game and the world consists of 8 regions.

title: Iron Saga VS
description: Take control of an assortment of superb mechs and engage in thrilling combat with other enthusiasts on the same battlefield! In addition to original mecha, well-known IPs such as "Mazinger Z" and “Dancouga – Super Beast Machine God” also ready for the mecha war!

title: Rocket Smash
description: Rocket Smash is a minimalist 2D physics and destruction arcade game. Navigate through countless arena levels, relentlessly smashing, bashing and crashing into enemy rockets to annihilate them. This game is all about precision, strategy, and the joy of destruction!

title: The Book of Death for Dummies
description: Death has taken a well-deserved vacation in Cancun and left George in charge! He'll have to learn to deal with Destiny and decide who should continue their journey in the land of the living. But beware, wrong choices lead to undesirable consequences!

title: Goblin's Bizarre Adventure
description: This is a maze puzzle game. It mainly tells that a goblin keeps avoiding the pursuer in order to live freely. It cannot escape the pursuit alone and needs your help. So can you help him escape?

title: Treasures of the Haunted Forest
description: Treasures of the Haunted Forest is a fantasy hidden object game, where player's goal is to find alchemical ingredients in the haunted forest.

title: The Dark Survivors
description: In the darkness, the survivor hunts monsters for fun! Eliminate monsters and become a more powerful dark survivor!

title: Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure
description: Welcome to "Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure"! You're an amphibious dinosaur with the power of water. Face challenges, recover your stolen egg from a ninja, and surf in championships. 2D Jurassic action awaits!

title: Empyrean Swarm
description: Escape the alien threat! Unleash searing lasers, fire precision phasers, and launch sizzling plasma bolts. Blast, spin, and cut your way through hordes to unlock your ship's potential as you unveil hidden horrors. Challenge the world, arcade-style, and ascend as the galaxy's ultimate pilot!

title: Vanity
description: Immerse yourself in a world of frenetic action where Vanity offers you several thrilling game modes in PvP and PvE.

title: Case Files: Behind Closed Doors
description: A man is murdered under suspicious circumstances, and four suspects emerge as possible killers. From an observation room, players review interviews, surveillance footage, forensic evidence, and case files to identify contradictions and separate truth from deception. Through critical analysis and key investigative decisions, the fate of the case rests in the player's hands.

title: Rocket Jump Race
description: Have you ever wondered what would be races like if wheels never invented? You are about to find out. Rocket Jump Race is a FPS racing game that we compete with the explosive force of our weapons. If you are here to be the last player standing by destroying your rivals, you came to the wrong place.

title: Little-Known Galaxy
description: Join Space Alliance as a new captain-in-training and work with your crew to solve the mysteries of an ancient relic found on the Grey Planet. Little-Known Galaxy is a cozy single-player RPG space adventure full of friendly characters, exploration, crafting, and farming.

title: Who's the Traitor
description: Who's the Traitor is a cooperative multiplayer FPS. Gather items, earn money, and work with strangers to figure out who is the traitor.

title: Ancient Wonders: Gardens of Babylon
description: Play through more than 100 hex-match-3 link style levels and earn enough gold to fully decorate the Gardens of Babylon!

title: Pitch Patter
description: Welcome to Pitch Patter, the game show where pitches meet punchlines! Use your devices as controllers and compete with 3-8 players in crafting the most outlandish adverts. Featuring two gameplay modes - Pitch Patter and the Pitch Pit. Get ready for a marketing showdown!

title: Sex House: Orgy Party
description: Enter the luxurious—and sinful—world of Barbara: Sex Story! A glamorous fashion event turns into a sensual thriller when its organizer is found dead. Uncover secrets, surrender to forbidden desires, and navigate passion, power, and deception.

title: The Eastern Sacrifice
description: “The Eastern Sacrifice” is an idle game combining simulation with Eastern Cthulhu-inspired themes. In a world spiraling into chaos over authority, vanquish enemy, gather treasures, and build a devoted religion. Your sanctuary will help you reclaim theurgy, ascend to the divine realm.

title: Space Operation
description: In2XXX,alien civilizations gradually came to the earth's clouds and outer space began to invade the earth. In order to counterattack,mankind will launch two space combat spaceships that have been developed for many years. Can the two pilots driving the combat spacecraft repel the aliens civilization

title: The Mystery of the Village's Sacred Tree
description: The mystery of the village's sacred tree. The day of the festival is approaching. The happiness and pleasure of people. The salvation of mankind by the cursed village begins now. ・Game Introduction A visual novel style horror adventure game!

title: Finding America: New England
description: Explore scenic landscapes, uncover hidden treasures, and immerse yourself in the rich history of this iconic region.

title: Astro Link
description: Astro Link is a Portal-like puzzle game that takes place withing the mysterious Astro Link facility. What is happening to this place? Will test subject #602 be able to find out?

title: Joninės
description: A first person Lithuanian horror tale of Midsummer Eve.

title: Bargain Wargame
description: Naval Grid Based , turn based Hard core Wargame. A.I. can control any ship so no need to micromanage , it has a live database to find targets. there is a supply mechanic, all ships need supplies fuel and repair and rearming , transport ships and major base's supply everything.

title: Escape from the Abandoned Outpost
description: Escape from the Abandoned Outpost is a hidden object game, where the player's goal is to search the remains of the abandoned outpost and the surface of the hostile planet for resources, allowing them to repair the outpost and get back to civilization.

title: West Hunt: Halloween Pack2
description: Halloween 2 DLC with scary items

title: My Daughter is a Cultist! SE
description: A Short horror experience.

title: Amberial: Nebulosa Realms
description:
The AmberBall is back in a huge new adventure with all that you requested !
22 new levels, time trials, and an insanely hard tower of glory.

title: Projeto: Átomo
description: In Projeto: Átomo, a thrilling shoot'em up/bullet hell game, you command the Alefuzo team's spaceship racing to escape Mars after a disastrous expedition.

title: Friday Night Funkin' Vs. Ourple Guy
description: Ourple Guy is a non-profit Friday Night Funkin' Mod that adapts Five Nights At Freddy's! However the mod is not meant to be taken seriously as its just us having goofy fun with these characters, some of which that are either our own interpretation of FNAF characters, or some new characters, too!

title: Mimic Dungeon
description: Help the Wizard escape the dungeon by killing enemies with the staff that makes everyone copy his moves.

title: Hallow Hunt
description: Hallow Hunt is a roguelike top-down shooter set during Halloween in a strange cemetery full of unredeemed souls. While unknown forces are haunting the land of the undead, you have to pass through spooky monsters and frightening bosses to retrieve the hallow artifact and bring it back to its rightful place... well, at least you can try.

title: Witch's Bananas
description: Witch's Bananas is a physics-based platformer where you collect a witch's lost banana collection by jumping around in during a time limit.

title: Scimitar
description: 20 shortish levels split into three episodes: Rear Entry, Knee Deep in the Sludge and Into the Blood. "The Source" - That's what they call it. No one quite knows what it is, apart from the birthing grounds of the monstrous army that invaded your planet. Your team was sent to destroy it, but the way in was heavily guarded, and now only you survive. You'll have to find another way in...

title: Ezekiel
description: Ezekiel is a nine-map Doom II episode WAD for limit-removing source ports created by various mappers, led by Jon Vail (40oz). The first episode is based around fast-paced combat and 1999-style levels with a similar aesthetic to Hell Revealed 2 and Thy Flesh Consumed. Episode 2 features a swampy dark green and grey Heretic and Hexen styled aesthetic, with large layouts and large monster quantities. The unfinished third episode was meant to feature suspenseful exploratory levels with jump scares and high contrast lighting, in a theme featuring lots of cement, charred rock and vine textures.

title: Somewhere in Time
description: Somewhere in Time is a set of 15+1 pure vanilla Doom 2 maps, inspired by the greatest of this category, most importantly Reverie, Revolution! and Scythe.

title: Nordhell
description: Nordhell is a three-level limit-removing PWAD released in December 2007 by Alexander S. (Eternal). It was created in celebration of the coming new year, and was released alongside a different Nordhell for GZDoom. This WAD was later updated by Eternal in 2008 and 2009 to add two new maps to similarly celebrate the new years of that time. The PWAD furthermore comes with a custom enemy through DeHackEd, the evil marine originally from Scythe 2, but with a brown, rather than red, uniform.

title: A Taste for Blood
description: 6-map episode for Doom 2. These maps, ranging from small to large, hopefully combines good detail and atmosphere with, at times, strong difficulty.

title: Congestion 384
description: 20 levels with play limited to a 384x384 square!

title: Data Center
description: Build, cable, and automate. Assemble racks, servers, and switches, connect enough capacity for each app, earn money from processed data, and unlock gear and bigger customers with XP and reputation. Follow colored data packets as your center comes to life.

title: The Attraction to All Things Uncertain
description: A city now mutated into hell.

title: Fracture
description: FRACTURE is a top-down 3D space shooter RPG, blending open-world exploration and fragmented memory-driven storytelling.It throws you into a recursive war shaped by identity, consciousness, and fate.You haven't come here for the first time—But are you sure... you've ever truly left?

title: Infected Area
description: Infected Area is a Doom II episode replacement mod of seven levels, created by Chuck Grant in 1996.

title: Dystopia 3: Re-Birth of Anarchy
description: Dystopia 3: Re-Birth of Anarchy is an 11 level WAD. It was one of the first WADs to exploit editing tricks discovered for the Doom engine, such as deep water and the famous double 3D bridge. While its gameplay was true to Doom II's style, the project's level of detail was revolutionary for its time, with levels containing custom textures, crashed spaceships, and elaborate architecture in varied environments, subtly referring to a self-contained story.

title: Ol' No Name
description: 4 levels for boom format using Darkening 2 textures

title: Foursite
description: 4-in-1 map concept. The Foursite military base lies abandoned. You’ve heard rumors of a secret backdoor entrance: find the entrance, explore the four quadrants of the base, reach the heart, and escape alive.

title: 900 Deep in the Dead
description: Nine maps with less than 100 lines each, hence '900 Deep in the Dead'.

title: Nex Credo
description: Nex Credo is 11 levels of an aborted megaWAD for vanilla

title: Murderous Intent
description: Now might be a good time to quit the job, make your way to the city and get off of Mars.

title: Sinister Intention
description: 7 maps done by Jayextee after a 10 year mapping break

title: Dystopia 3: Re-Birth of Anarchy Addon
description: An Add-on Level for Dystopia3. A Single level, that will keep you wanting more!

title: Pebble Jame
description: A merging puzzle game inspired by a certain game with watermelons. Merge pebbles together in multiple different game modes and see how high of a score you can get!

title: Heaven and Hell
description: This is a tense and thrilling escape game with a modern ugly and cute texture style that makes people cannot move their eyes away.

title: Monsters and Spirits
description: Are you tired of standing there and harvesting monsters waiting in line to die in boredom? Are you tired of the monotony of skill combinations? In the demon spirit, you can completely free yourself from these boredom

title: Anger of Peace 5
description: Anger of Peace 5 is a multiplayer/single player FPS combat game that supports up to 10V10 players in online battles, as well as offline single player games.

title: Wings of Redemption
description: Wings of Redemption is rogue-lite top-down action game with focus on combining melee and ranged combat. Destroy hordes of monsters in randomly generated maps with variety of weapons on your way towards freedom.

title: God of Death
description: Embark on a thrilling journey in God Of Death, an action roguelike where you must ascend Rohz's tower to reclaim the last light of the world. You will need to acquire new weapons and accessories in your inventory and carefully upgrade them to survive the monster attack in each tower level.

title: Lady of Bones, a Mother's Legacy
description: It always rains, they call it The Haze. Ghosts haunt every alley, every gray corner of the city. Lady of Bones is a visual novel that explores the darkest depths of existence where Maya will discover the horrible secrets of her mother's legacy.

title: Phantom Blaze
description: Phantom Blaze is entirely inspired by the bravery of Indian Commanders and their killing instincts. Hunting for weapon and equipment to kill the opportunity while saving themselves remain the fundamental spur throughout the game.

title: CatBox
description: In this 2D puzzle game you will have to arrange your feline friends in more than 300 levels. Gradually changing locations will add new challenges.

title: Block Games:Avoid
description: This is a minimalist block type game that tests reaction and perseverance. In order to achieve extreme minimalism, after trying many elements, I chose to use blocks as the main element. Go manipulate the blocks to avoid more blocks! Go challenge your limits!

title: CritterGarden
description: CritterGarden is an upcoming creature-collector/life sim with a focus on carefully crafting a unique garden to breed and evolve Critters!

title: LastRo
description: LastRo is a top-down shooter roguelike where you play robot, which mission is to clear up a lot of floors against different enemies. Your enemies are "evolving", which means they become stronger with each floor and difficulty you beat. Try out different weapons, abilities and upgrades to beat them.

title: Elara
description: Elara is a dark, narrative-driven visual novel where players investigate a corporate death, navigate manipulation and power dynamics, and make choices that lead to multiple endings.

title: Great Flame
description: Great Flame is a 3D adventure game with role-playing game (RPG) elements. Take on the role of a traveler who has magical powers and go on a dangerous adventure to explore the depths of the dungeon! You have to clear locations from monsters and bosses using magical weapons!

title: Grappling Gunners: Arena FPS
description: Grappling Gunners is a free multiplayer FPS with two grappling shots for high-speed gunfights and full freedom of movement. Utilize seven skills, including teleportation and bullet time.

title: Siege Island
description: Step into the world of Siege Island, a tribute to the classic arcade game "Rampart" by Atari. Prepare yourself for an immersive 3D action-puzzle game that will test your strategic skills and reflexes. As the Orcish fleet draws near, the duty to safeguard your island from their assaults is yours.

title: Grimbound
description: A minimalistic blend of RTS, Tower Defence, and Survivors-like. Build your city and take command of your troops in a battle against ruthless monster hordes. Upgrade your hero and stand shoulder-to-shoulder with your army in this grimdark fantasy world!

title: Party PooperZ
description: Party Pooperz is an awesome chaotic partygame, where you compete against your friends. The fate of tonight's party theme rests on your shoulders, steal guests and use items to make your party the most popular. Let the battle for the most legendary party begin!

title: Hazardous: Ovesis
description: Ovesis: Hazardous is a crafting-survival game where you explore cyberpunk and biopunk worlds.

title: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare
description: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare is a 2D Top Down Shooter. Survive by facing monsters in the nightmare of a little boy who didn’t heed his mother’s warnings that eating too much before bed can cause nightmares.

title: Mint Christmas
description: Get ready for a festive fun match 3 game. Featuring 2 exciting modes including a 12 round collection mode where you must get all the presents out of the grid before time runs out. Collect powerups and maybe you'll get extra time or perhaps a bomb to keep things moving. Can you beat all 12 rounds?

title: Convicted
description: Convicted is a 2D top-down asymmetrical multiplayer horror game inspired by SCP and Space Station 13. Escape a secret Soviet facility full of dangerous anomalies, be part of the lab and try your best at containing them, or even play as the anomalies themselves and hunt down the other survivors!

title: The Holyburn Witches
description: An atmospheric survival-horror game made from chilling panoramic photographs and terrifying sound design. According to old Scottish folklore, witches haunt the forests of the accursed village of Holyburn.

title: Self-indulgence
description: In Self-indulgence, players delve deep into the haunting psyche of the game's lone developer. Engulfed by a relentless cycle of self-destruction. A single-player, old-school survival horror experience that explores the harrowing confines of personal demons.

title: Rogue Racer
description: Race across the continent against the police and rival racers alike, survive bizarre encounters and become the Rogue Racer.

title: Pallet Panic
description: Dive into 'Pallet Panic,' an action-packed forklift frenzy that blends strategic logistics with fast-paced fun. Manage the chaos of a vibrant factory, combining, lifting, and racing to become the ultimate forklift operator. Unleash your skills in this whimsical world of cartoony mayhem!

title: Once Upon a Rogue's Tale
description: Embark on a journey through your favorite fairytales in this charming roguelike deckbuilding board game. Will you help Little Red Riding Hood find her grandmother or help the Frog Prince break his curse? How the story continues is up to you....

title: Immortal Beast
description: Immortal Beast - Dynamic 2D roguelike with a wide variety of enemies and weapons. You will play as a treasure hunter who has decided on a desperate adventure in search of wealth and glory! You will go down into a dark dungeon and enter into an unequal battle with dangerous enemies!

title: The Transference
description: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

title: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2024
description: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 2024 puts you in the role of general manager of your favorite basketball team. Every decision can be made by you from drafting, trading, signing free agents all the way to making each substitution to lead your team to championship glory and becoming a dynasty.

title: Beneath the Earth: Backrooms
description: Beneath The Earth - Backrooms is a Co-Op horror game that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. Where you and your friends will fight to escape from the different levels of the backrooms, solving different puzzles.

title: Swords & Shields AdvBattleBoard
description: A casual puzzle played with 4 sided chits with a swords or a shield on an edge played on a classic chess board. when chits clash they may rotate or capture the other, your objective is to capture the crown chits, there are 4 on both sides.

title: Insurgency: Sandstorm - Ultimate Edition
description: Insurgency: Sandstorm Ultimate Edition includes the base game and passes for Year 1, Year 2, and Year 3. Feel every bullet in thrilling close-quarters combat as your team fights toward victory in intense co-op and PvP multiplayer modes.

title: Shell Runner
description: 2045. Life's never been cheaper. Shells mean you can come back if you have money. You used to. Now you're on the bottom in a cyberpunk sprawl. Claw your way back up through wet work as a Shell Runner, in a PvE extraction looter shooter, where a gig can make you rich - or broke.

title: Realm of the Undead
