title: Oasis Mission: Colony Sim
description: A Sci-Fi colony and strategy sim with a complex economy, immersive logistics, and a war against the rise of the machines! Build your colony and ensure supplies for your people. Automate industrial ships and create combat groups to defend against waves of enemies.

title: Hovermania
description: 3D puzzle driving platformer game with a global leaderboard. Find where you stand in each of the surprisingly difficult levels

title: Mirrors of Epiphany
description: Do you like laser beams? Are you a fan of mirrors? Prepare to enjoy laser beams that change direction when they hit the mirrors YOU place on the board! Play around to find a workable solution, or aim for utter perfection!

title: My Friend Aki
description: A horror-tinged puzzle and exploration game set in an abandoned mall. Improvise tools, uncover secrets, and stumble upon something strange and bright in the darkness.

title: Cosmic Coop
description: 'Cosmic Coop', an alien farming/creature collector odyssey! Lure Critterlings with captivating objects, establish harmonious ecosystems, and ward off invaders. Delve into mines, craft for your farm, and chat with quirky native creatures. More than farming – it's deep cosmic bonding.

title: Cattie
description: Cattie is a platform game with retro graphics.

title: Check and Slash
description: Check and Slash combines the action and combat of a hack-and-slash game with the movement patterns of chess pieces. Find your way through a maze of boards, slash your enemies, dodge attacks, rescue black pieces to receive upgrades, and fight against formidable opponents until you find the enemy king.

title: Star Overhead
description: Star Overhead is a short but challenging 2D platformer following a retired military chaplain turned pastor. On his deathbed, he uses his connection to music to process his journey into the great beyond.

title: Zodiac Revenger
description: Zodiac Revenger is a 2D action platformer. Took place post the Zodiac race, the 12 winners have been reward with great mystical power. They used it to spread chaos throught the peaceful land. Follow the Cat on a quest to dethrone the terror rulers, and get his own revenge on the Zodiac leader.

title: The Da Vinci Cryptex
description: Are you ready to solve 50 incredible riddles to gain your freedom? Test your IQ skills by playing The Da Vinci Cryptex and find out the genius you are!

title: Gnarly Hike
description: Gnarly Hike is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore an eerie forest in a slow-paced, atmospheric world combining beautiful and horrifying scenery along with the constant fear of being hunted, and enjoy a genuinely terrifying experience. Uncover secrets, expel spirits and ...stay alive!

title: Lonely Space
description: Lonely space is an old-fashioned sci-fi immersive sim game. You find yourself awakened from hibernetic sleep in the docking bay of the Cassiopeia space station. All your crew gone long time ago. You have to resque them and find out what's going on on the station.

title: Turbo Champ
description: Turbo Champ is a fast-paced, arcade racing game. Unlock unique cars in the single-player campaign, or play online and locally with your friends. Will you be the world's next Turbo Champ?

title: Project Breakout
description: Project Breakout is a sandbox prison escape game, where you and up to three friends are put into a secured facility. Explore the area, train to improve your attributes and gather items, to craft tools that are necessary for your escape!

title: Ruiga Pirates
description: Kill thousands of pirates and sea creatures and survive! Ruiga Pirates is a game with survivors-like elements; Choose upgrades, get ready for bullet hell against hundreds of attacking enemies!

title: Realm of Ink
description: Realm of Ink is an Ink-style action Roguelite game. You, the heroine, unexpectedly discover that you are just a fictional character within the short story collection Realm of Ink when hunting the Fox. Only by defeating the mysterious Book Spirit can you be liberated from the realm.

title: Paramorfosi
description: Atmospheric horror thirds-person experience

title: Blood Running
description: Blood Running is a stylish extraction shooter where you'll enter the cyber-wasteland, collect blood for your clients, loot valuable gear, and venture into the remnants of a world in ruins. Are you willing to bleed to survive, Blood Runner?

title: Hidden Series 2
description: Experience the engaging and addictive Hidden Series 2 game to find the hidden objects across 30+ challenging levels. We have carefully crafted the puzzles which will give the ultimate challenges unlimited fun and allow you to relax.

title: The World Well: Blood of Caro
description: 814 R.E; the war is approaching. In Redimus, the chaotic world where magic, technology, slaves and vampires coexist, a young girl happens upon a magic gun that sets her on a journey of revenge. There is a burning manor behind her, and the road ahead disappears in the jungles of the night...

title: Edd-E
description: Edd-E is a pixel-art game maker with custom visual scripting and publishing platform. Create games and Publish them with just one click. Play games from other creators or edit them. Learn programming and game development!

title: Slice It Down
description: You will slaughter thousands of enemies, get new abilities and reveal new combo abilities, do not forget to improve your character.

title: Tercity Life Simulator
description: Tercity Life Simulator is an exciting open-world game where you can explore a big city, make friends, start a family, find interesting jobs, buy real estate and more.

title: The Grand Adventures of Leo
description: Join Leo in a platform adventure has he fights the CAT MAFIA to rescue his precious Mommy!

title: Arrows and Antiquity
description: A fast-paced archery-based score-attack set in the crumbling ruins of antiquity. Hone your agility and accuracy as you smash targets across various challenges while wielding unique weaponry and godly powers!

title: Red Eye
description: Red Eye is an adrenaline-pumping runner game that combines the excitement of endless running with the thrill of demon hunting. Are you ready to face the forces of hell and emerge victorious?

title: Drone Flight Simulator Online
description: Enjoy freedom with Drone Flight Simulator Online. Unlimited flight experience awaits you in the sky.

title: 100 Asian Cats
description: 100 Asian Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Asia! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Asian temples as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: The Braves: Beginning
description: Demolish hordes of enemies and survive against all odds! Unlock different characters, find powerful skill combinations and embark on an exciting journey through the variety of very different worlds in this cute but unforgiving roguelike game!

title: Western Redemption
description: be a woman cowboy and try to find all treasures and main treasure to finish game and beware enemy cowboys in this western shooter parody

title: Rain Tactics
description: Play Winter, an invincible god who desperately wants to die, in this cyberpunk RPG Tactics with roguelike elements. Explore the tower city of Shavanath, lead your avowed into battle and take control over your godly powers to change the course of Fate.

title: Isolation One
description: Exciting action with puzzle elements and an interesting plot, which takes place on the huge spaceship Transporter P18. In this game, players will encounter an incredible mixture of science fiction and horror. Immerse yourself in a dark world where t you need to survive at any cost.

title: An Aisling
description: An Aisling is an adventure game focused on exploration, story, and character. Make friends or enemies as you try to uncover why people are dissappearing on the island of Rashinmore.

title: Teke Teke: Moonlit Dread
description: After a disturbing online article, you set out for a late-night grocery run, only to find yourself trapped in a convenience store near a desolate train station. Will you outrun the nightmare or seek salvation in the darkness?

title: Tibor: Tale Of A Kind Vampire
description: When young Tibor is transformed from poor painter to vampire, his love for charming Agness vanquishes the evil from his heart. Throughout the game, you will visit different parts of the village collecting coins and other things that give you points, while trying to avoid or kill the enemies.

title: My Eyes Deceive
description:
my eyes deceive is a first-person psychological horror experience set in a basement, or shelter, if you will. Set over the course of roughly a week, you play as a young girl who has been living there all her life.

The outside world is infected with a deadly disease. Society is in chaos. Fortunately, your papa is protecting you by keeping you in his shelter. He's very insistent on you taking your disease-preventive pills every day. Why do the pills make you tired? When will you be able to leave? Can we be deceived by our own perception?

title: The Library
description: It's a very simple game where you can escape from the library on the 8th floor!

title: Fragor Portum
description:
The year is 208X, you wake up in the barracks of the UNSF Fragor Portum to find that something is amiss...
Fragor Portum is a Boom-compatible 5 map episode for Doom 2.

title: Vicarious
description: Vicarious is a limit-removing wad for Doom 2 set in a medieval city. It's mostly inspired visually by the Elden Ring Trailer that came out some time around last year, as well as Scythe 2 and @Egg Boy's Cold Front.

title: Bing Bong Blippo
description: Bing Bong Blippo is 9 map Vanilla episode that I had started back in late 2019 around the time I was leading Oops! All Techbase.

title: Acid Reflux
description: Acid Reflux is a map set for Boom-compatible source ports where you delve through acid-filled sewers, factories, and... subway stations? It should take you around 30 minutes to finish the whole set, and the maps get progressively longer and tougher as you go on. The map contains custom weapons, namely an auto rifle which replaces the pistol, and an upgraded chaingun. Plasma marines replace the wimpy Former Humans, with sprites done by @Tango.

title: Super Double Dragon
description: Super Double Dragon rises again after 30 years! Now with new features such as customisable wallpapers and speed options!

title: Gems and Knight
description: This is a game that combines action role-playing with elimination and leisure. In the levels, fast-paced elimination is performed based on the enemy's condition. Rich systems and hidden elements bring a refreshing feeling every time you play.

title: Moonstone Remix
description: A chat simulation game where you can befriend and romance players in an old-school MMORPG.

title: Assassin War Sniper Shooting
description: Embark on a realistic desert adventure with Assassin War Sniper Shooting, hunt your enemies with your sniper rifle, and achieve victory! Are you ready for an unforgettable FPS experience?

title: City of Death
description: Welcome friends who love adventure and are eager to explore to the Adventure Island.

title: Soul Blade
description: "Soul Blade" is a 2D platform action game with classic hand-drawn 2D animations that provide a smooth and immersive visual experience. The combat system is built around the "swordplay" mechanism, delivering intense and exhilarating battles.

title: Last Stand Delivery
description:
This is a new Sokoban-like RPG game.Send people love, wish them well, and mind your own business.
Let's them die.

title: Neon Fantasy: Monkeys
description: Neon Fantasy: Monkeys is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime. Collect pictures, develop your attention, and feel like a part of the beautiful neon world.

title: John Christian 3.0
description: John Christian 3.0 is a Christian adventure game with spiritual battles. The game presents the story of young John who, dressed in the Armor of God, embarks on his new mission to fight against the forces of evil in a universe with many challenges to free the imprisoned people.

title: Journey of the Forgotten
description: Jump into the tactical RPG that is Journey of the Forgotten and follow young Quia on her journey to unravel the mysteries that were revealed in her vision. Can you gather the four energies, restore the balance and confront the true evil in the end? And will you do it alone?

title: Yurei
description: Yurei is a top-down, arena-style slasher game. Face off fearsome enemies where you will slash, dodge, and eliminate those that stand on your path for revenge. Grab your katana, fight with honor, and prove your skills.

title: Slyders
description: Fight against insane hordes of demons to prevent an evil overlord from conquering Sky World in this first-person survival roguelike shooter. With an arsenal of weapons, perks, and items, the battlefield quickly transforms into a fast-paced bullet hell.

title: Paradise Architect
description: Click to get money. Build buildings, develop the city infrastructure to increase passive income. Keep the infrastructure of the city in working condition by completing quests on time and get bonuses.

title: Monkey Splash!!
description: Monkey Splash!! is an arcade, action-platformer featuring monkeys, diving, and historical landmarks! Fire your funky monkey up these colossal structures, avoiding rivals along the way to achieve the ultimate dive! It's time to splash!!

title: Topspace
description: A topdown bullet hell game where you control a spaceship and fight waves of asteroids and enemy spaceships.

title: Sky Fury
description: Hold on tight for this thrilling arcade-style air racing game. Equipped with various weapons, you will need to use strategy and skill to achieve victory. Play in single-player or versus mode and unlock new circuits and planes.

title: MycoRelic
description: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on an island inhabited by tribal robots. Raid derelict foundries and ancient temples to upgrade your body, gaining forgotten powers. Wield elemental magic to trigger powerful reactions or fight with melee and ranged weapons in dynamic combat.

title: To Victory
description: This is a single player strategy management game.Base on a randomly generated map.It includes construction, trading, strategy, and management elements . Players need to make decisions to achieve the final victory.

title: Halcyon Days
description: While exploring ancient ruins, Teflon accidentally releases a mysterious woman and her guardian from their cryosleep. When it's revealed that they are from a lost civilization that shaped the world as it is today, an adventure of treasure, betrayal and friendship begins.

title: New Zombie
description: Military agent Harvey Heller, having received orders, flies with his team to protect a group of scientists who are to create a vaccine. But halfway to his goal he finds himself in a small town where he saves a little girl. From this moment begins his long and not easy journey.

title: WildFront
description: WildFront is an immersive city building CCG adventure with rogue-lite AND souls-like elements. Venture deep into the wilds AND/OR compete against other players to bring prosperity back to your city. Build and upgrade your town to unlock permanent stat upgrades, cards, artifacts & more.

title: Incredible Dracula: Dark Carnival
description: It’s for a magical conundrum like no other! Elizabeth, Dracula’s beloved wife, has been cursed by the mischievous magician, Bestby. Her head was transformed into a pumpkin, and Dracula must embark on a quest to break the curse before it's too late.

title: Arcanamals
description: Arcanamals is a narrative-driven, turn-based RPG centered on exploration. Journey across Lanthos, a realm on the edge of turmoil. For ages Arcanamals coexisted harmoniously with humans. But now, a sinister transformation is taking hold.

title: Rugby League Riot
description: This sports game is must for any Rugby League fan! Choose from 17 teams, play a singles match or compete in a finals series. Unique gameplay, no controller required. Operate the ball carrier, many pass and kick options, simple defensive play. Fatigue system, commentary, TV theme design.

title: Lonely Mountains: Downhill - Rivera's Revenge
description: Turn on your bike light to explore the secret cave of Sierra Rivera's lost trail in this free DLC. Collect the fire elemental customization set by playing through the brand-new challenges. Saddle up and face Rivera's Revenge in the Lonely Mountains.

title: Gates of Yomi
description: Countless dead spirit and yokai have been terrorizing the land of the living in Japan. You are tasked to strike the dead where they come from, in Yomi. Battle against hordes of dead spirit and Yokai in the land of Yomi. Gather coins and upgrade your camp and roster to become stronger.

title: Glitched Out
description: Trapped in the depths of a top secret alien research facility, Lex must team up with A.I companion 'Chip' and hack her way to freedom. Along the way, she discovers the sinister secrets of the facility and meets the many monstrous creatures contained within.

title: Shivering Stone
description: Experience a serene journey through the winter forest as you unravel the secrets before you and enjoy brainteasing scenarios amidst tranquil visuals and soothing sounds.

title: Escape the Farm
description: Take on the role of an intrepid chicken to attempt daring escapes from the tyranny of your farmyard masters. Use a variety of tools at your disposal in this 3D puzzle platformer as you run, jump, and flap your way to freedom.

title: Gym Nights
description: You are the caretaker of an old abandoned gym. Working as a watchman has long been an important part of your life. But what does this place hide? Why do you end up here again and again?

title: Halloween Sinister Trivia
description: Humorous surreal horror. Never before has so much plot twist per square meter. 10 different endings, and in each one, you'll end up blood-stained. Dare to experience the unexpected!

title: The Dark Book 2
description: Explore dark secrets and battle evil in The Dark Book 2, the epic sequel to the dark fantasy RPG. An unconventional hero, a resurrected skeleton, unravels mysteries in sinister dungeons and dark lands. Confront malevolent creatures and formidable bosses. An enthralling adventure in the shadows

title: Star Stone Splash
description: Simple operation, extremely addictive. All you need to do is click, click, click.

title: Relgiros
description: RELGIROS, a plateform game, tests your patience and determination as it paces up surmounting obstacles, to boost you with the adrenaline rush. Through the game, the protagonist breezes through obstacles and traps, with a goal to prove worthy of the foresighted critical missions.

title: Rogues of Europa
description: Rogues of Europa is a gothic roguelike RPG. Fight the physical and metaphysical evils brewing below the surface of a rapidly modernizing society.

title: Blub
description: Blub is a cute but radioactive platforming adventure with detailed levels and challenging gameplay.

title: Invisible Fear
description: Invisible fear is a horror game where you will have to go through a nightmare, surviving during the nights, using your camera that is able to show the non-existent to your eyes...

title: Teku
description: Place hexagonal tiles to form islands across a selection of varied levels. Teku is a peaceful game where the goal is to achieve the highest possible score.

title: Volden Idle
description: Grind your way to 99 in this MMO inspired idle/clicking game!

title: Journey's Legend
description: Embark on an epic adventure in Journey's Legend! Choose from four unique characters, each armed with their own set of three powerful active abilities and a devastating ultimate ability. Find powerful relics to even further enhance them.

title: Voice of Flowers
description: Embark on an epic adventure full of perils and secrets. Explore distinct forsaken lands of Devetlam and fight your way by jumping on your enemies or showering them with a plethora of magic spells. An open-world platforming action inspired by the classics.

title: Avium
description: Avium is a sci-fi action adventure role-playing game in a city ruled by those of great cybernetic wealth and influence, such as the Big Four. A Plutocracy, a banana republic that keeps its peace with the employment of Vigilantes like you, Diezel, a War-Suit donning, crime-fighting hero with a past.

title: The Hospital of Fear
description: The Hospital of Fear - indie horror from the first person, in the genre of walking simulator. The main focus is on the atmosphere of horror, which is emphasized by realistic 3D graphics and immersive sounds, as well as a well-developed storyline with two endings.

title: Circle the Wagons: Prima Septimana
description: CTW is a survivors-like top-down-shooter with roguelite and tower-defense elements. Power up your cowboy with unique perks. Reinforce your camp with turrets, traps, and buildings. Survive against waves of hundreds of enemies. Explore unique synergies and builds, using every tool in your arsenal

title: Saga of the Moon Priestess
description: Explore a mystical world in classic top-down style and save the kidnapped prince! Saga of the Moon Priestess is a retro top-down action-adventure inspired by 8-bit and 16-bit classics,

title: Unknown Presence
description: Unknown Presence is a first-person adventure horror game where you will witness unexplainable phenomena, from floating orbs to unknown beings. You will explore many locations, from caves all the way up to snowy mountains and everything in between.

title: Cat's Vote
description:
Cat's Vote is a resource management and decision-making simulation where every choice counts. As the head of a feline household, you must ensure your family's happiness by meeting their needs—whether it's electricity/water bills, food, or entertainment. But there's a twist: the price of resources fluctuates based on the decisions of a cat government, and you get to cast your vote in the elections!

Every election season, you'll hear promises from candidates claiming they will reduce costs or improve living conditions, but can you trust them? Choose wisely, as the wrong decision could send prices soaring and your family into disarray.

Balance your limited budget, make strategic votes, and keep your family satisfied, all while navigating the unpredictable landscape of feline politics. Will you thrive, or will the promises made by smooth-talking candidates lead your family into ruin?

title: Agritopia
description: Become the largest food provider in history in Agritopia! Cultivate, unlock, and enhance your agricultural techniques to ensure a permanent food production to sustain the big cities, all while tackling the challenge of progressing through time and reaching the distant future's goal.

title: Lost For Swords
description: Lost For Swords is a Roguelike Deckbuilder, where the cards in your deck shape the rooms you’re exploring. Make your way up the tower, equip weapons and armor, cast spells and scrolls, activate auras, collect loot and defeat monsters in tactical turn-based combat.

title: Nine Errand
description: The protagonist, Nine, embarks on his first errand at the request of Alice. With his unique ability, Nine can resurrect no matter how many times he dies. Let's keep pushing forward without giving up, even in the face of death. Otherwise, you might incur the wrath of your master, Alice.

title: Aim in Space
description: A fantastic space game to train reaction and aiming skills. Don't let the aliens destroy your base!

title: Citres
description: Explore Citres, a unique blend of city-building & puzzle gameplay! Place Tetris-shaped buildings, merge them into advanced structures, and grow your population. Embrace strategy in a vibrant, low-poly world.

title: Assault Wing
description: Assault Wing is a free 2D side scrolling retro PvP shooter. You will choose your ship, special weapon and ship modification. The arenas are physics based with destructible terrain. See who of your friends is best with the global ranking system.

title: Bio Block
description: All new puzzle expereince!

title: Dream Celestial Body
description: Astronauts want to go home, begin fantasy adventure.

title: Kungfu
description: Kungfu is a simple strategic martial arts game.Enjoy it.

title: Traversion
description: Introducing Traversion, a movement-based arcade platformer with a focus on rocket jumping, strafing, and grappling to navigate levels as efficiently as possible. Enjoy a minimalist, skill-based experience where the primary goal is to achieve faster completion times and hone your senses.

title: Alstroemeria
description: It's a side-view scroll shooter. It's a game in which you control your own aircraft and shoot down enemy aircraft. There are 21 different types of weapons to attack, and if you accumulate 3 gauges on the UI, each selected weapon will be available for a certain amount of time.

title: Whale Game Online
description: Can You Make a Whale?It's a delightful game where you connect cute sea creatures to make them grow bigger.Single Player and Multiplayer Modes!There are both a single-player mode and a multiplayer mode for competing with friends and rivals from around the world.

title: LaserPoint
description: The turn-based strategy game that requires you to use building elements to hit all the laserpoints on each level with lasertrons! In this game, you'll encounter a variety of lasertrons that can be reflected, refracted, decomposed into a spectrum of lasertrons, or change colors.

title: Temple Guy: Quest for Chest
description: A chest full of diamonds awaits you on top of the Temple of Despair! Challenge yourself and climb the temple in this 2d-precision platformer!

title: Multiplayer Obby
description: Multiplayer Obby - A Fun Obstacle Course Race Party Game. Make your way across moving platforms, jump pads, rotating beams and bridges that suddenly open, and more. The first player to pick up the trophy is the winner!

title: Prophan Escape
description: In Prophan Escape you have to get five coper statues which are in random places around a labirynth to complete each level, it's that simple... Oh, yeah, there are also two antropomorphic weird cubes with realistic extremities that want to kill you, so you will have to avoid that weird guys.

title: Lost Pixel
description: Prepare to embark on an extraordinary journey like no other in Lost Pixel. You won't be stepping into the shoes of a traditional hero – instead, you'll take on the role of a lone, wandering pixel in a digital realm.

title: Anonymous Hunting Simulator
description: Anonymous Hunting Simulator is a dynamic first-person shooter. Your task is to explore the location and collect ten masks to complete the level.

title: Doashime
description: Dive into the chain boarding game "Doashime: Close the Door!" and fill the train with cute animals. While avoiding being spotted by station staff, chain same-colored animals for points, and ensure they board. Score until the last second and ascend to the top of the global rankings.

title: Emoji Sport
description: The soybean man sports meet has started, and you can manipulate your soybean man to compete and use different techniques to achieve different best results in the competition.

title: Sealchain
description: The "Sealchain" is a roguelite game where items can be connected to each other to create chain reactions. In this crumbling world, you will play as a medium, using the power of curse seals to cleanse the world of post-apocalyptic evil spirits.

title: SPGP Super Polygon Grand Prix
description: Ultra fast Retro Style Racing.

title: The Gnorp Apologue
description: (the) Gnorp Apologue is the journey of the gnorps as you guide them towards their goal of delightfully excessive wealth accumulation.

title: Call of Dookie
description: Imagine you went to the crapper, and emerged an hour later to a monster apocalypse! Retro first-person shooter action inspired by 90's classics! Old-school local deathmatch & co-op for up to 4 players!

title: Kumi-Daiko Beatoff
description: Whip and whack in the wildest couch multiplayer brawl! Put a mask on, get some friends over and unleash drum-whirling chaos together. May the nimblest of thumbs win!

title: Intravenous 2: Mercenarism
description: Playing as Gideon, a cold-hearted mercenary willing to kill for money without any moral principles, you'll have tactical freedom with a wide variety of weapons and special gadgets to complete your mission in the prologue of Intravenous 2.

title: Catast
description: This game is a puzzle game in which you destroy blocks with simple controls! Find a route to destroy many blocks at once and enjoy the pleasure of destroying them all at once!

title: Navigating the Labyrinth
description: Navigating the Labyrinth is a classic first-person party-based dungeon crawler RPG with grid-based movement and turn-based combat. Discover the secrets and riches of the labyrinths, and save your dying city.

title: Stacks: Jungle!
description: Stacks: Jungle! is an engaging adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more!

title: Merge ETO
description: It is a physics puzzle in which identical ETOs are merged together to transform them into the next ETO. Increase your combo count by successive merges, update your high score, and compete with the world on the Steam Leaderboard!

title: Cat Legend
description: The countless backyard gardens managed by Meow were simultaneously invaded by Mutant Lords. The situation was urgent, and the lively and kind-hearted Hakimi rushed out to defeat the Mutant Invaders, counterattack the Mutant Lords, and end the Source of Mutation.

title: M City
description: A crazy and strange town, filled with mysterious events. A hero with multiple personality disorders. Laughter, tears and madness!

title: Risiko Chess
description: Do you want to play chess? Monopoly? Risk? Or perhaps you want to play a wargame? Here you'll find all of that in one, wild game.

title: Noumisou Journey
description: A boy, is killed by a killer but resurrected on Halloween. But his brain had been stolen. Confront traps and monsters. Interact with strange inhabitants, solve puzzles, and get your brain back. Dying Game & comical horror. death scene collection feature available. pixel-art exploration adventure.

title: Fighting for Singleship: I am Chased by a Bunch of Women But I Just Want to Play Video Games
description: You relish indoor life, gaming, but now, a challenging twist: every woman adores you. Witness the story unfold. Conquer challenging waves of unhinged admirers, aiming to remain unmarried. Climb the leaderboard against your friends, proving your supremacy.

title: Galactic Heroes: Rise of the Black Alliance
description: Embark on a perilous journey as Max, the space ranger, to hunt down the leaders of the Black Alliance. Pilot different spacecraft, dodge asteroids, battle enemies, and confront ruthless leaders. Become a true hero of space!

title: K2: Digital Edition
description: Easy to play, hard to survive. Rush to the summit before weather breaks or set up camps and prepare to push later. Choose the right cards for the right moment. Play turn based strategy with friends, AI or in single player mode. Popular board game adaptation consulted with real K2 climbers.

title: Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder
description: A dead orphan has been found slashed next to Excalibur... Explore the orphanage to gather clues and uncover the truth in this colorful Game Boy-inspired mystery game, Detective Fantasia: Excalimurder!

title: Trading Simulator
description: Trading Simulator is an exciting and educational game that immerses you in the world of financial markets, where you become a virtual trader.

title: 3DC
description: 3DC is a graphic adventure that teaches children from 8 to 12 years old what depression is.

title: Tinkerlands: A Shipwrecked Adventure
description: Tinkerlands: A Shipwrecked Adventure is your portal to the expansive world of Tinkerlands. Uncover the story of the first survivors on these mystical and fantastical islands. Explore the breathtaking archipelago, craft essential tools, build your settlement, and strive to survive!

title: The Light of the Darkness: Origins
description:
A captivating dark fantasy action RPG featuring rich-visual biomes, an intriguing narrative, and a challenging Souls-like combat.
Players experience unique and epic aerial combats and exploration with a winged protagonist and absorb essence from others to grab their essence and natures. While doing so, they collect items that help to uncover a dense lore in this 8-hour adventure in the 'Lands of Oblivion, a perfect warm-up for players craving for short metroidvania/souls-like games before diving into heavier titles.

title: Forsisted: The Sacred Souls
description: Forsisted is a horror game, a mission to find an object in an abandoned mansion that is known to be cursed.

title: StarL2
description: Enjoy StarL2 a lovely fresh take on Match 3 games! A huge and colorful game with numerous levels of varying complexity. You must demolish tiles. You may build rows or lines of three by swapping adjacent stones. Collect more than three gems to unlock further goods.

title: Drink Human Beans
description: You will pay $99.99 to be psychologically tortured by a sentient job application. You will learn to live, laugh, love until the walls bleed. You will become a succulent beverage.

title: Cosmic Gunslinger: Alien Outlaws
description: Cosmic Gunslinger: Alien Outlaws is a pulse-pounding single-player video game where you, as the gunslinger cowboy Cosmo, and your trusty canine companion, must survive relentless waves of Aliens. Upgrade your weapons, collect crucial items. Can you outdraw and outlast the alien threat?

title: Magret & FaceDeBouc
description: The pilot episode of a likely long series of police investigations. Take control of an unlikely duo consisting of Inspector Magret, a refined duck and Inspector FaceDeBouc a devilishly contrasting goat. Help them solve the mystery of the murder of Mr. Couane, a local merchant found dead in the city.

title: The Adventures of The Black Hawk
description: Hide behind your mask so they won’t discover your true identity, and grab your sword to face the tyranny of the nobility in the days before the French Revolution in this funny point-and-click adventure, following the path of the classics of the 90s… thirty years later!

title: Chinese Ancient Poetry Matching Game
description: This game is a classic tile-matching game. Players can match tiles by clicking on the corresponding tiles in the order of Chinese ancient poetry, lyrics, and prose to pass levels. Through this game, players can experience the charm of traditional Chinese culture.

title: Survial
description: This is a classic RPG game.

title: Contorted
description: Contorted is a exploration/gameplay focused horror game, where you decend down seemingly endless amount of mysterious wells to find someone, only to find out you're neither alone or safe

title: Project I
description: Project I is an action-adventure game that follows the protagonist's journey to escape from an unknown laboratory and regain who he is. Defeat the enemies and escape from the lab.

title: The End Grows
description:
"The End Grows - a tales of Ashes" is a 2D action RPG combining exploration and time loops. Players battle hordes of monsters in a world collapsing every five minutes, grow stronger through persistent gear between runs, and uncover a powerful story told across 8 chapters filled with revelations.

The game is part of the Ashes saga, set in the same universe as "Ashes – Exponential RPG" released on mobile.

title: Potato Sack Racing Simulator 2024
description: I know what you are thinking, and yes, this game does feature the ability to fight grandparents, mugs, speakers and of course dirty tissues... Wait, this is a game about Potato Sack Racing? Umm.. Yeah there are like 4 levels about Potato Sack Racing out of the 17 levels... Phew, we almost forgot to make it have something to do with Potato Sack Racing! But now trust me bro, this game is the BEST Potato Sack Racing game to have ever been made! At least, from what we could find.. Yeah this is actually the first and only Potato Sack Racing game, it’s almost like it’s not a good idea to make a game about Potato Sack Racing, it’s pretty fun to say Potato Sack Racing. Potatooooo sack racingggggg!!!!

title: 100 Tokyo Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Tokyo Cats.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Nicotero Leatherface
description: From the mind of legendary special make-up effects creator, producer, and director Greg Nicotero, comes this twisted new Leatherface created exclusively for The Texas Chain Saw Massacre.

title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Click or Treat
description: The "Click or Treat" DLC serves as an expansion to the base game, introducing a new island within the HUB area. This island will feature portals leading to three spooky-themed levels, each with a unique gameplay focus.

title: Trepang2: Survival Mode
description: Test your ultimate badass skills with the Trepang2 Survival Mode DLC.

title: Elven Assassin: Rise of Darkness
description: Step into a world shrouded in darkness and take up your bow as you face off against an army of the Risen, from Skeletons to Undead Dragons. With the gloomy atmosphere and intense gameplay, prepare to test your archery skills as you defend the town on three new maps. Are you ready to join the battle?

title: Session: Skate Sim - Abandoned Mall
description: The skatepark skateboarders have been dreaming of. Check out the Abandoned Mall and find all the new spots where you can perform your best tricks.

title: Otherworld Legends: Ourania
description:
Hero Ourania
Drifts from the perennially snowbound steppes ever accompany the ethereally graceful Ourania, sweeping sin from every corner of the world and delivering her blessings in their stead. Doted upon by the spirits of her animistic ancestors, the fledgeling shamaness swirls and glissades through the immaculate landscape with unfettered carefreeness, her eyes bright as a sky after rain and her elfin form brimming with numinous potential.
[h3]Mark of Shamaness:[/h3]
Your skills and normal attacks apply a stacking Mark of Shamaness on enemies. Once the Mark has reached 8 stacks, your next normal attack will cause it to detonate, dealing damage.
You can absorb Mark of Shamaness from enemies by slaying them or holding down dodge, converting the Marks into Shamanic Mana. Once your Shamanic Mana is full, you gain the ability to transform into the Whisper of Spirit by holding down dodge.
[h3]Whisper of Spirit:[/h3]
You take on the form of a windborne plume that can freely traverse the environment, dealing high damage to enemies in your path and slowing them. Once the form ends, dodge will be unusable for a time.

title: Otherworld Legends: Synthia
description:
Hero Synthia
A cybernetically augmented and neurally conditioned transhuman, Synthia is able to bring to bear her hulking arsenal of Exoframe to sow carnage among enemies with terrifying ease.
Using exoframe builds up Heat. Upon reaching a threshold, you enter an Overheat state with heightened attack speed and movement speed, as well as a chance to burn enemies with your normal attack.
An actively-firing exoframe can be manually halted and cooled down by holding down its corresponding skill button.
If allowed to peak, excess Heat will trigger an Overload, rendering you unable to perform any action for a time in addition to initiating an extended cooldown on all skills.

title: Otherworld Legends: Sinistar Ruthven
description:
Skin for Ruthven : Sinistar Ruthven
For seven days and nights, Uriel Longinus, the Ferrum Daemonum, held his ground against the hundred thousand heavenly hosts who would compel his arraignment following his defiance of the Dictum Divinas. Ultimately battered and spent, Uriel was forced to abscond to the realm of man. Consciousness desperately waning, Uriel tethered his primordial animus to the form of a passing novitiate sword-brother - Ruthven - and over the course of the following days and years, clandestinely aided the latter in the honing of his swordcraft, intending to subjugate his mortal corpus once his own faculties were redeemed.
As Ruthven's mettle was whetted to a fine point, so too undeniably brilliant did its glint reflect among the rank and file of his House. Yet, on one fateful day where a sparring duel was to be arranged, Ruthven, in a moment of hubris, unleashed a strike fortified by livid Daemonic energy, instantly damning him as an irredeemable traitor to be hunted for all time. Hopeless and outnumbered against his former kin, Ruthven made one final appeal to Uriel, who answered by manifesting into being - and rebuking their beleaguering troupe of would-be executioners with ruthless efficiency - an act that was apparent in its message to the Celestial Realm. As celestial champions, one after another, set themselves to tracking down the revived Ferrum Daemonum and his human servitor to enforce their demise, the Daemonic duo steel themselves for a stand to the death... for a chance to live.

title: Otherworld Legends: Atomic Girl
description:
Skin for Anibella : Atomic Girl
Beneath the opulent neon-baptized countenance of Arcarune - the megapolitan hub of technological wonders - a syndicate of institutional malefactors scuttle to enact their Machiavellian machinations, while a coalition of the city's excelsiors - Atomic Girl and her companions - rise to meet them.
Time and time again, Anibella confides in not just her prodigious technological innovations and nonpareil rocket-saddled jockeying skills, but also the indefatigable teamwork of her fellow vigilantes to foil the sinister schemes of Arcarune's criminal underbelly.

title: Bus Simulator 21: Next Stop - Official Tram Extension
description: This DLC gives you access to your own trams that you can operate, buy, and customize. Tram routes become available for you to plan and create. Additionally, there are also new story missions and driving events.

title: OMSI 2: Agora Bus Family Citybus Vol. 2

title: Gloomy Tales: One-Way Ticket DLC
description: Dare to face the darkness, uncover the secrets, and emerge victorious in the face of the unknown. The adventure awaits - are you ready to embark on it?

title: Puzzle Land
description: Puzzle Land is a remake of the gameboy game Daedalian opus also known as puzzle road in japan.

title: Bendy: The Cage
description:
Test your sanity as you take control of Henry in this third person horror experience taking place during the events of Bendy and the Dark Revival.

Condemned to the Keeper prison known as "The Pit", Henry must survive the horrific inmates and mangled experiments set loose to devour him. A labyrinth of steel industrial dread lay before him as his mind is invaded by the past.

Discover the hidden blood-stained truth behind the monsters as you explore the dark levels of The Pit, slowly making your way to the very top of the facility.

Take on the darkness with your axe in brutal melee combat: Unleash fast and heavy strikes, block and parry incoming attacks, shove foes away, stomp on enemies with a vengeance, and time dodges to avoid being torn apart by the things that hunt you. Dive into the shadows for limited supplies as you embark on a twisted tale of Henry's self discovery while facing down new and familiar creatures of the ink.

Find the maestro. Escape the prison. Fight the madness.

title: Funky Cards Arena
description: A deck builder game which consists of utilizing your cards to destroy the opposing orb. It is a large crossover of many franchises, you can make Garfield battle Neymar from Fortnite, Goku battle Dora and there are even original characters. You will be able to unlock them all in the Funky Packs.

title: Model Employee
description:
Model Employee is a corporate horror visual novel where players take control of the latest individual amongst millions to start working in one of Tethys' online shopping labyrinthine warehouses. Just discharged from the hospital and massively in debt for their life-saving cybernetics, the player-character must adapt to the "extreme" work-life balance of a Tethys Team Member- but they have help.

Penny, the artificial personality that controls all security, waste disposal, and employee surveillance in the facility, specializes in reinforcing an especially cutthroat variety of workplace culture- and she's taken an interest in you.

With a vibrant cast, PC-98 inspired visuals and multiple endings, Model Employee is a modern horror story that'll stick with you long after you've clocked out of your shift.

If you want to get ahead in your career, you gotta be willing to take some risks.

title: A Little Walk in the Woods
description: Embark on an enchanting adventure with our 2D platform game, where a courageous girl sets off on a delightful stroll through the woods in search of hidden treasure. With its captivating pixel art style, immerse yourself in a world filled with charming landscapes and intricate obstacles. Traverse through 25 captivating levels, each brimming with challenges and surprises. Will you help the girl find the treasure and return home safely?

title: I Can Destroy Everything!!!
description: In this game, you can destroy all objects on the map! It's a fun and relaxing way to relieve stress and entertain yourself. Give this game a try to unwind!

title: Perfect Heist 2: Historic Characters DLC
description: Plan your heist with 6 brand-new historic characters! Perfect your robber strategy with Einstein, Al Capone, and Karl Marx. Or try to catch the robbers with Marie Curie, Caesar, and Queen Elizabeth I.

title: Deadliest Demolition
description: A 11-map Vanilla Dehacked mapset loosely inspired by the 1995 Cabal series, originally created for NaNoWADMo 2022. This mod contains numerous gameplay changes to your weapons. After a humiliating defeat, your supervisor saw it fit to demote you from a cyberdemon to a mere human, so that you can learn to maximize your combat potential instead of squandering your superior firepower. But there's no force in hell that could ever make you part with your beloved weapon...

title: Bloodbaths Terrible Vacation
description: Bloodbath's Terrible Vacation is about my bad experience on a doomed vacation. This wad consists of four small island maps with lots of action. The chaingun, rocket launcher, and plasma gun have all received an upgrade for the adventure. MAP01 is a thrill-seeking adventure to a tropical island, with lots of unsightly guests to contend with. MAP02 is a bit more chill, but still has enough heat so your chaingun does not freeze over. MAP03 is a romp through one of the hottest vacation spots imaginable. MAP04 is a look into how this adventure was booked in the first place.

title: Hotel of the Dead
description: You come to your senses on the street outside the hotel building and suddenly find crowds of demonic creatures all around you. You realize that you need to get out of the place as quickly as possible. But there's HE waiting outside the main gate. Knowing that you are incapable of confronting this horror now, you have no choice but to take refuge in the hotel building itself. There is no easy way out...

title: Ciudad Empresarial
description: Ciudad Empresarial is a vanilla map inspired by the early city levels of A.L.T. and my own previous works, most notably El Viaje de Diciembre. The map takes you through some kind of apartment complex, up onto the roof, down into the parking lot and finally out on the avenue. It's a mostly straightforward layout, and should take you about 20 minutes to beat blind. ﻿There's a catch though: I've added three new monsters through DeHackEd!

title: Jigsaw Together
description: jigsaw Together is a jigsaw puzzle game that supports custom materials. In this game, you can customize the number of puzzle pieces and use local images, MP4 videos, or specify web pages as background materials for playing.

title: Lust Bunker
description: Welcome to "Lust Bunker" – an enthralling adult visual novel that will immerse you in an underground world where intrigue, choices, and passion shape your destiny.

title: Dice Up
description: Dice Up is a puzzle platformer where you eat food to gain powers. Eat a large block of food to get a single use strong effect, or dice your food up into smaller pieces to gain a weaker effect that you can use multiple times. Determine how to dice up each food to reach the exit.

title: My Next Life as a Bird
description: "My Next Life as a Bird" is a speedrun platformer game. Players can customize various mechanics using "Bird Coins," evade incoming magical projectiles, and aim to reach the finish line as quickly as possible, creating their own fastest completion journey.

title: 18 Minutes
description: 18 Minutes is a single player FPS that combines stealthy precision with heart-pounding action. Engage in intense firefights, strategically infiltrate enemy base, and make split- second decision to outmaneuver enemy. Get ready for a gaming experience that offers the best of stealth and FPS action

title: Your House
description: A narrative puzzle-thriller that blurs the lines between games and books, reality and fiction, puzzles and storytelling.

title: Delivery INC: Large Cargo
description: Expand your fleet with trucks and conquer the large cargo market. Pursue new lucrative contracts, hire delivery assistants, and enjoy a new campaign scenario taking place in Stockholm, Sweden. Large Cargo is coming!

title: House with Puzzles
description: An unexpected inheritance has forced you to come to your grandfather's mansion. Grandfather was not an ordinary man, but a former NKVD officer. The house is filled with various puzzles. And to find the will you need to solve all of them.

title: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
description: Dive into Omnivael's enchanting world on PC! Master magic, embark on quests, and explore diverse realms. Uncover mysteries today!

title: Untamed Kingdom
description: Shadow Stalk Studios is an indie company creating Untamed Kingdom. We want to create a space for everyone to enjoy and explore with friends. Come join us as we adventure through the wilderness!

title: New Zealand Jigsaw Puzzles
description: Explore New Zealand's stunning landscapes in a captivating jigsaw puzzle adventure. Unravel the beauty piece by piece!

title: Torbaci Oyunu
description: Get ready to be the hero of your own city

description: Adult-Only Fantasy Visual Novel featuring 3 girls, a variety of choices, comedy, and sex in an exciting story with different endings!

title: Dawn of Anarchy
description: In Dawn of Anarchy, your skills, determination, and combat prowess will be put to the ultimate test. Will you be the hero the world needs to quell the uprising and bring an end to mechanical tyranny? Prepare for the battle of a lifetime amidst the dawn of anarchy.

title: IFU
description: IFU is a psychological horror about a young guy who is forcibly locked in an abandoned mansion of a dead surgeon along with his restless soul.

title: JailBreaker
description: A punishing, one-button platformer about escaping prison. Test your skills and intellect as you ascend a tower of hand-crafted challenges. Jump, fly, slide up walls, float in bubbles and perform somersaults; all with the press of a single button. Reach the paramount. Reach.

title: CastingPlz
description: CastingPlz is a 2-player cooperative roguelike game where players take on the roles of two characters with distinct responsibilities: one for attacking and the other for movement.

title: Dragonero
description: Dragonero is an immersive turn-based combat RPG set in a vast and savage fantasy world. Guide the heroes through trap-strewn dungeons, dozens of enemies and embark on your journeys with strategy. Protect the Erondár and defeat the Necromancer!

title: Cake Game
description: Strategize, combine cakes, and bake your way to victory!

title: Hot And Lovely: Tease
description: Hot And Lovely: Tease is a classic matching game. Slide the blocks to make three or more adjacent blocks of the same pattern disappear. After eliminating specific blocks, you can enter the next level. The game is easy to operate and easy to play.

title: Spellarium 10
description: Play Match 3, grow the elemental crystals, and place them in a secure location! If you get tired of Match 3, there are some extras to entertain you!

title: Shadow Of Sound
description: Traditional 4k drop style music game —— "Shadow Of Sound".

title: Dark Gem Tower Defense
description: Atmospheric tower defense. How many waves can you defend? Basic tower defense in a fantasy setting with gems.

description: This is a role-playing game with RPG-survival elements, based on an alternative history of ancient Slavs. You'll also find numerous references and plots based on Slavic mythology and fairy tales. Explore the open game world on your own or with friends.

title: Kerker
description: Kerker is a procedurally generated dungeon crawler FPS roguelike that challenges the player with its varying cast of enemies, exclusive weapons and different dungeon types. Fight your way to riches by slaying foes, obtaining/combining unique abilities and finding forgotten treasures.

title: Homage: Godless Grotto
description: Venture into the unforgiving caverns under the mountain on an impossible quest in this high-fantasy split screen roleplaying game.

title: SCP: Containment Chaos
description: SCP: Containment Chaos is a co-op horror survival game for 1-4 players. Become SCP Foundation agents tasked with containing and researching anomalous entities in parallel universes.

title: Rivers of Blood
description: Alice suffers an accident and wakes up in a parallel world created by her unconscious in a state of coma. Now she needs to find the strength and means to survive and return to the real world, in this new reality that is completely different and much more terrifying than any nightmare.

title: Pools
description: Liminal space game with focus on eerie exploration and immersion instead of typical horror. Navigate through endless alike rooms. Explore, orient, get out.

title: 3Paths
description: It's up to you to decide the fate of 3 girls! What choice will you make in this story of love, friendship and sadness? Adventure through alternate times in this visual novel that gives you a different experience every time you play it again!

title: Cooktopia
description: Cook and serve your delicious orders as fast as you can. A must try cooking simulator with endless fun!

title: Hermit Simulator
description: Being a hermit is not easy, but it is the way to freedom, where you have to survive and build a new home. Farming, hunting, fishing, gathering, building, crafting, trading and exploration await you in the hermit simulator! Will you be able to survive on your way and become the master of the forest?

title: Mecha Blitz
description: Build mechs and fight in this fast-paced, anime-inspired isometric top down shooter with online multiplayer PvP and single player PvE game modes. Customize your robot fighter with a variety of parts, weapons and cosmetics. Upgrade your equipment, abilities and stats. Battle and win in the arena!

title: Auroria
description: Welcome to Auroria, an open-world, multiplayer, and cooperative sandbox game. Design the Base, survive with your pals, and start your own interstellar travel in a relaxed and fun way.

title: FreeChicken
description: A 3D adventure single-player game for freedom! Test your agility to avoid traps and obstacles as you embark on a journey for freedom! Don't worry, there's a game save function, so start playing right away! Our game supports both English and Korean.

title: Block Catching
description: An online game of block catching with a twist. The catcher is not your friend.

title: Volkolak: The Will of Gods
description: Volkolak: The Will of Gods is an epic 2D soulsvania in a dark Slavic fantasy setting, with hand-drawn animation. Explore an enchanted world full of secrets and enemies. Your choices will lead to several endings: become a warrior, a werewolf, or join the darkness.

title: Side To Side
description: ¡Immerse yourself in this incredible universe and get ready for a challenge by pushing your skills to the limit... Let yourself be carried away by its dazzling effects according to the music!

title: To Infinity
description: To Infinity tells the adventures of a schizophrenic astronaut. The astronaut escapes from the world and goes to search for other planets where he can live with his spaceship, and in the meantime, he constantly makes parkour, witnessing the epic view of the universe.

title: Amber
description: Join Amber on a whimsical journey through the 5 kingdoms: Candy, Cake, Story, Rainbow, and Crystal. Spread love, restore balance with Amber Crystals, confront rulers, and set things right using the Mallet, Chocolate Staff, and Bubblegum Wand. Glide with the Rainbow Umbrella!

title: Endless Maze
description: This is a first-person 3D maze-themed casual game. The game features many different interesting mazes, each with its own characteristics. Each level is relatively short, focusing on the fun of the maze. Additionally, it also offers randomly generated traditional mazes of selectable sizes.

title: Vague
description: Vague is a first-person psychological horror inspired by early 2000s classic horror titles. Experience the unsettling atmosphere as you follow Raymond K. Fisher in his search for his missing family.

title: Summer of Love
description: In Summer of Love, you can have a happy ending (Romance Ending or Harem Ending), a neutral ending (Swinging Ending) or a sad ending (Netorare Ending) depending on how you play.

title: Monster Coming
description: "Monster Coming" is a fast-paced survivor roguelite game. Dark cracks suddenly appeared in the sky, and a tide of beasts emerged from them to invade humans. You stand up as one of the braves, face the menacing beast tide, choose your equipment, formulate tactics, and feel unparalleled.

title: Watcher Of The Abyss
description: "One day, a mysterious abyssal vortex appeared, unleashing countless monsters set on world destruction. Choose your warriors to guard the abyss. Collect tokens from fallen foes, buy nodes, and strategically place them for ultimate power. Reclaim abyss-covered areas."

title: Type Your Fate
description: Type your fate. Arm yourself with your keyboard and your wits, and try to escape from the abandoned house where you are. Unfortunately, you won't be alone...

title: Rotten Flesh
description: Rotten Flesh is a cosmic horror survival game where you have just lost your dog named Roy and you have to find him by shouting for "Roy" on your microphone. Venture deep into the sewers where your dog was lost - however, something else can also hear your screams in the tunnels.

title: Covert Ultra
description: Covert Ultra is an arcade-style tactical shooter, and every level is a lone-wolf terrorist hunt. Play as a high-tech hitman for hire with spider-like abilities and compete to achieve each mission's best time and highest rank. Efficiency is your only priority.

title: Redrum Hotel
description: Redrum Hotel is a short, first-person horror adventure game. Roam around the haunted hotel, collecting strangely scattered notes and avoiding the evil presence that seeks to rid you of your sanity.

title: Alice and The Ancients
description: Advance forward, surpassing all the Ancients on the battlefield!

title: Snake Crush Survivors
description: This is a Roguelite game that combines the gameplay of Snake with survivor mechanics. You will play as a large snake roaming above the city, clearing countless small monsters and spirits attracted by spiritual energy, as well as those frenzied large monsters.

title: Rewind And Reclaim
description: Rewind and Reclaim is a turn-based adventure inspired by 90's horror movies. Explore different B movie scenarios by creating scenes in which victims outsmart villains. Investigate their terrifying behind the scenes to unfold the story linking them all.

title: Apex Legends: Ignite
description:
Rowenna grew up amidst a war, but in a move that turned the tide, one Monarch Titan sacrificed itself to end the fighting. In the years after, her home planet of Nexus established ties across the Outlands, introducing Rowenna to the Apex Games. The Games represented everything she aspired to–heroism, hard work, sacrifice—and she became a dedicated fan.

When her elder sister Diwa suffered a terrible injury at work, Rowenna resolved to support her family no matter what. She stole the battery from the Monarch, still rusting on the hill, and had a combat rig built with its battery at the core. She used it to qualify for the Apex Games, and even though the battery exposes her to poisonous radiation, she refuses to give up. No one else was going to get hurt to support her family. Rowenna’s choosing to have hope for her dreams or die trying. Now, it’s Conduit’s chance for a day in the sun.

title: Remnant II: The Awakened King
description:
The One True King has awakened and is out for blood. Corrupted by the Root during his near-death slumber, the mad king sees betrayal at every turn and is on a rampage of revenge. Since his castle first arrived in a Dran coastal town, the tides are angry and the weather is chaotic, surfacing all manner of creatures from the depths and leaving many mysteries in its wake.

This DLC adds the Ritualist archetyp, a new storyline, dungeons and area based in the world of Losomn. It includes a wide array of new weapons, modifications, amulets, and rings along with new bosses, characters and fearsome creatures to encounter.

title: TSR Halloween Party
description: The cast of The Smoke Room prepare for a Halloween corn maze in a modern day AU.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - The Crepuscule Zone
description:
Version 1.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Huohuo, Argenti and Hanya
• New area: Fyxestroll Garden
• New trailblaze mission
• New companion mission for Argenti
• Simulated Universe update (World 8) and new enemies
• New main event: A Foxian Tale of the Haunted
• …and more!

title: Filthy Us: Complete Edition
description: Filthy Us: Complete Edition is an original horror adventure game with a dark story and puzzle elements. The game not only contains a large number of Buddhist and oriental elements, but also the horrifying customs of the people who used to live in that world.

title: Baker Street Breakouts
description:
"Baker Street Breakouts" combines the thrill of an Escape Room with the storytelling of an Adventure. Use your superior deduction skills in this story-driven mystery to help Sherlock deducing his way through an old film studio to finally face his arch nemesis Moriarty. Become a Master of Deduction!

"Baker Street Breakouts" focusses on puzzles and deduction. Instead of combat or grinding, the game challenges players to use their superior deduction skills and the ability to combine items in order to solve riddles and progress through the game. Explore, investigate, combine, deduce!

title: Maido Manie
description: White Rabbit Maid Café, owned by Iiko Shinkaichi, is losing money because there is a better Maid Café next door! What would be a better idea than to send her feminine younger brother to work there as a maid to find out their secrets?

title: Wormwood: Expanded Universe
description: A sequel to 2019's Wormwood, Expanded Universe is another Halloween-themed collaboration between Grain of Salt and Ribbiks

title: Wormwood III: The Horror
description: A sequel to Wormwood: Expanded Universe by Grain of Salt and Ribbiks.

title: Wormwood IV: The Final Chapter
description: A 10-level Halloween-themed wad for Doom II, Wormwood IV features maps by Ribbiks, Grain of Salt, and dannebubinga.

title: Wormwood V
description: The fifth entry in the Wormwood series of Doom II wads, featuring maps by Grain of Salt and Ribbiks.

title: The Police Mystery
description: The police have arrested dangerous criminals from the neighborhood and sent them to jail. During their time in jail, one of them was a witch who casted a spell to shrink many police officers to the size of an ant. The tinies now need to get a giantess police woman's attention before it's too late.

title: Grove
description: Nurture a small forest under siege by lumberjacks in this cozy tower defense game. Plant and upgrade trees with unique abilities to protect your grove, customize and decorate your forest, and unwind with the soothing escape of building a natural haven from a single sapling.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Greece
description: Explore the charm of inland Greece and discover enchanting islands, with approx. 14 cities waiting to be discovered. Picture yourself cruising through postcard-perfect villages, navigating winding roads, and passing iconic landmarks, immersing yourself in the centuries-old tapestry of Greek culture.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Impostor - Human Hijinks
description: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Impostor - Human Hijinks is a re-envisioning of Friday Night Funkin': vs. Impostor by Clowfoe, turning the Among Us crewmates and impostors into humans.

title: Sumo Tatami
description: Welcome to the uproarious world of Sumo Tatami, where bumbling sumo wrestlers take center stage in a plethora of zany and competitive platformer modes! Brace yourself for a side-splitting, body-slamming adventure as you go head-to-head with your friends and adversaries in races, king-of-the-hill battles, duels, bowling, golf, and more.

title: Hitman 3: Ambrose Island
description:
Ambrose Island is a brand new location for HITMAN 3, and a major release as part of our ‘Year 2‘ plans. It’s available now as a free download, included with the July Patch.

Embark on a new adventure with Agent 47 to a secluded island in the Andaman Sea. Located north from the Strait of Malacca, Ambrose Island is an isolated harbour packed full of dense vegetation, hidden coves, twisting paths and perilous bridges.

From the lit torches that illuminate narrow passageways, to the neon lights that flicker over the bustle of Farah’s bar, there’s a sense of discovery around every corner.

title: Sunland Town
description: Welcome to Sunland Town a serene and mystical walking simulator. Explore a captivating world as you search for hidden items, unlock secrets, and immerse yourself in the beauty of this unique town!

title: OhMyRace!

title: Miss Paint: Part 1
description:
To start us off, a bit of Athenian trivia. "Peristeri" is a real area of Athens, and the Greek word for "pigeon".

You will find pigeons in this fictional version of Peristeri - or, rather, they will find you - but were we to name this godforsaken place after the creature that populates it most densely, we really should call it "Cops".

Cops are a part of this story. Homeless men are a part of this story. Young artists who suffer menial part-time jobs to fund their creative pursuits are a part of this story. The protagonist of this story, however, is a middle-aged woman named Iris.

You would call Iris a protagonist, but you would never call her a hero, especially not to her face. If you called Iris a hero, she might actually die. Why? Because, God, she's no hero, am I? I mean, is she? Let me answer that: she's not. In fact, she's nobody, really. A totally unexceptional, deeply conservative, borderline detached shadow of a person who'd just like some paint. Pai--? Sorry, I meant paint. No. Not paint. I was gonna say she just wants some--

P a i n t.

Adventure RPG game of Abe, Bambo, Cici against the dark witch Indra who will resurrect the 1000 year old Demon. Interesting story, exciting battles, animated with Indonesian language, fun to play.

The Divinekids Adventure was the first Indonesian game to be awarded the MURI award in 2004.

title: Uncharted Lands: Beginning
description: old school dungeon crawler in pseudo 3d graphics from 90's

title: Weekend Solitaire: Summer Village
description: It's time to take on Solitaire Challenge. Pass the game's several stages. Conquer challenging card configurations and take on a big, vibrant game with several levels of varying difficulties. Overcome challenges, create combinations, and get bonuses.

title: Mindwave
description: Make your way to the top of Mindscape Tower and delve into the minds of your opponents in a cerebral microgame frenzy!

title: Overwatch 2: Season 8 - Call of the Hunt
description: Overwatch 2 Season 8: Call of the Hunt adds the newest tank Hero, Mauga, along with Beast Hunter-themed skins in a new Battle Pass.

title: Diablo IV: Vessel of Hatred
description:
The battle against Hatred has only just begun.
Journey into the new region of Nahantu in search of Neyrelle, who is both suffering the fate of her choice to imprison the Prime Evil Mephisto, and seeking a means to destroy him.
Become the apex predator of the jungle as the all-new Spiritborn class. Recruit Mercenaries to aid you in combat, fight together in a new PvE co-op activity, & more.

title: Hearthstone: Showdown in the Badlands
description: The Bloodrock Mining Company found powerful Azerite in the Badlands. They’re digging deep and bleeding the land dry, disrupting the Badlands and awakening slumbering elementals! Now mysterious outlaws are riding into town to set things right. Tumbleweeds roll by and high noon looms. Grab your horse and your hat, it’s nearly time for a Showdown in the Badlands

title: World of Warcraft: Cataclysm Classic
description: The World-changing Cataclysm arrives in World of Warcraft Classic, with changes made from the original release based on fan feedback.

title: World of Warcraft Classic: Season of Discovery
description: Seasonal content arrives to World of Warcraft Classic, adding new playstyles to previous classes, reimagined instances, new PvP areas, and more.

title: World of Warcraft: The War Within
description:
Journey through never-before-seen subterranean worlds filled with hidden wonders and lurking perils, down to the dark depths of the nerubian empire, where the malicious Harbinger of the Void is gathering arachnid forces to bring Azeroth to its knees.

Deep beneath the surface lies treasure vaults waiting to be discovered with Delves. Explore these world instances solo or with up to four friends, along with an NPC companion, to defeat bosses and gain epic end-game loot.

Expand the potential of your alternate characters with account-wide progression across your family of characters on your Battle.net account with Warbands. Share your Warband Bank access, War Within Renown, achievements, collections, and more.

Rise to new heights of power with new Hero Talent trees. Each class specialization has access to two choices of self-contained Hero Talent trees inspired by iconic Warcraft universe archetypes.

title: World of Warcraft: Midnight
description:
The second of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

Introducing Housing!
Before you put down roots in your own cozy corner of Azeroth later this year, jump into our virtual tour for an early glimpse at the customization options that await you.

Explore New and Reimagined Zones
The battle between the Light and the Void spans across four zones as you discover new allies and confront ancient enemies.
- Silvermoon City
- Eversong
- Zul'Aman
- Harandar
- Voidstorm

New Features and Improvements
As the Void invasion descends upon Quel'Thalas, an array of new features add more depth and improvements to our evolving world.
- Prey
- Devourer Demon Hunter
- Haranir
- Dungeons and Raids
- New and Returning Player Experience
- Transmog Updates

title: World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
description: The third of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

title: Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
description:
The Windows/Mac version of Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue was more like an activity center. The game uses interactive CD-ROMs called Datazords that provide a virtual interactive Power Rangers experience.

Originally it was released on 6 CDs, bundled in complete with Power Rangers figure toys (one CD for each figure).

title: FreeJack Online
description: FreeJack is a classic free-to-play multiplayer parkour racing game.

title: Sharp Things
description: Single map for Ultimate Doom created for the first Battle of the Bits Doom compo. In this spectacular adventure, you must wage a one-man war against a thorn bush in your backyard that happens to accidentally contain a portal to spiky hell. Time to break out the metaphorical weed whacker!

title: Endless Torture
description: 36 maps with various difficulties by the French Doom community.

title: Selfish Series
description: Selfish Series (Boom Edition) (bselfish.wad) is a compilation of seven maps of varying styles for Doom II, created by Paul Corfiatis.

title: Angmngthoo
description: a single map with brutalist style architecture

title: Grungy Grotto
description: A quake themed map

title: Malleable Intent
description: All is not well within the confines of the UAC, but what else is new. Hidden high atop a remote plateau, sinister machinations unfurl themselves inside this facility's walls. The demonic threat is present once again, but this time it seems that someone at the top was keeping fevered secrets well before their arrival. What price did they pay for progress? You'll have to procure your answers, and your equipment, on-site, but nothing should prove too elusive for a seasoned hellwalker like yourself. Leave no stone unturned, no evil unpurged, and dismantle the mechanisms behind this malleable intent.

title: A Stygian Anguish
description: The hellspawn spilled out of the UAC's hidden plateau base in a deluge of blood and fire, but that was only the beginning. It's clear now that the perpetuating evil took advantage of the Director's malleable intent; otherwise the assumption is that the UAC actually had the hubris to meddle with those otherworldly forces when the inevitable outcome has been laid bare time and again. As you step into the cargo lift and descend into the depths of the caverns beneath the plateau, you wonder what was worth burying under all this rock and stone. If the malice you faced to get here was just scratching the surface, what lies in wait in the darkness below? You steel yourself for what is to come, for anything given this much effort to conceal can result in nothing less than A Stygian Anguish.

title: Light Path
description: This is a casual racing game. You drove a big truck to a coastal city and had a car race in the city.

title: Galine
description: Jdagenet's first map in boom format.

title: Bromine
description: Somewhat large Limit-Removing level

title: Bichiro in a Cave
description: Bichiro, don't go there!

title: Novis
description: Novis is a standard, medium sized hell leveI designed in just under a month from scratch.

title: CodeRed: Battle for Earth
description: Standalone 3D first-person shooter running on Quake II's engine. Your mission is to defend the earth from the alien invasion and to discover the URF commanders secrets.

title: DarkGems
description: DarkGems is a cartoony mining rogue-lite game set in the deep gemstone caverns. Journey through three randomly generated map kinds filled with zombies, ghosts and demons. Keep an eye on your rapidly ending energy supply - one cannot survive in the dark dungeon without a light.

title: CodeRed: The Martian Chronicles
description: The Martian Chronicles is an expansion pack for CodeRED: Battle for Earth. Compared to Battle for Earth, The Martian Chronicles features several new enemies, improvements to the AI and graphics, and the level design is generally aimed at more intense, fast-paced, combat-oriented action.

title: Scudhead
description: This episode comprises five Plutonia maps which were originally submitted to FDTWID, mostly dating back to 2017. They include some balancing and progression changes to better tie them together as a standalone set.

title: Aspect of Daedalus
description: Aspect of Daedalus is a single map WAD consisting of a medium-sized run and gun/adventure style map. This is designed to play as a vanilla-style map with a moderate difficulty.

title: Atolladero
description: A single map with enough detail to make things interesting, along with different combat situations, from long range to close quarters.

title: Boom Stick in the Mud
description: An unapologetically brown new map. Hellspawn have overrun UAC's high tech sewage treatment plant. Now feces and piss pour out of the compound at a supernatural rate. It's up to DoomGuy to clear out the facility before the entire world is covered in excrement.

title: Crepitations
description: Old town, autumn season recreation.

title: GottaGoFast
description:
The goal with this project was to ﻿create a set of maps that one could UV MAX in a reasonable amount of time, hence the name. Scythe was the main source of influence.
One day you're at home watching TV when you sud﻿denly need to take a shit. You go to the bathroom to discover that you're out of toilet paper, so you decide to go to the store to get some. When you get to the store, you find out that it's crawling with demons. Looks like Hell has invaded. Again. You grab your pistol and go on yet another ridiculous adventure.

title: Hell On Earth Shareware
description: HOE Shareware is an attempt to imagine what a DOOM II shareware episode would have looked like, had the sequel followed a more traditional chapter-based style. It was made to be a cloudy miasma of the DOOM II I always saw in my head based on back-of-the-box description and strategy guide flavor text.

title: Linux Jank
description: A collection of maps that are short, sweet, and to the point. This wad is called Linux Jank as a reference to my learning all the strange quirks of Eureka Editor.

title: Vanilla Wafers
description: A collection of 6 vanilla-compatible Doom 2 maps that are short, sweet, and to the point

title: Turbo Trio
description: Released on a physical copy by Elephant Entertainment (a division of THQ), this compilation brings together all of the Turbo games in one CD rom.

title: Monopoly City
description: Monopoly City is a new imagination of the classic Monopoly board game. Play alone against the computer or against your friends in this new property builder title. Build houses, industrial complexes, skyscrapers and dominate your competition to become the ultimate winner.

title: Supermarket Security Simulator
description:
Welcome to your first day of work at our supermarket.
I know this is your first time working security so listen up.

As security you will have to:
Keep an eye on people so they don't steal, which entails searching old ladies, keep an eye out for gypsies (and not so gypsies) stealing from you.
If a thief tries to flee, don't be afraid to hit him with the truncheon or electrocute him with the taser. Check the ticket and if he has something he didn't buy you handcuff him and put him in the dungeon.
