description: Manufactured in 1976 at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these doubledecker cars were and still are used for regional passenger transport in Czech Republic, and many have been modernised. This pack features the CD Bmto292 109 version with interior views, PBR textures, and more!

title: Trainz Plus: CD Bmto292 109
description: Manufactured in 1976 at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these doubledecker cars were and still are used for regional passenger transport in Czech Republic, and many have been modernised. This pack features the CD Bmto292 109 version with interior views, PBR textures, and more!

title: Trainz Railroad Simulator 2022: CD Bmto292 109
description: Manufactured in 1976 at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these doubledecker cars were and still are used for regional passenger transport in Czech Republic, and many have been modernised. This pack features the CD Bmto292 109 version with interior views, PBR textures, and more!

title: The Dragon Prince: Xadia
description: Explore Xadia, team up with friends, and battle evil forces in this hack & slash looter ARPG.

title: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
description: Stealth, silliness, and a whole lot of chaos! Scurry and scramble your way to freedom in this co-op adventure set in the Chicken Run universe.

title: Koko
description:
Seiichi, a boy who has always lived near a forest in the middle of a small town, grew up hearing stories of monsters and fairies. When the time came to start a new life, he moved to the city, unlucky enough to get lost in one of those areas inhabited by non-human beings. Will he get out of there? Or what decision will he make?

"Her fingers looked like little spider legs on my clothes."

title: Spiegel Ei
description: You play as a young girl named Ei Eulenspiegel who is taken into an orphanage. She comes across a large mirror that allows her to explore between two worlds: The real world which is inside an old mansion, and the mysterious mirror world that lies beyond. As she travels back and forth between dreams and reality, her psyche gradually becomes distorted. Will she find herself or will she lose herself?

title: Goober Dash
description: Goober Dash: A 2D platformer battle royale where Goobers Run, Jump & Dash to victory! Customize your Goober, dash to outmaneuver opponents, create your own levels, and compete in global time trials. Unlock exclusive skins and celebrate your wins in this action-packed multiplayer Race Royale!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Saha and Rebirth
description:
Version 6.8 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Rebirth
• New ELF: Project Bunny
• New Story Chapter XXXIX: Daughters of the Sea
• New Captainverse Event: Before the Endless Dream Ends
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Straying Stars
description:
Version 6.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Sugary Starburst
• New Story Chapter XXXVIII: Lone Tower, Fallen Star
• New Featured Event: ☆Perfect Performance☆
• ...and more!

title: Dead Letters
description: Your mission is to enter the mansion of the dead magnate who killed his family and committed suicide. When still alive, he hid many treasures but nobody knows where. Look for his diary to be able to find them.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Woven from Last Snow
description:
Version 6.6 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyries: Dreamweaver & Terminal Aide 0017
• New Story Chapter XXXVII: Of Salt, Snow, and Sand
• New Featured Event: TeRiRi's Magical Quest
• ...and more!

title: The Way of All Flesh-Again
description: This add-on does not change the history of the episode, it only allows you to play it in an alternate way. There are 8 new levels and new textures from games such as: F.E.A.R., Kingpin, Redneck Rampage, Witchaven (1,2), Duke Nukem 3D, Shadow Warrior, NAM, WW2GI, TEKWAR, Manhunt, etc

title: Final Alone in the Dark
description: This final compilation of BAITD series lets you play (almost) all parts of the mod. BAITD is a pure experimental mod that shows to players new ways to mod the game and dedicated to original Alone In The Dark game series.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Hot Sands Escapade
description:
Version 6.5 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of Part 1.5 of the main story, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Valkyrie Quicksand
• New Story Chapter XXXVI: Hailing from Nagazora
• New Featured Event: Meow Town Escapade
• ...and more!

title: Eviction
description: Eviction (or EVICTION) is a new episode fan add-on released gradually since 2017 by Austin "SpillSomeBlood" Adams. As of 2021, it features four single-player levels and one Bloodbath map. As of the part four iteration, it features five new enemies and custom scripting requiring either the NBlood port or its fork Raze

title: Somewhere Under the Sea
description: A three level level episode released on March 12, 2015 based on Adam's earlier "Rapture" map inspired by the underwater city from Bioshock.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: From Finality, The Origin
description:
Version Kiana (6.4) of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the end of Part 1 of the main story, which includes:
• New Valkyries: Herrscher of Origin & Herrscher of Finality
• New ELF: Kiana Kaslana
• New Story Chapter XXXV: Toward a New Tomorrow
• New Animated Short: Graduation Trip
• New Featured Event: Bustling Holiday Symphony ∶||
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Symphony of Truth
description:
Version 6.3 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Truth
• New Story Chapter XXXIV: The Moon's Origin and Finality
• New Featured Event: Bustling Holiday Symphony ||∶
• ...and more!

title: Blood Chronicles Volume 1
description:
Yet another huge collection of blood maps.

Episode One: Underworld "tells the tale of Caleb's search for the Cabal's newest horror, The Grand Illusion Carnival, with plans to shut it down before it entraps any victims. The rumour is that there is a forgotten teleport back in one of the old Cabal mines that will put Caleb right at its front door."

title: Blood Chronicles Volume 2
description: Blood Chronicles aims to be the best blood map collection. Only the very best of Blood Community!

title: My Sister is Wanted
description: A mouse lost in time and the crimes of their family

title: Banzai's Addon
description: Banazai's Add-On (also known as Caleb's Revenge and previously Game Leader's Unofficial Add-On) is a single episode fan add-on for Blood featuring seven levels, last updated on November 9, 1998 by Team BANZAI. Partly to facilitate its final release and to lower the download size in the days of largely dial-up connections, it features only new levels and does not contain any new textures, weapons or monsters.

title: The Cult
description: BLOOD: the Cult is a new episode that contains 5 single player maps for original Blood.

title: The Dreamwell Enigma: Barlington Estate
description: Explore Master Barlington's estate, also home to his exclusive gentlemen's club including some prominent figures of the area, owners of influential businesses; Cobbleson & Son's Crimson Brewery, Leroux's M'daillon Bathhouse, Ashford's Bank and Trust, etc. Strange activities have been taking place at the estate and these men are likely involved. Rumours also spread about a new religious cult forming and gossip regarding Barlington's mental health as of late. Sudden disappearances have been reported surrounding the area, but no concrete evidence pointing to the club itself. What secrets are they hiding? Break inside, rummage around, seek documents and discover the truth, no matter how far you must dig to find it.

title: The Pandemonium
description: A single map that includes rotating doors, explosive walls ,respawning monsters, and more

title: Hall of the Epiphany
description: A two level mini-episode that chronicles the final battle in the Hall of the Epiphany

title: The Hall of Epiphany
description:
Fight your way through the dark realm and seal the rift once and for all!
You've reached the Hall Of Epiphany, now it's time for revenge! In order to summon Tchernabog's presence, you'll need to fight your way through the "Army Of Darkness". Once you finish the 3 main bosses, T-daddy opens a portal for you to return for the final battle. Once on the other side, you see Ophelia's soul trapped and tormented. You are now face to face with Tchernabog. The only way to set Ophelia free a end the Cabal, is to destroy T-daddy himself!

title: Maniac Mansion 4 Blood
description:
Loosely based on the 1987 point & click adventure Maniac Mansion by Lucasfilm.
If you enjoy running around in a huge house with a great variety of places then you might want to try this one.

title: La Ciudad Fantasma
description: A small city

title: Legends of Iconoclast: Scourge of Humanity
description: Take on the role of Logan, a Romanian gunsmith as he embarks on an epic quest of revenge and redemption as he journeys into an unknown dimension and wages war on the most powerful army to have ever existed: the Scourge, founded by the evil Garibaldi, a power-mad misanthropist hell-bent on the extermination of mankind. Logan must prevent the Scourge from resuming its war on Earth to save humanity and to avenge the deaths of everyone involved, including his own true love. During his quest, he'll uncover the shocking truth about Garibaldi and the plight of this unknown dimension. He must fight his way through Garibaldi's castle and ultimately confront Garibaldi in a battle to determine the fate of both humanity and the realm of Iconoclast.

title: Legends of Iconoclast 2: Unfinished Business
description: This sequel focuses on the protagonist continuing his war on the organization that he was once part of as he seeks to tie up a few loose ends, confront his internal demons, and once more save the world.

title: The Carnage Continues
description: The Carnage Continues is a modification for Blood that was developed over several years, with it being finally released on January 4, 2006, although the author commented that it could never be finished entirely as intended. The add-on was created by Harry, with one level jointly developed with Joel "Reactor" Blackwell (co-creator of Gods, the Epic Trilogy from 1998).

title: The Lost Episode
description: The Lost Episode is a unofficial add-on for Blood that adapts eight level files found in the Blood Alpha release and makes them into a coherent whole; speculated to be drafts by James Wilson III. Put together by Maz/kingmaz and released on November 27, 2014.

title: The Lost Episodes
description: Five dark tales of terror lost to the void of time, now available for your edification. From some of the best creators of Blood maps, this five adventure set promises to challenge the most avid Blood fan! A Collection Of Hard To Find Episodes Gathered Together In One Carnage-Filled Collection Including GODS by Joel & Kurt Blackwell, Journey to Hell by Martin Brintnall, Legend of Ravenloft by Michael Shire, Killing Time by Marc Levesque, Haunted Realmsby Joel Dube with additional maps by Treks, Johnnie Blaster, Craig L. Duckett & Dwayne Anderson. Adding Up To 23 Levels of Hardcore Gorefest

title: Haunted Hill
description: Caleb has bought an old mansion where he plans to settle down. The previous owners died under strange circumstances, and the mansion has been empty for years. But arriving Caleb finds out that his dreamhouse might not be what he expected. He finds it "infested" by the Cabal. And it seems the previous owners were up to no good either. Caleb must rid the house of the "pest" in order to finally get peace.

title: Meat Factory
description: Single player level done in the industrial style of E3M5 or BB3

title: Evil Dwells Within
description: This is the first map in an episode entitled "Crudox Cruo: Fresh Blood" which was never made.

title: Nitemare
description: This map takes place in some kind of huge and complex castle with it's own sewer system

title: Six Keys
description: Caleb must find the six keys by solving the puzzles, then use them to release Tchernobog and escape from the island.

title: The Abandoned Factory
description: Collect all six 6 keys and kills as many bad guys possible

title: The Fallen Priest
description: A short map requiring Plasma Pak

title: The Lost Temple
description:
There are some rumors about a ruin of a temple deep in the woods where strange things are happening. You are about to find out if this ruin really exists and what evil might has manifested itself in there. But first you have to fight your way into the ruin, as you find out that it is heavily guarded by some cultists and hordes of zombies. You wonder what will be inside this ruin, that seems to be reactivated in some strange way.
Will you be able to fight your way into the ruin...

title: The Old Manor
description: This map was going to be in an episode, but the episode is on hold right now and may not fit in very well.

title: Caleb's Dream
description:
Caleb fell into a deep sleep and...
Well, find out what happened next yourself!

title: Cemetary
description: One huge map

title: Count of Wallachia
description: You're at Draculas castle, find him... eliminate him.

title: Trainz Plus: CD Bmteeo 124
description: Manufactured in 1976 at the "VEB Waggonbau Goerlitz" factory in Germany, these doubledecker cars were and still are used for regional passenger transport in Czech Republic, and many have been modernised. This pack features the CD Bmteeo 124 version with interior views, PBR textures, and more!

title: Crescent Quest: Furry Home Expansion
description: This expansion adds another room to your house with a furry aesthetic and a few wallpapers for your device!

title: Wars Across The World: Dacia 101
description: Dacia 101 is Emperor Trajan's first campaign against the Dacians, the empire's last sedentary neighbors. The Romans must crush seize their foes and take their cities. The Dacians player must hold his strongholds, while at the same time waging war within the Roman lands to force them to negotiate.

title: Sclash: Pixels
description: A retro touch to spice up your look in Sclash. Wear a mask and carry a weapon with a low resolution! Includes a new weapon & a new mask, directly unlocked.

title: FPV SkyDive: FPV Drone Simulator - Flight School
description: Continue your journey towards becoming a skilled FPV pilot with ORQA FPV.SkyDive Flight School DLC! This educational module covers the topics of FPV flight throughout 5 units packed with theory and practice.

description:

title: Caleb Will Have His Revenge On Toronto
description: Caleb Will Have His Revenge on Toronto is a Blood fan add-on by members of the Russian Blood Community which released its first episode, "Scum of Dallas", on July 29, 2013. A sequel, "Run Like a Villain", was begun, but is now not certain to ever be finished. This includes new animated cutscenes, having the Flag of Canada as the menu background, and replacing the Sawed-Off Shotgun and Aerosol Can with their darker versions from the game's development.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Song of Perdition
description:
Version 5.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of the Elysium Everlasting arc, which includes:
• New Valkyries: Disciplinary Perdition & Golden Diva
• New Open World: Elysium Everlasting
• New Story Chapter XXIX: Tochter aus Elysium
• New Featured Event: Shattered Dimensions
• ...and more!

title: The Way of Ira
description: The Way of Ira is a fan add-on for Blood by MariusArmand currently featuring two chapters, the first released on September 22, 2019 and the second on July 9, 2021. The title is derived from "ira", the Latin word for "rage" (or "ire"). The add-on features narration and new Caleb dialogue performed by David "Tekedon" Wikström, as well as tracks from the Blood Music Project.

title: Time Episode
description: Time Episode is an eight level fan add-on for Blood created by Pyro on September 17, 1999. The player is a mass murderer who in a fit of remorse, or because the authorities have finally caught up to him, leaps off a tall building to end it all, and is sent to hell. From thereon out it is his quest to escape hell through a time gate and then make it back to his own time.

title: It's A War Out There 1
description: Caleb has been hiding out in his cabin for a long time, getting increasingly bored, but weary of all the dangers that lay beyond. After all "it's a war out there". Eventually however, the protagonist decides to venture outward, figuring that all those things that seek to hurt him he can hurt in return, and thereby find his means to amuse himself. The level features cemetery, urban, library, sewer, water, and cave areas and even a laboratory with portals to both the frozen north and to a temple complex. It is here that the player meets his final challenge: two beasts that guard the exit.

title: It's A War Out There 2
description: Caleb finds an axe zombie carelessly wandering around a cliff-face, falling to its death. Caleb figures this must herald a nearby Cabal stronghold, and so he decides to check it out, again to relieve his endless boredom. First he comes across an old library, which he blasts through, before retreating down into the sewers, and again through a laboratory, finding a similar portal that leads out into a lava temple. There he has a surprise encounter with Tchernobog, whom he defeats before once again heading along his way.

title: Eye of the Blood
description: A three level long episode for Blood by Swedish mapper Christian Green, a member of Team BANZAI, who spent awhile creating the maps; maps date from fall 1997 and were first released on Game Leader, and were re-shared from The Krunatus Blood Page from August 7, 2003.

title: 500 Milliliters of vr
description: 500 Milliliters of /vr/ is a community add-on by members of the /vr/ board on 4chan released on February 1, 2021. It features six levels created by three authors, and features numerous replaced assets. Four levels are available for Bloodbath. It is named as a play on the 200 Minutes of /vr/ and related community projects for Doom.

title: Assassin’s Creed Mirage: Master Assassin Edition
description:
Assassin’s Creed Mirage is a stealth-focused action-adventure game set in ninth-century Baghdad. It emphasizes parkour, infiltration, and targeted assassinations. The game follows a more compact structure than recent entries in the series. Players control Basim, a young thief drawn into a secretive order. The title blends historical settings with narrative elements tied to the franchise’s established lore.

The Master Assassin Edition includes the base game and six additional packs: the Deluxe Pack, the Lightning Pack, the Jinn Pack, the Fire Demon Pack, the Master Assassin Pack, and the Guardian Pack.

title: Castlevania 2
description: This is inspired by the NES game Castlevania 2, and kind of a parody of it at the same time.

title: Sacreligious
description: Just a fun little map i decided to release as a new years present to the community.

title: Swim! Sacabambaspis
description: The ancient fish “Sacabambaspis” game! Easy to operate but difficult! Let's compete to see how far you can swim!

title: Lagoon
description: Your mission, should you choose to accept it of course, is to eliminate the scourge from the facility, restore power in the Rosskotek Hydro-Electric station then meet up with "dude" in the escape craft waiting for you anchored in the estuary.

title: Castle of Horrors: The Awful Tortures
description: A huge and disgusting path down to the chamber of horrors. See also the cemetery of the zombies and their ceremonial death party.

title: CRE1M1: Greyvein River
description: First map from my upcoming episode 'Cabal's Return'

title: Innsmouth Corporate Plaza
description: Caleb is in his flat reading a newspaper. Suddenly, he hears an uproar down Innsmouth Plaza. He hears some shots, so he gets his Tommy Gun and decides to investigate.

title: Please (Don't) Touch the Art
description:
Take on the role of an uncultured and unprepared art museum curator in Please (Don’t) Touch the Art, a management sim-slash-visual novel where the only thing less ready for a make-it or break-it museum exhibition than you is the artwork itself.

Get your quarrelsome gallery of talking paintings and moving statues to stop fighting before the grand gala, or watch the museum crash and burn around you – the choice is yours!

title: Wasted Glory
description: Wasted Glory is an old-fashioned fnaf fan game that follows the traditional five nights gameplay with freeroam mechanics.

title: Nezumi Man
description:
Nezumi Man is a homage to/parody of the classic NES Mega Man games, starring a rat who can run, slide, jump and shoot like the Blue Bomber himself. His goal is to stop the plans of Dr. Gyoniku and his henchmen, along with seven other rat and ratlike characters.

The game was an entrant in the 2009 HSP Program Contest. It is notable for its humorous characters and situations.

title: Sigmatica
description: Abstract shooting game on Chiba University Computer ResearchingSociety compilation.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - The Remains
description: The Remains is a soon to be releasing mod for Steel Wool Studios' Five Nights at Freddy's Security Breach. This mod restores every single scrapped mission, model, map, minigame, ETC. Back into full functioning order!

title: Disillusion ST
description: Strange journey throughout an elaborate labyrinth awaits featuring hundreds of characters and happenings as you try to gather items that once brought happiness to others. An early access glimpse at the prequel to Disillusion, the oneiric dungeon crawler detailing the events leading up to the tower's creation.

description:

description:

• New Story Chapter XLI: Worldly Retribution
• New Featured Event: Captain's Ranch Tale
• ...and more!

title: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution
description: Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

title: On Your Tail
description: Embark on an intriguing seaside getaway you’ll never forget in On Your Tail, a sleuthy story-driven 3D life sim of relaxation, investigation, and knowing how to play your cards right.

title: Blade Chimera
description: In this exploration-heavy 2D action game, use your demon sword to interfere with the past, create platforms, and shield yourself from danger to explore a dystopian cyberpunk world depicted in gorgeously animated pixel art.

title: Prodeus: The Elder Veil
description: The Elder Veil is a DLC expansion to the retro first-person shooter action game Prodeus. Explore a new Greek-inspired environment with plenty of enemies to dispatch and weapons to use while airborne thanks to a trusty deployable chain for traversal.

title: Dross
description: Dross is an FPS Roguelike set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs. Travel a procedurally generated world, get powerful weapons and equipment, and upgrade your gear to survive. Fight the Dross, discover and destroy the infestation, and uncover the secrets of this mysterious installation.

title: Cthulhu Keeper
description: In this Lovecraftian real-time tactics game you play as a 1920s cult leader on a mission from the Old Ones. Build your cult, summon eldritch monsters, and undertake stealth tactics missions to spread insanity and amass power! In CTHULHU KEEPER you are the cosmic horror.

title: Keep Those Bugs Away From The Bomb
description: Survive the swarm and clear the arena of alien infestation in this fast-paced bullet hell roguelite shooter. Unlock new heroes, guns, and skills in a never ending quest with one thing in mind. Keep Those Bugs Away From The Bomb!

title: Dragon Quest X: All In One Package - Versions 1-7
description: A new all-in-one package including versions 1 to 7 of Dragon Quest X Online.

title: Resident Lover
description: Attend the prestigious Miranda's All Girls' University, hidden away in Romania. Choose to pursue the Arts, to follow your academic career, or to slack off with your friends. Along the way, face challenges, solve mysteries, and try to stay alive, as it becomes apparent that there is more to this school than meets the eye. Perhaps even find love in the chaos?

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Inherit the Flame
description:
Version 5.0 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Flamescion
• New ELF: Sirin
• New Gamemode: Elysian Realm
• ...and more!

title: Morels: The Hunt 2
description: Morels: The Hunt 2 is the sequel to Morels: The Hunt. It is a simulation game about mushroom hunting and wildlife photography. Explore a diverse range of locations spanning across the globe. Increase your hunter and photographer levels by collecting a variety of mushrooms, photographing animals, and completing weekly tasks.

title: I Dreamed of Dead Stars
description: A short game about a girl trying to process grief and getting into bad habits.

title: Heavensborne
description: The world as we knew it ceased to exist. Now it's your time to rebuild it. Will you do the right thing?

title: Written in Blood on a Mirror
description:
You're a young Victorian lady whose college classmates have branded as a potential witch. They dared you to spend a night in an abandoned mansion where a terrible incident occurred.

At least, that's what you remember. Their laughing faces, judging you.

But now you're trapped and have to work with other women to get out!

Try to gain their trust, romance them, or... who knows?

title: Ned Flanders Kills the Simpsons!
description: Must...Kill...Best...Friend! It was bound to happen. Somewhere deep inside everyone's favorite neighbor-ino, a darkness has bubbled to the surface, and now Ned Flanders is on a killing spree! Hey, they warned me that Satan would be seductive!

title: Bender Kills Planet Express
description: Go insane in the mainframe as BENDER, everyone's favorite alcoholic robot from the year 3000! Give absolutely 0 craps as you bash, knife, shoot or set the Planet Express crew ablaze in this first person robotic murder sim based on the hit show "FUTURAMA"!

title: Snapware ft. Tchabada
description: Snapware ft. Tchabada is a Mini Game Compliation Game

title: 360 Five Nights at Freddy's
description: 360FNAF is an accurate FNaF 1 Custom Night remade with modern technology. Play on your desktop in flat mode or in VR!

title: Last Escape: Dead Complex
description: Dead Complex is a 2D Top Down, Survival Horror Game. Sneak, Loot and Fight your way out of an infested apartment complex and begin your final escape from the city.

title: Hoku Shrine
description: A beautiful open world is waiting for you! Learn different fighting styles and magic skills, practice archery. Explore the world, mine resources, create weapons and brew potions, combine combat sets. Fight for justice and restore the Shrine of Hoku!

title: ClearIt 16
description: Try ClearIt 16, an innovative matching game for those looking for a new challenge! Use bombs and lightning to clear any obstacles you encounter. There are no time limits, so relax and have fun.

title: Déjà Drift
description: Stuck alone on a retro-futuristic racetrack, your only choice is to drift. Earn as many points as possible before time runs out, and then do it again and again... But wait, there is someone else here? And why does their driving seem so familiar?

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Countryside Charm Set - Autumn 2022
description: Decorate as a local mom n' pop pizzeria!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Rustic Retreat Set - Autumn 2022
description: Watch your garden transform into autumn!

title: Good Pizza, Great Pizza: Pumpkin Delight Set - Autumn 2023
description: Get pumpkin spice and everything nice!

title: The Dream Of A Cockspur
description: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's final researchers, you investigate a mysterious celestial body. The day before departure, the return boat is damaged, forcing an extended stay. Is someone playing tricks, or does the island want to kill all of you?

title: The City Of Hope
description: A light city-building game that combines elements of card games and tower defense, where players must survive daily enemy attacks and gradually grow their strength to ultimately defeat powerful invaders.

title: Math Olympiad
description: In the mysterious continent full of monsters, encounter mysterious creatures, according to the clues left along the way, try to challenge, find the way to the new world.

title: Helle's Undersea City Project: Bringing Air to The Garden - Nakino Mashiro
description: Vtuber "Nagino Mashiro" is moving to the Garden! DLC with resident character implementation is now available.

title: Lost Cat
description: "Lost Cat" is a single-player, adorable, healing, adventure game. Try to collect enough fish while avoiding traps and monsters, and use your wits to clear the levels.

title: Love Poem Written For a Fairy
description: A poet met a beautiful and charming fairy on the edge of the human and demon worlds..... Poets have no other choice but to pursue love poems.

title: Three Thousand Worlds
description: "Three Thousand Worlds" is a massively multiplayer online game (MMORPG). The game provides players with a lot of different quality equipment, and the pursuit of high-level (or best) equipment is one of the most important goals for players in the game.

title: What Games Does Your Dad Play
description: What games does your dad play - It is a management game with the theme of running a game center, and players can replay a variety of stalls, electronic games, etc. from the 80s, 90s, and even 2000s.

title: Zumbido Seele
description: Indie arcade FPS singleplayer shooter where you fight against hordes of monsters and explore the map in search of equipment.

title: Wolf Sheep Cabbage
description: Wolves eat sheep, sheep eat vegetables. Utilize your wisdom to simultaneously transport the wolf, the sheep, and the cabbage to the destination!

title: William and Sly: Classic Collection
description: The world of William and Sly is yours to explore, seeking out collectables and secrets, while soaking in the tranquil visuals and melancholic soundtrack. In this pair of classic Flash games, you play as a fox, running and leaping through an atmospheric ecosystem entirely at your own pace.

title: Yeetus
description: You are YEETUS! Your weapon? The very floor beneath your feet! YEET your surrounding terrain into destructive projectiles. Be strategic, though. A hasty shot may mean a long fall down to your doom in YEETUS, a casual time survivor game with rogue-lite elements.

title: Warpzone Drifter 2
description: With full throttle and no breaks, Warpzone Drifter 2 is a minimalistic, retro-hardcore, physics-based, drifter minigame.

title: Used Cars Simulator
description: Used Cars Simulator - trade used or stolen cars, fix and customize them, drive around, and explore the open world! Grow your business, complete quests, and have fun with a physics-based sandbox!

title: Tower Walker: MMO Grind Simulator - Tower Walker: The Lich
description: TOWER WALKER: THE LICH adds 1 new playable class with a unique set of skills and a special summon to the game

title: Typing Battle
description: "Typing Battle" is a game based on typing speed and accuracy. In this game, players need to use the keyboard to input designated characters in order to defeat their opponents or achieve their goals.

title: Time Loop
description: Time Loop is a 2D platformer with hardcore elements, dynamic gameplay and nice graphics. In this game you need to pass a variety of levels and avoid enemies.

title: Tiny Car Mess
description: A super fun, stylized, derby themed racing game with tiny cars that drift and crash into each other. Take the wheel!

title: Tormenture
description: A disturbing, pixelated game inspired by classic games. Solve puzzles, explore surreal worlds and escape from ghosts to avoid being trapped in the game - be careful, some creatures may break out of the game and lurk in the shadows!

title: Ticket to Ride: Round the World Ticket
description: All aboard for the ultimate Ticket to Ride adventure! Build railway networks around the globe, through North America, Europe, and beyond! With the Around the World Ticket, you'll get the European Expansion and 9 more Expansions as they're released!

title: Ticket to Ride: Europe Expansion
description: Hello! Bonjour! Ciao! Hola! Hérete! Buna ziua! The Ticket to Ride European Expansion will take you from coast-to-coast on land and sea as you build your travel network! Tunnel through the Alps, claim ferry routes across the Mediterranean, and complete tickets from Portugal to Poland!

title: The Imperial Capital Burns: Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse
description: A prequel to Muv-Luv Alternative Total Eclipse which follows Takamura Yui and her friends during their time as surface pilot cadets.

title: TheHunter: Call of the Wild - Labrador Retriever
description: Introducing the Labrador Retriever, your faithful new hunting partner! This popular and versatile breed can fetch a variety of small game on land or in water.

title: Space Rock Armageddon
description: Space Rock Armageddon is a bold and dynamic space arcade game, boasting lightning-fast gameplay and an explosion of vibrant colors that make it feel like an eighties arcade classic.

title: Star Conflict: Baphomet
description: This pack includes:Jericho rank 17 tackler “Baphomet”Special weapon “Missile module Trinity”Active module “Ties of Shadows”Unique portrait “Sectator”Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

title: Star Conflict: Baphomet - Deluxe edition
description: This pack includes:Jericho rank 17 tackler “Baphomet”Special weapon “Missile module Trinity”Active module “Ties of Shadows”Unique modifier “Baphomet” shield recuperator”Unique modifier “Baphomet pulse discharge”Unique portrait “Sectator”Pattern “Threads of power”Decor “Greedy one”Permanent credit reward bonus +10%Additionally, the pilot r

title: Steam Engine Simulator: Power Generation
description: Power a city in Steam Engine Simulator.

title: Struggle F.O
description: What the newly awakened girl saw was an unfamiliar world and unfamiliar creatures. And on her arm, there was a mysterious gadget that could speak. Somehow, the girl who could now communicate with all living creatures, starts to struggle with her allies to survive in this world!

title: Sugar Fruits
description: Sugar Fruits offers a serene puzzle experience where you release a cascade of colorful fruits with strategic taps, aiming to align matching types for chain reactions and high scores before the basket overflows.

title: Super Cave Run

description: Of Murder and Moonshine, set in prohibition-era New Orleans, is a side-scrolling shooter filled with thoughtful assassinations, frantic getaways, and brutal combat.

title: Oh Yeah
description: How much imagination do you have about the ways of love?

description: We are proud to show you our little game ! It is a vampire surviror like, but in a cute and colorful universe. You will fight waves of monsters with various weapons, from the machine gun to the magical girl wand !

Garden Trills is a cozy adventure game about exploring whimsical gardens and befriending a charming cast of tiny birds.

description: This is a love theme of AVG, you play the lead role is working internships college students, originally you thought it was just the most common work internship experience, until you met your female boss Mrs Ling, she is always so gentle. As the relationship heats up, you start to have more ideas...

description: A mix of farming and slapstick combat, Harvest Havoc is a chaotic multiplayer PvP party game for 2-6 players. Grow, harvest, (steal) and sell your crops to win! Fight with your fists or grow some weapons to smack your rivals and take their crops. Gather your friends online and compete to become the best farmer-warrior!

description: Control, defend, and manage a guildhall in this fantasy, party based, card battler with a heavy focus on trading. Your journey will take you through many procedural generated dungeons on your quest for power.

title: Color Splash: Animals
description: Color Splash: Animals is a charming and relaxing puzzle game that will lift your spirits and take You into the world of adorable animals and art. Venture into the gallery, where you will find many extraordinary and colorful animal paintings.

title: 100 Christmas Cats: Extra Content
description: By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 Christmas Cats.

description: You are a young boy. Tonight, your parents have gone out, leaving you alone at home overnight. Soon after, strange things start happening: your head inexplicably starts to ache, you realize your brother is missing, and there's a sudden commotion outside the door...

description: Aarik (and the ruined kingdom) is a perspective based puzzle game centred around a Prince trying desperately to repair his father's kingdom. Using a magical crown Aarik must grab, roll, move and mend to save his homeland and his family.

description: A language learning game created for a master's thesis -- play as one of four unique adventurers in the mysterious land of Anglonia, searching for the wish-granting artifact, the Heart of the Word. Practice listening comprehension, TOEIC vocabulary, and problem-solving.

description: Discover an enchanting world where cute neko girls await to steal your heart. Immerse yourself in a tale of romance and emotions. It's the perfect getaway for a good time.

title: Arcade Asylum
description:
The Pirate Gamer has trapped you inside the Arcade Asylum with other gamers. Play through a variety of reimagined classic minigames from diverse genres with new-age graphics and unique twists. The catch? You have to be the best across all genres of games to beat out all the other inmates and escape the Asylum.

"Arcade Asylum" is the perfect game for online parties, and competitive gamers who crave a blend of chaotic fun and strategic gameplay. Can you prove your skills and smarts to be the first to escape the Arcade Asylum, or will you become another mad denizen of this bizarre world? The Pirate Gamer awaits your attempt to escape!

title: A-Red Walking Robot
description: A-Red Walking Robot is a physics based toy robot simulator where you pilot tiny A-Red, a small clockwork operated robot that needs to overcome the trials it’s creator set in a workshop. A miniature nerve-wrecking/patience-proving journey where you are granted to fall… a lot.

title: Dreamin' Cat
description:
Dreamin' Cat - a little platformer game about how a cat is trying to get rid of nightmares, get some food and find a way home.

Use arrow keys to move, Z to jump. Use headphones for a better experience.

The game was made in 3 days for Ludum Dare 47.

title: The Red Bell’s Lament
description:
The Redbell Tree scrapes the sky, standing proudly in the heart of Hemeria, a land of sunlight. In a land ruled by a monarchy for generations, humans lived in peace and tranquility. That is, until the dawn of the day the world was dyed red.

On that day, vampires laid waste to Hemeria. They preyed on, devoured, and devastated its inhabitants. A great many people would go on to mourn their loved ones, their families and friends, for the rest of their lives. One particular town of Hemeria bore such a tragedy. A single girl was left alone in despair and disgrace. She vowed revenge, and grew into one of Hemeria's finest vampire hunters.

And one day, she became a member of the Elpis 7; those who inspired a light of hope in its people.

One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and a royal knight awaiting her. The hunters assembled receive an order from the monarch.

They are to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. A shiver of anticipation crackles through her at the opportunity she's been waiting for her whole life. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake. Pawns are sent forth, discarded, hidden out of sight...

And just how many will remain when this all comes to an end?

Navigate through intricate tracks, overcome obstacles, and rely on your skills to triumph over your rivals. As you advance through the game, you'll discover a trove of unique marbles. Each marble, with its unique appearance and stats, will become your secret weapon for dominating rivals and conquering every track in style. Engage in daily time trials and tournaments to prove yourself against other players.

description: The White Owl is a short atmospheric horror experience.

description:
You need me...
More than ever...
I'm here...

I can help you...

If you let me in...

title: Touhou Houtenkyou: Treasure Castle Labyrinth
description:
A glittering galaxy awaits inside! If you want treasure, get ready to dig! A retro-colorful dark-pop exploration STG fantasy!

Touhou Houtenkyou ~ Treasure Castle Labyrinth is a fan-made Touhou Project game made using the Touhou Danmakufu ph3sx shooting game engine.

Treasure Castle Labyrinth was first conceptualized as a hypothetical Touhou fangame by Iroboshi of iroirodou around the release of Undefined Fantastic Object, and was later made into a music album in 2014 with the help of Pesot.jp/. Development of the Treasure Castle Labyrinth game began in 2018, spearheaded by DOGSDAY. In 2020, the members of both iroirodou and DOGSDAY came together and established a common circle dedicated to the game's development: UWASA Enterprise.

description: All work and no play makes Jacka a dull boy...

description: A group of friends breaks into an abandoned mall...

description:
Skeleport Energy will take you on a wild journey through unpredictable locations as Skully The Skeleton! Your mission is to find your way out of crazy whacky situations by reaching a vending machine that sells Skeleport Energy- Energy drink!

With Skeleport Energy, Skully can become anyone's skeleton! Only problem being, that Skully has no control over, who they'll become and this leads into many problematic situations that you'll have to figure your way out of!

title: BoohaBlox: Arcade

description: In the wake of the attack at the White House, The Division has discovered that 11 people are unaccounted for and considered missing. You will be tasked to go on a high-stakes rescue mission to find the missing civilians, as they have valuable intel on the White House and The Castle Settlement.

MCC users will also get 2 additional party maps. Users will also be able to download the tags and content used to build the mod and create their own maps.

Now she is very interested in one student, whom she considers an ideal recruit and is trying very hard to make him a part of her cult. I am sure you will enjoy accompanying Kiki and her friend Kotoko along the way.

description: The game follows a girl named Dust as she is sent on a quest to bring bread and pie to a nearby village by the name of Woodpine. On the way she meets a charismatic young traveler who offers to aid her on her journey. When they arrive to the village they quickly discover that the village is not as peaceful as it seems. Young children have gone missing in the village, one after the another, during the last few months and as a result the village is in disarray. Will Dust with the help of her newfound friend, solve the enigma surrounding the missing children or will the dark secret of the village of Woodpine be left forever shrouded in mystery?

You must face over a variety of different obstacles, using the magical instrument known as "MOUSE AND KEYBOARD" to control Greenman. Promise you won't die though, right?

description: A narrative-driven roleplaying adventure with a touch of absurdity

title: Plus Ultra: Legado
description: Immerse yourself in a Mesoamerican metroidvania adventure, featuring vivid ligne-claire comic visuals set in the 16th century. Explore the intersection of two worlds in this spellbinding tale base on historical background with rich lore, dynamic combat, and a captivating soundtrack.

title: Probot Soccer
description: Probot Soccer is a third person soccer-style sports game where the player controls a robot. The aim of the game is to kick the soccer ball into the AI robot opponent's goal. The game includes various levels of difficulty that increase the number of rounds to play against the AI opponent to win.

title: Reckless Rally
description: Reckless Rally Is A Small Casual Rally Racing Game. Try And Set A PB On The Two Tracks Or Build Your Own Based Off Real World Roads!

title: Schrödinger's Call
description: When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time? Schrödinger’s Call is a visual novel that lets you experience the pain and salvation of human connection, as if you were turning the pages of a picture book.

title: Rekindling The Flame
description: Rekindling the Flame is an action RPG game. Hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies. Rebuild your town, Upgrade your equipment, and bolster your skills to face even greater challenges.

title: Dimlight Dungeon
description: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where the player controls a reptilian brawler and travels within the ruins of a once mighty heroic fortress.

title: England in London
description: England in London is a surrealist satirical dark comedy adventure game with an emphasis on atmosphere, characters and mini-games. Featuring weird looking art, hand drawn animation and an ambient score for when you truly want to be left alone.

title: Gruel
description: Go on a rampage in this endless arcade Boomer-Shooter! Gain the weirdest weapons and destroy all the monsters in the never-ending temple of GRUEL!

title: Fairy Carrots
description: Stealth action exploration game in which a "little hater" hides in a shared house where nine girls live and runs around looking for carrots.

title: HardAF
description: A punishing precision-based, speedrun 2D platformer...in the dark. Uncover the level with every death, earn swag and unlock new chapters. Run, Jump, Dash, Die, Repeat.

title: HelloWorldFactory
description: A quick programming language quiz is now available! Just read the code and choose a compiler that can output "Hello World"! A simple game you can play in your free time!

title: HoloParade
description: Collect your favorite characters, nurture them, and have fun just watching in this hololive fan game! It's a 2D tower defense game that offers depth for dedicated players, strategic elements, and easy enjoyment for casual players.

title: Ice Land
description: A game that simulates survival in harsh cold environments, including game elements such as environmental exploration, technology development, and character development.

title: Kill the Reaper
description: Reaper losing control over the taken souls and now all hell breaks loose.Hold back armies of the dead and find out, how long does it take to Kill the Reaper?

title: Jigsaw Advent Calendar
description: Surprise yourself every day leading up to Christmas with new challenging jigsaw puzzles in Jigsaw Advent Calendar

title: In Her Head
description: This is a short visual novel that immerses the player in the inner world of the main character, who suffers from social anxiety and is afraid even of a simple phone call. Experience with her the anxiety, procrastination, and constant struggle with herself.

title: Desolate Realms
description: Desolate Realms is a top down horde mode, survival game with tons of content. Multiple maps and weapons to explore and discover while facing multiple types of enemies. New challenges are created for each run to keep goals in mind when attempting to level up.

title: Dark is the Void
description: Dark is the Void is a combat focused JRPG-inspired roguelike, featuring fast paced, menu-driven battles. Build, customize, and optimize your party of four from a mix of 24 unique classes, spanning a range from Tanks, Healers, DPS, and every hybrid in between.

title: Crescent Quest: Y2K Home Expansion
description: A room with a Y2K aesthetic for your Crescent Quest home and a few wallpapers for your device!

title: Christmas Rocket Pudding
description: A fast-paced 3D platform game. Skillfully control the speed of your pudding to beat the levels fast while avoiding pitfalls!

title: Another Earth
description: We make a highly enjoyable virtual world, where players have the opportunity to be creators, allowing them the tools and ability to expand the world, and create their own stories and meaningful experiences for other players in the evolving world.

title: Anthem#9
description: Combine Gems to unleash Skills in ANTHEM#9, a deck-building rogue-lite puzzle-battler! Customize your Recipes for a wide variety of deck ideas, and explore the thrilling story of secret agents fighting for world order.

title: Apu's Journey
description: Apu's Journey is a retro action RPG, you can complete dungeons, defeat creatures, collect items, and improve your skills!

title: Ball of Poo
description: Help Dung Beetle Chan get the dung ball to the goal!

title: James' Fun House: Episode 1
description: You are a member of an elite strike team employed by the Japanese Americans Against Anime (J.A.A.A). Your mission is to prevent James the Dark Messiah of Anime aka. Jami Kun from releasing real life anime upon the universe. You will infiltrate James' stronghold (The Fun House), combat his cult of anime worshippers and alien allies, rescue hostages, and put an end to the threat of James forever.

title: 3on3 FreeStyle: Battle Pass 2023 Autumn Part 2
description: Experience the ultimate autumn adventure with our new Battle Pass, featuring a progression up to 55 levels with exciting rewards!

title: A Date with Death: Expansion DLC
description:
The expansion DLC for A Date with Death includes:

- Extra character customization options (five hair fronts, five hair backs, three fem outfits + recolors, four masc outfits + recolors, and 13 accessories)
- Adds extra choices and conversations throughout all days (find the ★ symbol!)
- Adds one additional ending (including a new CG!)

title: ADHD Arena
description: Let your ADHD loose and stack gems to accumulate points and get to higher more rewarding tiers, get the highest score you can by pushing gems around to organize and combine them and get lost in the joys of creating chaos the putting it into order.

title: Lake: Special Delivery
description: Take a trip back to the 1980's and visit the beautiful lakeside town of Providence Oaks, deliver their mail, and meet its charming residence. This bundle includes the base game, Lake, and its festive holiday-themed prequel, Lake: Season's Greetings.

title: Dusty Derby
description: Dusty Derby is a large online multiplayer party royal game with 32 players. Cute Dusts Compete to be King of Dusts in various places in the house!

title: Devil Slot Machine
description: On a cursed slot machine, you engage in a deadly game of souls with the demons. Devil Slot Machine is a roguelike pigeon tower defense game. Purchase chips as defensive towers and release elemental bullets to destroy your enemies. Enjoy the exhilarating feeling of annihilating demons!

title: Art is Boom
description: Let's create the art of explosions—different characters, different bombs. It's about the art of detonation and the creativity of crafting new bombs. Dive into the joyous game of various explosions!

title: Doom: Damnation
description:
Doom: Damnation (DDAMN10.WAD) is a full four-episode replacement vanilla megawad, for The Ultimate Doom. It was released in February 2021, following an initial three-episode release in November 2016. It was designed by Ofisil, who also composed the soundtrack for it.
This mapset acts as a retelling of the original events that unfolded in The Ultimate Doom; the maps are designed with traditional gameplay in mind, combining action, exploration and atmosphere on abstract and semi-realistic environments, with the custom made OST occasionally adding a slight horror vibe.

title: Chicocos S.A.
description:
Chicocos S.A. is a limit-removing map (complevel 2) set in a shipping/receiving office, featuring a non-linear layout with multiple paths to get to your goal.

Clear out all the buildings and pick up all 3 keys to get into the boss arena: the theater hall...!! (which, fun fact, is a recreation of the actual theater hall where the graduation ceremony will take place!). This is a commemorative map for my highschool graduation.

title: Vanilium
description: This is a simple map, made in roughly 8 hours with speedrunning in mind. This level has also been built and tested with Nightmare! difficulty and is easily beatable. Can you find the fastest exit route?

title: 10x1024
description: Inspired by LunchLunch's 10x10 Project and the Doomworld 1024 community projects, I decided to mash the two concepts together like chocolate and peanut butter.

title: Colour of Ineptation
description: 2 medium to short maps that I made after coming back from my summer vacation back to Taiwan and Japan

title: Didaskalia
description: It's year 1989, you are tired of your life, everything and everyone pisses you off. One day you decide to join the army, as a combat medic. You and your companions are sent to "Phobos". The mission is to get rid of the monsters that took control of the planet. You arrive a bit late, because you had some work to do. Every soldier brutally dies, you are left all alone. You hear in the radio that people from earth have sent help to rescue you. But soon it turns out that they want you DEAD.

title: Doomed: By the Hour
description: A full megawad of speedmaps that were (mostly!) made in an hour or less, for NaNoWADMo 2022! The standard 30 maps are split evenly between us, with Map31 being a collaboration and Map32 being a guest map by gabirupee!

title: Doomed: By the Hour 2
description: Doomed: By The Hour 2 is a megawad with 32 speedmaps created between 1-3 hours by finnks13 & Yumheart, with a special guest map by gabirupee. Maps are generally pretty short & violent, with a nice slaughtery finale in the last two episodes being generally equivalent to Speed of Doom.

title: Exoterrestrial
description: Exoterrestrial is a set of 5 MBF21-compatible maps that use Tango's Minicharge mod (You DON'T need to download it separately). The maps are mostly easy and pretty different from NoReason's standard fare, with the only exception of the final fight of map05.

title: Unternity
description: A map pack of short, linear maps. Episode One is Underclaustro, underground maps which you'll see skybox less often, hence claustrophobic. Episode Two is Unlifely, Snow maps, out doors, concrete building surrounded by heavy snows.

title: Satisfactory: Update 8
description: New Power Tower & Priority Power Switch buildings, new advanced game settings, improvements to blueprints, biomes and more.

title: Super Mario 64 in SuperTux
description: Super Mario 64 in SuperTux is a modified version of SuperTux which incorporates Mario using his moveset from Super Mario 64 into SuperTux using libsm64.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of The Spectre
description: Invasions is a dynamic single player campaign with a variety of distinct challenges. With built in progression and RPG mechanics, mixed with MK1’s incredible fighting action, Invasions provides deep, and engaging challenges, and a ton of rewards along the way.

title: The Dark is a Soft, Warm Pressure
description: isitjustmeinhere?

title: Oneirology Online
description: in our dreams/online, are we alone?

title: Rumble Club
description:
Fall into the physics-based massive multiplayer Battle Royale! Join the epic knockout madness with up to 20 clumsy players and punch, push, throw, or trick opponents out of the arena!

Fly in on Captain Punch’s Sky Yacht, get bopped into the arena, find silly Gadgets to battle with, and survive the dropping floor and shrinking battlefield to be the last player standing! Are you ready to punch your way to victory and become the ultimate champion?

title: Escape From Flea Market Montgomery
description: Escape from Sammy Stephens before he catches you and takes you to Flea Market Montgomery which, allegedly, is "just like a mini mall".

title: Super Super Fun World
description: Super Super Fun World is a small but weird 15 minute indie exploration game.

title: Tricky Taps
description: Use the levers to roll and bounce the ball along the twisty roads, without letting it drop or hit the spikes! Keep an eye out for tons of super-cool and tricky obstacles to jump and bounce out off or avoid.

title: ASMR Slicing: Joyful Cutting DLC
description: Unlock new unique objects to slice, new funny blades to cut with and get extra coins to spend!

title: ASMR Slicing: Nice Cuts DLC
description: Unlock new unique objects to slice, new funny knifes to cut with and get extra coins to spend!

title: Astro Miner: Moons
description: Explore 12 moons and collect all the treasures using your new vehicles!

title: Math, BFF, and Notes
description: Married women are the only women for me!

title: Sugar Lust
description: Embark on a journey through the realm of the cake. As you progress through a series of intricately designed puzzles, you'll encounter a diverse cast of charming heroes and heroines. Upgrade your characters and prepare to face off against the ruler of the land, the Demon Goddess

title: PSI: Pressure Climbing
description: A movement-based climbing game where you ascend on a suicide mission to save an amphibian cargo cult.

title: Bloki
description: BLOKI is an educational game in which you'll transform into a designer of residential building facades from the Soviet era. Using the available set of tools and guidance from the moderator, you'll design facades and develop the nearby area.

title: Sex Milfs
description: Sex Milfs - is the simplest 2D puzzle the final goal of which to give you pleasure!

title: Siegebreaker
description: Conquer the realm in this strategic tower defense game. Build unique towers, unlock powerful upgrades, and master new tactics to overpower your enemies and vanquish the fallen gods.

title: Skuf Simulator
description: Skuf Simulator is a cooperative, humorous simulator of real life skuf, based on a popular meme. In the game, you and your friends can take on the role of a skuf and participate in various fun and absurd mini-games and contests.

title: Slot Shots Pinball: Ultimate Edition
description: Get ready for some good 'ol fashion pinball fun with eleven tables ready for you! Bigger playfields, better physics, longer soundtracks, and more slot machine shots! Prepare yourself for the ultimate edition of Slot Shots Pinball featuring four unreleased tables along with some classics.

title: Snake Galaxy Online
description: Snake Galaxy Online is a 3D game based on the famous Snake. Travel the universe, save the people of the stars and defeat evil in this fun adventure for all ages.

title: Space Detective: The Case of the Rebel Robot
description: Uncover cosmic conspiracies in "Space Detective: The Case of the Rebel Robot," a Sci-Fi Mystery Point-and-Click Adventure with a twist of Yuri Dating Sim. Solve the murder, present your case to the incoming Marshal, and navigate your choices to unlock unexpected lesbian romances!

title: Spiritus 2
description: The survival horror concludes in part two of SPIRITUS, set in a post-apocalyptic city and the depths of pure evil. Survive in classic 90's gaming tropes augmented with modern HD graphics.

title: Swappy World
description: Simply two mechanics: swipe to move and tap to interact in an open-world survival crafting experience made through cards. Handle your energy tactically to survive as long as possible. Craft weapons, build your base and be prepared to explore a world full of secrets.

title: Next Floor
description: Next Floor is a score attack, fast-paced, difficult, gory fps, with a simple objective, reach the highest floor you can. Take all your stress out on enemies and make the most creative kills to get as many points as possible, however, higher the floor, more difficult it will be. How far can you go?

title: Ninja Resurrection: A tale of Kuro
description: Explore "Ninja Resurrection," an intense martial arts game that takes a fresh approach to the genre. This hardcore adventure features a mysterious storyline, demanding combat, diverse moves, and thrilling QTEs. Conquer the challenge, evolve with the game, and become a true ninja master.

title: Northgard: Vordr, Clan of the Owl
description: Subsisting through the ages, the secretive norns of Vördr keep watch over all realms in Northgard and beyond. Protectors of Yggdrasil, the sisters Skuld, Verdandi, and Urdr, use the power of this sacred tree to spread their knowledge inexorably across the land.

title: Not Burned Evil
description: The attractive and terrifying game "Got Burned Evil" is an exciting 2D horror with a side view that immerses the player in a mysterious world of tragedies and riddles.

title: Powers in the Basement
description: A short point-and-click adventure game set in a comedic medieval fantasy world, deliberately reminiscent of the great classics from the 80s / 90s, with a specific sweet spot for LucasArts production.

title: Plagueborn Survivor
description: Plagueborn Survior is a VRs only shooter game set in the present day, after a pandemic that collapsed the global economy, leaving everything in the hands of the military, criminal factions, and politicians.

title: Origin of Storms
description: Dive into Origin of Storms, a visually striking fighting game where elemental warriors clash in one-on-one or dynamic three-on-three battles. Unleash primal transformations, master distinct elemental powers, and compete globally for supremacy in this electrifying arena. Are you ready for the storm?

title: Prelude to Nuss Jump
description: Talking about the year 2022 Before the story of the Eastern Holy Son, we must first know this story When all the memory fragments are connected together, for him, there is only a devastating spiritual blow. But he must go through all this because This Everything is for a great mission!

title: RC Revolution: High Voltage
description: Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of RC car racing! Experience the thrill of multiplayer mayhem, delve into extensive car customization, unleash your creativity with track design, and embark on a rewarding progression system. Get ready, your track awaits!

title: Room
description: I thought it was just an ordinary day, but I accidentally entered this endless cycle of rooms. Among the countless terrifying and anomalous things, there is a girl who seems like she shouldn't exist here.

title: Roxy Raccoon's Pinball Panic: Winter Whimsy
description: 1 Brand New Table with online leaderboards and unlockable cosmetics! Ultra-wide winter themed table with 2 plungers and multi-ball madness.

title: Sanctuary in Time
description: A text-based, adult game with sci-fi & RPG elements!

title: The Key
description: It is a multiplayer, competitive combat game with support for 8 players per game. Your objective is to obtain 3 keys and survive to create your own path to the helicopter on the map which is your victory point.

title: Rogue Glitch Ultra: Upgrade
description: A roguelite action platformer in a vibrant glitch-ridden world. Amass a huge arsenal from over 150 weapon options and face hordes of enemies and tough boss fights. Jump into multiplayer (up to 4 player co-op online or local) to collect, unlock, and upgrade for endless replayability.

title: Witchhammer
description:
Witchhammer is a Real-Time Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.
Play as Clovelin, a card reader who was convicted as a witch and made a deal with the devil to avenge her own death. With the powers of her magical tarot deck, you will battle the Inquisition and try to destroy their most powerful weapon: the Witchhammer.
To master our real time deckbuilding roguelike you will not only learn how to avoid your enemies attacks but also how to play your cards most efficiently.
After every wave of enemies you will improve your deck, making it more powerful and adapting it to your own playstyle.

title: Lilly's Potion Shop
description: A third-person shooter in a bright, colorful world, where dynamic battles are mixed with leisurely exploration of the world in search for ingredients, and a intricate plot. Feel like a wizard, thanks to the unusual mechanics of making potions.

title: Minigolf Galaxy: Green Valley
description: Start your galactical minigolf journey in Green Valley! With courses created by our golf-loving designer team, you will surely be put(t) to the test to finish with a 3-star performance.

title: Manifest Destiny
description: Tired of playing the hero of regular RPG game? This time, Let’s trying to play as a game developer, go deep into the game world created by yourself, kill or solve puzzles with your abilities of programming, art and music, all depends on you!

title: My Dream Setup: Pets
description: Does your pet also live in your room? With the Pets DLC you can add animals, toys and accessories to your room. Choose your furry friend from the 16 breeds of dogs and cats featured in the DLC. In addition to dogs and cats, you can choose from fish, parrots, hamsters and even a lizard.

title: Monster Crawl: Warrior
description: FREE version of Monster Crawl featuring the Warrior & first few hours of gameplay || Horde based roguelite; slaughter them all with overpowering attacks & annihilate entire rooms. Explore diverse builds using heroes, abilities, buffs & relics. Beat Bosses to unlock Uber Relics. 2 player local co-op.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Megastructures
description: Advance to Type II civilization in Galactic Civilizations IV with the Megastructures expansion. Harness star power for awe-inspiring constructions like Dyson Spheres and Interstellar Gateways, each offering unique benefits. Think bigger and redefine your galactic scope!

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Tales of Centauron
description: Explore the 24th-century Centauron sector in Galactic Civilizations IV's DLC, "Tales of Centauron." Discover unique tech, planetary upgrades, and ship parts. Enjoy new events and expanded gameplay for custom civilizations, enhancing both strategy and story in a dynamic universe.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Tales of the Arnor
description: Uncover ancient galaxy secrets in Galactic Civilizations IV's "Tales of the Arnor" expansion. Explore the lore of Mithilar and the Arnor, encountering relics and uncovering Precursor Wars history.

title: Galactic Civilizations IV: Warlords
description: Transform combat with custom military doctrines, controlling ship behavior and strategy. Set precise war aims and conquest goals with the War Planning interface, influencing public opinion. Enjoy enhanced combat, intricate ship designs, detailed reports, deepening strategic warfare.

title: Light In Blood
description: Descending into the world of dreams, you are immersed in the ominous atmosphere of the game "Light In Blood". The game is divided into two teams: victims and executioners. The task of the victims is to survive and get out of the coma, and the executioners are to stop them.

title: Into the Grid
description: Become a master hacker in this cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive into the grid!

title: Hitler My Friend
description: Hitler My Friend is a 3D third-person shooter where you play as Hitler, fight off top shark predators and catch a turtle

title: Gran Carismo
description: "Gran Carismo" immerses players in an intense and competitive racing environment, combining the excitement of illegal underground races with a compelling narrative. Get ready to navigate challenging tracks, outmaneuver rivals, and claim the grand prize – the Rosso 50

title: Glitch Daddy
description: You have a strange dream where you meet a creature named Glitch Daddy, telling you that the world is ending. Then, you wake up and go to unravel the truth through a wild, abstract psychedelic journey.

title: I Love You Freddy
description: ah the celebrity life, the fame, and glamour, the wealth, and the insane psychopathic fan girl who chases you around an island she trapped you in, isn't the celebrity life wonderful!

title: High Fructose
description: "High Fructose" is a first-person shooter roguelite. As a prophesied hero, wield up to five weapons against monstrous fruit. Use various traits and items to create builds and endure the relentless onslaught.

title: American Isekai: Legends of Nipponia
description: 250 years ago, on the world of Nipponia, twin siblings Taneela and Tanaka seek to become Adventurers like their father. On the day of their registration, they are contacted by Mavis, the Crystal being of their world. Can they gather enough forces to stand against the rising evil in their world?

title: Ancient Rus vs. Lizards
description: An action game about battles with hordes of aggressive humanoid lizards!

title: Assembly Line 2: Mobile Version
description: Build and optimize your assembly line to make the most money possible!

title: Bright Oak
description: Bright Oak is a heavily character-driven visual novel with elements of science fiction. Discover the tragic secrets behind Bright Oak’s preternatural dilemma; find friendship, or possibly love; save the town and make your way home--and if at first you don’t succeed, try, try again!

title: Company of Heroes 3: Hammer & Shield
description: The Hammer & Shield Expansion Pack introduces two new Battlegroups for Multiplayer/ Co-op / SP Skirmish, an all-new Campaign Company for the Italian Campaign, and four premium cosmetic bundles.

title: Corpse Master Carnage
description: Welcome to Corpse Master Carnage!A survivor round-based hell-shooter game where your objective is to survive endless hordes of demons while improving your attributes and gaining more power and new abilities, as well as exploring and progressing through the game's story.

title: Dark Dive: The Last Tropic
description: Join the ranks of skilled duppy detective in a Caribbean town where danger lurks at every corner. Catch or fight monsters, build your deck, and uncover the secrets of the town's mysterious mines in this captivating RPG with turn-based combat and gripping story elements.

title: Die Cook
description: Presenting Die Cook, the first ever dice-based restaurant management game! Open your dream business, upgrade and equip your kitchen, level up employees to customize their dice. Express yourself with a customizable character and indoor decor. Aim for a 5-star rating in this unique relaxing simulator!

title: Detective Hayseed: The Cloning Madness
description: Join the crazy police detective Francis in his search for a kidnapped cloned beauty and go through countless escapades with him in this classic point & click adventure full of comedy.

title: 5:48AM
description: It's 5:48 AM, and everything is about driving back home before the effects of all the alcohol you've absorbed kick in...

title: The Desolation
description: The Desolation brings a complete cross-platform co-op looter-shooter experience to PC and mobile devices. Make your impact across endless procedurally generated worlds via cooperative action combat, deep build customization and richly satisfying tactical gameplay.

title: Cardboard Hero
description: Play as the hero of a young child’s imagination and fight your way through a fantasy cardboard adventure in this 3rd person action-adventure. Fight wacky enemies and find treasure to help you as you explore the vast worlds.

title: Horny Holiday
description: Dive into a festive romance in Horny Holiday! Play as Jack in a holiday encounter with the enchanting Joy at a Christmas party. Engage in a unique water, fire, wood challenge to win her heart, all wrapped up with captivating animations and a sound. Charm your way to a date before the lights dim!

title: The Five Rivers Land
description: Mini campaign in DOOM 3 hell-style with three small to medium sized, dark and scary maps, D3 textures (needless to say) and some ambient sounds.

title: I No Longer Fear The Ranger Guarding My Heel
description: A large prototype-textured map with non-linear progression, slaughter fights, and trick jumping. Runs on the Copper mod, which is included. Originally intended as an entry for SM224.

title: Pale Peril
description: 1 copper map using hundreds of enemies and makkon textures.

title: Hatchepsout: The Hell Temple
description: Small to medium Egyptian temple

title: Cheyenne Mountain Complex
description: Large underground base map with some Quake2 textures.

title: Euclid's Nightmare
description: Venture deep into the darkest depths of my mind. Experience the torture and mental anguish that comes with these dangerous visions from my mind. Hence the title of this mod; Euclid's Nightmare. It features 20 brand-spanking-new maps all hand-crafted by me

title: Vestige of V'othlog
description: Vestige of V'othlog is a short four-level episode inspired by the classic themes of Quake. The pack was designed for 2021 re-release (KexQuake) but it has also been tested with Ironwail.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Blood Moon
description: Invasions Season of the Blood Moon is underway! Be sure to take down the invading Nitara and add her blood-filled rewards to your kollection before the season ends on December 11.

title: Yip Quest
description: Fantasy comedy point and click game where you have to play three kobolds who have to steal some treasury.

title: Olivia's Bad Day
description: Olivia's had the worst day at work. Do whatever it takes to give her some much needed stress-relief.

title: Long Hike with a Cute Girl
description: Grace asked you to come with her on a quiet early morning hike, but her tight shorts and upbeat attitude make it seem like maybe she has a little more in store for you...

title: Paranormal Inc.
description: After looking for a job for a long time, you started as an operator in a company named "Paranormal Inc." You will watch live CCTV footage and report the anomalies you see.

title: Ultimate General: American Revolution
description: American Revolution is a sandbox strategy game featuring the epic historical period during the rebellion of the American colonies against the British Empire. Take on the role of the British or American Colonists, and fight for territorial control over North America. A gripping real-time campaign awaits you on a detailed 3d map where you can build your army and navy, construct military infrastructure, and fully command your armies on a regimental level. If you want even more action you can fully zoom-in and fight massive battles on a battalion level.

title: Ruindog
description: After centuries of invincibility, it became popular for humans to watch live alien hunting shows, participate in alien hunts, save up money, equipment, and use all the loot you find to move on to new maps and defeat more powerful enemies.

title: Dark City: London - Collector's Edition
description:
Collector's Edition of Dark City: Loudon includes:
- Solve a new case in the exciting bonus chapter!
- Collect hidden dominoes and morphing objects as you play.
- Never get lost with the strategy guide!
- Replay your favorite HOPs and mini-games!
- Enjoy exclusive screensavers, concept art, and music!

title: Liminal Memory
description: Walking simulator, where you finish levels to recover your memories. Firstly started as 1 month visual project, ended up being complete game. Features PSX graphics and liminal aesthetic as main style.

title: Dino Mayhem
description: Cause mayhem in this retro platformer by devouring people and destroying vehicles to earn points.

title: Dream of the Star Haven
description:
Dream of the Star Haven is a 1st person “giant leap” platformer with elements of exploration puzzling and light combat - a magical odyssey through islands in the sky where you soar gracefully and eventually even bend gravity itself to your will, giving you the power to literally turn the dreamlike world upside-down.

Explore awe-inspiring floating islands with gravity-defying agility. Discover the stars scattered across the islands using your magical scanner to reveal hidden celestial secrets.

In this captivating land, you're invited into a serene journey where you to traverse the floating archipelago in search of secrets, to liberate that which has been unjustly taken.

The game introduces a mesmerizing combination of a mighty triple-leap ability and a magical scanner, both essential tools for navigating the world.

Discover the stars scattered across the islands using the magical scanner helps you on your main quest, while other side quests and secret collectibles are more elusive. As you progress through each realm, you uncover mysteries of a lost era.

Immerse yourself in a unique blend of soothing exploration, graceful platforming, and a dreamy atmosphere. Savor the expansive vistas and uncover all that's hidden among the floating islands. With its emphasis on relaxation, exploration, and light combat and puzzle solving, the game provides an oasis of tranquility and is the perfect game-between-games when you need a break from big, noisy and chaotic gameplay.

Cruise through the low-stakes core of the game, or challenge yourself with the more difficult collectathon of secret challenges!

Embrace the joy of a harmonious journey as you leap toward the stars and reach toward a higher Dream of the Star Haven

title: Mall Heist
description: Sneak, hack, and confront guards as a security tester in 'Mall Heist.' Utilize your surroundings to your advantage! From bananas in the supermarket to boots in the clothing store, everything becomes a tool for your heist!

title: Forgotten Knight
description: It's a turn-based deck building RPG based on 2D dots. In an environment where attacks work differently on each turn, set the best strategy to defeat your enemies and upgrade your equipment to be stronger!

title: Life of Thife
description: Try to escape from the wanted city! Gather the necessary supplies by yourself and fend off the guards' pursuit! Cooperative guards are waiting for you at the checkpoints along the escape route.

title: Ace Racers SP
description: Import, build, and export arena courses for space drone racing. Customize your ships thrust and rates, and work on your manual thrust skills.

title: Twistingo: Hummingbird Haven - Collector's Edition
description: Restore paradise in 'Hummingbird Haven'! Uncover hidden nests, rescue animals, and rebuild a sanctuary. Your journey awaits in this thrilling hidden object fun with challenging puzzles!

title: Poozle Mania: Girls DLC #2
description: This DLC adds new mechanics to the game, as well as 3 more girls!

title: Hotel in the Dark
