description: That's the day it all started on Sept. 13. 2020. In the early morning of the same day, I was already standing at the bus station, waiting for my bus. I had to travel a couple of three hundred kilometers to a small town. I found a hotel quickly. It was quite a modern building at first glance.

title: New Life of Aged Town
description: Be the mayor of this super aging town and fulfill the wishes of the old people.

title: United Football
description:
United Football is a free to play, multiplayer, 5-a-side online football game.

United Football allows players to play in teams consisting of both human and AI players and boasts a unique control system and viewpoint that puts the gamer right in the action.

title: Cold War 2395: Solus
description: Cold War 2395: Solus invites you to explore an abandoned research outpost on a distant planet. Learn the secrets of the last person to venture there and uncover a galaxy-spanning conspiracy's origin.

title: Little Witch Academia: Project Luna
description: Little Witch Academia: Project Luna is a fan-made role-playing PC and VR video game by Ian JCV, Trota, and OcculusMalus based on Little Witch Academia. The game is currently under development.

title: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
description: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards now with an array of technical enhancements that make The Last of Us Part Il Remastered the definitive way to play Ellie and Abby's critically acclaimed story.

title: Super Nin-e Sisters
description: Super Mario Bros. alternative art fangame.

title: Catrina's Halloween Nightmare
description:
It's been three years since the Halloween Party massacre tragedy. Catrina wants nothing to do with Halloween, but her best friend Hope convinces her to attend a small reunion, she can't keep avoiding this night forever. Besides, what are the odds of the same thing happening twice? Grin Pumpkin is back.

The sequel to Jake's Halloween Night, a game inspired by old slasher movies.

title: Alex Jones: NWO Wars
description: Alex Jones: NWO Wars is an arcade-style video game that merges the worlds of political satire and retro gaming. In this title, players step into the shoes of Alex Jones, the well-known figure behind Infowars, as he battles through a series of levels inspired by his controversial broadcasts and political views.

title: Touhou 1: The Highly Responsive to Prayers NES Demake
description:
From the programmer that brought you Chuhou Joutai, Drillimation Systems brings you a port of the game that helped kickstart a global internet sensation.

Once upon a time, there were two races that ruled over Gensokyo (The Land of Illusions): humanoids and youkai. They both helped bring peace to the world. One day, war broke out between the two races. The humanoids were largely unsuccessful, as the youkai dominated over Gensokyo. During the battle, an important landmark in the eastern part of the land was destroyed: the Hakurei Shrine.

Underneath the rubble, a young shrine maiden named Reimu Hakurei emerges. You are destined to go out and punish the one responsible. But, there are two paths to take. Armed with a mighty wand, an infinite supply of throwing amulets, and a yin-yang orb, you must make your way across the Aetherworld (Makai) or the Netherworld (Jigoku). But, once you meet the Angel of Death, be sure to keep your stake sharp. And say your prayers!

Original by Team Shanghai Alice, adaptation by Drillimation Systems.

title: Karasu Meltdown!
description:
Karasu Meltdown puts you into the elephant's foot of hell raven Utsuho Reiuji, who thought it'd be a fun idea to smash up the Palace of Earth Spirits!

But Satori's having none of it and sending all of her pets to stop her!
Shoot, dodge, bomb, and raise bullet hell in this caravan shoot 'em up!
This game was originally made in three weeks for the Gunner Parade '22 Winter League game jam.

title: United Penguin Kingdom: Huddle up
description: This free version of the United Penguin Kingdom covers the content from one-year in-game time. A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales.

title: Midnight Blanc
description: A horror game where you pilot a crude airplane over the North Atlantic.

title: The Walking Dead: Empires
description:
Cooperative survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world after a letas virus causes people to turn into zombies when they die and infects the people they bite. Game from the series franchise: The Walking Dead.
The game is web3 and can be found in the Gala Games store. Developed by Ember Entertainment

title: Fast as Duck
description: This is an Indie game developed by AalexDoesStuff. It is a 3d platformer made for speedrunning, and includes intentional bugs as one of the features in the game.

title: Angel Hare's Learning Adventure
description: Join Angel Gabby and friends on an educational journey through the skies! Will you remember how to behave well with others? Or will you need to be taught an additional lesson?

title: Donny Donut 3
description: Donny's new adventure is taking you to the Cyber Lands, to save the world from the evil Mark Donald. With the help of Pixie, a pixel, Donny's going to travel through cities, data and clouds to find Donno and Donna, his siblings...

title: Shockwaves
description: Shockwaves is a captivating merging puzzle game where strategic placement creates powerful shockwaves, pushing and merging numbers. Challenge yourself with endless scoring or solve intricate puzzles.

title: School Evasion
description:
This small and simple project was made with the intention of being an assessment game for the Digital Games course at FAESA (Brazilian university center).

"What happened at this school?"

It's the first question a curious person would ask. That's why your mission is basically to explore this place and discover the mysteries that surround it, in quick and simple gameplay.

When you pass through these gates, you accept your destiny. You must find pieces that complete the puzzle that this school really is. With simple 3D gameplay, flashlight, batteries, and letters scattered throughout the school, it is up to the player to face their fears and accept this adventure. May the light guide you.

title: Gu-L
description:
While on the road during a school trip, a class becomes stranded in the middle of a derelict forest when their bus abruptly crashes. Fending for themselves, they soon come across a mansion whose lone habitant is a stoic maid. Seeking shelter, they take refuge in the mansion, only for the stay to be anything but restful.

This surreal RPG-Maker horror game was a submission in the March 2001 edition of the monthly contest that Enterbrain would host. Gu-L won first place, with Hyogo's very own Yubu Yakushiro receiving 30,000円 as the prize.

title: Tobari Dream Ocean + Nightmare
description:
For those of you who want to experience the best of both worlds, the sea of fun and the sea of nightmares, this is the place. A 2D action game with various magic 'Tobari Dream Ocean' and Nightmarish additional content 'Tobari Dream Ocean Nightmare' bundle!

Tobari Dream Ocean is a side-scrolling action game in which players clear stages while acquiring various kinds of magic from enemies.

Tobari Dream Ocean Nightmare, dive into a nightmarish addition with ' Tobari Dream Ocean' – now featuring nightmarish versions of all stages!

Nightmare is a game that CANNOT be recommended to any normal gamer. For those who have conquered all of Tobari Dream Ocean's main stages and crave even greater challenges, this content is tailored for the true daredevils!

title: Glitcher
description: Glitcher is a Tactical Espionage game where you play as a computer virus.

title: Fiction Fixers: Curse of OZ
description:
The Land of Oz is in great peril. The evil Victor Vile has erected towers that consume the people, light, and energy of Oz itself. Protect Dorothy and Toto as they travel across Oz in hopes of finding a way home to Kansas.

Team up with the Scarecrow, the Tinman, and the Lion and use their powers to overcome great obstacles. But beware of the Wicked Witch and Victor, an Illiterati agent, who will stop at nothing to destroy you.

title: Empire of the Golden Witch
description: An Umineko fangame. Dig through records to uncover the truth of a very different Ushiromiya family.

title: Icharko
description: Become that military hero - go through step-by-step trials, be tactful and think through every move you make before you go into the open. Experience the taste of military action of the 2000s.

title: Puke
description: Puke... No one loves this town. No one walks by. The departing trains are empty. But why? Listening to the townsfolk and witnessing the events there is your job. Go there as the investigative journalist you are to find out what's going on with the locals' lives.

title: Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story
description: Vanquish and recruit youkai in randomized dungeons in Kagura Genesis: Kuon's Story, a replayable roguelike RPG!

title: Arena of Faith
description: Win,Team up,Get Rewards and become the eSports King in Arena of Faith.

title: DDS x Narcos
description: Spinoff of the hit game Drug Dealer Simulator and the legendary show Narcos. It’s the 1980s, you are a disgraced CIA agent turned drug dealer. You will run your business in Mexico and the US in this story-driven simulator about the life of crime.

title: Medieval Machines Builder: First Siege
description: Embark on a captivating journey back to the roots of medieval conflict with Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege. This free-to-play simulation game offers a taste of the grandeur and challenges that await in the full game. Design, build, and destroy. Medieval lethal weapons await you!

title: Catting Over It
description: Challenge your jumping skills and immerse yourself in the world of real jumping tactics. The stakes are high, remember, the higher you climb, the harder you fall, every mistake can teach you a valuable lesson, or not, but it will be fun!

title: Barbarous: Family Secrets
description: Help Emyr save the world in a Time Management game full of adventure and comedy!

title: Kingdom Rush Vengeance - Hammerhold Campaign
description: Hammerhold's in for a surprise: Vez'nan sends you with the mighty Dark Army fleet for a lightning strike on the desert shores, catching the Legionnaires off guard!

title: Christmas Nightmare
description: Christmas Nightmare is an atmospheric horror game about New Year's Eve.

title: God For A Day
description: In this 2D, narrative-based simulation game, you play as the Son of God. Your mission: Decide, bless or condemn city residents. Uncover the person's story through their items and secrets before making decisions. Your choices alter the city's destiny, and impact your revelation on Judgment Day.

title: Dimensional Shift Awakening
description: This game is a soul born inspired action adventure RPG game. I want to make each character unique and flesh out their own story, background, personality then all of this will affect the character powers, type, talents, skills, fighting styles, and weapons.

title: Yukiusa
description: A game of bouncing snow rabbits!

title: Necrophoresis
description: Necrophoresis is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore a haunted morgue to find its dark secrets. Use what you can find to make your way through the morgue and find your way out.

title: Descent from Arkov's Tower
description: Highly moddable retro roguelike. Descent from Arkov's Tower - or die trying!

title: Arcane Blood: The Shattered Star
description: PLAY as Verana, a young witch and master a variety of spells!! DEFEAT bosses sealed away in forgotten dungeons! UPGRADE Verana's health and magic at Angel Maiden Statues! EXPLORE a great forest, dark caves, sandy waste, and even quaint towns!

title: Blood Radiant
description: Blood Radiant is a lovecraftian soulslike action-RPG. Explore a mythical island at the intersection of many space-times while you find weapons, battle eldritch abominations, uncover secrets, and talk to NPCs in a dark quest to achieve ultimate power.

title: Void Guard
description: Follow the Void Guardian as she inspects a space station after receiving a distress beacon from it and help her vanquish the hidden evil.

title: Rise & Reign
description: Washed ashore on a strange medieval land, its up to you to choose your destiny. Harvest resources, craft weapons, and build your kingdom. Raid other players or work together. Serve the king or take the throne for yourself. This land is harsh, can you survive?

title: Panicore
description: Panicore is a survival horror game that mixes permadeath, AI monsters and a co-op experience. Try to escape and don't get caught.

title: Blades and Bullets
description: In 1939 Grand Emperor Hil’Tar a high elf who has set his sights for Poland which would spark the start of the Second World war. Hundreds of miles away across the ocean, you a young American working out of his parent's farm, learns of the fatal news that war in the Kingdom of Europe has broken out.

title: Multiplication Mayhem
description: An educational adventure to learning multiplication! Choose the right platform with the product of the multiplication or fall to the depts. Save animals with each multiplication table completed and use their buffs to your advantage. Experience the visual novel like story to save the realm.

title: The Chronicles of Ezra Blackwell: Episode 1 - Pappi's Peril
description: First Person Mystery Adventure with twisting story and multiple endings.

title: Hazeron Starship
description: Explore and colonize a vast universe. Discover resources. Build cities. Make spacecraft. Walk aboard them. Operate their controls. Command a crew of NPCs. Lift off. Fly up through the atmosphere to outer space. Land on other worlds, anywhere, not at designated places. Build an empire.

title: Homeless
description: Beneath the dazzling lights of New York, a sinister darkness lurks. In the hour when the whole city is sleeping, a strange and terrifying man emerges from the darkness, intent on shattering your mind and spirit

title: Battlecry Berserkers
description: A never repeating dungeon. Fight your way trough waves of enemies and make your own path. Unleash new powers and defeat mighty foes, in order to find and take to the gods' justice the responsible for this attack!

title: Detective Dave
description: A washed-up Detective demoted to graveyard shift has gone rogue and stops going by the book. You play the part of Detective Dave as he explores the dark side of the city. Solve cases, work undercover, or hand out justice the old fashion way.

title: Trois Mouvements Perpétuels
description: Three games about music. One alone is light, short and weak, but the three allow you to enjoy the consistency of ideas.

title: Swing Solver
description: Swing Solver is a physics based action puzzle. Stab the wire and swing to bring the ball to the goal.

title: Northanda Chronicles
description: Master role-driven combat in Northanda Chronicles, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Recruit three heroes from countless combinations, craft a shared deck of powerful abilities, and fight to save Northanda from the devouring Void.

title: Warja
description: Warja is a roguelite tower defence game where you collect loot, upgrade towers, and level up your hero to defend against endless waves of monsters.

title: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest
description: Hidden Cats: Magic Forest is a hidden object game where you will search for lost cats while exploring the mystery of the magical forest. Touch the enchanting texture of the forest and interact with other surprise objects. Experience the silence and the discovery!

title: FeastTower
description: Pon a prueba tu destreza en la creación del sándwich más monumental y asegura tu lugar en lo más alto de la puntuación. ¿Te atreves a asumir el desafío?

title: Charrua Soccer: Pro Edition
description: Charrua Soccer is an arcade that brings you the most fun part of soccer! Play friendly matches, tournaments or create your team and lead it to glory in career mode!

title: AI.Gears: Team Tag Battle
description: "AI.Gears" offers innovative robot combat with diverse, customizable robots and 1v1 matches. Featuring reinforcement learning AI, it provides rich PvP and PvE content for a diverse combat experience. Join the world of varied robot battles in "AI.Gears."

title: Buzz Cut Simulation
description: A Korean man enjoys simulating the process of getting a buzz cut in a game. Click to choose whether to do the buzz cut or not

title: Epic Pizza
description: Epic Pizza - The People of Calzonia are hungry for Pizza. You have to Race against Time to get it to them.

title: Dread Protocol
description: Embark on a thrilling 3rd-person space adventure. Engage in merciless combat, wield a vast arsenal, and explore procedurally generated environments. Take down the Federation, one station at a time.

title: Fan Zhuan 21 Ke
description: You will play an excellent detective with a history of retired soldiers, accidentally wrapped into the case of life and death brothers involved in, and stepped into a life and death of a difficult to predict the maze, and this maze behind the layers of unseen crises and crimes.

title: Girl Gunner
description: Girl Gunner is a fun 2D shooter game with a rich weapon system, exquisite graphics, and beautiful BGM, especially bullets. Currently, there are up to 24 types! Players will play the cute girl Emily, escaping from the deserted island and breaking out of the siege.

title: Jewel Craft Fusion
description: Explore cosmic wonders in "Jewel Craft Fusion." Match gems, solve puzzles, and unlock ancient cosmic secrets. Dive into a celestial odyssey of brilliance!

title: Critter Crossfire
description: A genre-breaking fusion of Turn-Based Tactics and First Person Shooting made by a solo developer. Position your units in a detailed 3D environment and skillfully aim your shots with physics-based weapons. Collect and combine items to build unique loadouts from over 50 wacky weapons and upgrades.

title: Armored War
description: Armored War is a hardcore tactical first-person shooter set in the realities of modern conflict. Take part in ground battles using a full arsenal of weapons and equipment.

title: Only Up Samarkand
description: Only up Samarkand is a parkour game where speed and agility are important so as not to fall and start again! Reaching the end is an important milestone in the game.

title: Ostrich Farm
description: Sunshine graces the farm and your birds are a fashion disaster. Breed vibrant ostriches by matching colors and patterns to complete unique orders. Earn valuable rewards and mutation points to enhance your farm's genetic diversity.

title: United Penguin Kingdom
description: A city-building game where you build a penguin settlement and satisfy the various needs of your penguins while dealing with seals and killer whales. Enjoy the growth of your settlement, become the king, and lead the United Penguin Kingdom.

title: ThroneForge: The Fortress War
description: Throneforge: The Fortress War:Build an arsenal of diverse towers, each with unique abilities and strengths.Strategically place towers along the enemy's path to maximize their impact and create impenetrable defense lines.

title: Grimhook
description: Descend into Grimhook's sunken ruins as Dart, mastering Lovecraftian powers. Bounce, dash, and grapple through flooded caverns, confronting robotic foes in this fast-paced first-person action platformer. Explore, battle, and unravel the mysteries below Miletos.

title: Chimp Quest: Spirit Isle
description: Swing into a heartwarming tale in Chimp Quest: Spirit Isle.

title: Duck's Most Terrible Day
description: A time-bending 2D platformer in the least amount of pixels possible.

title: Notice
description: NOTICE is a 7-10 minute short interactive experience that follows the story of having a panic attack, then using awareness and presence to overcome it. As you get home and start to breathe, you take control over your thoughts. By clicking on each object, you start to become aware of everything in your space and what it means to you. Each object has its own style, musical note and meaning - whether that be the can of soda lying on your desk or the guitar gifted to you from a friend back home.

title: Nobody Nowhere
description: A side-scrolling, story-driven text adventure game in pixel art. The story is set in 2079, when a Replicant awakens in a lab facility amidst a life-or-death situation. The replicant aid agency tries to rescue him but fails. In the process they stumble on the real secret of the Replicant project...

title: Xelan Force
description: 8-bit style vertical scrolling shooting game Xelan Force. We aimed to create a game that you can enjoy over and over again, such as the feeling of play that changes between offensive and defensive types, and the ability to search for hidden items.

title: Triadino
description: Triadino is a casual puzzle game inspired by Tetris and Rock-Paper-Scissors. Unique interactions between typed blocks make the game more interesting and challenging.

title: A Chocolate World
description: This is 3d platformer an unusual adventure, come inside a world of chocolates and desserts where every move can be fatal 4 levels each one differs from the other.. No save point the goal is to finish every level with absolute precision it's challenging it' has zero calories.... press f4 to quit game

title: Where the Music Dies
description: A short visual novel about dealing with loss. You explore a festival filled with old memories and regret. Where the voices of the dead never stay quite dead. Will you manage to change, before it's too late?

title: Idle Percent
description: Every upgrade in this game is a percent which is added to the upgradable value. Your progression is slow at the beginning but with time your income will become higher and higher! Buy prestige and super prestige upgrades to maximize your profit!

title: Smash and Bash Monsters
description: An addicting Clicker-Looter game where you defeat Thousands of monsters to loot equipment and get stronger, that can be as Relaxing or Frenetic as you like!

title: Tunguska: Slaughterhouse
description: A wave defense mode set in a new location in Tunguska. Stop the waves of minions from energizing the Dark Disciple and destroying the Zone. Arm and supply yourself with Soul Stones left by your fallen foes. Use your creativity with all the gears in the game to outgun a seemingly undefeatable enemy.

title: Lawless Lands: Witchcraft
description: The Witchcraft DLC for Lawless Lands adds 3 new spells in a new spell class - witchcraft, which can be learned or gained through a staff or wand! Use your craft and trickery to bring your enemies down and bend the wrathful forces of nature to your will!

title: Big Klondike: Tri Peaks Solitaire
description: Support Big Klondike and unlock Tri Peaks Solitaire.

title: Warm Snow: The End Of Karma
description: During the ten years of Bi'an's slumber in the Ash Of Nightmare, the malevolent god Helo was fully unleashed, bringing havoc to the world. The resistance force led by Linglong once glimpsed hope, but in the face of madness and despair, everything seemed so fragile...

title: Classic Car Simulator Car Driving
description: An immersive car game awaits you with a classic car driving simulator.

title: Cyber Horny
description: Cyber Horny - is an exciting 2D game, the essence of which is to find paired colors. And as a reward, you will receive an image with an incredibly beautiful girl. This game will give you aesthetic pleasure. Everything in Cyber Horny is aimed at making you experience the real pleasure of this game!

title: Guardians of Eden
description: "Guardians of Eden": a tower defense cultivation game where you serve Valkyries, meeting their needs, and showcase strategic skills in battles by placing them strategically and allocating resources for success.

title: Paradox Guardians
description: Paradox Guardians is a real-time adult RPG where you play as an alien Time Traveler who arrives on Earth and must conquer the planet.

title: Superpersons University
description: The game to end all games. Superpersons University is a comedy deckbuilder game. Compete with one of the Superpersons to get a date with another Superperson, but you don't know who the other suitor is. Discover your nemesis, foil their plans, and get the date. (This is not an erotic game.)

title: Sexbot
description: Can't find a date for the homecoming dance? Then order AmaZone's Alexa today! Our newest version of Alexa is a super sexy humanoid robot ready to follow your every command! *AmaZone is not responsible for Alexa AI sentience or robo-hostility, or global destruction

title: Orb in Wonder
description: This is a puzzle game with simple rules. Complete the missions given in each stage to clear the game and enjoy exciting encounters and interactions with numerous heroines!

title: Cyberpunk Sex
description: Cyberpunk Sex is a quest game with a lot of sex. Find the key (sex toys) to open another room

title: Survivor Girls
description: "Survivor Girls" is a roguelite which is about pretty girls and added a variety of strategic ways based on the traditional roguelike,13 different characters available plus hundreds of weapons and items bring the game more possibilities.

title: My Tsundere Femboy
description: My Tsundere Femboy is a short erotic kinetic visual novel where you play as the typical depiction of a gooner protagonist, a wanker and a loser, who's about to get involved in an exciting adventure with her landlady's effeminate son.

title: Songs of Steel: Hispania
description: Relive the conflict between the mighty Roman Republic and the brave Celtiberian people of Numantia! Featuring hand-drawn illustrations, classic turn-based strategy mechanics, and combat tactics, with decision-making and side missions.

title: One Military Camp: Multiplayer Mode
description: Enjoy the ultimate strategic battles in One Military Camp Multiplayer Mode. Build your camp, recruit and train soldiers and send them on missions to conquer territories against your opponent. This online mode includes 10 maps, all 6 biomes and features such as minimap, voice chat and drone attacks.

title: ParryRobot
description: ParryRobot is a 3D action game where you play as a tiny but agile robot, “PAR 12-H”. Using the game’s “Parry System”, you are tasked with overcoming the mysterious, hulking “TB 001-L”…a massive automaton who’s set its eyes on your metallic hide!

title: Zombie Sanctuary: Juliet
description: In the ancient Middle Ages, a lot of zombies have appeared in an abandoned village. As a member of the Seabird Strike Team, you were reasonably assigned to check it out. Your captain gives you a total of 6 different weapons that you need to use to defeat hordes of zombies.

title: Time Hunters: Curse of the Golden Idol
description: Are you ready?! Make some noise (and some enemies) in this action-packed party shooter for 4! Utilize your unique energy shots, power-up your attacks with an array of pick-ups, and get set to take down the competition!!

title: Lamprey
description:
Fang couldn't be happier about her new job at the prestigious tech startup Riverstone, Inc. When she starts on her new team, building a revolutionary workplace assistant AI called Lamprey, she jumps into her work head-first.

However, it's not long before things start going wrong, with a software bug causing Lamprey to trap the team in their office. Will Fang and her co-workers be able to escape a prison of their own making?

title: Enough Sheep
description:
The wolves are following the innocent sheep! Your job is to push them inside the circles to make them disappear.

This game was developed for the GMTK Game Jam 2023 with the theme "Roles Reversed"

title: 404 Knight
description: Story Game of Cleaning Viruses from Computer as a Robot

title: Miku Chan's Robot
description: Earth is on the brink of destruction, but Miku-chan's robot is ready for duty! Or is it ready?

title: Temporal Odyssey
description: Temporal Odyssey: Journey Through Time is an enigmatic adventure game that invites players into a mysterious journey across different epochs. Guiding the character Aylin, players will embark on unique explorations in various time periods, solving intricate puzzles and wielding the power to alter the fabric of time itself. The game delves beyond mere time travel, challenging players to shape the past and change the course of the future. Temporal Odyssey not only encompasses the thrill of temporal exploration but also encourages players to unravel the secrets of time, rewrite history, and craft their own epic temporal saga. Immerse yourself in this captivating experience that reveals time travel as an unpredictable and surprise-laden adventure.

title: Outlanders: Home is Where the Heart is
description: After receiving a letter from an estranged family member, a rookie Leader will journey through the tricky swamps of the Outlands while tracking the steps of his ancestors.

title: Narava RPG
description: Explore a magical open world crafted by a passionate developer. Battle using weapon skills or magic and evolve your character throughout your adventure.

title: Infinite Forest Idle
description: A true idle RPG with roguelite and multiplayer elements. Made for playing (on a second screen) while doing something else.

title: Futanari Tales
description: There are girls with a twist here! Let's get weird.

title: Scream or Die
description: Horror game.

title: Bloodshots
description: Immerse yourself in a terrifying survival horror experience set in a laboratory where horrific experiments have been conducted. Take on the role of Joseph Alexander Blackwell, who has to rescue his daughter. To succeed, you will be forced to use your own blood in unusual and twisted ways.

title: Desolate City: Last Show
description: It's the last concert of his tour, and Don Aitor will have to survive the horror. Discover the consequences of the strange virus threatening the pixelated city of Gray Bay in this survival horror/action RPG.

title: King of Throwing
description: Author’s suggestion: Use a notepad to record the angles of your throws. Players can aim and throw by clicking the left mouse button, and control the character’s left and right movement by pressing A and D. Control the angle of your throw, you don't want to make a mistake

title: Twista
description: The Hardest Game in the World! (I guess.)

title: Ericanskinsmonsters
description: Join Ericanskinsmonsters and her band of misfits as they embark on a dangerous undertaking to save the realm of Strifestav from a cruel necromancer and his army of undead at any cost. Nothing will stand between you and your vengeance in this classic style turn based rpg!

title: Stealth Assault: Urban Strike
description: Great shooting game, prevent the insurgency crysis on the planet! We will see you on the frontline!

title: Atomic Titans: Light Violence
description: Embark on a cosmic journey with Atomic Titans: Light Violence, an action-packed casual combat game. Engage in heart-pounding showdowns within the confines of space faring arenas.

title: The Death Focal
description: The death focal(TDF) is a first-person shooting game where you have to prove yourself worthy in mini-battles in order to be qualified for the incoming great battle .

title: The Spellswapper
description: The Spellswapper is an arcade roguelite where you use spells to defeat waves of enemies. Command an ever-moving arsenal of spells. Swap out old spells for new ones after each wave, crafting a unique magical repertoire in every run.

title: Kings Call
description: Kings call is a free-to-play, trading-card based MMO . Playable through a browser, the game allows players to take the role of the Lord of Silver Heron Ridge

title: Soldier Yōki
description: Soldier Yōki, is an indie, action, and third-person shooter game. Solo or in cooperation, up to 4 players, explore the different settings, with diverse gaming experiences. Face the Extraterrestrial alliance and defeat the Boss in order to win the game.

title: Ling Hun
description: A 2D Platformer Game were Jumping is not affected by gravity (that's what happens when you got your soul stolen). Master the jump to succeed in every level. Enjoy the classic Pixel Art with a mix of Asian ink style in the Background. Change the pace of the game to adapt it to your gamestyle.

title: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero
description: Eternity's Echo: Patient Zero takes place at a gas station in Winona, Arizona. Rayne Williams is a D.I.B Agent sent to investigate the strange occurrences at this gas station along Route 66. Join the story through Rayne's perspective as she tries to fulfill her mission amidst the challenges she encounters on the station's premises!

title: Champion Road
description: Champion Road immerses you in a dynamic fusion of classic beat 'em up intensity and entertaining platform challenges. Join six formidable fighters in a nostalgic 90s-style tournament arena. Unleash your skills, relive arcade gaming's golden era, and emerge as the ultimate champion!

title: Click Cricket
description: Click Cricket is a single player casual cricket simulation for PC. The simple but engaging gameplay makes each match is unique with its own set of challenges to overcome and ensure victory on the field!

title: Mr. Sanna Clozz
description: Candied blades, magical guns and tons of fun. Chestnut takes off on an adventure to save Christmas night!

title: ReHarmony
description: The main character finds themselves ensnared within a mysterious realm, and it's up to you to help them avoid getting lost in time. As our hero navigates different time periods, they must activate special keys to control the flow of time.

title: Corporate Pussy
description: Corporate pussy is an adult visual novel with point&click elements. Dive into the office life as a corporate worker, interact with hot colleagues and become the big boss.

title: Super Kawaii Ninja
description: Super kawaii ninja is a single player arena fps.

title: Chrysolite
description:
A strange knight sat in front of a fire, darkness surrounding him. His sword stuck in the ground, covered in dried blood. He warns you against going any further, but the intrigue of what lies beyond far surpasses the instinct of self preservation.

Play as a young thief and explore the dangerous ruins of a once-prosperous kingdom. Fight against hordes of terrifying monsters, make your way through challenging platforming sections and discover the secret that lies at the very bottom of the ruins in this handcrafted experience.

Chrysolite is a narrative driven, pixel-art, 2D platformer with Soulslike inspirations.

title: The Dragonhood
description: The Dragonhood is a clicker RPG with rougelite elements and automatic battles. Collect eggs, hatch dragons, and loot stuff on a variety of 1 vs 1 adventures or 3 vs 3 dungeons. Complete quests and build your dragons the way you want with various evolutions, abilities, amulets, and more!

title: Chutney: Space Survivor
description: Chutney: Space Survivor is a third person, hoard-shooting deck builder where you play as Chutney, shooting down hordes of enemies with his Omni-gun. Alter your attacks by collecting different cartridges and create unique synergies!

title: Starlight Legacy
description: Forge your own legacy in Starlight Legacy! Explore the vast Evaria Kingdom in beautiful 2D pixel art graphics, an exciting turn-based battle system, and a non-linear story.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Tremor Kameo
description: Tremor, Ninja of the Black Dragon Clan, returns to the new Mortal Kombat Universe. Purchase this pack and receive Tremor as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

title: Mystery Box VR: Escape The Room
description: The VR version of the third chapter of the Mystery Box series. Can you crack crazy puzzles to open incredible boxes and escape the room you're trapped in?

title: Devil's Gambit
description:
Devil's Gambit follows Hector, a badger healer returning to the little town of Rannai, the birthplace of his fondest memories. He holds dearly his time with the mischievous yet friendly wolves, the stories they told, the fertile forest east of town, and the mist that heralded every sunrise. Most of all, he remembers Cadgan: a wolf a bit younger and smaller than himself — an unrepentant troublemaker who left in him a bundle of emotions.

But that was nine years ago, when he was just a teenager. Upon his return, Hector finds the town transformed by the new duke's reign, and a Cadgan that has grown into a cold, distant mountain of a man. As he works as a healer and reignites a long-forgotten passion, Hector notices something other than love in the air.

The trees' roots stir with his every step.

title: Olsenbanden Jr. I Vikingenes Fotspor
description: This time the history goes back to the viking age. A group of criminals kidnaps a history teacher (a viking expert), forcing him to show them the secret viking grave. Olsenbanden contacts their old teacher which leads them on an adventure where they have to stop the bad guys before they find the grave. In order to solve the mystery, the player have to go through 10 missions. For each successful mission, they will get closer to the finish line. As always, the Olsenbanden jr have both police and villains on their heels.

title: This Game is For You 2022
description: Hi there, welcome! This is a horror game I've made just for you.

title: Holy Maid Academy
description: When Ryunosuke Kokuto receives a personal invitation from the chairman of a respected edifice to serve as a professor there, he doesn’t say no to the opportunity.

title: My Girls’ Secrets
description: This is a "casual" game with beautiful painting style, go through the level and explore the mysterious world, in this world will meet all kinds of girls, in the face of their challenges you should make choices to make them succeed as your girlfriend.

title: Fairies Love
description: This is an elimination game with beautiful painting style, go through the level and meet six girls with different personalities, in the face of their challenges you should make choices to make them succeed as your girlfriend.

title: Hibernation
description: A small but eerie town, an unknown killer, and a cash reward! In this short PSX style horror game, you play as a local detective investigating a murder in the hopes of earning themselves some cash for finding the killer. Venture into town, and see what you can find out for yourself!

title: Frontline Battles
description: In this tug of war style strategy game you can send out soldiers to destroy your enemy's bases. Deploy army's comprised of multiple different types of soldiers that each fill a different role. Push across the map to your enemy's HQ and destroy it to win in these short less than 20 minute matches.

title: Newcomer: Intermediate Immersion
description: A fantasy language learning adventure for intermediate language learners. Practice and improve your ability to speak in your target language to save the the kingdom and befriend its people!

title: Thought Experiment Simulator
description: Trolley Problem, Ship of Theseus, Brain in a Vat, Infinite Monkey, Sisyphus, Prisoner Paradox, Schrodinger's Cat, etc.

title: Annihilator
description: ANNIHILATOR is a gritty top-down shooter, originally made for the Game Boy Color. This is a modern adaption.

title: Dracula's Castle
description: Duke Nukem gets shot down by a Science experiment gone wrong near Dracula's Castle - get in and make the bastards pay for rising your flight insurance premium yet again.

title: Magdalene
description: Duke enters a city covered in gray clouds and quiet rains of autumn. Unfortunately, it seems that the alien scum don't respect this beautiful season. Note that this map can be pretty difficult. It also contains couple of silly traps and puzzles

title: Bacon Grease
description: Bacon Grease is a rather typical city map with particular attention payed to a grimy mood and a strong sense of place. You'll make your way through the streets of a besieged city, encountering a mix of commercial, residential, industrial, shopping, and transit locations.

title: Overdose Delusion
description: Duke got a job as watchman for a research unit on the freezing shores of northern Siberia. However, because of gross negligence and lots of alcohol, Duke locks himself out of his guardpost and loses the keycard. To make matters worse, aliens launch their attack on the station, so Duke is about to have a busy night.

title: Block Mind
description: A dream-like map that spans multiple environments. The premise is to transport yourself out of a hub area to different locations, solve the puzzles, return to the hub, and open up a forcefield.

title: Day of Night
description: Map takes place in nighttime. Duke has to roam through sewers, a subway station and city streets.

title: Memory of The Waters
description: Duke is lost in a snowy wilderness (probably because of alcohol). He stumbles heroicly around and discovers all sorts of eerie locations.

title: Null Moon
description: Duke is enjoying his holiday. He visits the secluded town of Whitehorne in snowbound Ontario - and just like that, his holiday is suddenly filled with work.

title: Promise
description: Christmas is at the door in snowy Allentown and Duke has promised to collect gifts for Lara. While doing so, he also needs to teach the aliens how one respects wintery holidays.

title: Reverse Will
description: Duke has arrived at Florida to investigate the SPCH facility.

title: Satoyama Note: Natsukusa Komichi
description: "Satoyama Note: Natsukusa Komichi" is a novel game about the creatures that live in satoyama. Collect illustrated books and take the quiz-style satoyama test. The background music is played live by a shinobue flute, and the world is depicted by hand-drawn ink paintings.

title: Sp(l/r)ite
description: When you wake up, you are in a different space. "Sp(l/r)ite" is an adventure game in which you must cooperate with your neighbors and a vivacious goddess, separated by walls, to escape from a room floating in a different space, while solving riddles. Which door will you choose when you get there?

title: Death Front
description: Death Front is a first-person shooter with supernatural elements. Team up in parties of four to uncover the mystery behind a series of gruesome murders while being haunted by ghosts. Do you have what it takes to face these sinister forces?

title: Main Deity Space
description: The journey of endless slaughter and reincarnation, survive together with your companions.

title: Knight Versus Demon
description: In Knight Versus Demon a VR player controls a villainous demon battling against a tiny stoic hero played by a local friend on the PC.

title: Synthwave Runner
description: Synthwave Runner is a casual game where you have to jump over different obstacle to keep running and increase your highscore in an stunning synthwave style.

title: Half-Life: 25th Anniversary Update
description:
To celebrate the 25th anniversary of the ground breaking FPS, Valve released this update (and will support it going forward). Included are:

Half-Life Uplink
4 New Multiplayer Maps: Contamination, Pool Party, Disposal, and Rocket Frenzy
Updated Graphics Support
Controller and Steam networking support
Steam Deck support

And much more!

title: Five Nights at Freddy's Doom
description: This 1993 DOOM mod lets you visit Five Nights at Freddy's 1, FNaF 2, and FNaF 3 pizzerias.

title: LotR: Realms in Exile
description: A total overhaul mod for Crusader Kings III, based on the works of J.R.R. Tolkien's The Lord of the Rings.

title: D3ad Hand
description:
Crack the code, feed the cat, save the world.
Yuri Spraytyvich has been selected for the role of Junior Strategic Missile Force Manager of Čerëmuški Command Post in Chita, Siberia.
His new position comes with a lot of responsabilities and he will need to deal with lack of maintenance, worker strikes, radioactive materials and PERIMETER, the soviet automatic defence system.
When PERIMETER receives by mistake the order to start the launch of the ballistic missile, it is up to Yuri to fix the problem and save the world from nuclear apocalypse.
D3AD HAND is a satirical Point and click comedy adventure game set during the cold war in a soviet bunker.

title: Black Hole Interior Explorer
description:
Here's your chance to cross the event horizon and see what the inside of a black hole looks like.

Use WASD to control your magical laws-of-physics defying space-time vehicle. Move the mouse to look around.

title: Backbone's Rampage
description:
You play as the treacherous Backbone in his quest to spread villainy across a city full of super heroes, with splendid surprises awaiting you!
Made for the GMTK game jam 2023 in under 48 hours.

title: Curiosity Killed the Explorer
description: You were driving home one late night. Nearby de-forestation has revealed an uncanny cave. Authorities have yet to block the entrance, so you decide to take a look before it is inevitably closed down. What could go wrong?

title: Calamity Mod: Infernum Mode
description:
An extension mod for Calamity that adds an extra difficulty - Infernum

This difficulty is harder than Death mode and can be activated with the difficulty selection UI in Calamity.
The primary focus of the mod is expansive reworking of boss AIs.

Some bosses gain extra phases for maximum "It's not over yet!" energy.

title: Super Reaktor
description: Super reaKtor is a fast-paced Bullet Hell with original controls, where you must survive by collecting green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb various types of hostile TRI-SKL bullets.

title: Waifu Hell
description: Old school classics with the new twist.

title: Cleany's Window Service
description: You get a request from an unknown client. They need you to clean their windows during the night. Given the look of their luxurious home, you expect a big payout for your service.

title: Half-Life: 25th Anniversary Adventure
description: LambdaGeneration's special browser based game for Half-Life's 25th Anniversary where you can find and learn all sorts of Half-Life facts and trivia

title: Aeruta
description:
A bread revolution across the world now begins!
Aeruta is a side-scrolling action game with a shop management twist, fight monsters for materials and use them to make breads, then finally make the deserted town popular again!

title: Natural Craft
description: A funny Blocks Puzzle game.

title: A Army Base
description: 2D side-scrolling shooting, 5-player local cooperative combat, base defense, zombie survival, firearms, melee weapons, vehicles, and mechs.

title: Tales of Three Kingdoms: The Mortal World
description: Dou Fu, who has always tried to live a low-key life in the chaotic period, gets involved in different events after meeting the “Princess” from the Han Dynasty. The choices he makes will lead them to different endings…

title: Keep Up
description: Keep Up is a cute-as-heck 3D platformer! Explore giant worlds freely and reach new heights! In this action game, you will control a small dog with various jumping skills. Keep going up and find the path to the top.

title: Synthetic Fantasy;
description: A "Visual Novel Play" about the nature of love and relationships! Caught between his fiance and an android, Dan Garland must make a choice that will change lives forever.

title: OG Puzzlers: Kira Maus
description: OG Puzzlers: Kira Maus is an casual puzzel game with cute dog images. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Dungeon 3D: Eastern
description: The Eastern Theme pack contains over 100 new assets to build a glorious Eastern village, city, temple, or cultural battle scene. It contains a multitude of fun new props to really make your worlds come to life, built to work seamlessly together in Dungeon 3D!

title: Four Hunters Survivor
description: Play with four hunters to defeat and survive several hordes of countless enemies, improve your characters to survive more and more and become the most powerful hunter in the world.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: DAF XD
description: The DAF XD truck represents a new generation of distribution and vocational vehicles. From its aerodynamic features enhancing fuel efficiency to the advanced safety systems ensuring a secure journey, it is the ideal choice for your next regional delivery on the road.

title: Model Builder: Alaskan Road Truckers
description: Get ready to hit the rugged Alaskan wilderness in the Model Builder! With the Alaskan Road Truckers DLC we are expending already existing collection of models and giving you the possibility to recreate your favorite trucks! Customize them with unique modifications, colors or decals!

title: FireFly
description: A momentum-driven 2D platforming adventure where mastering movement unlocks exploration. Leap, slide, and swing through vibrant open maps as a grounded firefly searching for family and hidden secrets.

title: Thunderblade Saga
description: "Thunderblade Saga" is a 2D side-scrolling action game featuring a rich array of combos and unique skill builds. Come challenge the distinctively unique bosses, unlock powerful skills, and enjoy an intense and thrilling combat journey!

title: From Space: Operation Clear Skies
description: This DLC provides additional content for Story Mode. During this expedition, you'll find immersive new characters that will provide you with dangerous tasks.

title: Rogue Survivalist
description: Choose Knight, Mage, or Rogue. Face enemies on 6 maps, level up, unlock unique abilities, and become a hero in this thrilling action RPG.

title: Inverse Ninjas vs. The Public Domain
description: Fight off increasingly powerful ninjas as some of the most iconic characters of all time in this 2-4 player party game!

title: Profound
description: A quirky action RPG made by only one person. Collect gold & loot. Upgrade weapons and armor. Kill enemies and level up your skills.

title: Hentai Girls Slide
description: Hentai Girls Slide is a slide puzzle solving game. calm and relaxing moments. Enjoy calm and relaxing moments while solving slide puzzles with beautiful girls.

title: This Is How U Look Saying This Shit
description: This Is How U Look Saying This Shit is a mod for Friday Night Funkin' by phantasmuh that is based on the Boykisser meme.

title: Konkwest
description: Konkwest is a globe based, arcade grand strategy game. In one evening, you (and your friends) can play through a world conquest campaign. Many historical starting scenarios bring you into the game world and let you bring your empire to glory. The single-resource economy lets the game appeal to casual players too.

title: Space Garbage
description: Do you like Tetris? Doesn't matter. Space Garbage is here to rotate Tetris 90 degrees on its head and add a little car to it. Blast and stack your way to the top of the leaderboard with this farm-to-table, indie, retro, solo, arcade... experience!

title: Christmas Clash
description: Help Santa claus and his christmas elfs to stop the angry babies, toddlers, and kids. Use strategy and management to secure the road to the workshop.

title: Auto Auto: Maximum Autodrive In The Alien Apocalypse
description: Oh no! Aliens have taken over! All of humanity is a hive mind with one goal... to destroy the last person standing! Drive, drift, and shoot your way through the onslaught before the aliens decide to deal with their little problem themselves. How long will your spirit keep the last person alive?

title: System Override
description: System Override is a first-person, single player heist game where you play as a hacker clearing a route through a variety of traps that block the way of your non-playable companion on the field.

title: Inari
description: INARI is a high-speed kunai action platformer set in an Eastern fantasy world. You are an executioner sent to hunt down the Seven Daughters who dared defy the mighty Lord. Engage in rapid, relentless combat using kunai and instant teleportation. Face overwhelming odds with a single life.

title: Wizard's Beard
description: Explore locations, fight enemies, cast spells, and repeat! What more could you want in a game?

title: Sofi Origins
description: Sofi Origins is an adventure, suspense, and horror game in which you play as Sofi, a girl with a very sad past, but who in her world has powers. Alongside Sofi, you will experience fear and sadness in a unique way. You will have to use your skills and stay focused to confront the past.

title: Sympathia
description: 『Dodge × Beat』 Enjoy the world of sympathia in rhythm!

title: The Wizard Party
description: The Wizard Party is a whimsical adventure game where all dialogue options are physics objects that interact with each other!

title: Magnavody
description: Experience the magic and weirdness of the world's first home video console, the Magnavox Odyssey, lovingly recreated for modern hardware.

title: Rivals' Duel
description: Act fast, duels are fierce. Opponents will not wait a second to defeat you, accelerate your mind and face them with your swords and guns

title: Undead Mayhem
description: Undead Mayhem is a survival horror fps game where you will try to survive for as long as possible while fighting waves of bloodthirsty monsters coming to kill you!

title: Gombo
description: Explore, build, fight and survive in an enchanting cartoon world! Take control of Gombo, your very own animated character, and adventure through a beautiful, yet unforgiving world full of dangers and surprises.

title: Hannah VCR
description: Solve the mysteries that are locked within Hannah's videotapes by changing the order and color of obstacles inside a retro videogame.

title: Bubble Chicken Farm
description: Bubble Chicken Farm offers an immersive game experience where adventure, farm management, and magic merge to create a world full of possibilities. Discover the joy of being a pirate farmer and create your own legend at Bubble Chicken Farm.

title: Fimbul's Gemboree
description: Collect Gems, explore worlds, and party hardy. You’ll do it all in Fimbul’s Gemboree- a fast-paced adventure platformer. Play as Fimbul, a little ice dragon, and help him run, jump, and roll across lands to collect items that will let him into the best party on the block.

title: Undertale: Mad Mew Mew Port
description: Undertale: Mad Mew Mew Port is an Undertale fangame by DeadDuck. The game is a recreation of the Mad Mew Mew boss battle from the Nintendo Switch version of Undertale, making it playable on both PC and Android.

title: Terraformers: New Frontiers
description: The ‘New Frontiers’ DLC for Terraformers adds the option to found outposts on other celestial bodies in the Solar System. Explore the dangerous atmosphere of Venus, adapt to the massive gravity field of Jupiter or research the mysterious rings of Saturn.

title: Class of Heroes 2G: Remastered Edition
description: Are you ready to take on dark winding dungeons crawling with magic and monsters? Prepare yourself for a remastered classic dungeon crawler, full of exploration, combat, and endless opportunities.

title: Where the Music Dies: Mirror of Regret
description: Two new supporting characters. Several strange new people to interact with. A new area, the dark twisted funfair, to explore.

title: Niels Penguin Adventure
description: Help Niels save his love, Lisa, from the cunning Professor Travis in this thrilling adventure game! Ready for an exciting chase with the villain? Play now on Steam!

title: Speed-Deus-Ex-Machine
description: "SPEEDUS" is a competitive card battle game based on the classic card game "Speed." Quickly play cards from your hand that follow the numbers on the field! Use skills and abilities! The first player to play all cards from their deck and hand wins!

title: Screw Drivers
description: Crazy physics and high-speed races! Craft vehicles cleverly by combining building blocks and mechanical parts to create powerful drivetrains. Unlock new parts, race for the gold, and challenge your friends in multiplayer.

title: Horizon Springs
description: Live your dreams in Horizon Springs – an open world of limitless possibilities. Build, explore, and shape your destiny in alternate paradise. Make a name for yourself in Horizon Springs.

title: Once First-Person Adventure
description: Once First-Person Adventure is a first-person action adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic setting. As a volunteer, you go to conduct an unscheduled inspection of power plant points.

title: Redneg AllStars Swing-By Edition
description: From the developer of Cosmo Dreamer and Like Dreamer, "Outside", this is a fantastical and comical boss-rush bullet-hell shooting game remade from a free game. Both beginners and experts can enjoy the intense boss rush!

title: Spin Up
description: This is a climbing action adventure game. The player has fallen to a certain planet and must use punching and spinning to reach the top.

title: Waiting in the Lime Forest
description: Face your friend's twisted mind and do your best. You should stay sane until the end.

title: Apocalypse Party
description: "Apocalypse Party" is a 3D top-down action Roguelike game. It's the brand-new sequel to "Plague Project Zero"! A new mission has begun! You will travel to the medieval era, where you'll gradually master firearms, melee weapons, magic, cursed witchcraft, summoning, and more. Through your choices, equip yourself to become the ultimate survivor. Before the apocalypse arrives, have one last wild celebration with your teammates!

title: Roguelike Adventures and Dungeons
description: Do you like roguelike dungeon crawling games? Or exploring Minecraft world for dungeons and structures for loot? Tired of all that tech stuff and just want more fun? Then this pack is for you. It is completely focused on adventuring and exploration, looting and fighting. Fight you way through the dungeons, improve your skills and gear, complete quests and conquer new undiscovered dangerous dimensions. There is no time to relax because as you grow stronger, gathering better equipment mobs will also gain health and becomes stronger!

title: Mitsugasero! Joon-chan!!
description:
Yorigami Joon is a plague goddess who loves money and goods.
This is a game where you just pay tribute to Joon-chan.

title: Drmwrldgrl
description:
Emmett is a regular girl, she lives a regular life and doesn't have many complaints.
Nova is a demon made from ash and bone.
One day they meet.

title: Mamiya: DoomsDayDreams
description: Mamiya: DoomsDayDreams is the thrilling final part of the dark mystery visual novel Mamiya, in which in which a group of young men struggle against existential dread before the end of the world.

title: Novopangea
description: Novopangea is a multi-player economy style strategy game. The game is designed around real world mechanics such as renting land, owning a business and completing jobs. Novopangea is set in a fantasy world comprised of six realms, each with their own story and lore and cast of characters.

title: Noisz: Episode G
description: Noisz Episode G is the second story expansion for Noisz, exploring the tale of Gaius Antiphon long before the events of Ignition and re:||VERSE with 6 brand-new stages! Challenge new and old content with the tricky mechanics of Proto Style, further expanding your Style Lab possibilities, and earn more achivements and titles!

title: Succubus Simulator
description: Succubus Simulator is an episodic visual novel. It is NSFW, very queer, and sex positive. Go in expecting a complete fuckery of gender norms, a bit of plot, an emphasis on consent, and lots of coding bugs. It explores kinks like femdom, pet play, S&M, and more.

title: Rauol
description: It's a story about a thief, "Rauol," who hides in a secret warehouse of a large company to make a big deal, unexpectedly becomes a combination with Duoksini, who is being tested in captivity and runs away.

title: Sling Puzzle: Golf Master
description: Have you ever imagined what happens to the world when gravity is not always downward? In an inverted city, you will walk over walls and fall into the sky. In the game, you will explore in the intricate gravity space, break the traps, solve the puzzles, and discover the path to the end.

title: Planet Suika
description: Take your Suika stacking skills to a new planetary level in this Casual Puzzle Game! Combine smaller planets together to turn them into larger planets. Master the games Physics to combine the planets until you make a big Sun!

title: FishTDX
description: Buy towers to defend your islands against waves of fish! Unlock new towers after each round with new play styles and new synergies. Build your defenses to annihilate the fish with hours and hours of incredibly satisfying and addictive gameplay!

title: Vigaro Runner
description: Player is Vigaro pill and his mission is to avoid traps and use platforms to find star and finish levels

title: Sweet Home: Look and Find - Collector's Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the comfort and tranquility of home as you relax and enjoy finding objects, solving puzzles, and conquering mini-games in this cozy and clever new hidden object game from Avi Games!

title: Cat Sandbox
description: Save pixel cats in this physics puzzle game!

title: Myth of Future Dimension
description: A real-time strategy game that abandons complicated operations and pursues lightheartedness.Tells a story that............ is not easy to summarize or describe......Experience the cultivation of armaments with a "high degree of freedom".

title: Nightscape City
description: Nightscape City is nightclub management simulation. Manage your nightclub, buy new music, unlock new drinks, grow your empire!

title: Deckbuilder Fantasy
description: Embark on a thrilling deckbuilding adventure! Craft your strategy as you explore treacherous lands and face challenging foes. Discover a vast array of powerful cards and unique treasures, fighting your way to the final boss on a journey that's different every time.

title: Aim Trainer: Shooting Range
description: Aim Trainer - Shooting Range is a casual shooting game that includes a variety of exciting and fun game modes and a extensive weapon upgrade system. Train your shooting skills, collect different types of weapons, and become an excellent shooter elite!

title: I Still Live Under Your House
description: You're a horrible monster living under someone's house.

title: Peasant Royale
description: Meet the first standalone medieval battle royale game! Take part in battles with up to 50 players using a wide variety of weapons and other items.

title: Emi: Christmas Special
description: Emi and our Protagonist find themselves on the naughty list this year! Follow their holiday escapades as they earn their way back into Santa's good graces.

title: Lunar's Chosen: Episode 2
description: Lunar's chosen introduced a world of magic, danger, romance and sex. With a whole host of changes and improvements, animations and HD renders, the story continues in Lunar's Chosen Episode 2!

title: Kittenbay Cats - A Hidden Object Game
description: Explore '"Kittenbay Cats - A Hidden Object Game', where elusive felines await discovery in a day-and-night adventure. Find hidden cats, interact with locals, and unveil the charming secrets of Kittenbay!

title: Little Chefs: Co-op
description: Call up your friends and dive into the world of culinary madness where you get to be Little Chefs! Cook dishes, customize and improve your kitchen with the building system, upgrade your character, complete missions and remember: nothing without teamwork, speed and a pinch of madness!

title: Champion of Venus: Tayla's Big Adventure
description: Join Tayla on her biggest, bustiest adventure so far! Unravel a conspiracy of gods and monsters, square off with the most lustful Champions in existence, and uncover the stadium's mysteries!Like, totally!

title: Twizzle Puzzle: Cats
description: Twizzle Puzzle: Cats - is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime.

title: Yoko
description: Yoko offers a terrifying first-person psychological horror experience. Unravel the sinister mysteries of Saikominami, where spirits impede your exploration, immersing yourself in an immersive journey filled with suspense and horror.

title: Cat Palette: Merging Colorful Kittens
description: In this 2D puzzle game you have to mix different colored cats together. "Cat Palette: Merging Colorful Kittens" has 150 handcrafted levels with tons of different and unique fluffy friends!

title: Whispering Paws
description: Embark on a poignant journey with Whispering Paws, a 3D adventure where you guide a determined fox to reunite its family. Explore enchanting landscapes, solve puzzles, and immerse yourself in a heartfelt narrative. Discover the magic within nature's embrace.

title: Pru the Pigeon
description: Pru the Pigeon is a bite-sized 3D platformer with precise and expressive controls. Join Pru on adventures through charming levels, collecting various items for a nostalgic, fun-filled experience!

title: Nafanya the Poltergeist
description: A game about a house spirit - Houseboy. With the name Nafanya. The player will have to get out of a multi-unit Soviet house, which is run by the Domovoi. To find the way out, you will have to solve riddles from the spirit, and maybe even make friends with him.

title: Buried Shards
description: Get Inmersed in the intriguing narrative adventure of Buried Shards, progressing through the story chapters while alternating between day and night. Guide your sleepwalking self with house lights during the night and confront the traumas of your past in this unique blend of storytelling and puzzles.

title: Chasm Crawl
description: Chasm Crawl is a first person action adventure game, filled with dangerous dungeons and even strange monsters. A mist in The Land of Monsters has turned its inhabitants into hostile creatures that will attack on-site. Level up and maintain resources to discover what lies in The Chasm.

title: Bear It
description: Can you handle this un-bear-able fast-paced FPS? Bear It is a highly replayable roguelite parkour movement shooter for agile players. Use parkour on the environment and even on your enemies to traverse the Ark’s platforms quickly and efficiently. Be prepared for the unexpected!

title: Celestial Return
description: Celestial Return is a story-driven RPG where dice are your bullets, your bribes, and your last breath. Loot, gamble, and survive a reality-crumbling city. Uncover cosmic horrors, outwit corrupted megacorps, and pray your next roll isn't your last.

title: Walpurgis Raid
description: Prepare yourself for Roguelite bullet-hell battles! Dive into a magic world to sets out on the royal battle. Upgrade your witch and transform into an unstoppable force, obliterating enemies in epic combat showdowns. Brace yourself for a survival match like no other!

title: Skyline Sprint: Turbo Tracks
description: Race through the skies, master aerial stunts, and unlock cars in Skyline Sprint: Turbo Tracks. Collect stars, conquer levels, and enhance immersion with optional Perspectacles head tracking glasses. Become the champion of high-speed, airborne racing! Pick a car and give it a Go!

title: Jrago II: Guardians of Eden
description: Jrago II Guardians of Eden is a Multiplayer Co-Op METROIDVANIA style 2D Platforming Action-Adventure Role Playing Game. The darkness has once again returned, and this time Jrago teams up with his fellow guardians as they slay the evil demons and bring back the light!

title: Deadville
description: In Deadville, players must face their deepest fears, rely on their survival instincts, and make tough decisions to outlast the apocalypse. Only the most resourceful, cunning, and resilient survivors stand a chance against the relentless zombie horde.

title: Kinstrife
description: Medieval RPG with revolutionary physics-based combat & strategic campaign. Become a wandering knight in a quest for fortune & glory, as you fight in duels, battles & tournaments. Build your wealth, equipment & following - and carve out your destiny in a realm of warring great houses and petty lords.

title: Dandelion Planet
description: A heartwarming atmosphere,SF novel adventure game. Let's relax on another planet! You enjoy going to different places, interacting with space people, and trying part-time jobs.

title: Fire Guardian
description: A platform adventure game. Explore various scenarios, lute against mercenaries, drones. Feed the animals.

title: Crying Alone
description: Dive into 'Crying Alone', a 20-minute narrative-driven game that reflects my personal journey through heartbreak and healing. Experience the raw emotions of loss, the struggle for acceptance, and the first steps towards recovery in this poignant story.

title: Idle Plant Game
description: Idle Plant Game, an idle and offline progress or clicker plant simulation!

title: Miss Neko: Pirates
description: Pirates ahead! The pirate girls on Skull Island have yet to witness the true extent of your prowess, Captain. Can you conquer them one by one with your skills and plunder that precious treasure onto your ship?

title: Hide or Sex
description: “Hide or Sex” In our new game, you must be ready to survive the love that your adventure companions want to give you. With awesome 2D animation, this is a must play!

title: Apex Rush
description: Race, Drift & Stunt in this physics-based arcade racing game! Build and share your own tracks with the world and top the leaderboards!

title: SnowRunner: Kenworth W990
description: Expand your SnowRunner garage with the 2023 Kenworth W990! This Heavy-class truck brings superior on-road capabilities thanks to its retractable axle and superior fuel capacity. The Kenworth W990 is not included in the Year 1, Year 2 or Year 3 Pass.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - Dynamite featuring The Acclaimed
description: The boldest Tag Team in AEW history, Anthony Bowens and Max Caster of The Acclaimed, PLUS the brand new Dynamite themed arena kick off AEW: Fight Forever's Season 2 DLC series.

title: Asteroid Core
description: You are isolated on a small meteor and need to build a fire to escape before being destroyed by aliens. Use your limited space to create machines and obtain more and more resources. Enjoy this mix of puzzles, tower defense and incremental gameplay.

title: Forza Motorsport 2019: McLaren #03 720S GT3
description: Forza Motorsport 2019 McLaren #03 720S GT3

title: 52Hertz
description: An eternally snowbound town. An inescapable time loop. A group of travelers trapped between memory and truth…You will embody Mo Shi, the amnesiac protagonist, stepping into this enigmatic town known as the "Singularity" , partner with the protagonist to solve murder cases and expose the killer.

title: Naiko's Room
description:
"The handless clock may shatter, but it will never stop ticking."

Naiko's Room is an RPG Maker psychological horror game about a monotonous life, a priceless purpose and an old, rotten friendship. A guiding light for the abandoned, a Room where the past, present and future will collide until The End of all.

Follow an introverted girl who ends up in a room with no door, as she does her daily routine. Read books, experience nightmares and find flower scented memories in a journey to gather the will to get out.

But remember, there's someone out there waiting for you outside...

title: Quaternion
description: Quaternion is a total-conversion modification of the game Marble Blast Gold, which is a ball-rolling platform game released in 2003. Quaternion puts a new spin on the game, adding a central hub level and more puzzle-oriented gameplay, as well as modernized graphics and physics.

title: Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition
description:
Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition is an open-world RPG containing two powerful adventures: the base game of Cyberpunk 2077, taking place in the dark future of Night City, and Phantom Liberty, a spy-thriller story set in the walled-off district of Dogtown. Players take on the role of V, a cyber-enhanced mercenary, and embark on a fight for survival filled with story-defining decisions, action-packed gameplay, and unforgettable characters, including rockerboy Johnny Silverhand (played by Keanu Reeves) and FIA sleeper agent Solomon Reed (played by Idris Elba).

This new release is the perfect way to experience every story of the dark future; it also contains the free Update 2.0, which overhauled many of the game’s systems, introducing dynamic skill trees, high-octane vehicle combat, and enhanced enemy and police AI — as well as adding new weapons, vehicles, and clothes. The release is bolstered with a set of previously released digital goodies available as part of the “My Rewards” program, available to all who register.

title: Stray Shot
description: Monsters come from missed shots! Learn the monster's behaviours, shoot wisely and balance the difficulty to maximize scoring!

title: Counter-Strike 1 Anthology
description:
The original version of the #1 online action game in the world offers an action experience of incredible depth and realism. This Anthology also includes a collection of single player CS games and the official CS bot for skirmish play.

Includes: Counter-Strike, Counter-Strike: Condition Zero, Day of Defeat, Deathmatch Classic, Ricochet

title: Sisyphus Paradox
description: Sisyphus Paradox is a fusion of roguelike tactical elements with classic side-scrolling shoot 'em up gameplay. Explore and fight your way across the galaxy as you try to get back home to Earth in this hand drawn indie game.

title: Grandfather Simulator
description: Open the door to Grandfather's life! Watch TV series, play with the dog, argue with your wife, take pills, eat lunch, sleep, go for a walk. Live the measured life of a grandfather, where every day is an adventure, and routine is an art!

title: Neon River
description: Long distances into future there is nothing left to have but one thing: fun. Endless battles in endlessly generated worlds is the only thing you will find in this arcade-inspired rouguelike action bullet hell. Fight your way through, live as much as you can or just have fun, die and restart.

title: Your Shots Count
description: Defeat monsters, protect your village and practice your math skills in Your Shots Count. There's strength in numbers, and you defeat the three different types of enemies by shooting at the correct answer to the math expression above them.

title: My Time at Sandrock: Summer Heat Collection 1
description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

title: My Time at Sandrock: Summer Heat Collection 2
description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

title: My Time at Sandrock: Summer Heat Collection 3
description: Travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin!

title: My Time at Sandrock: Starlight Collection 3
description: A starlight costume collection with outfits for Nia, Unsuur, Amirah, and Owen in 4 colors for each character. Each outfit contains a hat, top, bottoms, shoes, and 3 additional accessories.

title: My Time at Sandrock: Starlight Collection 2
description: A starlight costume collection with outfits for Fang, Catori, Ernest, and Mi-an in 4 colors for each character. Each outfit contains a hat, top, bottoms, shoes, and 3 additional accessories.

title: My Time at Sandrock: Starlight Collection 1
description: A starlight costume collection with outfits for Logan, Grace, Elsie, and Qi in 4 colors for each character. Each outfit contains a hat, top, bottoms, shoes, and 3 additional accessories.

title: The Witches Pond
description: The Witches Pond is a horror-adventure game based on the real-life place with the same name. Enter a world of mystery and strange places where you will experience events that may or may not seem real.

title: Surviving with a Bat
description: Surviving with a Bat is an open world game with endless waves of zombies. Your only weapon is a baseball bat.

title: Hrumka
description: A rogue-like battler on a match-3 board. Match gems to attack enemies, avoid damage and gather collectibles. Use your level-up upgrades to become stronger and try different play styles. Be careful though - enemies can also level up!

title: Hidden World 10 Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Hidden Western Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: Five Nights at Backrooms: Waifu Edition
description: Welcome to Backrooms, to a previously unknown level. The Backrooms are inhabited by special entities that look cute, but when you get close to them, they'll do anything to kill you. Their peculiarity is that they move only at night. Yes, on this level Backrooms has a day and night shift.

title: Ultra Nothing
description: Abstract rule-breaking 2D puzzle platformer with turn-based strategy elements and distinctly erratic pixel graphics.

title: Send It: The Game
description: An Action meets Puzzle meets Milsim game. You aim the mortar, you shoot the mortar. You follow the mortar to its target, and use various upgrades to do so, including Plummeting shot, Precision Shot, Glide bombs, autocannons, cluster bombs, and more! Did you miss? Adjust the angle!

title: Happy Color Links
description: An adorable sokoban puzzle game , where you push blocks from the same color to link them together and make them happy.

title: Elven Dreams
description: Welcome to this elven-infused world, where you'll be free to capture the elves you want, control them into battle, level them up and evolve, and finally fuse into that unique "strongest elven"!

title: HunterX: Code Name T
description: HunterX: Code Name T is an action adventure with fast and stylish combat. Perfect your own fighting style using various weapon actions and magic, and explore an ever-greater world.

title: Simulator Z
description: A world where you can create your own zombie apocalypse to your liking!

title: Cats Huddled Together
description: There are many cats here, come and take a look!

title: Sensual Adventures: Episode 9
description: Trinity meets Alexandra for the first time!

title: EVE Vanguard
description: EVE Vanguard is an upcoming sci-fi sandbox FPS where every deployment onto a hostile planet is high stakes. You fight, scavenge, and adapt in brutal warzones - and every choice leaves its mark on a player-driven universe at war.

title: Ant Farm Simulator
description: Ant farm (formicarium) with a colony of ants. Ants have artificial intelligence that mimics the full life cycle, behavior, nature and physics of real insects.

title: Corvid's Night
description:
