Rumina the Bloodwolf has retired from her days as a notorious mercenary to live a peaceful life with her wife, a former nun named Ophelia. That is, until she finds Ophelia missing, with only a note bearing the crest of House Corvid...

Corvid's Night is a survival horror dungeon crawler, with an art style and gameplay inspired by classics in the genre from the fifth console generation. Manage Rumina's vitality and the oil in her lamp, as you explore and fight grotesque monsters to uncover the mystery of Castle Corvid.

title: Echoes of Steel
description: A first-person horror game where you’ll perform rituals, evade deadly animatronics, and explore a decaying factory. Outsmart the relentless machines and escape if you can.

title: Airborne Arena
description: Airborne Arena is a shooter-racing game set in 2058's Rider City. Enter an action-packed new reality filled with deadly hoverbike races, as you take the role of "The Prodigy" and infiltrate the different Viker gangs in the story mode or challenge your friends to online races and deathmatch arenas.

title: Diesel Burners
description: Diesel Burners is a fast-paced aerial shooter. Destroy hordes of enemies while collecting resources and power-ups. Buy, upgrade, and customize your character and planes; and put your skills to the test facing bosses in a variety of single-player and multiplayer modes!

title: SCP-087-B UE Remake
description: SCP-087-B UE Remake is a free single-player horror experience which seeks to recreate many aspects of the 2012 game SCP-087-B made by Joonas Rikkonen while keeping the charm and feel of the original.

title: Domenation
description: Survive the Pulse in Domenation's futuristic post-apocalyptic Bubble Royale. In this round-based multiplayer shooter, scavenge for gear and outlast rivals to become the ultimate survivor.

title: Mafia Thief
description: Mafia Thief is a third-person stealth game. Break in 6 unique missions into houses, mansions, a warehouse or a junkyard to steal more than 100 different items. Complete the missions and follow the exciting story. Avoid security guards, residents and the police. Get ready for the hardest thief experience of the year!

title: GTA Turk City
description: GTA Turk City (also known as GTA Türk) is a mod of GTA Vice City

title: Seraph: In the Darkness
description: Seraph: In the Darkness is a classic dark fantasy. It's an action role-playing game (ARPG) with hack-and-slash combat mechanics, allowing for item customization tailored to your playstyle. Experience new thrills in the world of SERAPH, where aesthetics of darkness and fear combine

title: Mydhia Online
description:
Welcome to the world of Mydhia Online, an MMORPG that brings back the nostalgia of the golden era of RPGs, inspired by classics like Final Fantasy and Chrono Trigger. With 16-bit pixelated graphics, the game captures the same retro vibe as hits like Stardew Valley.

Get ready for real-time combat against hundreds of enemies in a complex and engaging storyline. But remember, Mydhia Online isn't just about solo adventures. Socialization is the key to success in this game, with party, guild, and EXP-sharing systems among friends.

So, join us, Wanderer, and dive yourself into the vast universe of Mydhia.

title: Chico and the Magic Orchards DX
description: Solve puzzles by rolling a giant walnut in this retro-handheld-inspired adventure. Explore a variety of levels each with unique mechanics. Help Chico build his winter stash and get home!

title: Metro Quester
description:
Metro Quester is a dungeon exploration RPG based in a post-apocalyptic futuristic world created by the manga artist Kazushi Hagiwara, with a deep game system desgined by Hironori Kato that offers the excitement and surprises reminiscent of 1980s computer games through hack and slash.

Featuring 24 characters and 8 classes, enjoyable combo skills, numerous customizable weapons, a bestiary, and features like NEW GAME+ for replayability, it offers plenty of depth for dedicated gamers.

title: Golf Guys
description: Face off against a dozen opponents in an ultimate golf battle royale, or invite friends to play in multiplayer mode for up to 4 players!

title: Helix Jump: Letter Madness
description: Compete in the new multiplayer gameplay mode! Be the first to collect all the letters of the drawn word and become the winner!

title: Helix Jump: Party Skins
description: Change the look of your bouncing ball with brand new and unique skins!

title: Mob Control: Triple Backup
description: Grow your card collection in the armory with Soldier mobs, Triple cannon and a new Mass Abduction ultimate!

title: Mob Control: Champions
description: Grow your card collection in the armory with Knight mobs, Explodon champions and a new Rocket Barrage ultimate!

title: Golf Guys: Space
description: Dress up your golfer as a Astronaut or an Alien and try out a new toy hammer bat!

title: Golf Guys: Party
description: Dress up your golfer as a Hot Dog or a Punk boy and try out a new electric guitar bat!

title: Golf Guys: Fantasy
description: Dress up your golfer as a Knight or a Magic boy and try out a new sword bat!

title: Hell Galaxy
description: Hell Galaxy is the only game where you can experience the fusion of space battles, eerie specters, and daunting titans. This unique gameplay offers a mix of action, horror, and space exploration. Engage in dynamic mining, looting, and crafting while traversing an RPG-influenced cosmos.

title: Pixelment TD
description: Pixelment TD is an Element based Tower Defense game, You are facing a new tower defense game with unique graphic experience.

title: Contract Sudoku
description: Sudoku is a popular puzzle game around the world, in order to let more people like Sudoku, we developed this game. I believe it can accompany you for a long time.

title: Endless Glory
description: Lead your army to endless glory

title: Hentai: Nude Quest
description: Embark on an enchanting journey through the mystical realms of Hentai Nude Quest, a unique and visually captivating walking simulator that combines the allure of anime aesthetics with the tranquility of a lush forest.

title: Mortadelo y Filemón: Dos Vaqueros Chapuceros
description: Mort & Phil travel to the Wild West in this new adventure, thanks to Dr. Bacterio (naturally!).

title: Major Minor 2.0: (Re)Vision
description: Become intertwined in the fateful connection plaguing two worlds, bound together by a murder mystery, and a competition for the throne of a god. The award-winning visual novel, completely revamped! New script, new choices, and romance! Become The Savior today, and choose wisely...

title: Mortadelo y Filemón: Terror, Espanto y Pavor
description: Mort and Phil travel to the world of horror cinema in this adventure, thanks to Dr. Bacterio (of course!).

title: Paco El Hare vs Los Marcianos Siderales
description: A brief piece of history about Spanish software and video games.

title: KnifePlayground: Horror Battle Royale
description: Multiplayer Survival Horror: 4 Players Co-op or Solo Battle Royale. Players have to cooperate or kill each other in a 3 floors mansion full of monsters which every floor closes after a deadly countdown. Shoot, stab, hide, upgrade and get stronger after every death by unpredictable Roguelite elements

title: Mortadelo y Filemón: La Sexta Secta
description: Extended version of the merging of 'Operación Moscú' and 'El Escarabajo de Cleopatra,' with additional and alternative content.

title: Bug Riders
description: Leptus is dying, and the tournament is on to succeed him as the Emperor of Entymion. Enter the hi-resolution huve of insane insect racing and fly the unfriendly skies!

title: Super Dr Corona
description: Super Dr. Corona is a Super take on classic 3 match games with a familiar theme.

title: Supreme Ruler The Great War Remastered DLC
description: Real-Time Strategy/Wargame. BattleGoat Studios invites you to travel back to 1914 and select from more than 50 playable regions at the onset of World War I, as European powers struggle to survive and new technologies transform warfare.

title: Cute Cats Slide
description: I love cats, you love cats, who doesn't love cats. Have fun with this classic slide puzzle with lots of cute cats.

title: Supreme Ruler The Great War Remastered
description: Real-Time Strategy/Wargame. BattleGoat Studios invites you to travel back to 1914 and select from more than 50 playable regions at the onset of World War I, as European powers struggle to survive and new technologies transform warfare.

title: I Bring The Chaos
description: Embark on a relentless bullet heaven in I Bring The Chaos. Vanquish foes, level up and dial up the challenge to earn hefty EXP bonuses and coin rewards. Explore 3 unique worlds, delve into deep strategy and master your firepower. Become the ultimate harbinger of chaos!

title: Allogloom
description: Chaos has descended upon the town of Gruesome Grove and its fate rests in Nora’s hands. Join her on an oftentimes gory journey through a beautifully hand-drawn world. Discover forgotten truths, make peculiar friends, encounter monsters and solve puzzles in this mysterious and macabre adventure.

title: Problemlöser
description: Take control of the new IT trainee in this 2D action game and avoid collisions with the IT professionals. Debug scripts to find bugs to squeeze. More administrators are waiting for you in each level. Remember, your time is limited! If that sounds too easy, try 8 different difficulty levels.

title: TaxingTiles
description: Shape your realm. Conquer chaos. Unveil mysteries. Deck-building roguelike fun!

title: Rogue Knight
description: Experience fast-paced rogue-lite gameplay. Explore ever-changing locations and fight vicious enemies in souls-inspired 2d combat. Every run you will find variety of items and spells to compliment your playstyle, as well as resources to upgrade your town for future runs.

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Warships DLC
description: Get ready for an unforgettable adventure in the world of ship demolition with Ship Graveyard Simulator 2: Warships DLC! Discover epic new warships, earn unique loot, hone your demolition skills, and become a legend in the demolition of warships.

title: Speak of the Devil I: A Deathly Proposition
description: Experience the impact of making a pact with a demon in this linear visual novel, where the consequences can be life-changing in an instant. Michi, the main character, has the chance to pursue a romantic relationship with any of the female characters, including the demon he made a deal with.

title: 36 Nights
description: 36 Nights is a tower defense game with roguelike and bullet heaven elements. Buy turrets and upgrade your survivor to defend against waves of zombies. You'll need careful strategy and a little luck if you want to survive 36 nights...

title: Cosmic Carnage: Prologue
description: Prepare for an interstellar showdown like no other in a gripping roguelike top-down twin-stick shooter set in the vast depths of space. Pilot your advanced starship, engaging in relentless battles against hordes of alien adversaries. Destroy, Collect, Upgrade, Die, Unlock, Repeat.

title: Exp10sion
description: Dive into a whimsical journey with various levels in the cycle of explosions and rebirth. "Exp10sion", a pixel-style 2D platformer born in Ludum Dare 51, will tickle your puzzle-solving fancy!

title: Scourge of the Village
description: "Scourge Of The Village"is a Chinese folklore horror-themed text decryption game. An ordinary intern reporter, Chen Xi, is investigating a news event about factory sewage discharge, but she somehow fell into the torment of nightmares.

title: Veronikka's To-Do
description:
You cannot go back, there is no way to ignore it, no matter how difficult and gross it is…. If it is written in the To-Do, it must be done. Because that's why you created the list, to do your daily chores, such as watering the plants or going to pay your debts!

Interact with the inhabitants of "That Place", live a day in the life of a 16-year-old girl while she completes her chores, has fun with her friends and goes to the mall!

You can just do the chores and rest, or meanwhile discover what is Esther hiding in her basement!

title: Rocket Frog
description: In this challenging precision platformer, a bubble gum chewing frog bites off a bit more difficulty than he bargained for.

title: 3D Watermelon Game
description: Match fruit and get the high-score in this 3D Watermelon matching game! Try out 3 unqiue game modes and make your PERFECT smoothie!

title: Tsuki no Namida
description:
Winner of the Enterbrain Contest Park Web 2007 Autumn Edition Gold Prize.

Set in a world of silver, the protagonist, the kind-hearted prince "Kate," embarks on a journey from the castle to uncover the secrets of his birth. Rather than traditional RPG level-ups, character enhancement is achieved through equipment called "Talismans," into which gemstones are fitted.

In addition to the fire magic initially learned by the protagonist, it's possible to learn up to four different magics. Magic can be utilized not only in battles but also in locations marked with a "?" in towns and dungeons.

The game offers replay value with features such as Talisman crafting, combining magic to create higher-level spells, defeating monsters for "Monster Information," and striving to complete it. The graphics and characters exude a warm and gentle atmosphere, creating an emotionally impactful experience, despite lacking flashy and innovative elements.

title: Thunderbolts and Lightning!
description: Thematically open to interpretation, the jam had just one rule: maps must include a Thunderbolt (aka Lightning Gun)! This speedmapping event also includes some new mini powerups! A mini-pentagram, mini-quad-damage, and mini-bio-suit, each of which last only 8 seconds!

title: Ontranto
description: Five map episode set in a medieval fantasy world, with many custom textures, a few new monsters and some other QC: starting in a dark swamp, the player has to travel through caverns and temples to a ship bringing him to the town of Ontranto, where he is to battle the Duke.

title: Swamp & Towne
description: A medium sized, dark and hostile swamp, and a large medieval town with a few custom textures. The second map centers on the cult of Koth.

title: Cute Ice!
description: Cute Ice! is a single map for Doom 2 that features a frigid, icy landscape which utilizes Jumpwad's textures. It is kinda slaughter-ish but is balanced for all difficulties for every player to appreciate the map, Ultra-Violence as always is the difficulty for players who seek a bigger challenge in this map.

title: NTR Dream
description: A steamy story about an affair going too far.

title: Qi Shen Nong Gui
description: Deception is a female-oriented pixel rpg game set in a hollow female background. In the game, you will play the role of Zhen Wu Si's Tie Rider to move freely in the Jianghu and the imperial court. The sea of bureaucracy is full of changes. The fate of the world is yours to decide.

title: Akai Onna
description: Akai Onna is a psychological J-horror game featuring a student.

title: Home Domes
description: Explore this life sim on a new planet. Create your new home on the rugged surface of Mars during the early days of colonization inside the safety of your new Dome. Everyday life on a new planet has new challenges and more difficulties of surviving out on the Domestead.

title: Case Guardians
description: Case Guardians, a thrilling multiplayer co-op experience that puts you in the heart of the action! In this fast-paced game, you and your friends embark on an exciting mission to protect a precious briefcase from waves of enemies cleverly crafted from everyday items!

title: Extreme Custom Night
description: You have finished your job of a night-guard last week, and now you have nightmares of your own. The memories are still awake in your head, and to stop the terror, you must survive against all of them!

title: Xtract
description:
Embark on a treasure hunt in the Xtract shooter full of puzzles, PvE as well as PvP missions, treasure hunting, and much more!

The lost civilization has left rare artifacts and untold treasures on a mysterious island. Find them, outsmart your rivals and get all the loot!

Assemble your team, fight enemies and other adventurers! Get new weapons and supplies, customize equipment and use all the capabilities of modern technology and the power of mystical artifacts!

title: Honey Magician
description: Have you ever been attracted to a sexy, mysterious beauty magician? This game will let you enjoy and participate in the beautiful magician's performance.

title: Guàishòu
description: Survive a derelict city overgrown by jungle and filled with grotesques mutants lurking in the dark. Use your lighting gun to see it through.

title: Barbarians & Beasts
description: Choose your barbarian character to hack and slash many beasts. Swords and magic will fight alongside you against the beasts to free the kingdom.

title: Master Manager
description: You are the manager of a football club, determine its future by making the best decisions regarding tactics, training, player contracts, sponsorship deals and infrastructure. Watch your players performing on our amazing 2d match engine.

title: Dodo
description: Dodo is a tricky puzzle game where you have to enter the correct word to get to the next level. The letters you enter will change the grid on the screen - and you must get that grid to match the symbols!

title: Quizz
description: Call your friend and start engaging in a simple and cozy experience while discovering all the questions that wait for you. Quizz is a game for everyone, having multiple question domains I am sure that some will fit you. Test your knowledge and luck to be the number one in the lobby.

title: Weapon Party
description: Weapon Party is a game that combines traditional Battle Royale with RPG, MOBA. Inspired by Vietnam.

title: Daldzah
description: Daldzah is an adventure inspired by the Nart Sagas, following the journey of a child and a deceased deity to the top of a mountain. Warm your surroundings, burn obstacles in your path, and help the North Caucasian deities on your way to reunite child with his parents.

title: Behind the Beyond: Ulti
description: A card game of wit and strategy. Can you defeat the best players and become the ULTImate Champion in the Kingdom Behind the Beyond?

title: A Void Shaper
description: Shape the void with the power of your cursor! A Void Shaper is an arcade game about avoiding shapes and killing them, while you collect upgrades. Unlock new enemy shapes and upgrades as you progress through the game and complete your collection.

title: One Fine Tourney
description: One Fine Tourney is a casual, single-player archery-puzzle game with over 40 handcrafted target challenges. Join 5 unique protagonists as they compete their way through a wild, unpredictable, medieval-style world and encounter everything from mythical creatures to chill concerts in the woods.

title: Mothman
description: A 1-4 player CO-OP horror game, a nightmare from hell, it is your objective to hunt down a sinister demon known as Mothman. Underequipped you must search the landscape for resources. Lay bear traps, stalk from a distance, and stay quiet. You came to hunt, only to be hunted.

title: Outlands
description: Build, Upgrade, Reset, Repeat

title: MundusHex
description: MundusHex is a 3D logic adventure game, transporting players into a world filled with puzzles and mysteries. Explore, combine items, and converse with characters to unravel a captivating story.

title: Lanternia
description: Lanternia is a survival RTS with roguelite and deckbuilding elements. Build, defend, and expand the village in a dark wood, illuminated only with lanterns.

title: Hungry Jungle
description: A 2D survival adventure game. You come to the jungle alone, collect water and real objects, make survival tools to survive, face various beasts, and resist various harsh weather.

title: Zomcats Invasion
description: Zomcats Invasion, completely remade with better graphics, animations and smoother gameplay! Play with up to 10 friends online and fight endless hordes of Zomcats! Choose between a variety of maps, difficulties and weapons. Unlock abilities and find cosmetics that fit your style!

title: Soul Warden
description: Soul Warden is a deep dungeon-crawling RPG that combines classic roguelike gameplay with a pinch of collect-a-thon progression, plenty of humor, tons of loot, and a build-your-own-dungeon sandbox!

title: Lisa Total Investigation!
description: Lisa Total Investigation is an adult game about corruption. Play as the future husband of Lisa, who was forced into an investigation by a mysterious Scotland Yard officer. How far will you push your fiancée to successfully complete this investigation? Beware of your most perverse desire!

title: Futanari College: Episode 1
description: Futanari College is an adult Visual Novel in witch you take control of an 20 year old guy whose life is turned up side down when he went to college where only futa-girls study. Will he be fun for the girls or will he find true love?

title: Hands of Timber
description: Hands of Timber portrays the journey of a little wooden doll that wakes up inside the mind of its creator. To find her father, she must wander through his memories... the good, the bad, and the incomplete ones...

title: Model Human
description: Dive into Model Human, where platforming meets programming. Solve puzzles, learn coding basics, and guide protagonists to freedom in a visually striking world. Are you ready for this innovative gaming experience?

title: True Reporter: Mystery of Mistwood
description: A free detective "Hidden object" game. Solve the crime now!

title: Warship
description: This game takes players on an adventure soaring through a stormy sky.

title: Astral Druids
description: Be ready to protect the astral plane and survive the relentless monsters lust! Using the druids powers you'll be able to defeat every oponent, or make them kneel for you. Do you have what it takes to conquer them?

title: Circus of TimTim
description: Circus of TimTim is a Stealth Horror Survival Game about two siblings trying to sneak inside the most hunted carnival of all time to recover lost items with a metal detector device, however enemies are roaming around and they can hear your every step! TimTim is not happy ..

title: Lofty Form
description: Yakushiji Shion is the eldest son from the clan that punishes bad people. But after he assassinated Empire's shadow Kurobe Akiyoushi, it is regarded as a rebellion against the Empire. He gathers the clan and moves towards the North. Every day they are attacked by pursuers. At the same time he is chased by the girl Hiramatsu Yae who fell in love with Shion.

title: Lag
description: Our guy's father want him to find a girlfriend within 3 years. To start him off, his father build a new school and fill it with strong people, plus sealing off his fighting skills so he has to start new. Since our guy has been training all his life, he doesn't show much emotion. Can you help him get one of 4 girls within 3 years?

title: Dreamhaven
description: Unlock the doors to your wildest dreams with Dreamhaven! Designed by an extraordinary team of junior developers aged 8-14, players will travel, through the imaginations and dreams of the next generation. Interact with AI power npc's that can create open ended conversations.

title: Anxious: Yuukyuu no Memory
description: Near future. Technology advances have allowed to create a perfect artificial lover indistinguishable from real women. Main character gets a job to test four such robots every day. He understands those are robots, but can't help having feelings for them.

title: Ko Ko Ro...
description: Kuonji Souji seems to have it all going for him. He is handsome, popular and excels at his club activities. His past is another thing altogether -- as a boy, he was raped repeatedly by his foster parents. The years have passed, and he has tried to forget by repressing those memories. They are still there, though, and come to him as hallucinations. Who is the raven-haired beauty he keeps seeing in those visions? Does she hold the key to unlock his past?

title: Rolus in the Outskirts
description:
Funny, fresh, and full of heart: A story of one unlucky cyclops, the grimy town he lives in, and the miracle bestowed upon it!
Rolus in the Outskirts is an action-adventure that blends the gameplay of The Legend of Zelda, the humor of South Park and the heart of dead-end America. Meet endearing characters as you explore the ramshackle world of The Outskirts, risking it all in pursuit of a dollar-menu cheeseburger.

title: History of Meme Essence
description: Hardcore platformer, challenging gameplay. The game tells the story of the Meme Essence, which was awakened after Bebe the Ram seized power in the kingdom.

title: Elite of Conquerors
description: An independent MMORPG, created by the company "EC Games Studio," Elite of Conquerors is a multiplayer adventure game set in a fantastical world.

title: Mesimes PT
description:
You go down an elevator to explore an abandoned underground research station. But something is wrong with those robots in there. Can you survive the horror that awaits you down there?

Mesimes PT is a horror survival game with original characters, location and story developed in the Blender Game Engine.

As main features, you can operate EMP turrets in the cameras. In addition, the game has detailed animations and a PS1 graphics style.

This is a passion project that has been in development for 2 years.

title: Pro Evolution Soccer 6: The Den Patch
description: A patch for the football videogame Pro Evolution Soccer 6, made by the Argentinian group The Den.

title: Hello Neighbor Prototype
description: Fan Build and Playable Version of Hello Neighbor Prototype

title: Betterified VI: Bestified
description: The sequel to Betterified V and the final game in the Betterified series. Sin Man assembles a team of four villains in an attempt to take down Mario or Toad.

title: SKD
description: Challenging action-adventure with stylish characters and sick combat (soulslike inspired) in a furry anime world.

title: Detective Instinct: Farewell, My Beloved
description: A woman vanishes without a trace on a cross-country train. The catch? Nobody on board remembers her ever existing in the first place - nobody, except for you. Uncover the story in this detective ADV/visual novel!

title: Macro-TV
description: "MACRO-TV" is a 1996 Japanese sci-fi point-and-click game developed by the three-person studio MACRO-ARTS. Armed with the "MACRO-TV" system, players investigate the activities of hacker David Browith. Utilizing built-in CCD cameras and an ultra high-speed network, players navigate the dangers of cyberspace, unraveling the mysteries behind Browith's intrusion and his peculiar world.

title: Loe: Legend of Enomoto
description:
The protagonist received an invitation to enter a contest to win a very rich man's inheritance. The contest consist of quizs and games. Other contestants will compete with him. He can either do it alone or with someone's help.

This game consists many different kinds of puzzles like Japanese phase puzzle, math puzzle, room escape puzzle, finding item puzzle, etc.

The player must solve all puzzles correctly in order to progress the story. For example, if you fail the first entry level word puzzle, you will immediately reach the bad end.

title: Koutei Heika ni Narou!
description: While our king was visiting his dying teacher, he found and released a girl sealed in a tree. It seems his teacher had sealed her because she came from the underworld. What he released was just her spirit. To get her body back, he has to find medals that his teacher gave to other kings. Well, he has four commanders to help him do that. He can also get some princesses too, if he want to.

title: Pokémon: Too Many Types
description: Pokémon Too Many Types is a rom hack of Pokémon Emerald that was originally created for content creator Alpharad. This hack adds multiple new types into the game bringing the total to 62 types as well as 118 new moves. Preexisting moves and Pokémon have their types altered to accommodate for the additional types and also allows Pokémon to have three types (at most) at a time instead of two.

title: Head Trauma
description: Head Trauma is a 6-level map miniwad (5 + ending) in Doom 2 - Boom format.These are somewhat cramped and slightly hard, each one loosely inspired by one of the five senses, with some homages to classic megawads like The Plutonia Experiment, TNT, and Going Down.

title: Summer Heat
description:
Summer Heat is a romantic visual novel with heavy emphasis on choices. Some choices affect dialogue, while others impact the story in major ways. There are five main girls for you to romance, each with her own story branch, and even more side girls if you only want a casual fling.

The game has a smartphone. In future updates, we plan to fully flesh out the apps and make them really fun and exciting to use! The dating app Ember will be an especially big part of it, with Influencer-tier patrons being able to vote on decisions regarding Ember's content.

Other features we plan to include in the game are animation and an interactive photography system.

title: Zakesta-Z
description: Zakesta-Z is the newest version of the shoot 'em up that challenges players to blast their way through a total of five stages, with a main shot that can be powered up 5 levels and an array of sub-weapons that can be powered up 3 levels. The game also includes a stage select feature that allows players to practice previously-cleared stages with infinite lives, as well as a sound test that unlocks upon clearing the game.

title: Zooplop
description:
Zooplop is a physics-based puzzle game where you drop animals from a mechanical claw. When two animals of the same kind touch they merge into bigger ones!

Plan your moves carefully and avoid dropping too many animals at once, or you might run out of space. The game goes on forever or until all animals fill up the screen. Zooplop is easy to play but hard to master. How big can you go? Can you reach the whale? Can you merge the whale?!

title: Plane Starship: Galactic Frontline
description: This is a roguelike game which is minimalist (crossed it out) which has no money for art. The player needs to play as a fleet commander, commanding the fleet to travel to a galaxy bathed in war, purifying the dangerous enemies entrenched in it, and saving your people from fire and water.

title: Zanzibart
description: You are Myrmidon of Loss. Because of your foolishness, your beloved master, Zanzibart, has been killed. Go forth and slaughter enemies and accumulate iterms to avenge Zanzibart.

title: The Iceman
description: The Iceman is an exciting and thrilling game that puts you in the shoes of a character who loves the cold and will stop at nothing to reach the fridge.

title: The Last 66 Days
description: I'm Anna, met Qiqing in a video game, he bright light in my once dark world. But in 66 days, he'll be gone, every day precious. You, my friend, the only one can help me. Please review my story, nurture our relationship, find out why he's leaving!

title: Other Side Of Mist And Mountain
description: In 2005, a sophomore student named Igarashi Mahane took a private train to Soukyo City. She disappeared after alighting at a station named "Kisaragi". Five years later, her lover, Yokoyama Shizuno, began investigating the case and strange stories started to unfold one after another.

title: The Shape of Things: Gacha Box 1
description: Experience a relaxing atmosphere from the comfort of your cozy room by solving small 3D puzzles inside collectible gachapons, and find the original shape of things inspired by Rubik’s style.

title: Tickle Magnet
description: Make laughter, make love, make friends, and make memories in this tongue-in-cheek tickling fetish simulation. Set in modern day America, spend your sophomore year in college investigating a series of mysterious kidnappings while balancing your finances, your love life, and your school work.

title: Trip Not
description: Trip Not is a physics-driven, parkour Platformer. Each step accompanied by whimsical voice acting. Watch out, though; a simple misstep spells doom, and every platform is a dynamic physics challenge, Unlike other games in the genre, you can buy shortcuts with money like in real life.

title: Truck Offroad Sim
description: Conquer a new world of valleys and hills with Truck Offroad Sim!

title: Shards Online
description: A casual, smooth, physics-based online shooter!

title: Protocol 11: Episode 1
description: A sci-fi story about friendship, love and what it takes to be human. Embark on an action-packed adventure to recover what was taken from you by a strange race of invaders. Survive PROTOCOL 11.

title: Protocol 11: Super Cute Alien Legacy Edition
description: 1-4 players sci-fi adventure about friendship, love and what it means to be human. Featuring local multiplayer with Coop and Versus mode against your friends!

title: House of Lizards
description: Unique Ancient Rus Simulator with Horror Elements. Get Intelligence for Slavic Brothers, return to the base Ancient Russian Manuscripts, drink Baikal Water and Destroy the base of Lizards!

title: School Curse
description: ``-School is a cursed place. -That's why I'm going to take revenge...''

title: Shuffled Sky
description: Use elemental cards to modify the world in the sky and combine them to discover new abilities in this Roguelike RPG adventure with deckbuilding and tactical combat!

title: Sinabro
description: Sinabro is a 2D adventer platformer game. Explore the level with characters that have different action mechanisms and find ways to break through obstacles. Depending on your proficiency in platformers and avoid genre, the experience of this game will be different.

title: Snack Of The Kitty
description: Explore Snack of the Kitty, a platformer featuring adventurous cat Kitty on a quest for tasty snacks. Use her plasma weapon to defeat foes, uncover secrets, and traverse mysterious portals. An exhilarating adventure!

title: Soulshard
description: In a realm between life and death, a confused soul, haunted by a life filled with misguided choices, seeks redemption and freedom.

title: Glimpse
description: "Glimpse" is a single-player atmospheric horror game. Get a glimpse of the struggles and fears of a person affected by Alzheimer's Disease.

title: Japan Train Models: JR West Edition
description: Japan Train Models second edition features trains from JR West Japan! Build, view, and run realistic reproductions of trains in your own railway space!

title: Four Lights: Erie Ever route
description: The second story in the urban fantasy romance "Four Lights," Erie Ever Route with horror mystery.

title: Heart-S-Truck
description: Navigate a world on the brink in "Heart-S-Truck," a challenging physics-driven platformer where you steer heroic delivery trucks on a mission to save humanity!

title: Hell Takes All
description: Utilize the unique power of cacti to obliterate thousands of enemies. Choose your items wisely, build a formidable defense, and conquer the depths of hell with precision and skill. Make the devil fear your presence!

title: Knight's Path: The Tournament
description: Knight's Path: The Tournament is a short medieval RPG featuring challenging combat, an immersive progression system, and a nice little story.

title: Oh Baby! Kart
description: Kart Racing. Ultimate abilities. Over 100+ Karts. 100+ Challenges. Unique racing modes including Race Royale and Grand Prix Duo.

title: Pancho's Mission
description: Embark on an epic journey alongside Pancho, the brave panda who has decided to save his world from the tyranny of the evil eagle and its loyal followers. Explore three unique locations — a mysterious forest, an unforgiving desert, and the eagle's cave — by completing 15 captivating levels in each.

title: Paradise Angel
description: All was peaceful in God's miniature garden, Erodrad, until the day the Holy Grail went missing. It's up to the angel Elu to retrieve the sacred artifact and restore order to the world. Explore God's miniature garden in search of the Holy Grail. Be careful, though! The enemies in areas of interest are corrupted by overflowing Power, making them incredibly violent. Use Elu's miracles to protect yourself in this exploration-based RPG!

title: PentaZorg
description: PentaZorg is an intense arcade bullet hell that is quite difficult to describe in a single sentence.

title: Neon Heights
description: In this 3D precision platformer jump and climb your way thorough various obstacles while trying to reach the top of the level. Be sure to use all the tools and skills you gain along the way to help aid you in reaching the goal at the end of the level. One misstep and you'll fall back to the bottom.

title: Monologue: Winter melancholy
description: In this short but profound story, you will discover that the New Year is not only fun, but also a time for self-reflection. Immerse yourself in an emotional journey that will leave you thoughtful and perhaps with a new perspective on the meaning of this holiday.

title: Mr.Welder's Pinball Defence
description: Mr.Welder's Pinball Defence - is a unique genre mix that combines the classic arcade fun of pinball with the strategic challenge of tower defense.

title: My House and I Got Transported To Another World
description: Asmongold got transported to another world by an evil AI version of himself! Battle your way through this unknown world to find your way back home!

title: Lost Love Island
description: A survival RPG. After a kraken attacked their ship, the two novice adventurers Lloyd and Meryl find themselves stranded on a lone island. Spending their days exploring the island, they soon meet other people on their quest to unravel the island's secrets.

title: Let's Go! My Harem Farm
description: This game is a farm life simulation game. Players will control this young man, growing vegetables, raising livestock, and after work, go out to the village to get along with the women. As you get closer, events that deepen the relationship occur, and eventually, they may wish to have your children.

title: Planes Combat
description: Welcome back, Mr.Pilot! We urgently need your help.

title: Phantoms
description: "Phantoms" is a retro-styled first-person horror game that takes place on a strange train. Fix an electric box to escape from a level that is random every time... but you're not alone in here. And these "things" will do anything to stop you.

title: Extreme Riding 2
description: Extreme Riding 2 is a continuation of the exciting first part of the game, where new cars and levels await you! Go through unusual obstacles, jump over cliffs, maneuver, and get to the finish line within a certain time! Complete all the tracks and show everyone that you are the best!

title: Flying Stunt Simulator
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey with the Flying Stunt Simulator, a cutting-edge aviation training game designed for aspiring pilots.

title: Piece Link
description: Connect the shapes to fit them together!

title: Dirty House
description: Dirty House - An exciting 3D game that will help you relax and unwind. You are an ordinary citizen who has just been hired and you are already full of orders! Your main task is to restore perfect order in the house! Clear rooms of trash, bottles, boxes, broken trash, etc.!

title: Dexterous: Time to Steal
description: A Match-3 Roguelite where you build your deck of blocks, collect game-changing relics, and battle your way through crime bosses in an attempt to pay off your debt and escape the time loop.

title: Demons are coming!
description: Demons are coming! is a bullet hell rougelite shooter where you fight a high variety of demons that occupied your holy land. Use the upgrades you find to your advantage and create your ideal guns to help you kill the most terrifying monsters.

title: Bible Trivia
description: How well do you know your Bible Trivia? Bible Trivia has never been so much fun. Challenge yourself or have a Bible Trivia night with friends and family in Party Mode!

title: Color Fusion Fever
description: This is a game in which you combine stuffed cats of the same type to earn points. If the cat is left unattended for a certain period of time, it transforms into a cat that damages the player. The game is over when the player's health reaches 0.

title: Card Fuse
description: A deck building roguelike where you will combine your cards with new ones you find, obliterating enemies with the cards that you make and becoming more powerful with each card you fuse.

title: ChiroTerra
description: Enter the rocky depths of an unmarked cave. Fight for survival and escape with only the gear and supplies you choose to bring. Every item has its advantages and disadvantages, so choose carefully. Once you've entered the cave, there's no turning back.

title: AWA 2024
description: AWA 2024 is a fast paced shoot-em-up featuring modern military aircraft. Choose one of the ten fighter aircraft and take the battle to the skies throughout nine action-packed stages each with their own special end-level boss.

title: Automobilista 2: Formula HiTech
description: Formula HiTech features some of the most technologically advanced cars in the history of Grand Prix Racing. The cars are split in two classes from two distinct generations, each headlined by officially licensed Mclaren Racing cars.

title: After War Town
description: "In the heart-pounding virtual battleground of 'After War Town,' immerse yourself in a gripping shooter experience where the fate of a besieged city lies in your hands.

title: 3D Puzzle: World War II
description: Collect a 3D puzzle, transferring things to the right places to create a beautiful place.

title: 100 Kills Challenge
description: "100 Kills Challenge" is an intense and fast-paced first-person tactical shooting game. The only goal in the game is to kill 100 enemies as much as possible within the specified time to win.

title: A group of beauties surrounded me
description: This is a male-oriented, high-freedom cultivation work. You are the wealthiest man, surrounded by beauty. A total of 155 characters can be pursued, with one tailored to your preferences. The work has super high freedom, with no fixed plot. Come explore five very different plot lines quickly!

title: Ancient Russian Life Simulator
description: An exciting clicker game that will allow you to plunge into the times of the war of the Ancient Rus against the Lizards, stand next to your ancestors to protect the Russian land!

title: Ark Odyssey
description: Ark Odyssey is a top-down arcade shooter that lets you command an army of starships to fight against the force of void! Gather your fleet into formations, and build your team of evolving synergistic compositions. Order your army of Starforce through space and protect the cosmos!

title: Battlefield Commander WWII
description: Battlefield Commander WWII is a real-time tactical game where you lead the soldiers and vehicles that battled across the globe during this time in history. Play hundreds of unique units across dynamic campaigns, skirmishes, and online PvP.

title: Triggerheart Exelica
description: Triggerheart Exelica is a vertically scrolling Japanese arcade shooter with a little bit of everything: fast-paced action, scalable difficulty, massive hordes of enemy Ver'mith, and cute humanoid weapons who can either shoot down enemy ships or capture them to use as shields or projectiles. Help Exelica and Crueltear save the universe!

title: Make it! Takoyaki
description: It's a street-food classic: a takoyaki-making challenge! Make as much takoyaki as you can!

title: The Midnight
description: The Midnight is a mod being developed by Cryptic Mushroom that adds a new, mysterious and scary dimension to explore. It is a dimension of darkness; the only light comes from crystals and the various life of the dimension. You may travel willingly to this dimension, though you may find yourself being unwillingly dragged into this strange and hostile world...

title: Pacific Drive: Deluxe Edition
description: Pacific Drive: Deluxe Edition is a retail exclusive that features the base game, a set of 3 art cards from the heart of the Olympic Exclusion Zone, traveler’s journal, deluxe sleeve, reversible coversheet; as well as a pack of in-game cosmetic items for your station wagon.

title: Oshikake Petit Lily
description:
A short 20-30 minute fully voiced Girl x Girl visual novel, where you come in contact with your crazily cute childhood friend.
May include some disturbing depictions including blood, mental illness and suicide.

Nozomi is currently recovering from clinical depression at home. Her eccentric childhood friend Puchiri comes to check on her, but their relationship may suddenly take an unexpected turn...

title: FlyKnight
description: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler. Earn your knighthood as you oppose the evil witch Lunamoth and stop her curse which prevents everyone from growing wings.

title: Asahina Mikuru no Yoko Scroll Action
description: Play as Mikuru Asahina with a machine gun. Shoot rabbit, cat, pig and avoiding any obstacles. Asahina Mikuru no Yoko Scroll is an action game based on popular anime series Haruhi Suzumiya no Yuutsu.

title: Kriaturaz: Guardian of Legends
description: Kriaturaz: Guardian of Legends is a game that presents Brazilian myths and legends in an unprecedented way and features characters that are part of a new concept of Brazilian legends, myths, and folklore, based on research carried out over more than five months and made up of more than 300 Brazilian legends.

title: Neoathlon
description: A sci-fi racing title aimed at being a highly polished and fun experience for players and spectators alike. Neoathlon utilizes style and substance with its custom physics mechanics to make the most robust and enjoyable hover racing experience possible.

title: Heaven Studio
description:
Heaven Studio is a tool to create playable Rhythm Heaven custom remixes, with many customization options.

This title was delisted from GitHub and Itch.io per a DMCA takedown.

title: Hoodie Survivor
description: Auto shooter score attack survival game where your character moves forward continuously and you control the direction of travel by rotating left and right

title: First Time In Hawaii: Collector's Edition
description:
Kate and Nicole Robinson hit up Hawaii for a very special occassion: the wedding of their good friend Stella! Kate's got a date with with Hawaii!

In this Hidden Object game with a tropical twist, see all the local sights, experience all the local favorites and maybe even give your good friend Stella the best wedding ever!

title: Trash can Army
description: The pioneers have been salivating at your trash can for a long time! They have formed a garbage can army and are preparing to launch an attack on your home! Reasonably use your characters to resist the repeated attacks of the Garbage Can Legion! Or...... Join the Garbage Can Legion!

title: Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs: The Thrilling Steamy Maze Kiwami
description: Want to dive into a bath? Or into a dungeon? "Yuuna and the Haunted Hot Springs" is now an RPG that's pushing all sorts of boundaries! Power up in the hot spring, then push through clothes-ripping dangers to clear out the dungeon! A new story of hauntings, hot springs, and high adventure awaits!

title: Y2K Directive
description: Will your leadership help your country survive a sci-fi disaster like a zombie plague or an alien invasion? Find out in this unique blend of real time strategy and a brutal (and often unfair) survival wargame!

title: Warbringers of Angrul
description: Warbringers of Angrul is a grand strategy RTS where you manage your empire on a grand campaign map and command your armies in exciting real time battles. Lead zealous crusaders, cunning elves, or savage orcs in bringing war to the world of Angrul in both single and multiplayer.

title: Trupe do Sapinho
description: An RPG with cute forest creatures that venture out to explore the world!

title: Tower Factory
description: Tower Factory is a tower defense and automation game with roguelite elements. Optimize resource production using conveyor systems while defending against monster waves. Can you find and destroy the enemy tower before it's too late?

title: Tochos vs. Brokens
description: The Brokens are invading and only you can save the planet, use your Tochos and defeat the evil forces in this strategic tower defense game.

title: Rusty's Retirement
description: Rusty's Retirement is an idle-farming simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks while caring for your farm.

title: Royal Romances: Cursed Hearts - Collector's Edition
description: Join a noble prince and a beautiful princess on their quest to vanquish evil, unearth hidden family secrets, and fight for a moment of respite in each other's arms!

title: Quantic River
description: Dive into the dystopian world of Quantic River, where frenetic action meets captivating exploration. Master katana combat, unlock cybernetics, slice through environments, hack obstacles, and explore dual-layered levels for speedrunners and explorers.

title: Operation Kyiv
description: Operation "Kyiv"": Immerse yourself in intense FPS battles on the territory of Irpin, Bucha, Gostomel, Сhernihiv and the M0-6 highway. Authentic combat, strategic firefights that determine the fate of Kiev. Are you ready to fight?"

title: Digested
description: Digested is an open-world horror survival game in which you must evade a giant snake intent on eating you alive. Utilize various tools and abilities to formulate an escape strategy, and use the map to navigate through unfamiliar terrain. Locate your extraction pod and don't get digested.

title: Multiworlds
description: The game is a strategy simulation game where you control more than 1 player at a time to fix the timelines you broke.

title: Harrowed Ground
description: In this early release, the game follows the main character on their first outing with the purpose of prepping to rob the great vaults in their city and sew chaos among the nobles of Orichalc, the City of Brass

title: Kubikon 3D
description: Cubes, cubes, cubes... Cubes everywhere. Whether you're in the mood to challenge your brain or just relax, Kubikon and its addictive gameplay are here for you!

title: Mechanical Lab
description: Mechanical Lab is a 2D action game focused on the physical interaction of machines with the environment. Explore, build and experiment to survive in the city of robots long after the end of human civilization.

title: Fog of War: Book One
description: Fog of War is a romance, story focused adult visual novel. You play as an Ex-Delta Force operator attending medical school upon retirement. You make choices that shape the story and potential romances.

title: Flow: Syn x Vertue
description: Flow through the Synthesized pipes of the inter-future-web. Or not. It's up to you!

title: Ablight
description: Ablight is a classic real-time strategy game set in an alternate universe where dieselpunk, cyberpunk and medieval aesthetics meet. Join the rebellion against the zealotic Inquisition, who have been mankinds scourge for hundreds of years and fight a war for survival. Freedom is within touch!

title: Man in the Dark
description: Man in the Dark realistically expresses the dark feeling of the end of the century, set in a place that has turned into a place full of zombies and bizarre creatures. You don't have to go through a lot of learning to experience the cool play. Sweep away a swarm of zombies running from all sides.

title: Ava's Hidden Adventures
description: Search for hidden objects in hand-drawn, highly interactive worlds of imagination. Ava's magic pencil makes her drawings come to life! Choose a drawing and enter it. Twang trees, break rocks, tickle ninjas, poke goblins, have fun and relax, as you adventure with Ava.

title: CyberVerse Showdown
description: Welcome to CyberVerse Showdown, the ultimate card game set in a futuristic cyberpunk world! Unleash your strategic powers as you assemble a team of powerful cybernetic warriors, hackers, and technologically advanced humans to battle against AI rivals or PVP with a Friend.

title: Borderline Enigma
description: Our Empire is spreading thin through the galaxy. Your responsibility is to assist your comrades on our newly founded colony. Keep your station operational at all cost. Your pivotal role may shape destiny. And don't forget: Humanity Above All!

title: Cursed Enigma: Priest and Prayers
description: Father Giovanni, a devout priest, becomes entangled in mysteries and secrets while overseeing his local church. Explore the dark truths and menacing events behind the serene facade of the parish in the first episode of Cursed Enigma: Priest and Prayers

title: Brinemegeddon
description: An action-packed turn-based RPG which prides itself on its team-based combat, unique bosses, and story!

title: Summoner of Greats
description: Luis the Mad Painter. His last work, a series of portraits, "The Effects Series". - Is it a prayer or a curse? Over 200 beautifully rendered historical figures and worldviews. Casual real-time strategy with a variety of aspects depending on party combination, training, placement, and terrain.

title: Death Run
description: Dodge lethal lasers in a dark sci-fi death show — or die trying.

title: Red Green Donkey
description: Red Green Donkey is a single-player top-down shooter game. You will grope your way through the darkness with the dim light to find the donkey. You will face a variety of enemies, and the only thing you can rely on is the arrows and shields in your hands.

title: Last Moor
description: Last Moor is a horror game in which a man wakes up and escapes from a secret laboratory on the moon. You have to escape by solving various puzzles, exploring the laboratory, avoiding or fighting the monsters there.

title: Shhh!
description: Face a terrifying experience but don't scream! If you make noise... It's game over! (You will need a Microphone)!

title: Total blade
description: Medieval overworld RPG, 3d physics battle, massive battle

title: Killer Instinct: Anniversary Edition
description:
The 10th Anniversary Update brings with it two versions of KI:

The Killer Instinct Base Game will be FREE TO PLAY on all platforms: Xbox consoles (One, Series X|S), Windows PC, and Steam. The free KI base game will feature one free weekly rotating Fighter and Single-Player, Local, and Ranked modes.

The Killer Instinct Anniversary Edition will include all 29 Fighters, and all Premium Content ever released: the VIP Double XP Booster, holiday accessories, and more. This edition replaces the "Definitive Edition," which was delisted upon release of the Anniversary Edition.

The 10th Anniversary Update will go even further, with a few more changes:

- Improved matchmaking. We want to make it easier for folks to find matches quickly, regardless of which platform they’re playing on.
- Optimization for Series X|S consoles.
- Balance updates. That’s right – new meta for Killer Instinct, more than five years after the last adjustments!

The following Mature-rated content included in KI Definitive Edition will NOT be included in the Anniversary Edition:
- Definitive Edition App (featuring developer interviews, concept art, Killer Cuts soundtrack)
- Xbox KI Classic 1 & 2
- But DON’T WORRY! If you already own Killer Instinct Definitive Edition digitally, you will still be able to download the above content even after the Definitive Edition is retired.

title: Scott Pilgrim Versus
description: Scott Pilgrim Versus is an I.K.E.M.E.N game based on the Scott Pilgrim series, heavily inspired by Scott Pilgrim vs. the World: The Game. It was created by Ultra Fatality & Ryon, and released on June 1st, 2023.

title: Five Nights at Fredbear's
description: Five Nights at Freddy's: Fredbear, or as it was named later, Five Nights at Fredbear's, is a FNaF fan-game made by KidduTheMan and epicsurfingvids119

title: Gardens Of Celestial Globes
description: The Book That You Can Play! Feel like a puppet theater choreographer in a fantasy reference book that came alive! It has many interesting locations, creatures, items, 10 races, 3 main types of magic: lightning, fire, arcane, AI support, random worlds generator and 3 modes: ARENA, QUEST, and TOWER.

title: Destiny 2: Lightfall - Season of the Wish
description:
A Dream of Dragons

The door to the Pale Heart remains locked. And in the wake of our endeavor with the Hive, an ancient mystery turns our gaze to the Dreaming City, to the last of the Ahamkara, and to the place of the Fifteenth Wish.

The key to the Pale Heart cannot be taken. It must be granted.

title: Make Me Real: Worthlessness Selected
description:
Make Me Real: Worthlessness Selected is a collection of delinquent unreal top-down action experiences revolving around localized incidents in a realm known to most as "The Dream World".
Prepare for possibly one of the most chuuni things to ever exist and witness a cacophony of noise, charged weaponry, and a sword that might just be a tad too long for its own good.

title: Clearence Sale
description: Clearance Sale is an experimental spinoff to the Make Me Real series about shopping in a store's last days.

title: Dreampunk: Virtual Unreality
description: With EnsureLife's new DR-34MM headset, you will never want to go back. Featuring bleeding edge graphics, crazy action and ear-destroying sound, the unreal world has never felt so real before.

title: Escape From The Dreamy
description:
A horror Slender type game inspired by the Dreamybullxxx memes.

In this experience, you step into the shoes of Steven Sanchez, a dedicated investigator on a mission to unravel the mystery surrounding a missing camper from North Carolina.

title: UpTogether.io
description:
Up Together is a multiplayer 3D obby / obstacle course platformer game where you jump, climb, and bounce your way to the top of the level!

Jump with your friends or alone. There are lots of fun characters to choose from, including Taco, Baguette, Hot Dog and more. Try for a spot on the leaderboard if you're up for the challenge!

title: Tribes 3: Rivals
description: Tribes 3: Rivals resurrects the high-speed, aerial combat of this legendary shooter franchise, for a fresh yet familiar FPS experience. In this fast-paced team shooter, you’ll ski, jetpack, battle, and race to capture the enemy team’s flag, all while ferociously defending your own. Choose from unique classes to customize your abilities, perks, and weapon loadouts, while playing across epic terrains from snow covered peaks to haunting deserts. Emphasizing teamwork, tactics, speed, and intense combat, Tribes 3: Rivals offers both nostalgic fans and newcomers an exhilarating FPS experience in this rebirth of the world’s fastest team shooter.

title: Memoria: Stories of La Garma
description: 16,500 years ago, a group of humans came back to their shelter in Spain after hunting. The entrance had collapsed, leaving everything trapped inside. Narrated by Geraldine Chaplin, this VR experience invites you to explore the memories of the cave, untouched and preserved for thousands of years.

title: A Long Walk Home
description: The enemy weren't supposed to be active in this area. Hell, all you were trying to do was transport your little repair mech, barely even equipped for combat, across areas of operation. Missile Warnings. Explosions. Your transport drone crashes into the nearby canyon. Now you and your little repair mech have a long walk back to friendly lines.

title: Beyond Good & Evil: 20th Anniversary Edition
description: Swoop into the marvelous world of Hillys as action-reporter Jade to investigate the mysterious DomZ alien attacks alongside colorful characters, like her adoptive uncle Pey’j or the valiant Double H. Embark on this epic adventure in up to 4K, 60 fps with improved graphics, controls, and audio, along with brand-new autosave and cross-save features. Enjoy exclusive new rewards as you explore the planet and discover more about Jade’s past in a new treasure hunt throughout Hillys. Put your skills to the test thanks to the new speedrun mode and updated achievements, and learn more about the game’s development and secrets in the anniversary gallery! Armed with her daï-jo and faithful camera, Jade’s adventure will get you to freely explore Hillys, combat creatures large and small, infiltrate dangerous areas, solve enigmatic puzzles, play addictive mini-games, race the best hovercraft pilots, and take pictures of the whole experience.

title: Lunar Glow Stellar Dance
description: "Lunar Glow Stellar Dance" is a love-themed game for all ages, produced by the Chinese girl game brand JROCKSTUDIO.The protagonist, able to see ghosts since childhood, is drawn into non-ordinary events, where he encounters five adorable girls. All mysteries will gradually be unveiled.

title: Banana Drama: Alpaca
description: Alpapaca! Get the incredibly fluffy Banana Drama alpaca with this DLC. He has incredible balanced capabilities and is one of the best allrounders of all Banana Drama aimals. Unfortunately, he is allergic to bananas and therefore often sneezes - his sneezing is often mistaken for spitting.

title: Banana Drama: Cockatoo
description: Fly cockatoo! Get the incredibly agile Banana Drama cockatoo with this DLC. He has incredible offensive capabilities and is able to run/fly faster than others. Similar to his best friend "Kiki the cockatoo" his abilities are often underestimated due to his cute looks!

title: Banana Drama: Cow
description: Cow (moo)! Get the incredibly sassy Banana Drama cow with this DLC. The cow has incredible defensive capabilities and is able to collect resources faster than others. The cow is very self-confident and often likes to show off its beautiful udder!

title: Banana Drama: Deer
description: Oh deer! Get the incredibly shy Banana Drama deer with this DLC. He has incredible defensive capabilities and is able to collect resources faster than others. It's lucky that there are no roads or cars in Banana Drama, because that would be fatal for the deer!

title: Banana Drama: Giraffe
description: Helicopter giraffe! Get the excited Banana Drama giraffe with this DLC. She has incredible balanced capabilities and is one of the best allrounders. Sometimes she gets so excited that she can't stop spinning her head like a helicopter. Let's hope she doesn't fly away!

title: Banana Drama: Lion King
description: Roaarrrr - the Lion! Get the incredibly proud Banana Drama lion with this DLC. He has incredible offensive capabilities and is able to run faster than others. A lion throwing bananas is a little unusual at first glance, but he has learnt this effective fighting technique from the monke(y)s!

title: Banana Drama: Tiger
description: Wow a tiger! Get the incredibly cute and sleepy Banana Drama tiger with this DLC. He has incredible balanced capabilities and is one of the best allrounders of all Banana Drama animals. He is particularly proud of his beautiful coat and regularly impresses many female tigers with it.

title: Forest Guardian Battle Chess
description: This is a game that lets you show creativity and strategy in turn-based combat. You can build obstacles, develop resources, develop characters, choose skills, and deal with different maps and enemies.

title: Troopstuck
description: In this addictive game, the player embarks on a journey to dominate the battlefield by capturing strategically placed buildings using a combination of soldiers, tanks and aircraft.

title: Twin Stick
description: Twin Stick is a game all about flow. Control your car with the left stick (WASD) and the gun with right stick (arrow keys) in order to beat the levels in record time, and to explore the world! Boost the guns fire rate with R1 (space) for a powerful speed boost!

title: Umbra: The Last Summoner
description: As the sole summoner, step into the mystical realm of Umbra to rescue it from the encroaching demon army emerging from dimensional rifts. To end this invasion, call upon 60 diverse heroes, each with unique abilities, and engage in strategic, round-based RPG battles.

title: Until the Last Plane 1942
description: Soar across the skies of World War II in this vertical shootem'up. Duel enemy fighters, strike critical targets and choose your wingmen wisely. The year is 1942, and the odds are against you.

title: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising
description: You are a vampire. Build a castle, manage your clan and expand your hold over Sangavia. Develop your character, experience a dramatic story in an open world and rule the land either alone or with your friends in co-op mode.

title: Voidwalker
description: Embark on a distorted journey as Voidwalker, battling chaotic entities and unraveling secrets to save your universe. With retro graphics and the Quake engine, brace yourself for intense first-person shooter combat.

title: Xeno Runners
description: Flying dreams? Live the thrill of high-speed aerial racing on a breathtaking alien planet. An adrenaline-fueled experience like no other with challenging time trial races that will push your skills to the limit. Master multiple tracks and unlock new flying machines or simply fly and enjoy the views.

title: Tank Team
description: A team based PVP game where groups of up to 8 players must work together to operate a tank!

title: The World's Egg: For Those Who Dream
description: While enjoying an ordinary day in town, Mari suddenly finds herself surrounded by people collapsing, and some transforming into monsters. Guided by a mysterious voice, she is given the ability to fight back against the evil creatures.

title: Titan Revenge
description: Set in the vast expanse of Norse mythology, this MMORPG thrusts you into a world on the brink of apocalypse. As an intrepid hero, you must navigate the realms of the Aesir and Vanir, battling fearsome giants, mythical beasts, and treacherous gods.

title: Token Town
description: Trapped on a planet, you must collect shiny objects and upgrade your computer to mine enough crypto to pay back your debt and escape.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Nancy
description: Bring home Nancy, possibly the most heinous and disturbed Family member of them all! She's an expert at using her friendly looks to lure unsuspecting Victims into deadly situations they can't escape. Her barbed wire traps and unnatural Spy ability make for a unique and deadly combination.

title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre: Danny
description: A kind and intelligent Victim with a rough exterior, Danny is desperately searching for his missing girlfriend, Maria. His Study and Tamper ability allows him to examine and manipulate crucial items around the environment, giving himself and fellow Victims a better chance at survival!

title: The 52 Fragments
description: The 52 Fragments are an experimental, esoteric series of games and experiences. Beginning Nov. 1, 2023, one fragment will be added to the library each week for one year. These games examine themes related to identity, agency, perception, and the creative process.

title: Tell Me Your Story
description: Uncover Grandma Rose’s extraordinary stories along with Amelia, all hidden in multiple cozy puzzles spread around the world. Dive into globetrotter adventures, discover granny’s treasures, and relax along the way.

title: Short Sad Stories
description: Alice is a dreamy girl who lives between the real and imaginary worlds, in love with the wrong person. Just before that situation becomes unsustainable, things change unexpectedly, and a new path opens for her and those around her.

title: Soul device
description: Soul Device is a 2D platformer shooter with features of the roguelike genre. On your way you will encounter various items that will strengthen you, equipment that will give you new abilities, and several weapons that will be responsible for your attacks.

title: Starfall Serenity
description: A cozy game about catching the falling stars and unlocking constellations in beautiful locations.

title: Tales From Aturian: Battle of Cleaved Fields
description: Enjoy a short Turn-based RPG loosely inspired by Dungeons and Dragons mechanics, with many jokes and laughs to be had.

title: Risk of Pain
description: Risk of Pain is a hardcore puzzle platformer that challenges you to complete many challenging levels. Use parkour, wit and luck to avoid dying! Are you ready to take a risk?!

title: Rivandy
description:
Rivandy is a online multiplayer game that blends Battle Royale and cooperative Survivor mode. Players clash in a mystical conflict where spirits and souls shape your power.
You control two entities at once:
- A human (with 4 abilities).
- A spirit (with 4 abilities).

title: Scary Psycho Lady Simulator
description: Descend into psychological horror with 'Scary Psycho Lady' on Steam. Uncover a twisted plot as Ikoma, Rina, and the Psycho Lady navigate a chilling narrative of deception, betrayal, and murder. Solve puzzles, confront fear, and survive the sinister journe

title: Scourge of War: Remastered
description: Welcome to Scourge of War, a real-time 3D computer game/simulation developed by NorbSoftDev, the company headed by renowned game designer Norb Timpko, designer of Mad Minute Games' acclaimed Take Command series. Scourge of War is the epitome of historical command simulations.

title: Sephiria
description: Sephiria is a top-down action rogue-lite game with pixel graphics. Go down the tower, meet various animals, and collect various talismans and artifacts to become stronger.

title: Seth
description: Become Seth, god of storms, and crush Apophis’s legions in a fast-paced roguelite FPS blending Egyptian mythology with science fiction. Fast combat, random challenges, and divine power in every run.

title: S.E.X. Retreat: WellCum In!
description: Welcome to the fascinating world of S.E.X. Retreat: WellCum In!, a visual novel for adults! Immerse yourself in a captivating story where the main character, tired of failures and searching, decides to start a new chapter in a different spa.

title: Operation Food to Gold
description: Operation Food to Gold is a free to play idle game. Produce food, feed it to the alien and collect it's golden... excrements.

title: Peeking at the peak
description: ”Peeking at the Peak" is a challenging high difficulty mountain climbing game. Control the fun melon to overcome dangerous mountains and difficult obstacles. This unique mountain climbing game requires precise control. Test your skills on demanding courses and reach the top!

title: Perfect Cells Project
description: You are a pink life form. The target is utilizing the evolved abilities to seek revenge on the researchers while progressively breaking through barriers toward the exit.

title: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers - Guardian Police Vehicle
description: This patrol car is the biggest Brighton police force has to offer. It's a big help fighting crime, allowing you to arrest up to six suspects at a time!

title: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers - Surveillance Police Vehicle
description: Technology equals efficiency – and the Surveillance Police Vehicle proves it! Make the lives of traffic offenders harder by patrolling the streets of Brighton in this car and using its exclusive surveillance camera to record a multitude of car-related felonies.

title: Reflectron
description: Reflectron is a geometrically-styled arcade game that will keep you coming back for more. Halfway between a brick-breaker and Geometry Wars, with a pinch of Vampire Survivors thrown in for good measure, it's a simple yet effective mix that will keep you coming back for more.

title: Pussy Kingdom: Queen of Passion
description: Embark on a magical adventure where you will have to unite all the kingdoms and save the world from evil.

title: Quantum Contours
description: From zero to hero: Outgun alien hordes in a rogue-lite bullet hell adventure. Fight through waves of randomized enemies in procedurally generated levels with fresh, new upgrades every run.

title: Quantum Drive
description: Welcome to Quantum Drive! Get ready for the intensity of speed, where the streets are your playground, and speed is your ally.

title: Rank Boss Bullets
description: A vertical bullet hell game. Preview and select between three randomly generated options to choose the boss and every add-on you're going to face, then start a time-based survival trial. Difficulty can be scaled infinitely here, and your limit will be tested.

title: Rated Sudoku
description: Everything you ever want in a Sudoku game! You can play Sudoku, analyze puzzles, edit puzzles, generate puzzles, there are campaigns (lessons) and you can even paint Sudoku images!

title: Skibidi Toilet
description: Fight against the Skibidi Toilets. Try and survive all 5 nights.

title: Puppet Master: The Game - Movie Edition Blade + Execution
description: Get ready for an adrenaline-packed experience with the Movie Edition Blade Pack! Dive into the action with a fully revamped Blade character model, a cutting-edge Weapon Model featuring a brand-new brutal Execution for Blade. Customize your combat style with 6 stunning weapon skins. Blade is geared up and prepared for battle, showcasing his fierce prowess with the Axis Termination emote!

title: Revenge Crystal
description: Revenge Crystal is an epic top-down action RPG. You explore a defeated world by unknown invaders as an amnesiac knight who must save the world and defeat the invaders by navigating through a world of interconnected challenges, fierce enemies, and intricate puzzles.

title: Stealth Blade
description: Stealth Blade is a side-scrolling action/dark art-style game. You need to save your son from demons.

title: Heatchain
description: Arcade game where you need to find the next glyph to make the longest chain

title: Hypothetimania
description: Inspired by 2D classic platforming games, Hypothetimania is a game that is about speed platforming with only a couple things in mind: collect everything and get to the end as quickly as possible. The faster you are, the better your score.

title: It's OK to Fail
description: "It's OK to Fail" is a difficult silly physics-based platform game where your ultimate goal is to reach the end in under 15 minutes. Control your arms and your legs to jump and overtake your fails !

title: Leap up no Justu: Double
description: Leap up no jutsu: Double is the next version of the game Leap up no Jutsu. From now on, you must control two characters to avoid obstacles at the same time by clicking on the side where the character needs to jump.Enjoy!

title: Mine Memory
description: Uncover the skeletons in Hana's closet in "Mine Memory," a gripping psychological visual novel. Dive into Hana's memories, shape her destiny, and confront haunting choices with deep consequences.

title: My Faithful and Loyal Wife Would Never Cheat on Me
description: Join Karl, a forum moderator, and his wife, Stacey, in a tale of suspicion and unexpected turns. Stacey's new boss, Tyrone Bullman, adds complexity to their lives. Explore trust, love, and the unexpected in My Faithful and Loyal Wife Would Never Cheat on Me.

title: Mystic Strife
description: Mystic Strife is a fast-paced chaotic party fighting game for up to eight friends. Choose one of six characters with unique abilities and prepare yourself for a simple yet surprisingly deep platforming deathmatch!

title: Gladio Mori
description: Gladio Mori is a cutting-edge physics-based multiplayer fighting game where you use razor-sharp weapons to cut down your enemies or die trying. Pick your blade, choose your armour and create a fighting style unique to you. Enter the arena to face your friends or hone your abilities against the AI.

title: Girlfriend from Hell
description: He didn't want to marry me! I will make his life a living hell!

title: Garage Works
description: Car simulation game where all kinds of handling and performance affecting parts can be changed as well as tested on road or on track.

title: Escape Party
description: Embark on 3D online multiplayer escape rooms in Escape Party. Solve puzzles, test your speed, and conquer challenges together.

title: Escape From Boykisser
description: "Escape From Boykisser" is an immersive first-person psychological horror game that throws you into the sterile spaces of the backrooms.

title: Emerging Tactical
description: Take your hero on a quest to become a tactical medic!

title: Dead by Daylight: Chucky Chapter
description: Meet your new best friend ‘til the end. Dead by Daylight: Chucky brings an iconic horror legend into The Fog with a new Killer: The Good Guy - Chucky. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Charm: Good Guys Box.

A childhood friend has been missing for as long as you can remember. You decide to investigate the abandoned town in which he used to live only to find something truly unexpected and even more so unexplainable. Have you got what it takes to find out what happened to Chris Williams?

title: A different summer
description: A visual novel about a young man with bad grades and "good attributes", punished for a summer, in a remote place with sexy women who love sex. What can go wrong?

title: Aquametsis
description: Dive into Aquametsis: a Tactical FPS/Base Building hybrid set in a submerged corporate hellscape. Engage in tactical combat, control skilled mercs on high-stakes missions, and oversee resource management as a logistics manager.

title: Hellmet: Seven Circles Down
description: A top-down twin-stick shooter that pays homage to the golden era of arcade classics. With its vibrant pixel-art style, this game offers a blistering blend of intense shooting action, dynamic combat and strategic gameplay.

title: Bounties of Babylon
description: A tabletop-inspired game about expanding the world, harvesting its bounties, and then trading them to outwit your opponent.

title: Block Control
description: Pink and Blue are running towards the Flag again today. Use 7 blocks with various gimics to reach the flag. There are puzzle maps that test your creativity, and control maps that need to reach the flag in time. Don't give up until you clear all the maps!

title: Because I Love Her Episode 1
description: Because I Love Her is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel that focuses on character relationships over time. Play out the lives of two main protagonists while learning about other love interests and uncover the mystery that surrounds your new neighbors in this zero grind Visual Novel.

title: Dynasty
description: Dynasty is a singleplayer social deduction roguelike in which you must rule your kingdom through your untrustworthy advisors. Earn your advisors loyalty and grant them the power to administrate, but beware: the more power you grant them, the more they may use that power against you.

title: Vs Suicide Mouse
description: Vs Suicide Mouse is a mod by gamepro_25. It is based on the creepypasta "suicidemouse.avi".

title: Luminaria: Dark Echoes
description:
Welcome to Luminaria Dark Echoes, the thrilling roguelike action role-playing game that fuses the intensity of Vampire Survivors with the strategic depth of Dark Souls!
