description: An abandoned medieval military base is infested with mutated zombies, and your female boss accidentally enters it while on a mission. Because the zombies are so bad, your female boss is infected by them. You must go and save her. Are you ready?

title: Christmas Adventure
description: Welcome to the Christmas adventure. In this game you have to guess the girls' outfit for Christmas celebration. If you get it right, you are in for a naughty Christmas night.

title: Extreme Bike Racing
description: Extreme Bike Racing is ultimate 3D Bike Racing game for all age group. There are 3 stages with 3 challenges in every stage in which player has to face different hurdles and difficulties to complete that challenge.

title: Dungeon Artifact
description: Dungeon Artifact is a roguelike deck-builder game with authentic card game elements. 200+ cards offer the possibility to create new combos all the time. Build the most powerful deck by your own hands and overwhelm your enemies!

title: Epic Donald
description: A follow up to the Epic Mickey series which would have featured Donald Duck and elements from the Carl Barks comics. The game was cancelled after the dismal failure of Epic Mickey 2 and the switch to focus on the mobile gaming market.

title: Genshin Impact: Roses and Muskets
description:
Version 4.3 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Navia and Chevreuse
• New main event: Roses and Muskets
• New story quest for Navia
• Major update for Genius Invokation TCG
• Major update for the Serenitea Pot housing system
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: My Office Adventures
description:
Interactive casual SOL porn game where you help revive your father's dying business with your groundbreaking idea. Along with the ride, you are joined by many cute girls and hot milfs.
Will you be able to handle them all? Time to find out!

title: The Art of Reflection
description: The Art of Reflection is a first-person puzzle game where you traverse mirrors as if they were natural extensions of space. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and perform gravity-shifting acrobatics through a sprawling environment as you learn to navigate this world with mastery.

title: Pets & Stuff
description:
Immerse yourself into the role of a pet groomer at a cute pet clinic. Help adorable, furry friends with all kinds of different treatments. Let your imagination run wild and impress not only your fuzzy customers, but everyone around with a completely renewed, colourful and healthy look. Everyone deserves to be happy, groomed and in style!
Cuteness overload and fur everywhere guaranteed!

title: At Tony's
description:
At Tony's is a first-person horror experience taking place in a haunted pizzeria.

The last night shift worker vanished mysteriously, it's your turn to step in to help the family's business.

Will you survive your shift, cooking pizzas while unveiling the restaurant's mysteries?

title: All Demons Go to Heaven
description: We will follow the story of Samwell, an orphan guy, innocent and shy and without any friends, who until now has been constantly bullied by his caretaker Charlotte. On the other hand, we have Grynesha, a succubus who fled from the Demon World and came to the Human World, with one goal in mind, to be able to recover her home from who took it from her. These two characters will become inseparable, Grynesha will offer Samwell a life of all that he deserves, full of lust and power, but in return, she will use Samwell for her benefit. With Grynesha's ability to create lewd situations, Samwell will be involved in many circumstances with different girls that he will meet on his adventure.​

title: Metal: Hellsinger - Purgatory
description:
The Purgatory DLC delivers three new songs, a new weapon, and three searing new looks.

Don the skin that reflects the fire within, then ride the demonic voices of Matt Heafy (Trivium), Melissa Bonny (Ad Infinitum), and Joe Bad (Fit for an Autopsy) as you punctuate each beat with your infernal bow.

title: Legend of Kalevala
description: Legend of Kalevala is a 2D platform with retro 16-bit style artwork and music which weaves a tale about an alien planet Kalevala and its inhabitants. The player is dropped right into this scenario and must puzzle out the story behind Kalevala while trying to survive.

title: World War Z: Valley of the Zeke Episode
description: Introducing a new story episode including 3 new missions set in Arizona, featuring new characters. As a convoy of survivors flee Phoenix, they’re attacked by the infected and one of its patrol squads is separated from the group. They must race to their rendezvous in Tempe or risk being left behind.

title: Loose Leaf
description: Manage a tea room between worlds with the most in-depth tea brewing simulation ever. Experiment with ingredients and tools to find the best recipes for serving your haunted guests. Then read their fortune in the cards to help ease their worries. Will you become a true Tea Master?

title: Kind Words 2
description: A game about being kind to real people. Send nice letters from your cozy room, go outside and say hi to your neighbors, swap recommendations, dress up for the poetry slam and add your dreams to a sky full of wishes. Join a community of real people with their hearts on their sleeves.

title: Llamasoft: The Jeff Minter Story
description: 42 of the weirdest, trippiest, sheepiest games ever created. Enter the mind of Jeff Minter, the legendary creator of Attack of the Mutant Camels, Gridrunner, and Tempest 2000, in this interactive documentary from Digital Eclipse.

title: The Mermaid Mask
description: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

title: Vivarium
description: You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

title: Nirvana Noir
description:
Nirvana Noir, the sequel to 2021's "Genesis Noir," is a cosmic adventure beyond time and space. Become your own existential threat and put out the fires of eternity.

Dual noir adventures beyond time and space; one where the Big Bang was never fired, the other an explosion of color and sin. Your new lover is tangled in rumors of a Bigger Bang. Can you unravel its mystery and stop the threat to the cosmic city?

Hit the street; counter the culture; be changed.

title: Vampire Survivors: Adventures
description: Adventures are self-contained, mini story-modes that remix the game's content. Aside from providing deep lore , their main goal is actually to give you an excuse to play VS when you feel like it, but have already unlocked everything the game has to offer.

title: Combo Devils
description: Combo Devils is an evolution of the platform-fighting genre. Stylish combat, and a cooperative roguelite mode offers content for all player skill levels. An experience that balances accessibility with a high execution ceiling for a dedicated core player base to grow around.

title: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
description: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open, in a narrative mystery adventure where nothing is quite as it seems.

title: Sticky Business: Plan With Me
description: Plan With Me not only brings you a delightful array of cozy stickers for your shop but also infuses them with a unique theme.

title: Voyagers of Nera
description: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative seafaring survival-crafting game for up to 10 players. Sail across a magical ocean world, skim along the waves, and protect lost nature spirits from monsters emerging from the depths.

title: Vampire Survivors: Emergency Meeting
description:
The Survivors are desperate to hunt vampires, but are running out of places to look. Only one option remains: Be the bullet hell... in space!

Gather your most trusted Crewmates, prepare to eject the Impostors, and try to survive while mowing down thousands of extra-terrestrial foes in this expansion for Vampire Survivors. Turn classic Among Us tasks into outrageous weapons, upgrading your abilities after every roguelite run to overcome impossible odds with ease. Be alert to subterfuge as you explore the vast weirdness of the Polus Replica and keep your wits about you, as suspicious eyes are always watching.

title: Rocket League: Season 13
description:
Tape your Season highlights on VHS.
The 90s and early 2000s, a time that was bold, radical, and most importantly: destined to return in Rocket League Season 13! Get ready for reminiscent nights at Mannfield—Season 13 kicks off December 6.

Here’s the 4-1-1 on this Season’s Rocket Pass Premium. Upon purchase, you’ll auto-unlock the Ace Car Body. Go up the Tiers to unlock other new items like the RC Antenna, CRT Wheels, Primo Car Body, yadda yadda yadda…

title: Ragnarock: Jonathan Young Raid
description: The Jonathan Young Raid DLC is the latest major update to the 2021 rhythm game. It follows June's Sabaton Raid which added six new tracks from the Swedish band like Seven Pillars of Wisdom and Night Witches.

title: Ironna Hito ga Iru
description: CD-ROM-based edutainment title developed by Studio Harz

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Janet Cage Kameo
description: Announced for the Mortal Kombat 1: Kombat Pack, Janet Cage is a gender swapped version of Johnny Cage from an alternative timeline that is being added as a Kameo Fighter. The character appears during the final chapter of the story mode in cutscenes and as an opponent for some characters.

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Khameleon Kameo
description:
Announced for the Mortal Kombat 1: Kombat Pack, Khameleon is returning as a Kameo Fighter and was previously playable in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon as an exclusive character for the Nintendo Wii version.

She was introduced to the series in the Nintendo 64 version of Mortal Kombat Trilogy as a secret character with the abilities of all female ninja characters in the game. A male version called Chameleon was officially introduced on the other platform versions of the game with most of the abilities of all male ninja characters.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Starbound Painter
description:
Version 7.1 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the conclusion of Part 1.5 of the main story, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Cosmic Expression (Griseo)
• New Story Chapter XLII: Earthbound Order
• New Featured Event: Starry Voyage: Strike Back!
• UI Overhaul
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Outworld Traveler
description:
Version 4.9 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the conclusion of the Remaining Flames arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Prinzessin der Verurteilung! (Fischl)
• New Story Chapter XXV: Set Tomorrow Ablaze
• New Animated Short: Everlasting Flames
• New Featured Event: Outworld Quest (Genshin Impact Crossover)
• ...and more!

title: Anchor Panic
description: In 2085, Taino star was invaded by the alien race "Shogel", and mankind encountered an unprecedented crisis. They wanton destruction, infection, assimilation, parasitism, human civilization is facing unprecedented crisis. The infection of fission bodies, the threat of new humans, the conspiracy of ancient alchemists, a series of problems are intertwined at the same time, where should the fate of mankind go?

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: The Phantom of the Theater
description:
Version 4.8 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Starchasm Nyx (Seele)
• New Story Chapter XXIV: The Legion Theater
• New Featured Event: Stan Wars!
• ...and more!

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Ferra Kameo
description:
Ferra, the small but nimble barbarian of Outworld, returns to the Mortal Kombat Universe. Despite not having her usual partner, she wont hesitate to make you her mount.

Purchase this pack and receive Ferra as a Kameo Character to assist you in fight.

title: Let's Find Larry!
description: While taking a stroll through the park you bump into your old bestest buddy from high school, Larry! Unfortunately for you he is very busy... Try to find him so you can say HI!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Hacked
description:
Version 4.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of the Everlasting Flames arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Haxxor Bunny (Bronie)
• New Story Chapter XXIII: The Solo Stage
• New Featured Event: Arc: Light Bound
• ...and more!

title: The Amazing World of Gumball: Fellowship of the Things
description:
In the Fellowship of the Things game, The Wattersons have to battle some ghosts and monsters in a chase after their stolen belongings. While Tobias was teaching Gumball some fighting moves, the phone rang. A scary voice lets the Wattersons know that their missing stuff is in the cemetery. They have to take their electronics back before their mother arrives home! Can you give them a hand?

Your role is to help Gumball and Darwin defeat the enemies that took their stolen objects and restore them to their place. You will be given clues on what you should do. All you need to do is make sure to follow the instructions carefully. Are you ready for a spooky adventure with the Wattersons?

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: A Rift in Time - Chapter 2: The Spark of Imagination
description: The second of 3 chapters of the "A Rift in Time" expansion pack for Disney Dreamlight Valley. Explore Ancient's Landing to uncover more of its secrets and befriend a very lucky villager.

title: The Fan Game: Back to the Future - Part IV: The Multitasking Crystal
The Fan Game: Back to the Future - Part V: Multidimensional Space-Timelines
Newly Wed AV Debut - Cuckoldry Honeymoon-
description:
Shion was the beautiful, tidy bride of a happy protagonist.
But on their honeymoon, she got plucked from his embrace in more ways than one!
In an instant, she fell from loving pure wife to filthy porn slut.

title: God of Stickfights
description: God of Stickfights is a rogue-like, multiplayer stickman game and extreme overpowered real-time fighter. Have fun and outsmart your opponents. Selection by Selection. Be a God and destroy everything in your path. Evolve during battles and feel like in a stickman animation.

title: OG Memory: Kira Maus
description: OG Memory: Kira Maus is an casual memory game with cute dog images. You have to find all of the correct pairs to complete the game. your best round will be count and always be displayed in game, to compare your rounds. try to reduce your turns every game and set up your new record.

title: OG Puzzlers: Fall 2K23
description: OG Puzzlers: Fall 2K23 is an casual puzzel game stunning images of coloured leafs made in fall 2023. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Sling-A-Thing
description: Sling-A-Thing is a mind-boggling comedy action puzzler. Throw and transform into an extreme variety of cartoon characters and objects to find your way to the exit.

title: Urban Chase
description: "Urban Chase" immerses players in a lively city chase between police and mischievous thieves. In this whimsical world, players take on the role of a police officer, engaging in thrilling pursuits to apprehend playful troublemakers.

title: Ectoplasm
description: Step into the chilling world of paranormal investigation. Gather crucial information from a haunted location using specialized equipment, all while staying one step ahead of the ghost. Experience the psychological horror alone or in a team of up to 4 players.

title: Beyond the Curtains
description: "Beyound the Curtains" is a tranquil and relaxing game of casually gazing out the window, longing to witness interesting events and surprises. Additionally, the interior of the room will change over time, which may reveal some personal information about the one viewing through the window...?

title: Night Feed
description:
From the depths of the 1920’s comes this summer’s most petrifying tale! Come and see the story of a man lost in the jagged streets of a cursed city and feel the dread of being preyed by an unknown beast! “There are hidden things that roam the dark corners of this city, I pray for a safe return to my wife. May God have me if not.” Will he come back home to his wife after a high-class feast? Or will he succumb to the darkness that awaits him in the night? Only your blood will know the answer…

Inspired by “The Cabinet of Dr.Caligari” and other silent movies. Our submission for the Haunted PS1 Summers Of Screams Jam.

title: Gallery of Things: Reveries
description: Explore nature and tech through Dada-inspired hidden object puzzles.

title: Don't Text and Drive
description: Don't Text and Drive is a challenging single-player horror game where you text for help as you are driving.

title: Kill Santa
description: Santa has been a naughty fellow this year. Kill him and his helpers before things get out of hand!

title: Some Goodbyes We Made
description: I have some memories of saying goodbye that I don't want to forget, so I turned them into 11 minigames and backed them up in this collection.

title: Containment Zones
description: Position yourself, attack random hordes of enemies, don't be cornered. Keep the containment zones under control, keep the Structure alive.

title: Mirror Throne: Auto Battler
description: Assemble a party and master synergies in this Roguelite Auto Battler. Strategically place units and combine their unique abilities to defeat the Mirrored Legion. With game changing trinkets, events, and treasures, no two runs are the same. Adapt and evolve on your quest to reclaim the Mirror Throne!

title: Skeleton Rebellion
description: A turn-based RPG about a skeleton who sets out to take back an unjust, institutionalized mage tower, with the help of some fairly likely allies.

title: Ooga
description: Help Ooga to retrieve his stolen food stockpile in this fast-paced, spear-based parkour platformer. Play the first world and a half in the free demo, secrets included!

title: Super Retro BoxBot
description: 1990s-style puzzle gameplay inspired by the DOS classics Block-man and Loader Larry, Super Retro BoxBot is sure to entertain and challenge you through its hand-crafted levels! You can also create your very own challenges with the included level editor! Put your puzzle-solving skills to the test!

title: Tiny Hero Idle
description: "Tiny Hero Idle": An Idle RPG on PC that allows simultaneous play with other games. Join a unique adventure with daily rewards and cool actions

title: Shooting Donut
description: "Shooting Donut" is an addictive puzzle game with 100 diverse stages, where you shoot donuts to break blocks. Utilize 4 items strategically for precise aiming and level clearance.

title: Homebrew32
description: Drawn into your PC by a mysterious antivirus, control a 1-5 barrel tank. Navigate the motherboard, defeating boss viruses to unlock new zones. The 'UPGRADE MACHINE' grants enhancements every 1-10 seconds. Use points from previous runs to upgrade it and gain an edge.

title: Night Raider
description: Night Raider is a thrilling adventure exploration shooter game. Players need to carry weapons into the city occupied by zombies, as far as possible in various buildings to collect necessary supplies, evacuate alive to bring supplies back to the camp. But you have to face are not just zombies...

title: Super Cloud Fight
description: Super Cloud Fight elevates aerial combat to new heights! Engage in thrilling dogfights, unleash epic maneuvers from your biplane in a sky-bound battleground. Dive into clouds for cover, seize power-ups, and dominate the skies to become the ultimate airborne champion!

title: Rogue Slime
description: Rogue Slime: An engaging isometric 2D roguelike adventure where you maneuver a slime character through dynamic dungeons, utilizing slime ball attacks and a variety of power-ups to overcome diverse enemies and evolving challenges.

title: Wizdom Academy
description: Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

title: Envelope
description: Envelope is a psychological thriller game that puts you in the shoes of an unfortunate soul who finds himself getting pushed to do something beyond anything he could possibly imagine.

title: Party Pirates
description: Party Pirates is a couch co-op game where players become clumsy pirates traveling from port to port, taking on dangerous foes and sea monsters along the way. Gather your crew, don an eyepatch, and do everything to keep your ship afloat!

title: Wild West Saloon
description: Howdy partner! In Wild West Saloon you manage and maintain your own saloon. Serve drinks, cook food, clean tables and most importantly keep your customers happy.

title: SysOps Saga
description: SysOps Saga is a simulation game that puts you in the shoes of a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), managing the intricate web of software, security, and hardware to keep digital systems running. Developed by a FAANG veteran, this game offers an immersive and educational experience for IT enthusiasts.

title: NanoApostle
description: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique "Destruction Point" system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.

title: Intruder Alert
description: Intruder Alert is an action-stealth 2D adventure combined with multiple other genres packed into a single game. Stealthily avoid other shapes, defeat them when necessary, and complete various tasks along your journey.

title: Psychiatrist Simulator 2
description: Take role as Dr. Smith, psychotherapist. Game consists of real people video recordings. Talk with them, treat, learn about psychology. Your choices have consequences, at the end you will see what happened in their life after meeting with you.

title: Merchant Isle
description: Ship wrecked on an island, establish your merchant empire from the ground up. Buy and sell items, negotiate prices, invest in businesses, and establish trade routes. Explore ancient ruins for high worth relics. Claw your way up to the top of the merchant guild!

title: OG Memory: Fall 2K23
description: OG Memory: Fall 2K23 is an casual memory game with stunning leafs images made in Fall 2023. You have to find all of the correct pairs to complete the game. try to reduce your turns every game and set up your new record.

title: Planecraft
description: Planecraft is a 2.5D Sandbox game. Build your settlement on the surface map where you grow crops and tend to your livestock or let your settlers do that for you. Explore multiple levels of dungeons below, the depper you go, the better the resources you can find.

title: Oil Coin
description: A game in which you need to explore new oil fields. For this you will have different ways, such as moles, geologists and so on. Build towers, oil storages, pump your production, improve buildings and warehouses. Hire workers, guards, fight off or buy off raiders. Buy new lands.

title: The Backrooms Regret
description: Are you prepared to survive in this hostile world? Uncover who you are and how you ended up in this dimension. But don't worry, the warm company that accompanies you will make your experience much "more pleasant". Oh, and good luck, you will need it.

title: Desert Kingdoms
description: Desert Kingdoms is a minimal real time strategy game. Protect your king and conquer the desert.

title: Orbius
description: Orbius is a suika-like, rogue-lite casual game where the goal is to get the highest score possible. As your score rises, you must select spells that make furthering the game more and more difficult. Will you master Orbius?

title: A Kingdom to Conquer
description: A Kingdom to Conquer is 2D tactical action RPG where you play as a weak monster, clawing your way up the food chain. Do what you must to survive. Fight. Bargain. Run. Evolve, lead armies, raid monasteries and conquer kingdoms...

title: Bubble Wrap
description: The simple and fun way to relax!

title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange
description: Set out on an adventurous journey, searching for capybaras with orange during both day and night in this exceptional hidden object game.

title: The Phoenix Protocol
description: The Phoenix Protocol is an action-roguelike game set in a cyberpunk world that is easy to learn but hard to master with a focus on complex mechanics with a lot of depth.

title: Bloody Knuckles Street Boxing
description: The Sweet Science Meets The STREETS!

title: Castle of Lord Velimir
description: Epic battle against encroaching darkness. It is a baby from Warcraft 3, Dark Souls and Super Mario bros. Don't ask, it was wild party.

title: Sonia no Daibouken: Mittsu no Hihou no Kakusareta Nazo!
I Keep Dying in Another World
description: Fantasy Murder Mystery Isekai Kinetic Novel featuring a variety of girls, comedy, despair, and deaths in an exciting story!

title: Journey to the Wand
description: "Journey to the Wand" is a delightful experience for those interested in platform games. The struggle to retrieve Elowen's wand will offer players a unique adventure, and the captivating story of the game will immerse players from beginning to end.

title: JK Puzzle
description: JK Puzzle, a very simple puzzle game.

title: Ycom
description: Have you ever wondered what is it like to be a elite snowballer? Well look no further Ycom is game for you.

title: Goi Survivors
description: Humans, dwarves, and elves exploring diverse landscapes and dungeons, they combine their unique abilities in trios to combat mythical creatures and uncover ancient relics, striving to aid the goddess to cleanse the realm of malevolent forces.

title: Sakura Succubus 8
description: The eighth part of the Sakura Succubus series is finally here! Join Hiroki and his loyal harem as they try to help Alice overcome her greatest challenge yet: trying to find a job.

title: Christmas Girls
description: It's Christmas time! Everyone is looking forward to it, including our girls! They have already put on their Christmas hats, so they are ready!

title: Separated Worlds
description: Go to the dungeons and find out where it leads. On the way you will meet a lot of creatures from different worlds. Maybe we should find out where they came from?

title: Mecha Break
description: Mecha Break is a multiplayer mech game that allows players to choose from diverse mechs, customize appearances, and battle colossal war machines on treacherous terrain. Get ready for the ultimate showdown—blitz, brawl, blaze!

title: Mallion
description: Play the game from the perspective of a traveler who comes to the dealer and is faced with numerous choices in a story prepared by the dealer. Experience a story that changes based on your choices and see the ending that changes based on your choices!

title: Sands of Salzaar: Land of the Eclipse
description: This DLC includes three expansion contents: "The Eclipse Hive", "Exotic Wayfarer", and "Siege and Conquest"; each can be loaded/removed independently in the game.

title: Super Liftpia
description: Pick up the enemy and throw it! This is an action game drawn with dots that gives you a nostalgic feel.

title: Girls of the Tower
description: This is a Rogue-like game with a combination of JRPG, auto chess, and galgame elements. Players can choose from two different female protagonists to embark on a unique adventure. Additionally, players can recruit followers, strategize their formations, and develop their town!

title: Cole Dingo's Vtuber Blackjack
description: You like streaming? You like blackjack? Cole Dingo's Vtuber BlackJack is a game where you can play blackjack on stream with your audience with you as the dealer!

title: Power Fantasy: Krampus Night
description: It's Krampus Night and Santas little helpers got corrupted. Help Santa Claus to end the curse and save Christmas!

title: Christmas Wonderland 14: Collector's Edition
description: Enjoy an exciting Christmas Wonderland and Happy Holidays in Springfield. Help Santa at his North Pole Workshops. Fly in his brand New Sleigh. Visit Santa's Amazing Virtual Reality Grotto. Take part making a Movie.

title: Shadow Gambit: Yuki's Wish
description: Yuki and Kuma from Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun return! Recruit them to your pirate crew, explore the enchanted Japanese island “Dragon's Dream”, and experience six new story missions. Will you solve the dragon's riddle and fulfill Yuki's wish?

title: Dream Sketcher: The Lost Opera
description: This DLC includes 1 new script The Lost Opera, 1 new investigator "Mercenary" Diana, and 30 new cards.

title: Shadow Gambit: Zagan's Ritual
description: "Zagan the Apostate" is inviting you to his ominous laboratory. Recruit the zealous scientist and former Inquisition member to your crew, set sail to an eldritch castle island and experience a new campaign. Will you unveil the secrets of the Inquisition's holy flame?

title: Let's Play Jigsaw Puzzles: Happy Holidays 2023
description: Spread the cheer and make this holiday season extra special in our winter wonderland!

title: Umbrella Girl
description: Umbrella Girl is a 2D belt-scroll action adventure game. You can enjoy various actions through the character's type transformation, and become the main character to free citizens from acid rain.

title: Phantom Girls: Ghostbuster
description: Immerse yourself in "Phantom Girls: Ghostbuster", an adult FPS horror game where sensuality meets horror. Go through explicit scenes and supernatural phenomena immersed in the story of a ghostbuster.

title: White Lilies Code
description: You’re an average electronic technician. You live in a big city. You’ve a lot of work. You’re tired so it’s high time to have a vacation. But… a chain of sudden events puts you in an incredible adventure.

title: Dude Simulator Six
description: Dude Simulator Six is an open world sandbox game. A mortal danger looms over humanity. The planet was invaded by representatives of a distant planetary system.

title: TryAndLove
description: A man's life is a life of pursuing love. The childish love of childhood sweethearts? White Moonlight's pure love? Ignorant of the astringent love of forbidden fruit? Blind love like a moth flying into a flame? True love that transcends the world? Act Ren Xing and make a willful choice.

title: Pok The Little Artiste
description: PC game by Living Media and Arborescence.

title: Planetary Taxi
description: Educational CD-ROM for Windows 3.1 and Macintosh.

title: Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew
description: "Journey of Realm: Dawn Dew" is a 2D story-based turn-based game developed by an individual. In the game, you will assume the role of "Dew", and encounter a variety of characters, confront the looming threat of the dark beasts, face the ultimate evil, and ultimately fight for goodness and freedom.

title: Epic Roller Coasters: SpongeBob SquarePants
description: Epic Roller Coasters and Nickelodeon bring you the most phenomenal roller coaster combo ever in the funniest place across the ocean.

title: Fighter Aircraft Race
description:
Epic Skyward Duels Await!

Dive into "Fighter Aircraft Race" – where high-speed aerial races meet thrilling local 2-player battles! Navigate treacherous skies, outmaneuver your rival, and flaunt your superior piloting prowess.

title: Six Minute Showdown
description: Six Minute Showdown is an unique DOOM II map by Vytaan featuring rhytmic elements. The map responds to the music's beat and will end at exactly six minutes, it requires quick reaction time as well as developed combat skills to keep up the pace.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 21
description: A new challenging Season of Ranked – Season 21 has arrived with this update.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 22
description: A new challenging Season of Ranked – Season 22 has arrived with this update.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 23
description: A new challenging Season of Ranked – Season 23 has arrived with this update.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 24
description: A new challenging Season of Ranked – Season 24 has arrived with this update.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 25
description: A new challenging Season of Ranked – Season 25 has arrived with this update.

title: PUBG: Battlegrounds - Season 26
description: A new challenging Season of Ranked – Season 26 has arrived with this update.

title: Project Chameleon
description: Project Chameleon is a stealth game where you must shape-shift into objects to go unnoticed by your enemies. Play as Siren, an elite spy executing missions around the globe. Manipulate your surroundings, set traps, and use powerful gadgets in each mission.

title: Hey Ma I'm a Dragon Now
description: A Single Player 2D Side-Scrolling pixel art Skill-Based Bullet-Hell Game where you kill various enemies and bosses to get coins to upgrade your character so you can beat more enemies and progressed further.

title: Newly-wedded Woman Stealing Life
description:
Yukino has a boyfriend named Makoto whom she promised to marry.
However, Makoto is a man from a good family and they refuse the marriage with Yukino.
Then, Makoto's uncle, Masao, comes up with a deal. He would arrange things to make the marriage possible if Yukino agreed to spend a night with him.
Yukino hesitantly accepts the condition.
However, it's the beginning of a devastating life...

title: Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons Remake
description: Guide two brothers on an epic journey of discovery, loss, adventure and mystery remade for the latest generation of graphics, performance, and gameplay. Play in single-player mode or local co-op with a friend. This is one journey you will never forget.

title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

title: The Rise of the Golden Idol
description: The Award-winning detective saga returns. Uncover the truth behind 20 strange cases of crime, death and depravity in the 1970s. The world has changed dramatically - the sins of humanity have not.

title: Usual June
description: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

title: Windblown
description: Brave the Vortex and dash your way to greatness in this lightning-fast action roguelike from the creators of Dead Cells. Alone or in coop, become the ultimate killing machine as you enhance your skills and master your weapons in search of that perfect run.

title: Thrasher
description: Thrasher is a mind-melting cosmic racer and an essential audiovisual experience. Swoop, dash and thrash across the void, taking on wild bosses in a race for survival that begins at the dawn of time.

title: Dave the Diver: Dredge
description: Dave the Diver: Dredge is a DLC that adds content themed around the fishing horror role-playing adventure game Dredge.

title: World of Goo 2
description: Use living liquid creatures to build bridges, grow towers, terraform terrain, and fuel flying machines. The world is beautiful, dangerous, and evolving.

title: God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla
description: God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla is a free DLC that introduces a new mode that uses elements of the roguelite genre. Players progress through a series of trials set in procedurally generated levels, where they must choose a relic, shield, and rage ability for each trial run. After completing a challenge within a trial, players can opt for upgrading their weapon, relic, or stats, but these enhancements only apply to that specific trial run. Each run and the completion of specific gameplay challenges unlock permanent rewards. If a player dies, they restart the trial from the beginning. The downloadable content (DLC) also introduces new enemies, including new and familiar ones from the Greek era games like cyclopes and minotaurs.

title: Big Walk
description: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

title: Kemuri
description: Kemuri summons you into a realm where the unpredictable meets the extraordinary in an urban jungle where mysterious creatures - Yokai- hide amongst the population. Become a Yokai Hunter and use your Fox Window to unravel the mysteries of the city and bring balance to the world. Dive into a thrilling adventure alone or with friends, hunt yokai in style, collect their powers and face even greater challenges.

title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance
description: Slay the enemies in the silence of the moment. Run through the world of Shinobi full of monsters and ninja actions. Grab Oborozuki, the legendary sword, and slay evil once more. Your clan and the world are counting on you.

title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
description:
It's time for crazy driving, crazy adventure, and crazy money! Crazy Taxi is back and going global!

In this new high-octane adventure, follow Axel as he chases down the mysterious masked villains who stole his beloved taxi. Tackle extreme missions around the world all while earning some CRAZY money!

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
description: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball!

title: The Casting of Frank Stone
description: The shadow of Frank Stone looms over Cedar Hills, a town forever altered by his violent past. As a group of young friends are about to discover, Stone’s blood-soaked legacy cuts deep, leaving scars across families, generations, and the very fabric of reality itself.

title: Visions of Mana
description: For the first time in over 15 years, a brand-new entry in the mainline Mana series arrives! Embark on a new adventure with Val, the newly appointed soul guard, as he sets off on a journey across the world to accompany his friend on her pilgrimage to the Tree of Mana. Experience action-packed gameplay and explore a vibrant semi-open 3D field, encountering fearsome foes and unlikely allies along the way.

title: Tales of Kenzera: Zau
description: Tales of Kenzera: Zau is a 2.5D metroidvania developed by Surgent Studios and published under the EA Originals label. The game follows Zau, a young shaman who bargains with Kalunga, the God of Death, to revive his father. Players explore the mythological lands of Kenzera, using Zau's athletic abilities—such as double jumping, wall jumping, and air dashing—to traverse the environment. Equipped with the sun mask for melee attacks and the moon mask for ranged combat, Zau can upgrade both weapons along distinct paths. As players gain new skills, they unlock previously inaccessible areas, progressing through a world filled with ancestral spirits and powerful monsters.

title: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage
description: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage is a brand-new story-driven journey through time from the creative minds behind Life is Strange. The magical summer of 1995 is one of self-discovery and forging unbreakable bonds for high school friends Swann, Nora, Autumn, and Kat. 27 years of no contact later, fate reunites them to confront the long-buried secret that made them promise to never speak again.

title: The First Berserker: Khazan
description: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pelos empire, whom overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Crown of the Mundane and Divine
description:
Version 1.6 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Ruan Mei, Dr. Ratio and Xueyi
• New area: Herta Space Station - Seclusion Zone
• New Forgotten Hall stages
• Simulated Universe update
• New event: Pure Fiction
• …and more!

title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III - Season 1
description: Prepare for an incredible Season 1, bringing a massive drop of free and premium content, including five free weapons, four new Multiplayer maps, multiple modes, the next Zombies story mission, the arrival and integration of Call of Duty: Warzone and the new Urzikstan map, an all-new 100+ Tiers of Battle Pass content to earn, BlackCell, and more.

title: Marvel's Blade
description: In Marvel’s Blade, Eric Brooks is the legendary Daywalker, half-man, half-vampire torn between the warm society of the living and the rushing power of the undead. From Bethesda and Arkane Lyon, Marvel’s Blade is a mature, single-player, third-person game set in the heart of Paris, now in development in collaboration with Marvel Games.

title: GTFO: The Final Chapter
description: Bringing the story of the four prisoners to an end in the most GTFO way possible. This time is different/same. The right/wrong place with the wrong/right people. How low/high will you/they go before you start/stop following orders? This is the end/beginning.

title: Den of Wolves
description: Den of Wolves is a co-op heist FPS from the creator of Payday: The Heist, Payday 2 and GTFO. In this techno-thriller you and your friends operate as criminals for hire in the conflicts between rival corporations in Midway City. Gather your crew, design the plan, gear up and execute the heist.

title: Exoborne
description: Exoborne is an open-world, tactical extraction shooter set in a world torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Customize powerful exo-rigs to gain strategic advantage in ever-changing weather conditions. Face hostile factions, enemy players, and Mother Nature herself in intense high-stakes sessions.

title: The Two Towers
description:
The Two Towers MUD is a free Multiplayer Online Roleplaying Game set entirely within Tolkien's world of Middle-earth, at the time of 'Lord of the Rings'. We have extensively re-created the lands of Middle-earth in a rich text environment, from Mithlond to Mordor and the lands of Harad beyond. With over 100,000 rooms and always growing, The Two Towers is a richly developed and highly interactive world. There are hundreds of quests, with rewards great and small, for you to discover.

The Two Towers has an active community of players from around the world who come together to play online. Players join together to create guilds, raid enemy lands, and more.

Online continuously since 1994, The Two Towers is one of the longest running multiplayer games on the internet and is maintained by a staff of hardworking volunteers who love Tolkien and multiplayer gaming.

title: Light No Fire
description: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

title: Guilty Gear: Strive - Additional Character 11: Elphelt Valentine
description: Elphelt is joining Guilty Gear: Strive!

title: Final Fantasy XVI: Echoes of the Fallen
description: Echoes of the Fallen is the first DLC of Final Fantasy XVI, which unlocks a whole new story, battles, weapons, accessories, level cap and more. For players who have completed the required quests, this new adventure begins before the base game’s final battle, as strange, dark crystals begin to circulate on the black market. Players will follow Clive and his friends during their investigations as they encounter a group of suspicious traders, leading them to a long-abandoned Fallen tower known as the Sagespire. There, they will unravel the terrible secrets that await within.

title: Final Fantasy XVI: The Rising Tide
description: The Rising Tide is the second DLC for Final Fantasy XVI, which will bring new challenges, new locations and more, including the confrontation between Clive and the legendary Eikon, Leviathan.

title: The Finals: Season 1
description:
Season 1 was the first season of THE FINALS. It launched along with the game on December 7, 2023, and ended three months later on March 14, 2024.

This season was sponsored by HOLTOW and VOLPE, featuring an all-new arena: Las Vegas.

New content introduced in Season 1 includes:
- Arena: Las Vegas
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapon: Throwing Knives
- Gadget: Vanishing Bomb
- Game show event: Alien Invasion
- Progression: New career levels

title: Baldur's Gate 3: Deluxe Edition
description:
The multi-award winning RPG Baldur’s Gate 3 released to the mortal plane.
Fill your mantelpiece with feelies while you fill your heart with adventure.
Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in a tale of fellowship and betrayal, sacrifice and survival, and the lure of absolute power. Mysterious abilities are awakening inside you, drawn from a mind flayer parasite planted in your brain. Resist, and turn darkness against itself. Or embrace corruption, and become ultimate evil. Choose from 12 classes and 11 races from the D&D Player's Handbook and create your own identity, or play as an Origin hero with a hand-crafted background. Or tangle with your inner corruption as the Dark Urge, a fully customisable Origin hero with its own unique mechanics and story. Whoever you choose to be, adventure, loot, battle and romance your way across the Forgotten Realms and beyond. Gather your party. Take the adventure online as a party of up to four.

title: Monster Hunter Wilds
description: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

title: Final Fantasy XVI Expansion Pass
description: The Expansion Pass set includes Final Fantasy XVI DLC “Echoes of the Fallen” and “The Rising Tide” at a discounted price.

title: HaremRoid VR
description:
You can interact with up to three characters at once. Create the harem of your dreams!
You can place files in the VRM folder to play with any character that you want, even ones not in the game already!
Animation, expressions, voice work, arrangement — it’s all up to you!

title: VR Room: The Flintstones
description: A recreation of the 1994 pinball game The Flintstones for Visual Pinball VR.

title: Undertale: No More Deals
description: A fanmade continuation of the Undertale genocide route, featuring a boss battle against Chara.

title: LEGO Fortnite: Odyssey
description:
Explore vast, open worlds where the magic of LEGO building and Fortnite collide.
​​​​Collect food and resources, craft items​, build shelter and battle enemies solo or​ team up​ with up to seven friends.

​Get creative in building and ​customizing​​​ your ultimate home base​ using LEGO elements collected from the world around you​, then recruit villagers to gather materials and help survive the night. Gear up and drop into deep caves in search of rare resources and hidden areas.

Find the ultimate survival crafting LEGO adventure in Fortnite! The journey is only just beginning with new world building, gameplay features, and more LEGO Style Outfits arriving in updates starting early 2024.

title: 25°N 71°W Remastered
description: 25°N 71°W, Bermuda Triangle: An airplane is on its way to America. Suddenly the engines fail. At the end of the day there's a lone survivor: you, stranded on a desert island. Welcome to 25°N 71°W - a survival game where you have to mine, craft and build - to survive somehow! Remastered 2023.

title: Level Devil
description: Level Devil is a platformer with a mean twist. The goal is simple; get to the door at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it may seem... Holes can show up out of nowhere, spikes can move unexpectedly and ceilings can fall down on you as you make your way through the many different levels. One wrong step and it's game over. You'll have to keep your wits about you, expect the unexpected and most importantly: don't get angry. Can you make it through these hellish levels and beat Level Devil?

title: Purah's Lab
description:
Purah is waiting for you!!
Her lab is a mess and everybody is busy to help her to finish her experiment...

A machine that can detect all your most sensible points of your body and make you explode in a pleasure that no human can give you.

That's why Purah needs you to pass her the items to build the machine in the shortest time possible and without any mistakes or the energy used in the machine will be overloaded and horrible things could happen...

title: Rocket Racing
description: From the developers of Rocket League comes Rocket Racing, a supersonic arcade racer that lets you drift, fly, and boost your way to the finish in a rocket-powered car! Climb the ranks and test your skills in Ranked or pull up to Casual Racing and enjoy the thrill of racing without high stakes. Want to race against the clock? Drop into Speed Run and put your best time on the leaderboard.

title: Shotgun Shenanigans
description: A multiplayer FPS sports game

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Unequaled, Unrivaled
description:
Version 4.6 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Sentience (Fu Hua)
• New Featured Event: Once Upon a Time in Shenzhou
• ...and more!

title: Texting the Awkward Ace Guy You've Had a Crush on Since High School
description: It's tough having a crush. Especially when that crush is on your best friend. And especially when that crush lasts five, ten years! But it's OK—you can text him! Who knows, maybe he'll finally figure out what you've been unable to say these many years. Or, you'll just annoy him! Either way.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Blazing Hope
description:
Version 4.5 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the conclusion of the Taixuan Dream arc, which includes:
• Neon Genesis Evangelion Collaboration
• New Valkyrie: Blazing Hope (Asuka)
• New Story Chapter XXII: Me and Myself
• New Animated Short: Shattered Samsara
• New Featured Event: New Century
• ...and more!

description:
Version 4.4 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Dea Anchora (Durandal)
• New Story Chapter XXI: Wings of Reawakening
• New Featured Event: Stellar Mythos
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Rhythms of Neon
description:
Version 4.3 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of the Taixuan Dream arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie Augment Core: Fervent Tempo Δ (Rozaliya)
• New ELF: Tesla ZERO
• New Story Chapter XX: Immortal Phoenix
• New Featured Event: Honkai Quest
• ...and more!

title: Birdo's Holiday Brawl
description: Take control of Birdo to rescue her friends from Wart and the Eight Bits before the Subcon Holidays!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Rosemary's Nocturne
description:
Version 4.2 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the conclusion of the Here Lies Bellflower arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Fallen Rosemary (Rita)
• New Valkyrie Augment Core: Danzai Spectramancer (Raiden Mei)
• New Story Chapter XIX: Into Earth Does the Water Flow
• New Battlesuit Event: Rosemary's Floriograph
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: As Thunders Filled the Sky
description:
Version 4.1 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of the Here Lies Bellflower arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Herrscher of Thunder (Raiden Mei)
• New ELF: Bella
• New Story Chapter XVIII: From Beds of Everlasting Snow
• New Featured Event: Gemina Invasions - Deep Paradise Arc
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Lone Stargazer
description:
Version 4.0 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the conclusion of the Elegy to Yesterday arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Starlit Astrologos (Theresa)
• New Story Chapter XVII: Thunders over Nagazora
• New Animated Short: Lament of the Fallen
• New Battlesuit Event: The Day You Vanished with the Stars
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Starlit Sanctum
description:
Version 3.9 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Bright Knight Excelsis (Durandal)
• New Story Chapter XVI: Imminent Storm
• New Featured Event: Honkai Kingdoms: ZERO
• A Post-Honkai Odyssey Continuation
• ...and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Dawn of Glory
description:
Version 3.8 of Honkai Impact 3rd, marking the beginning of the Elegy to Yesterday arc, which includes:
• New Valkyrie: Valkyrie Gloria (Durandal)
• New Story Chapter XV: The Prodigal Girl Returns
• New Open World: A Post-Honkai Odyssey
• New Featured Event: Cybernet Havens
• ...and more!

title: Nadine in: Diamond in the Grave
description: Nadine in: Diamond in the Grave is a short Halloween special side game of Prototype N! Featuring returning new and old enemies along with all brand new six levels and a major boss fight.

title: Tony Hawk's Sonic McOrigins Plus Christmas
description: Tony Hawk's Sonic McOrigins Plus Christmas is an update for Sonic McOrigins, which includes the ESPN reskins of the 2004 games, featuring everyone's favorite Sonic characters: Tony Hawk, Vince Carter, and more!

title: Team Slay-Bells
description: Team Slay-Bells is about a reindeer named Charlotte and her friends, who are trying to help their home planet Kringlaus.

title: Mega Man Y+1: Operation X.M.A.S.
description: Mega Man Y+1: Operation X.M.A.S. is a bite-sized Mega Man adventure to save Christmas! Featuring 9 unique stages, you'll be taken to all sorts of locales in the hunt for your misplaced belongings. With fortresses made of gingerbread, summery beaches south of the equator, and even Dr. Wily's own chimney, there's no telling where you'll need to go. Don't dawdle, though - these levels don't pull any punches, and you've got time trial records to beat! Aim for gold!

title: Babies Dream of Dead Worlds
description:
What do babies dream about when they’re too young to remember?

Before we have memory, before we know what this world is, we dream. Babies dream of what came before, of universes that are no longer there. Babies dream of dead worlds.

title: Anime Spa
description: Anime Spa is a game where you own a spa. You recruit girls and have them work in order to satisfy the otakus who come to be relaxed or for other kinds of services. There are four girls to recruit: Chihaya, Nami, Tsunade, Chika, and Hayasaka. It has over 50 different animations and gameplay you will see nowhere else.

title: Sonic Drift 16-Bit
description: Get ready to race with Sonic Drift 16-bit, the electrifying Genesis-style kart racer brought to you by the creators of Sonic Triple Trouble 16-bit! This bold Game Gear reimagining speeds its way into the spotlight, delivering an exhilarating "best-of" the Sonic Drift series in a vibrant, revamped form!

title: Frackin' Universe
description: Frackin' Universe (FU) is a continuously evolving mod for Starbound, amplifying the game in numerous ways since the inception of modding. It enhances nearly every element of the base game, introducing fresh mechanics and content, spanning from new mission, biomes, planets, an extensively revamped crafting system, science, research, monsters, tiles, and a plethora of other in-game assets.

title: Fortnite Festival
description: Play in a band with friends or perform solo on stage with hit music by your favorite artists in Fortnite Festival! On the Main Stage, play a featured rotation of Jam Tracks. Compete against friends for the best performance or team up to climb the leaderboards. The festival is just beginning with more Jam Tracks, Music Icons, concerts, and stages coming soon. Take your stage in Fortnite Festival!

title: Bracket Chain
description:
An action-packed adventure where you dash, grab, and fling your way through a variety of stages!
Follow the robot Bracket as he ventures out of his technology-driven home realm and into Alastair, a mysterious new realm governed exclusively by magic. Meet determined allies, heartfelt villagers, zany goons, and dangerous villains.

title: House spirit cat
description: Kot-Domovoy is a visual novel with interactive features. It’s a story about a kind spirit of a house in the shape of a cat who is searching for a new owner. Will it find a new home or a place of despair? You are to choose.

title: SCP: Rulebreaker
description: Dive into the heart of horror with this survival game inspired by the mysterious SCP Foundation. After the opening of Site 1730, once the stronghold of the Foundation, chaos has erupted. All sites, except Sites 15 and 19, have been abandoned, converging towards Complex 1730. An unprecedented concentration of anomalies released during a containment breach has left the complex in a state of desolation. Step into the shoes of a Foundation guard, facing the ultimate survival challenge as the horrors of anomalies threaten to engulf everything.

title: Eviternity II
description:
Eviternity II is a 37-level megawad for Doom II using MBF21-compatible source ports, created by a team lead by Joshua O'Sullivan (Dragonfly). It was released on December 10, 2023, the 30th anniversary of Doom's release and the 5th anniversary of the original Eviternity. Making extensive use of a newly updated build of the OTEX texture pack (to be released as a standalone texture pack in the future), Eviternity II’s six chapters explore a series of unique and varied themes, continuing on from where you left off after the Archangelus’ defeat!

The 37 maps are split in six episodes that each have five regular maps and one secret map, plus one credit map.

title: A War On Christmas: Part 2
description: A War On Christmas: Part 2 is a 12 map sequel to last year's Christmas rampage. Featuring the things you loved about the original and much, much more!

title: Holiday Hits
description: Holiday Hits is a limit-removing set of 7 small simple DOOM 2 maps that uses Arsinikk's 2023 updated version of the classic Doom X-Mas pack.

title: Terminal Voltage
description: Terminal Voltage is a new episode of electric maps for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports made by various members of Doomer Boards, lead by 40oz.

title: Crush Crush: - 18+ Naughty
description: This DLC installs a new mode in your Crush Crush game that allows you to play an uncensored hentai (adult) version of the game. New artwork is included, with beautiful high-resolution illustrations and sexy scenes. The DLC also includes the “lingerie” and “birthday suit” outfits.

title: Metal: Hellsinger - Complete Edition
description: Dig your claws into the complete Metal: Hellsinger experience with the base game and all DLCs, containing more original and licensed music, new weapons, and new outfits.

title: Toree Jolly Jam
description: Toree Jolly Jam is a short little, speed based, one level 3D Platformer, in a wintery holiday coating, that rewards the player with certain goodies. Finishing the level will grant the player several bonus "presents" to choose from, containing different surprises. These could be anything from new characters (or multiple characters at once!) to completely different minigames. There is even an old fashioned retro styled "sound test" hidden in there somewhere (as pointless as it might be nowadays).

title: Reverse 1999: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
description:
Version 1.1 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Melania, Pickles, and Diggers
• New Garments for Regulus, Centurion, and APPLe
• New main event: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
• …and more!

title: Reverse 1999: A Nightmare at Green Lake
description:
Version 1.2 of Reverse: 1999, which includes:
• New characters: Tooth Fairy, Jessica, Blonney, and Horropedia
• New Garments for X, Sotheby, Bkornblume, and Eagle
• New main event: A Nightmare At Green Lake
• …and more!

title: ErMa: Early Mammal
description: A mysterious force has set up shop in the distant past, and is doing everything in its power to ensure reptiles - particularly, dinosaurs - remain the planet's dominant life for good. Erma is our completely unwitting heroine, and it's your job to help her help us!

title: Headmaster Disaster
description: It's a new school year at Sawfish High School, but with the entrance of a mysterious new principal, it's no longer ordinary. Teachers are acting strangely and students are ferocious and feral. Follow Hazel and Petros as they not only fight for their grades but also their minds and uncover secrets about their world's past. But remember, there's no homework, that is... because you may never come home.

title: Tech-Panic
description: Tasked with collecting presents, the goofy little robot boy is back and ready to do his best.

title: Occultryx: Beast of Nocturne
description: Occultryx: Beast of Nocturne is a story that follows the Bounty Hunter H-13 "Dysis" Hunting down a rival and elusive bounty. A werewolf master of combat who has taken over a mysterious facility on the planet Stygia. The nearby city and surrounding areas have been infected with the wolf's curse. It's Dysis' job to wade through the the creatures, hazards, and minions to track down her bounty!

title: Mother Mixup!
description:
Eric from Business of Loving gets a bit lost on his way back from work, and ends up in an interesting place... Welcome to Fertile Grove!

Stephanie is nice enough to give him a little shelter for the night, but her hospitality comes with a little more than just a bed to sleep in...

Play this crossover mini game by Dead-End and Fulvi!

With 4 scenes, enjoy this crossover special combining Business of Loving & Fertile Grove.

title: OnlyFap Simulator
description: OnlyFap Simulator is a casual clicker adult game that looks like a popular social media.You should help main character to earn enough money to make a post. After each level an amount of post becomes higher, and you need to hire manager and do analytics to build a huge fan base

title: Sonic: Lock & Load
description:
Sonic: Lock & Load is a hyper-fast stylish action first-person shooter based on the Sonic the Hedgehog series of games and built on GZDoom.

It's heavily inspired by the high-speed platforming of Sonic Robo Blast 2, the heavily movement-based FPS gameplay of ULTRAKILL and the stylish action of Devil May Cry.

title: Normal Super Mario Bros. DX
description: An enhanced port of Normal Super Mario Bros.

title: Normal Super Mario Bros. 2 DX
description: An enhanced port of Normal Super Mario Bros. 2.

title: Normal Super Mario Bros. Trilogy DX
description:
Normal Super Mario Bros. is a series of fangames created by gamester and released for PC. Trilogy DX is a port of the original games, with enhanced features, making the games available in other platforms.

The first the was released in December 2023, with the first game 99% and the second about 60% complete. The third game wasn't available yet.

title: Zoo Tycoon 2: Forgotten Animals
description: A Zoo Tycoon 2 mod pack focused on animals from the first Zoo Tycoon game that didn’t appear in the sequel.

title: Zoo Tycoon: Dinosaur Digs - No Grass, Please!
description: A mod to the Dinosaur Digs expansion of Zoo Tycoon that makes changes to the animals featured, and even adds in 4 new ones.

title: Pee Pee Bon Bon: Qusumi Masayuki No Appare Characters 100
A Posteriori
description: An experience where you traverse through a fever dream.

title: Silly Employee
description: It is now the school break period. Arata, a high school student, decides to apply to be an employee at the (suspicious) café.

title: Sweet Skullvivors
description: Unleash the power of Mexican food to survive the hordes of hungry Alebrijes. Make the most colorful and delicious Ofrenda the world has ever seen.

title: Isaac Asimov's The Ultimate Robot
description: Interactive encyclopedia on Isaac Asimov and his theories of robotics. The program features video clips, robot schematics, encyclopedic information and other interesting stuff as well as clips of Asimov talking about the future of robots.

title: Pesterquest Rewritten
description: A fanmade rewrite of Homestuck - Pesterquest!

The Eye of Typhoon: Tsunami Edition/Saiki

description: "Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat" is a simulation game set in a school. Interact with the girls and gain their love. You must then offer that love to the devil you love.

title: Muzy
description: Explore the mystery behind a once-loved and hugely popular children's toy, also known as Muzy, in this terrifying horror adventure game. Several reports detail frightening incidents connected to accidents. Your job is to solve the puzzles and find the cause of these unsettling occurrences.

description: Build and manage multiple colonies on different planets. Heavy focus on mining and industry, and setting up automated cargo transport between colonies. Also there are mysterious alien drones that will attack you, so you'll need some weapons to fight them off.

Inspired from movement shooters, stealth games and ninja culture. Different terrains and settlements will let you carve various approach to enemy territories.

description: Climb from the Earth to the Moon to try and solve an urban legend! Brave tough challenges as you float and grapple your way up to the tune of a great soundtrack! Be sure to bring a space suit, and get climbing!

The Digital Deluxe Edition upgrade content includes in-game cosmetics, such as a unique custom dice skin to show off to your friends, as well as practical in-game items such as the Mask of the Shapeshifter from Divinity: Original Sin 2.

Listen to the magical music of Borislav Slavov’s Original Soundtrack for Baldur’s Gate 3 or even pick up a pen and play D&D as one of our Origin characters with the handy printable pre-made character sheets. There’s plenty to get stuck into, in and outside of the game.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Deluxe Edition
description: THE FIRST CLASSIC CRPG IN THE WARHAMMER 40,000 UNIVERSE

title: Runner
description: A speedrunning platformer. Run, jump, and slide to the top of the leaderboards.

title: Elf Shield

description: Curse Seal Rotation is a rougelike card game. You will play a warrior to defeat invaders one after another. On this difficult road, you will encounter various monsters and elites. Please become as strong as possible to defeat them.

title: BadDool

Build a deck of cards by exploring a dungeon and use your cards to kill enemies and gain more exciting cards! Make friends by helping them out or challenge them to a DOOL to kill them for their loot.

title: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
description:
Rooftops & Alleys is more than just a game about Parkour & Freerunning. It’s the adrenaline rush of landing an impossible trick combo, defying gravity, and feeling like you’re flying… until you crash face-first into a dark alley 30 meters below.

In solo or with your friends, explore in total freedom massive-parkour-ready maps. Reach every corner of your playground to uncover hidden spots — time trials, trick challenges, and more! In multiplayer, dive into game modes like TAG, Capture the Flag, Trick Battles, or simply freeroam with your friends!

description: In this fast and demanding game, the player must demonstrate mastery to managing his skills, in order to beat the world record. The gameplay is geared so that players can challenge each other.

description: The Snare is a single-player crime and horror game. Atlas follows clues sent by the killer to rescue his wife Samira. While trying to find out the reason for Samira's kidnapping, he encounters surprising facts.

title: Notes To Myself
description: The horror began when you wrote your first note.

Choose your hero, explore the program-generated card dungeon, collect resources, kill enemies, combine and match active skills with various special-effect artifacts, make rational use of various props and buffs, move to the next floor, and finally win the victory!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: VTBS Airport
description: Suvarnabhumi International Airport is the primary airport serving Bangkok, Thailand.Pronounced “su-wan-na-poom” meaning 'The Golden Land', it is one of the largest and busiest airports in Southeast Asia and is a major cargo air freight hub for the region.

You will have to survive 3 nights using different methods to defeat the aliens including a flashlight, turning power on/off, and closing your eyes (pretend to sleep).

description: "Get ready for a game-changing experience as Zen Studios partners up with Asmodee to bring you three tables based on the best tabletop games. Step into a new realm of pinball, and remember, just like with the dice, a single flip can change everything. "

description: This is a game about repetition and never ending failure, face the unknown road ahead, failure is inevitable, but "memory" will record this failure for you, help you to cross it next time, until "right".

description: Dragon Shelter is a farm sim set in a fantasy world. Take on the role of a hero who will revive the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Take care of wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and restore destroyed biomes!

Dorei Same

description:
Medieval Dynasty expands with Co-Op map for up to 4 players.

Medieval Dynasty's new co-operative map, The Oxbow, introduces a new exciting location that will also feature enigmatic characters, captivating landmarks and charming villages. Leading the way is Piastovia, the heart and soul of the Oxbow where your epic journey begins.

description:
The Book of the Dead: Lost Souls is immersed in a gloomy atmosphere of horror, which is overflowing with the storyline of the novel. The game is made in the genre of visual storytelling, in which you will observe the events of a young man named Charles and his wife Emily. The heroes inherit a mansion from their uncle, to which a young couple goes. Upon arriving at the place, strange events begin to occur after a while, which will scare the guys and face otherworldly forces.

Users will observe the events taking place with the help of illustrations made in an anime style. The game creates a feeling of gradually escalating suspense, intimidating and arching

description: Based on Marcus Pfister's children's book 'Rainbow Fish and the Whale'. An interactive underwater adventure where you can talk and play games with sea creatures.

description: Second year student Hiroaki at the Arihara Gakuen meets two girls on a summer day. These two grils tell him, that they're magicians and with this event his normal life descends into chaos.

description: An old visual novel from Petit, set in the Edo period. It is about a westerner killer that is hired as a bodyguard and a self-acclaimed disciple heroine, that tries to compete with im at every step. Together they have to save the world.

title: The Bodega Court of Salty DQs: Amai Edition
description: A visual novel featuring a young man named Dennis, who must save a thug operated restaurant by winning two million dollars in a tennis tournament.

title: They Can Hear Us
description: "They Can Hear Us," the first episode, narrates horror stories that interact with you through the microphone, playing on the fear of whoever is listening.

title: DunJumb
description: Whether you choose magic, swords, or both, make your way through the thousands of monsters attacking you! DunJumb is a colorful 2D medievial survivor game with roguelite elements, in which you create, buy and reinforce a combination of weapons against formidable enemies!

title: Seasons of Rocco
description: Help Rocco prepare for the winter season by gathering and sorting fruit at his Tree House in the autumn season. Plant new fruit trees in the spring season, to make sure Rocco has even more food next winter! A relaxing experience for cozy gamers who seek a delightful escape into the charming seasons.

title: Occult Crime Police: Medium at Large
description: The sequel to Occult Crime Police. Boomtown, USA is visited by a spirit medium who claims to be able to solve the case which ruined Sheriff Miranda Warren's life seven years ago. Everyone in town has a reason to be upset about the upcoming seance, but could someone be upset enough... to kill? Explore the set of a ghost hunt, uncover evidence to reveal the truth, and interrogate rude and/or stupid witnesses to unravel a mystery that defies the very laws of reason!

title: Goodbye Tired Stars
description:
"What's the best place to watch the end of the universe?"

Accompany a cosmic being in finding a place among three different planets to watch the end of the universe from. And on the way, walk, observe, and remember...

title: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition 2.0
description: The 2.0 update of Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition adds two full-length story modes, featuring different gameplay and characters!

title: Lunistice 1.5: Accel Coda
description: Lunistice 1.5: Accel Coda is an upcoming free content update for Lunistice, it overhauls major parts of the base game, ranging from new character models and animations to minor and major reworks of the original levels! Besides Accel, it also adds three additional playable characters - each with their own bonus stage. And if you like replayability, the new Randomizer Mode will have you covered!

title: Sonic Robo-Blast! From The Past
description: Sonic Robo-Blast! From The Past is a remake of two classic fangames from 1998 on a new engine in "standard definition 480p widescreen" with rad new features!

title: Link's Awakening DX HD
description:
Dive into the enchanting world of The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX as you've never experienced it before, with this meticulously crafted PC version that breathes new life into this classic adventure. Immerse yourself in the nostalgia of Koholint Island with enhanced graphics and widescreen support, bringing the charming landscapes and characters to vivid detail on your modern PC display.

But that's not all – we've turbocharged the gameplay with high framerate support, ensuring that every sword swing, puzzle solve, and enemy encounter feels smoother and more responsive than ever. Rediscover the magic of this timeless Zelda title with improved performance, letting you explore dungeons, uncover secrets, and engage in epic battles with unparalleled fluidity.

Whether you're a long-time fan of Link's Awakening or a newcomer to the series, this PC version offers a fresh take on the beloved classic, combining the essence of the original with cutting-edge enhancements. Embark on a journey across the mysterious island, solve puzzles, meet quirky characters, and relive the adventure with a level of polish and finesse that pays homage to the legendary legacy of The Legend of Zelda.

The game was taken down by Nintendo.

title: Xeno Fighters R
description:
Xeno Fighters R is an in-development shmup fangame inspired by the Raiden Fighters series by Seibu Kaihatsu.

This game features gameplay inspired by shmups made by Seibu Kaihatsu and Psikyo, in which enemies attack with relatively fewer, but faster, projectiles. It is different from bullet hell shmups like most of CAVE's games and Touhou, in which the screen can contain hundreds of bullets that are slow. Seibu-style shmups focus on quick reaction times and awareness of enemy locations, compared to bullet hell shmups, which focus on dodging and weaving through intricate bullet patterns.

The game has four original ships: the Amada Vipros, the Phyxius, the Zaiva, and the Xelcor. It also features guest fighters from other shoot 'em up games by Psikyo, Capcom, Konami, and others.

There are 20 stages to play in the game with four different game modes to select from.

description: An online version of Princess Maker developed by MGAME Korea.

description: A game that combines hardcore platforming of classics like Celeste with mind-bending puzzles with lasers, portals, and many more.
