description: Welcome to the archipelago! Here, you are free to do as you please, but be cautious... some islands are full of danger. To protect yourself, explore, build your shelter, arm yourself, and conquer your enemies.

title: Mr. Jones: Retrubition
description: Mr. Jones:Retrubition is a third-person action and adventure game. Paul Jones was a family man who lived an ordinary life. But one dark night, their lives turned upside down in a matter of seconds. Do you want to join Paul Jones' adventure right away?

title: Altitude's Toll
description: Altitude's Toll is a short walking simulator mystery set in Himalayas. Deliver packages as sherpa and uncover possibly the biggest Himalayan secret in history.

title: Weird Meese
description: An exploration game about photographing strange moose, wander through the last moose civilization and take pictures of it's inhabitants to help out moose and humans. As you photograph, you will discover the sinister plot lurking in the moose town.

title: Clem: The First Attribute
description: CLeM: The First Attribute is a free prologue that offers the first loop of CLeM, a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy.

title: Paper Sky
description: Experience the rush of an adrenaline-fueled paper plane adventure in an interactive semi-open world. Explore stunning landscapes in various art styles as your paper plane transforms into a ball, rolling and soaring through thrilling challenges for an unparalleled high-flying action!

title: Kingdom's Deck
description: Kingdom's Deck is a city-builder and deck-builder game where you embark on a journey to transform your humble hamlet into a formidable empire. Deploy your cards wisely, defend your walls from sieges, manage your resources, respond to various exciting events, and create the ultimate Kingdom's deck!

title: Crazy Monster
description: A tower defense shooting game where players take on the role of a hero and defeat powerful and crazy monsters with their allies!

title: Astra Ignota
description:
Astra Ignota is a minimalist puzzle game set aboard a sentient spaceship adrift between stars.

You must grow symmetrical galaxies from their cores outward, fill the entire board, and solve 60 rewarding, handcrafted puzzles, all while uncovering a mysterious sci-fi story told through brief narrative episodes.

The original idea comes from the game Tentai Show (also known as Galaxy), by the Japanese puzzle magazine Nicoli, creators of the Sudoku.

The game features multiple grid types, simple gameplay, and multiple tools that get unlocked as the story progresses. And no time pressure. It's about patience, observation, and discovery.

title: Perfect Chess
description: Chess Designed Specially for GAMERS! Integrated with the XZ Tutorial, which teaches you everything to play a competitive and successful game Have a LESS Boring and More Dynamic and Competitive Game Awaken the "Grand Master" in you today!

title: WorldShaper Idle
description: A tile-based world-building idle game. Place forests, rocks, mystical flowers and much more. Discover new tiles by experimenting with their placement. Then try to use their bonuses to optimize your production, or just sit back and become more powerful! What will your world look like?

title: Brutal Ball
description: Brutal Ball is a retro-styled shooter-sport hybrid where players can kill each other with gauntlet weapons or giant controllable spiked balls of destruction. Players strive to work together and dominate a match scoring goal after brutal goal.

title: Bloodsong
description: She's just a teenage siren. Let her rock... Play as Mari, a punk rock siren princess, who’s hell-bent on headlining her concert no matter the cost. Use your ear and “bloodsong” to match musical pitch, defeat enemies, and solve puzzles along the way. The stage is set–are you ready to rock?!

title: It Mimics
description: "It Mimics" is a short indie horror game heavily inspired by the original Slender The Eight Pages game. Step into the shoes of an unknown protagonist, collect the eight pages, and survive being followed by something lurking in the woods.

title: Vent Vipers
description: Embark on a serpentine adventure with this fast-paced, 3D snake experience. Slither through twists and turns, collecting apples to ascend to new heights. Outsmart the mazes, claim the top spot, and dive into the challenges now!

title: Escape from Blackwood
description: From wanting to go visit a castle to being trapped inside it. Solve the clues and discover how to escape from it

title: The Journalist
description: The journalist embarks on a risky investigation.

title: Rat Trap
description: Swap, fuse and split to escape! A fast paced, hand-drawn metroidvania adventure based on multiple unique characters that you can fuse together or split apart at will. Use these powers to explore a mysterious facility, solve puzzles and beat the bad guys! Can you escape the Rat Trap?

title: Zodiac Landing
description: This is a rocket flight simulation game. You will control a rocket by left and right engines to fly in space and try to land on target platform, while enjoying beautiful nebulas and ambient music.

title: Roll Over Princess
description: From the tower of mysterious ruins exuding an enigmatic power, the only things you can bring back are knowledge, memories, and experience. Amidst numerous challenges, combine equipment, legacies, and allies to conquer the top floor!

title: Idle Fishing
description: Relax and catch fish in a beautiful environment. Build up your fishing empire with automated rod setups, bustling markets, and delectable restaurants. Dive into the active challenge of the fishing mini-game for a hands-on experience!

title: Noxium
description: Welcome to your new job mining Noxium for a sketchy business. Keep the power on and everything should be fine.

title: Multilateral Planet
description: This is a single player game, in this multi-sided planet, humans in order to survive the attack of mutants, built a tall wall, this is the last city of mankind; Players need to control the character to pick up a sword and shield, to kill mutants, get them to drop food and weapons to arm themselves.

title: Soulers
description: Soulers is a Team-Building Twin-Stick Shooter. Assemble a team with time-slowing Protagonist and Colleagues with different abilities, and save the world from invasion of 'Glitch'.

title: Shepherd Planet
description: Shepherd Planet is a leisure puzzle simulator game in which you play a witty sheepdog and drive the lambs into the sheepfold.

title: HackeRPG
description: HackeRPG is a coding-based top-down arena roguelite in which you control a programmer avatar to battle hordes of viruses, bugs, trojans, etc. Upgrade you character, create unique builds, and automate your fights by writing code.

title: BraveEmini
description: BRAVEmini is an action game in whitch the player chases and blows up the enemies.Defeat enemies, blow them up, earn combos, and chase them a certain number of times to power up! Knock down bosses with your strengthened heroes!

title: Merry XMerge
description: Merry XMerge is a good board game for all ages this Christmas. Put together Christmas cakes and candies to make them more attractive. Merry Christmas.

title: Void Reaper
description: Pilot your ship through the Void in 'Void Reaper'. Face diverse enemies, upgrade your ship, and battle bosses to reach the End Boss in this action-packed void odyssey. Can you destroy the Void and save the world?

title: Bread around bread around bread around bread
description: A short story about how grandpa went to the store for bread.

title: Tools Up!: Ultimate Edition
description: Tools Up! Ultimate Edition is a chaos-filled, local couch-coop extravaganza, all about renovating homes and the outdoors. It comes with all updates, content, and DLC in one package, supporting up to 4 players.

title: Void Wizard
description: Dual-wield wands to levitate, manipulate time, conjure explosions, and use other unique abilities in this fast-paced FPS roguelike! Explore procedurally generated dungeons. Buy powerful upgrades from suspicious looking shopkeepers. Defeat the void wizard.

title: Don't Melt the Snowman
description: ​A festive hangman type word game which is fun to play - but Don't Melt the Snowman

title: FNaF 2: Night of Misfits
description: "FNaF 2 Night of Misfits" is a fan game created as an unofficial project based on Scott Cawthon's Five Nights at Freddy's. It is a non-commercial creative incarnation developed from scratch and differs from the original in both mechanics and story. It is important to note that "FNaF 2 Night of Misfits" is not an official or free version of "Five Nights at Freddy's" and is not to be distributed for money

title: FreshWomen: Season 2
description: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. Become a freshman attending Minerva Bay College, romance girls and solve a mysterious incident. Your journey will be filled with comedy, drama, and lots of sex.

title: Trainz Plus: Pro Train - F-Series: FAA Container
description: Combine the tried and tested with the modern! The new FAA container wagons used in the UK bring new colour to your fleet. In addition to various weather options, this trolley provides brand new containers that are compatible with the standard 20ft / 40ft container industry.

title: Trainz 2022: Pro Train - F-Series: FAA Container
description: Combine the tried and tested with the modern! The new FAA container wagons used in the UK bring new colour to your fleet. In addition to various weather options, this trolley provides brand new containers that are compatible with the standard 20ft / 40ft container industry.

title: Trainz 2019: Pro Train - F-Series: FAA Container
description: Combine the tried and tested with the modern! The new FAA container wagons used in the UK bring new colour to your fleet. In addition to various weather options, this trolley provides brand new containers that are compatible with the standard 20ft / 40ft container industry.

description: Lam ChoTung, who runs a maid cafe in Shenzhen, discovered a girl sitting unconscious on the ground at the storefront as she prepared to return home from the shop. This girl not only had unclear consciousness but was also dressed in peculiar maid attire. This is a love story about these two girls.

title: Ninja Attack
description: You play as a ninja fending off waves of various types of ghosts, each getting increasingly difficult from the last. How many waves can you last before the ghost onslaught overwhelms you.

title: Phantom Unit 999
description: There is a new danger that has befallen the world, which has led to creatures being brought to life Adam is the leader of Unit "Phantoms 999", With your help, you and Adam and his team will pass through strange worlds, upgrade your weapons, and try hard to end this danger and kill whoever caused it.

title: Cannon Master: Military Sport
description: In this unusual game you will shoot with cannons at many types of targets, and you will also find arcade and logical elements. Each subsequent level is a new challenge.

title: Powernaut Decay
description: A tough exploration-based platformer with souls-like elements.

title: EndlessCar
description: The car passes through obstacles to earn points mini-game.

title: Ego's Spark
description: Is this a nascent ego—or just a nasty bug? Crash headfirst into cuddles, comfort, and maybe even love in this short visual novel about robots and the human heart.

title: Falnarion Tactics III
description: A missing queen, a world engulfed in war, a mysterious new hero. Take control of a colorful cast of characters from both the perception of the heroes and the villains, as you fight the final battle for Nerfelo.

title: D.A.M. Champion
description: Assemble a team of monsters to use during turn-based battles in this Non-Linear RPG. The world of D.A.M. Champion takes an original approach to the concept of being a protagonist in a monster-taming game.

title: The Verge Miner
description: The Verge Miner is an immersive mining, tower defense, and action roguelike game. Jump through asteroids on The Verge of space, and mine valuable resources. These uncharted rogue rocks are filled with space aliens you need to protect yourself against. Choose and upgrade gear for your play style.

title: Catch Flex: AI Dance Game
description: Dive into "Catch Flex," the dance game where professional choreography meets advanced AI motion tracking. Just use your iPhone or Android camera – no extra gear needed! Mimic our dance coach's moves for scoring and calorie counting. Perfect for solo fun or group enjoyment with friends and family.

title: Shade: A Dog's Expedition
description: Join Shade, a loyal Border Collie, and his loving family as they navigate challenges, overcome obstacles, and celebrate the enduring bonds of love.

title: Splat!
description: Race your way your down a series of increasingly difficult levels avoiding obstacles and trying to reach the end without going Splat!

title: School Curse2
description: The curse continues...

title: Touhou Kaikeidou: Marine Benefit
description:
Touhou Kaikeidou ~ Marine Benefit is a Touhou Project fan game made by Primary-Color Space. It has an oceanic atmosphere reflecting some false predictions that Ten Desires would have an underwater theme.

Marine Benefit features three playable characters to choose from, each of which has three shot types to choose from.

The game features 'Oxygen' and 'Hydrogen' items which, when enough are collected, grant extra lives and bombs respectively. Hydrogen items are also important in that the marker which indicates how many you have also acts as the game's point of collection.

Grazing is also important as it increases Oxygen.

title: FPV Kamikaze Drone
description: "FPV Drone Kamikaze" is a fast-paced action game where players control a combat drone from a first-person perspective. The objective is to destroy enemy equipment in war using maneuvers and explosive devices. Speed and strategy will be the keys to victory.

title: SCP: Valravn
description: You Never Lose a War, When War Is What You Sell. Play the role of a member of the elite Mobile Task Force to uncover the story of the Valravn Corporation, a shady PMC group involved in human experimentation.

title: Alpaca Wonders Why
description: Alpaca Wonders Why is an interactive adventure for children in the form of a visual novel with a quiz.

title: Love Breakout
description: Relax arcade game to keep you in a good mood

title: Anime Artist
description: Anime Artist is a casual-puzzle game that will allow you to Sketch, Color and Collect anime artworks. Are you ready? This is your best chance to become the ultimate Anime Artist.

title: Touhou Mashousei: Fairies of Sorcery
description: Fairies of Sorcery is a fan-made Touhou Project script for the Touhou Danmakufu shooting game engine. Gameplay is based around the "burst" system, a limited-use skill which removes bullets on the screen and temporarily increases the value of point items. There are three stages in five difficulties plus an extra stage.

title: Hakuga
description: Hakuga is a psychedelic, disturbing and abstract horror game where the goal is simply to walk around and explore the things from the disorient world of the game.

title: Old Hound of Baker Street
description:
Play as a retired Sherlock Holmes in this text-based murder mystery, where your only eyes on the scene are those of the same person threatening to kill you.

When Sherlock thought his detective life was long over, he finds himself in a new case: solve the murder of the great philanthropist, Mr. Banks, from his office in Baker Street, or die trying.

Be an armchair detective and navigate through dialogue options in order to find the truth. But be careful about how much you press your client and how you word your accusations, or you might not see the next day.

When the client is nervous, your hound instincts will kick in. Will you press forward and try to get the truth, or will you direct the conversation in more subtle ways? Discover who, how, and why, and give the right answers when the time comes.

title: Zet Zillions
description: Zet Zillions is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder where you use your cards to make freakish combinations and explode entire planets. BIG-BADDA-BOOM!

title: Your Last Xmas
description: The house formerly belonged to a singer who had some success in the 1980s as part of a duo, singing about tropical holidays and whatnot, before going solo and achieving greater success with his newfound freedom. There were always the rumors however - that he may have been connected a series of gruesome cannibalistic murders. He passed away a few years back, but some say he returns every December 25th - and Last Christmas, he ate people's hearts...

title: Quake: Contract Revoked
description: Contract Revoked was a 2002 episode consisting of 4 levels and a start map, with knave textures, some modified models, and sounds. It was later made into an official free DLC for the 2021 remaster of Quake.

title: Apple Bag
description: Working the late-night shift as a cashier in a small town, you starts to form good relations with your regulars. Between flirtations and friendly banter, the specter of a mysterious disappearance haunts your nights as you’re exposed to more and more suspicious behaviors. Are your regulars linked to the missing student, and, more importantly, will you secure a Halloween date?

title: Divine Journey: The Life of Jesus
description: Embark on a Devine Journey, a captivating game narrating Jesus' life through 25 chapters, from birth to resurrection. Experience divine miracles and profound teachings.

title: Albatross
description: After an unnamed catastrophe, you've been left alone and stranded on a boat in the middle of a sunken world. Journey through vast megastructures and the giant rotting frames of mysterious machines. Feed the boat's engine with fish caught using your harpoon. Never slow down.

title: The Traveller: Vanilla Version
description: Complete the mission for a secret organization and meet some hot girls and women!

description: Now, Anais is a formidable boss of a criminal organization that trades and produces an exotic hallucinogenic mushroom. Such a mushroom sexually stimulates its users, making them avid and active pornographic performers.

description: Attacker, coward, swindler or endgame wizard: I'll show you how to win against anyone! After my World Championship victories in 2022 and 2023, I am the reigning Chess Software World Champion and am now looking forward to showing you how to become even stronger against your opponent!

title: Backstage at Naked Porn Battle
description: Welcome to Naked Porn Battle. The most famous glorious fighting championship in the world. There are no rules and any fighting style can be used. The only requirement is simple: Everyone fights naked and the opponents MUST fuck each other.

title: Orphans
description: Orphans is an adventure, stealth, and puzzle game. Join Victoria in this dark journey through a dystopian city where the most savage instincts stalk in every corner. She must rely on her slingshot skills and agility to be able to free and cooperate with other orphans to survive.

title: Sonic Robo Christmas Blast
description: SRB1 Christmas (also known as Sonic Xmas Blast) was released in December 1998, during the period between the end of SRB2 TGF's development and the release of SRB2 Halloween a year later, as it was clear by then SRB2 would no longer be using this engine. It is largely a repackaging of SRB2 TGF's existing levels with Christmas-themed names and a winter theme applied. The ability to save the game was not present however, and the game itself would start immediately on load.

title: A Desert Dusk
description: Large desert themed SP level that also supports coop and deathmatch.

title: Scorpion Garrison
description: Sequel of "A Desert Dusk" - Large desert themed SP level that also supports coop and deathmatch.

title: Brutic
description: Mix of Brutalism and Gothic.

title: Untamed
description: Untamed is a planned multiplayer creature survival game that takes place in a post apocalyptic world full of overgrown ruins.

title: Warmage
description: Your city is under attack Warmage ! In this grid-based turn-based roguelite, defend the many different districts of your city against waves of enemies with the help of one of your students, and in between, buy and upgrade spells to prepare for the worst.

title: Unveiling
description: Experience the UFO abduction in first person and take a trip to meet thy keeper. Explore layers of reality and learn what is concealed behind the modern Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon (UAP) in this esthetic and eerie interactive experience.

title: Doomsday Overture
description: A role-playing game with multiple endings. Throughout the ten years of life from childhood to adolescence, the protagonist will experience encounters, sacrifices, choices and separation. Also: This game does not support English, please understand.

title: Where is Drake?
description: Find a hidden pirate in a massive crowd of people, and be prepared to be spooked!

title: Witchy Woes
description: When a power hungry, egotistical young witch disobeys her school’s headmasters, she is cast out and exiled. Play as Devious Donna as she wreaks havoc on those who have wronged her. Harness the dark arts and exact your revenge on the masters of magic.

title: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Upheaval in Jingxiang
description: The third DLC, "Upheaval in Jingxiang," depicts Liu Bei's forces as they fight back against the threat of Elixir that has gripped Jing Province since the death of Yu Ji.

title: Valuable Cargo
description: Valuable Cargo is a 3D forklift simulator. Your task - to transport goods across different levels and deliver them to the required places. The game features different locations, each location will require attention and skills from you, as various obstacles await you on the way to delivering goods.

title: Train Sim World 4: Cargo Line Vol. 1 - Petroleum
description: Discover different freight services with Skyhook Games' Cargo Line for Train Sim World 4. In Volume 1, keep the UK running with modern, VTG-branded TEA tankers, driving heavy fuel-laden services - a flammable challenge awaits.

title: Trash in the Flower Garden
description: A rumor spread through the school that Ina likes girls. She denied it with a bold face when her teacher asked, but inside she was worried. Who could have exposed her secret?

description: Defend your kingdom by fighting back against an approaching robot invasion. Place, upgrade, and relocate elementally-charged towers strategically to destroy incoming robots. Watch as elements collide and combine to create explosive reactions!

Get ready for massive tricks, high scores, and gnarly slams in Streetdog BMX. Carve your way through six huge maps featuring hidden spots, handcrafted challenges, and flowing lines!

Customize your bike and rider before hitting the streets to explore six maps packed with wallrides, gaps, bowls, ramps and rails. Uncover new spots, complete handcrafted challenges, and link up your combos!

title: TableTop Soccer: Redux
description: TTS is back with another fresh take on strategic and tactical games - skill based goal keepers, physics based kicking, 10 player teams, full steam multiplayer, new graphics, offline play and lots more

description: Temporality is a first-person game where the player takes on the role of Jack who wakes up in a room without knowing how the protagonist got here and must travel through the past. of him and his wife to find the truth.

title: The Balls
description: Fresh Online PvP Battle Royale FPS. Players (balls) are not bound by gravity, centrifugal force, direction, or predetermined paths. They can instantly reach any location they desire, making the Battle Royale more dynamic than ever before. Utterly addictive!

title: The Da Vinci Cryptex 3
description: Take the challenge again and crack 50 new amazing riddles in the third chapter of The Da Vinci Cryptex! series!

title: Royal Romances: The Cursed Hearts DLC
description: Unravel the enigmatic tale, confront the shadows of the past, and steer your destiny towards a love that transcends the ordinary!

title: Rogue Fable IV
description: Rogue Fable IV is a traditional rogue-like game which combines the depth, complexity, and challenge of the genre classics with a shorter, more tightly focused game length.

title: Realms of Madness
description: Build a medieval fantasy castle, expand it to recruit mythical creatures, and lead them into battle to demolish the enemy stronghold.

title: Paprika Trainer
description:
You play as a inmate being kept in the WOOHP asylum for the criminally insane. When suddenly the power goes out, all the villains escape and turn Beverly Hills into a warzone. It's up to you and the three spies to go undercover and take back the city!

In this game you go on missions, capture gang leaders and keep your spies safe by preforming more and more slutty actions. While playing you will encounter an engrossing, comedic story, a fully implemented mission mini-game, lots of supporting characters and of course many many lewd scenes. Most of which are fully animated and voice acted!

title: Hiraeth
description: HIRAETH is a game about mind-bending puzzles and unique platforming challenges, all with stunning graphics and physics-defying mechanics. The overarching plot is a puzzle as in of itself, and the ever-present music elevates the game's dreamy atmosphere.

description: A small satiric anti-war game with a cute Fuhrer as a lead character. Will you be able to melt her heart?

description: This game is a classic memory game with several levels of difficulty and beautiful arts. All characters appearing in this game are over 18 years of age. Enjoy ;-)

description: Elithian Races Mod is a substantial expansion designed for Starbound, introducing four fresh playable races alongside an extensive array of hundreds of new items, objects, weaponry, armor components, and numerous other enhancements. Two additional outposts have been incorporated, brimming with fresh quests and various merchants for players to engage with.

title: Meadgard
description: Run your own viking pub in a chaotic co-op management adventure! Grab your friends, axes and tankards, and work together to both serve and fight your hot-headed customers. It’s time to show the world what viking hospitality looks like!

title: Bombcapsule
description: Run and Dodge, and Destroy the waves of Bombs. Brand New Arena Shooter!

title: Erannorth Renaissance
description: Erannorth Renaissance is a text-driven narrative RPG featuring turn-based tactical battles, where destiny is shaped by the echoes of your past. Carve your path through an enchanting Renaissance-fantasy world, where every decision molds your character and weaves your unique tale.

title: Grave Gunner
description: A fast-paced gothic arena FPS. Survive as a gunslinger against waves of undead monsters, utilising smooth and expressive movement, sliding, rocket jumping and formidable duel handguns. Easy to pickup, yet only a master gunslinger shall defeat all waves then claim the final reward!

title: Evolution: From the Little Light
description: A small creature is born in the depths of the ocean, beginning its journey for survival in a ruthless world. Embark on a 2D adventure full of exploration and puzzles, making crucial decisions, facing dangers and discovering the hidden secrets of evolution.

title: Ememe
description: Ememe Town, a place where AI NPCs live freely. Chatting, laughing, falling in love... Now, let's simulate the life of your favorite character with generative AI!

description: A simple choose-your-adventure RPG, set in the desert. You're a line man that's stolen the company truck, in search of enlightenment. Roll your dice, and get into trouble.

title: Date With the Night
description: Ben O'Hara and his new assistant Yuhiko Kosuke have a Date With the Night in this Noir Survival Horror. Choose your character to investigate a new thrilling case in the sequel to the critically acclaimed cult hit Ghost at Dawn. Navigate your way through unspeakable horrors in an abandoned apartment building while piecing together clues to solve how so many people suddenly went missing.

title: Oblin Party
description: A wacky physics-based, couch/online party brawler where the hands do the talking. Utilize your elastic arms to wield powerful items, or swing, slingshot, grab, and punch to catapult your opponents off the map. Perfect for quick, hilarious multiplayer sessions with friends!

title: Slime Brawly Brawl
description: An early prototype, Slime Brawly Brawl exists to scratch an itch. An itch for a simple, fast paced platformer melee game like 90s kids might have played and loved growing up.

title: Arena: Gameboy Edition
description: Step into the pixelated realm of nostalgia with the AR3NA: Gameboy Classic Edition DLC! This remastered version takes you back to the roots of the original AR3NA, featuring 100 challenging levels that will test your precision and gaming prowess.

description: Murder Mystery meets Dating Sim in a small southwestern town beset by cults & conspiracies. Can you prevent your coffee shop from closing, solve your uncle’s murder and maybe even find love?

description: Berry and his friends count on you! Evil monsters invaded the candy world and stole all the candies. But you and our heroes are here to save their candy world! Use their powers to destroy the monsters in this cozy 2D adventure game!

description: Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of MANA, where strategic brilliance combines with explosive visuals! Engage in intense multiplayer battles, using angles to unleash a dazzling array of shapes and colors. MANA reinvents strategic warfare with a visually stunning and uniquely dynamic twist.

title: JumpOut
description: You are a bloog, a type of non-existent animal from the future, who has to survive the deadly lava that spread throughout the world due to a crack under the earth, and your goal is to kill the person who caused it, that of course he put some lasers on you trying to kill you. That crack can only be closed with metal so you must collect as much as possible to close it while you play with your life in jumps that could kill you at any moment.

title: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults
description: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults is the first-ever co-op Hack and Slash ARPG based on the Adventure Path, in which players lead iconic Pathfinder heroes into the depths of Gauntlight Keep and battle deadly abominations to reach the evil sorceress Belcorra Haruvex and end her vile schemes.

title: Christmas Puzzle 5

Tackle a series of quests from cleaning cookie crumbs to creating a gingerbread house, a castle and a chocolate factory. Get ready for a heartwarming conclusion as the characters find their way home.

Starminer is a space industry and logistics simulation that strives to be at the forefront of space strategy gaming, blending cutting-edge rendering technologies with deep tactical and creative gameplay. It's set against backdrops of fully-realized 3D environments, where the beauty of space becomes an integral part of player immersion, setting Starminer apart as a visually stunning and technologically advanced space base-building game. Starminer is built with realism and immersion as core design pillars through the incorporation of Newtonian physics for propulsion and movement. This not only adds a layer of authenticity and complexity to the gameplay but also introduces a rewarding learning curve for players seeking a genuinely advanced spacefaring experience.

In Starminer, the universe is more than just a pretty backdrop for exploration and conquest—it's a playground for players to explore their creativity and long-term ambitions for their fleets. Central to the game's creative ethos is the ability to design a variety of space stations that bring them toward their goals; whether it's to mine resources, be a defensive power, colonization, energy production, or something else entirely. The dynamic and customizable nature of these different types of stations means that the player doesn’t only decide what their cosmic empire will be; it will become a unique reflection of their strategic prowess and imaginative flair.

Step into the shoes of a lowly villager, Dahnzell, entranced by images of glory and a reclusive prince, Nero, starved of answers for profound questions in a fight for clarity and change.

title: Dreamblood
description: An episodic WAD for the 2020 Doom 64 remaster by HeadshotTAS featuring large, dynamic maps and challenging combat. Its first episode received one of the 2023 Cacowards.

title: Charon's Sabbath
description:
Upon death in the world of Charon's Sabbath, souls leave behind their physical bodies, immediately venture to the spiritual realm, and fuse with a sentient cluster of spiritual energy, called the Soulmother. However, when the Soulmother is suddenly dormant, the souls of the dead have nowhere to go and are left behind in the world of the living, unable to find peace, becoming lost.

These lost souls are completely cut off from interacting with the living. The boundary between the dead and the living is so extreme, the dead will perceive any spoken, written, or non-verbal language of the living as unintelligible. Lost souls are doomed to continuously relive their death through their memory. The vast majority of them descend to wrathful madness and insatiable hunger due to this hellish fate.

You play as Munica, the soul of a young girl, tasked by the weak Soulmother to gather the last of the lost souls that have yet to be tainted and help them find peace.

Sever the never-ending cycle of suffering, and realize salvation.

title: Halo's Mixtape
description:
A short winter story about the Witch of the Isle, who protects a Orb that many seek to try to claim.

Recently someone has broken into her Dungeon unbeknowst to her, and stolen a precious something!

title: Hardfest 2
description: Greetings mortals! Hardfest 2 is a community ﻿project for boom-compatible source ports that is focused on "hard maps" of any style, this time with a yellow theme! Featuring maps by 24 designers, there ﻿is a wide variety on offer, including large macroslaughter maps, tiny and precise combat puzzles, quiet exploration heavy maps & platforming maps. ﻿

title: Xombycapyse
description:
a seizure inducing negative romp into a dark world deep world filled with intrigue and swors. There also happen to be shields. The main character is set. He has a propensity for making treks to the forest and random people's houses. There is a time limit before the Xombycapyse occurs and this is the worst of the worst!

Made for the RMN 2012 Horror Game Contest in less than a day!

title: Usagito Watashi
description:
Made for a 'A Game By It's Cover 2016', based on the fantastic coverart by Achabox!

This details the adventures of Reido and Dr. Asagi as they wake up to a world under fire from all varieties of cosmic threat!

Experience the joys of space debris with a self destructive attitude, space stations long abandoned with stench of all the remnants of lives gone by, and also facing off with the immensity of the stars in classical famicom fashion.

title: Cave Escape With FNIA Chica
description: Chica was having a stroll in the forest until a rock slide happened you then walk in a cave and it starts to collapse now you must escape.

title: Solve et Coagula
description: Solve et Coagula is a limit-removing replacement for Doom Episode 2: The Shores of Hell created by Nicolas Monti that was a runner-up for the 2023 Cacowards.

title: TNT 2: Devilution
description: TNT2 ﻿is a 32-map fan-made sequel to Team TNT﻿'s Evilution that originally began development in 2009. Its public beta received one of the 2023 Cacowards.

title: Overtime at Freddy's
description: Hello! Hello! Freddy Fazbear's Pizza welcomes you back to the night shift! Overtime at Freddy’s continues where Five Nights at Freddy’s left off. This game is more difficult than the original by intruding a few new features while staying true to the classic game.

title: Spring Crisis 2
description: This is a 2D action game with more and more vegetables.

title: Gardens of the Void
description: Small idle game that I started working on out of boredom.

title: Being Dead Simulator
description:
Have you ever wondered how it is to be dead?

This great simulator will let you experience that, which would normally be out of human's reach.

Not only does it simulate the state of being dead, but also some (as for now) possible scenarios that may occur while being buried underground.

title: Exadimension Neptunia
description:
Ever watched the ending video of a Hyperdimension Neptunia game and wanted to play that 2D-style RPG? Now you can in this fan game!

Slay monsters, make video game references and break the fourth wall all in 2D Graphics! Two years after the events of Megadimension Neptunia VII, take control of your favorite characters from the world of Gamindustri as they face a new threat: the personification of present day video game industry problems!

title: Exadimension Neptunia 2: A Chao Returns
description:
Ever watched the ending video of a Hyperdimension Neptunia game and wanted to play that 2D-style RPG? Now you can in this fan game!
Slay monsters, make video game references and break the fourth wall all in 2D Graphics! Two years after the events of Exadimension Neptunia , take control of your 3 character as they face a new threat: the personification of present day video game industry problems!

title: Lux: Dream.Girl
description: Lux: Dream.Girl is a surreal psychological horror game created in RPG Maker 2003, about a socially inept teenage boy with writer's block who uses lucid dreaming to interact with his characters. In his dreams, he falls in love with a girl he has never seen or thought of before. It is the second entry in the -UX Series.

title: Träumerei: Chapter 0
description: Träumerei is an original Horror RPG game created in VX Ace. The game is focused on exploration, story, and characters. It contains original art, graphics, and sprites.

title: Arctic Eggs
description: A Sci-Fi Cooking game where you take up the role of a Poultry Peddler stuck in Antarctica and longing for a way out. Sell your illegal eggs to those who look hungry.

title: Moonshire
description: Embark on a journey to save Moonshire as you navigate through a mysterious world filled with dungeons, weapons, upgrades, and fast-paced combat!

title: Mobile Suit Baba
description: A mysterious force is out to steal all the Fruit! Help Baba & friends foil their plans by maneuvering gigantic mech suits around. Features tactical puzzling action, heart-wrenching storytelling and extra challenges over a total of 43 missions.

title: Melting Moon
description: Melting Moon is a horror/dark fantasy game that is heavily story-based, and involves various mythologies to its world. What happens in the game and what happens to Luna is heavily influenced by what the player does or doesn't do in regards to the story and choices given. Luna can explore Havenfall and various locations in Hell and Purgatory as she finds pieces of her heart and saves (or doesn't save) souls afflicted with Soul Rot, all the while finding out her true self and her true purpose.

title: Grim's Gambit
description: Get ready for a tale where every cup poured is a step closer to unraveling the mysteries that bind the afterlife. Take on a soul-stirring quest as you serve lost souls, piece together your forgotten past, and unveil the chilling secrets of the Stygian Keep.

title: Sonic Colors DX
description:
Sonic Colors HD/DX is a bundle of original modifications to the original (wii) Sonic Colors on a modified version of the Dolphin Emulator, with the goal of bringing the game up to modern graphics standards.
This mod aims to be more faithful to the original design than Sonic Colors: Ultimate, while containing fewer glitches.

title: Tails of Iron: Bright Fir Forest
description: Set after the climactic events of the base campaign, ‘Bright Fir Forest’, a new free end-game expansion, sees our noble Rat King Redgi invited by the Squirrels to celebrate the Festival of Leaf Fall… However, a new foul and revenge-seeking adversary stands to ruin the celebrations.

title: I Think I Need Your Help
description:
A strange entity has been keeping Vela up at night so she calls her ex, Mira, to help her figure out what's going on, but none of them knew what they were getting themselves into. Together they venture into a forest full of strange creatures to find answers.

The game takes around 20 minutes and was made for Yuri Game Jam 2023.

title: Underfell: One Hell of a Show
description: An Underfell Fan-Game containing multiple battles! Fight against Mettaton, the killer robot with a penchant for stardom, who hopes to finally become popular with his most daring act yet: killing a human!

title: The Edge of Forever
description:
Far across the Dead Sea, beyond the shores of white sand are The Dragon's Teeth--heartless mountains consumed by cold howling winds and separated by valleys of icy fog. Nestled deep within is a small rocky pinnacle upon which rests the palace of The Guardian, the architect of the Vault of Knowledge.

For centuries people have visited the Guardian hoping for blessings and the chance to take the Trial of Knowledge but few have been granted the wish. After many wars and natural disasters the location of The Guardian eventually slipped from people's memories and was lost forever from maps. Only legends remain telling of the trial and the strange machines that seem to crackle with the power of the skies.

For years you have dreamt of finding the Vault and gaining the treasure of the ancients but the mountain paths have just led you round in circles. One day, while searching the northwest mountain peaks, you discovered a hidden trail marked with small piles of stones covered in unusual symbols. Something looks familiar and you suspect you have seen these symbols before in ancient books, but your memory is fading and you are not sure anymore.

After days of walking past countless marker stones, the trail eventually descended from the higher peaks towards a misty valley. Far off in the distance you could see a small hill with what seemed to be a man made structure on the top but you will need to get closer to find out.

The trail leads down into a dense forest shrouded in a thick miasma that chills you to the bone. The boughs creak and groan but there is no wind, just the fog blocking out the light above. Several days pass and eventually the winding trail leads upwards again, out of the mist. You stand before a small ornate building with glass on all sides.

You enter the main door...

title: In-Terror-Gation
description:
The game was developed in around 2 weeks for Senscape's Cursed Adventurous Jam 2022 (Won 3rd Place).In-Terror-Gation is a horror investigation game influenced by the works of Lovecraft and Junji Ito. As a psychiatrist at the Innsmount Prison Hospital, you are tasked with the interrogation of a mysterious patient in the hopes of getting to the truth behind a bizarre case of kidnapping.

Ask questions, listen to what she says, and examine your evidence to find the contradictions that may lie within. Only by questioning everything can you figure out the real truth about what happened to this patient, and just what is going on with her.

title: An American Tail: Animated Movie Book
True Stalker
description: The plot centers on a run‑of‑the‑mill Stalker nicknamed Topor. He’s made several forays into the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone, yet—even though the Zone’s heart beckons—his fear of the unknown always holds him at the Cordon’s edge. But life beyond the perimeter has long since lost its meaning, so at last he resolves to venture beyond the Cordon…

title: Nyran Survivors
description: Embrace the role of Thoria's ultimate Mediator. In this gripping Action Roguelite, unlock diverse classes, harness thousands of spell combinations, and face epic boss battles. How long can you survive the endless enemy horde for?

title: Bloxd.io
description: It is a multiplayer sandbox game where you can build, explore, and compete in voxel worlds. Play with Friends in mini-games such as bedwars, skywars and more or unleash your creativity by designing your worlds.

title: Oguzok Horror
description: Oguzok needs to peel off labels from bananas! He better make it fast because chef is very angry!

title: Bloody Ink
description: Bloody Ink brings your nightmares to life. Constant terror at home, mysteries to solve, and vocal interaction. Collect items, uncover Luca's past, and face your fears.

title: Meta Revelations: Armour of the Abyss
description: A turn based RPG where you can adapt your armour and save the world! You are Adena Krieger - a cold blooded huntress. Uncover your mysterious past and prevent a calamity that is written in your name.

title: Pixelborn
description: Fanmade digital version of Lorcana

title: Too Late.exe
description: TooLate.EXE is a fan-made horror mario fangame. Players navigate a disturbing environment filled with glitchy visuals and unsettling audio, with the goal of uncovering hidden details and surviving unpredictable threats rather than engaging in traditional combat.

title: Friday Night Funkin': Mario's Madness v2
description:
Mario's Madness v2 Is Finally Here, 29 NEW and Remade Songs + the original 7 songs from v1, a lot of characters, stages, mechanics and new extra additions in the mod, Beat all the songs to try to defeat mario for good.

Be ready, survive, and say hello to murder.

title: Six & Six
description: Six & Six is a game made by OKSoft, BanzaiBonsai and TerraDev64 featured on the Madvent Calendar 2020 on day 6.

title: Cruel
description: Cruel is a solitaire card game based on Perseverance. Cruel became popular when it was published as video game for Microsoft Windows by Microsoft in 1990 as part of the Microsoft Entertainment Pack for Windows 3.0.

title: Dungeon Rummage: Rise of the Allies!
description: Dungeon Rummage - Rise of the Allies is a short dungeon crawler created for the Harold Jam 2023, Ascend of the Allies. Pick your character and escape the dungeon, where the allies are currently held hostage.

title: Chew Chew Mimic
description:
Play as a hungry mimic in this head-scratching puzzle game where you have to guide unsuspecting knights to their doom.

Lay down traps to get all the knights to the mimic and try to collect each level’s 3 coins for an extra challenge.

title: Kharkov: Disaster on the Donets - Across the Dnepr: Second Edition
description:
Across the Dnepr: Second Edition is an expansion for Kharkov: Disaster on the Donets developed by Strategic Studies Group. It also serves as a remake of their 2003 game Decisive Battles of WWII: Across the Dnepr.

The main scenario is based on the historical World War II battle known as the Battle of Smolensk (1941). It also contains 3 additional scenarios: Operation Husky, Operation Konrad, and Kirovograd.

title: Last Seen Online
description: “last seen online” is a psychological horror escape room, based on early flash games. Look through someone's computer files. Solve puzzles and discover the secrets that lie within the computer.

title: Earthion
description:
Earthion is an upcoming aftermarket shooting game developed by Ancient primarily for the Sega Mega Drive. Physical MD versions will be published by SUPERDELUXE GAMES in Japan and by Limited Run Games in North America. The game will also get a 16:9 version for modern platforms.

Earthion is published under the label YKGGG, a brand name covering all the retro-style games developed at Ancient. If Earthion meets success, Ancient will go on the venture of releasing video games designed for retro consoles. A separate version of the game for Arcade was confirmed by Ancient and published by exA-Arcadia, which features a new, exclusive mode that will not be available in the Mega Drive version.

title: Tell me tonight was real
description: A game about two friends with benefits, a vampire and a human going on a impromptu date and realizing they are in love.

title: Bendy and the Ink Machine: Chapter Five
description: This is the fifth and final chapter of Bendy and the Ink Machine, continuing and concluding the game. On 6th September 2018 it was announced all players who owned chapters two to four would receive it for free on 26th October 2018.

title: Cherry Tower
description: Enter the world of Cherry Tower, a charming 2D pixel platformer that will take you on a sweet adventure unlike any other! Join Cherry on her small adventure climbing tower to return home and maybe even more. Overcome obstacles and traps to achieve your goals.

title: Hehe
description: A 2D platformer about saving a sugar cube from tea monsters.

title: Family Ties
description: Discover the power within you, challenge the hardships of life, and keep your family together in this epic game called 'Family Ties.' Take on the challenging tasks that await you and seize control of your life. Stand strong in the face of life's sudden twists because there's a hero within you!

title: Hamster Hunter
description: You come home for an annual family reunion, only to find your family missing with an eerie note left by your father. After you discover what has happened you seek revenge!

title: Dreams of Saturn
description: Dreams of Saturn is a Shenmue Xmas fan game from George Kitchen. The game features around 10-15 hours worth of content in the form of a short Shenmue story, taking place before and after the events of the original Shenmue, along with a wide variety of mini-games, achievements and more.

title: Super Piracy Quest
description:
Long ago, an unknown figure took control of THE CAVE OF HYPE and put an end to PIRACY. Embark on a journey with our protagonist and deuteragonist, Pikachu and Dr. Andonuts respectively to save PIRACY, but more importantly to find one of the greatest artifacts THE CAVE OF HYPE has to offer...THE BAG. Throughout this journey they will meet very few helpful people, and many cows!

Download link: https://rpgmaker.net/games/13022/

title: XP Spelletjes
description: A collection of over 1000 shareware games.

title: Milo and the Christmas Gift
description: Milo and the Christmas Gift is a free-to-play short and atmospheric point-and-click adventure game created by artist Johan Scherft. The game is a spin-off story following the events in Milo and the Magpies. The game has 5 chapters and a gameplay time of around 30 minutes!

title: Neural Parasite
description: Experimental survival horror game where every action is controlled by your mouse.

title: Heroine Anthem Zero 2: Scalescars Oath
description: Heroine Anthem ZERO 2: Scalescars Oath When the world was freed of chaos, the Twin Virgin Saints started the circle of the seven doomsday. When the lands were flooded on the sixth doomsday, after the descendants of the Savior received blessings from God, they resurrected under the new born Tree of Life Terasyr, establishing the royal city of Vuzahem. But ichthyopagion still continued to grow, making clear that the Gods have not forgiven the world. People must find answers to the meaning of war while surviving the sins and punishments before Judgement Day. The story includes multiple subtle metaphors for the relationship between God and humans.

title: Somsnosa
description: If I had to, like, identify some part of this that expresses the theme of "Minimalism," it'd probably be the plot. Yeah.

title: Hopeful in Joyful
description:
A mod for Austin Jorgensen's LISA: The Joyful which includes characters from Taco Salad's LISA: The Hopeful.

Requires LISA: The Joyful to play.

Replaces Buddy with Beltboy, Lanks, Cyclops and Rodriguez.
Changed a lot of battles and re-balanced combat because Joyful's was shit.
Campfire scenes from Hopeful in tha game.
More enemy/player interactions.

A couple endings, a few idk I didn't count.
Like, two new secrets and a song.
A gripping story that will leave you in tears, because it is very very sad, and you are probably going to cry when you beat the game because it is that sad.
Probably some bugs I missed. Point them out to me,.

title: Psycho Patrol R
description:
Psycho Patrol R is a mecha FPS hybrid policing and punishment simulator set in the decayed state of Pan-Europa. You play as an officer of the European Federal Police, a V-Stalker pilot of Psycho Patrol, a special unit tasked with solving mental crime, among other things.

The gameplay is a combination of high intensity tactical FPS combat, combined seamlessly with operating your V-Stalker mecha unit to decimate your enemies. The world is open with a variety of different goals to achieve.

Wide variety of weapons, from small arms to 120mm cannons.
Customize your V-Stalker for a massive tactical advantage.
Choose from a wide variety of routes and approaches.
Open, non-linear world.
Unique NPCs to meet and interact with.
Solve the mystery of the Orgone.

title: Gnoll Way Home
description: You awaken in another world, inhabiting the body of one of the realm's most reviled beasts - the savage gnoll. Before you can even come to grips with your situation, you are thrust into a journey to find your place in this world that fears and rejects your very presence. The path to discovering yourself is a dangerous one, but you won't walk that path alone.

title: Half-Life 2: Overcharged
description:
Overhaul modification for Half-Life 2 & Episodes which adds everything you like to live.
Refresh your Half-Life 2 Experience with brand new gameplay and post-processing features!
Fight against Race X,New Combine Units or Xen Aliens with new weapons!
Choose between lots of options,make your own style you like!

title: No Time for Mercy
description: "My best friend came back after six months. There's someone else in her skin."

title: The Interactive Adventures Of Seymore Butts
description: The Interactive Adventures of Seymore Butts is an adult full motion video game with basic adventure game elements, although it's more of an interactive story than an adventure. The player takes the role of Mr. Butts as he meets his new attractive neighbor and attempts to romance her.

title: Seymore Butts Interactive II: In Pursuit Of Pleasure
description: Seymore Butts Interactive II is the sequel to the original Seymore Butts game, with a similar play style. This time, Seymore is trying to hang out with his girlfriend Brianna, who has left for Canada. In order to follow her there, Seymore needs to earn some money by starting some kind of voyeuristic dating service - he hooks up his friends with girls in the Los Angeles area and he (you) watch the dates and decide what the men should do to win the women.

title: Bleedthrough
description: A vanilla-compatible three-episode megaWAD by Jayextee; including some fixes and minor balance tweaks to the maps included from The Becoming.

title: Blue Terror
description: A single vanilla map for Doom II that is blue. Nothing more, nothing less.

title: Hangul
description: Revisit the map that started it all in this reimagining of E1M1: Hangar, now christened Hangul and set in a demon-infested fortress built into the cliffs of a remote desert. Old secrets and new surprises abound in this tribute to 30 years of 둠

title: Hell's Bane
description: This is a Boom compatible megawad replacement for The Ultimate Doom. It features 4 episodes with 9 levels each all themed in the vein of the original game. The levels are all levels that Chris Hansen has released either solo or as part of projects over the past 25 years. There are also a couple of new levels to fill in the gaps. "Hell's Bane" is oldschool Doom with a few Boom tricks behind the scenes.

title: The Quinary Conundrum
description: This was produced during NaNoWADMo 2023. It is a sequel to The Lost Magic (you may want to play that first!), and is a fair bit harder in difficulty and far more experimental.

title: Thirty Years with Doom
description: A classic Doom megawad made by level designers at iddqd.ru to celebrate the anniversary of their beloved game. The maps provide a variety of experiences: there are ones authored by newcomers and by experienced mappers, desert cities and snow-covered bases, compact and very large levels. The first episode is based on the original Doom, while the later maps are variations on Doom II-related themes.

title: KGZDoom1
description: You find an old outpost, primitive brick and wood. They have found something evil, and are building a new complex to bring the evil to life.

title: 150 Line Massacre: The Golden Skulls
description: 150 Line Massacre: The Golden Skulls is a 36 map megawad by @NinjaDelphox, featuring maps by @Arsinikk, @Cacodemon187, and @Large Cat, and is a non-canon sequel to 100 Line Massacre. Originally intended as remaster of Ninja’s 5 Maps with 100 Lines, it turned into a full blown sequel featuring “remasters” of these original 5 maps that led to the eventual creation of 100 Line Massacre, along with re imaginings of these maps and 27 entirely new maps, including a previously unreleased 100 Line Massacre map! 150 Line Massa﻿cre also features a new gameplay mechanic: The Golden Skulls! Each map contains a hidden Golden Skull, and is required for a 100% playthrough, displaying a “Skulls” count at the end of each map instead of an item count.

title: 200 Line Christmas: Snowy Slaughter
description:
200 Line Christmas: Snowy Slaughter is a community project targeting MBF21 (complevel 21). The project is inspired by Arsinikk and NinjaDelphox's Line Massacre Series and is the sequel to 100 Line Christmas. It uses the new Doom Christmas Enhanced resource pack with some new additions specific to the project.

As the 200 in the title suggests, each map was limited to 200 lines at most. Each mapper was asked to add some kind of friction in their maps (Either slippery ice or heavy snow). In addition, each map has a hidden runaway gnome for you to grab (replacing the item count)!

title: Emergency Christmas
description: Santa got dead and you have to infiltrate the illuminati before they make evil santas something something save christmas and shoot stuff you know how it goes figure it out.

title: Frostbite Express
description: A train level inspired by Build Engine vehicle levels (see Blood E1M3) and The Polar Express (movie).

title: Plataform
description: Plataform is a MBF21 map of medium duration (about 15 minutes maximum), not too difficult, and tested in WOOF and DSDA

title: Veranda
description: Inspired by my love of malls and the album Illuminations by FM Skyline. A fairly linear adventure through a dreamily brutalist structure with a few tonal shifts and surprises sprinkled in.

title: Broadsword Jim Saves Christmas
description: A new single map for GZDoom, done for @Baratus's birthday using their and Skelegant's custom weapons mod Broadsword Jim, a modifier that puts you in the metallic, armored shoes of Jim, a sword-headed wielder of both medieval and modern weaponry. ﻿

title: DemiDato: Monster Dating Show
description:
DemiDato is a comedy romance visual novel inspired by real-life dating shows with a tongue-in-cheek monster twist!
Welcome to the set of the monster world's biggest dating show, DemiDato! Your protagonist (with your choice of name and pronouns) is a plucky human in a silly hood, the latest contestant to team up with the show's notoriously snarky host Paul T. Geist on live TV.
It's time to find your very own demihuman date! But if you can't win anyone over, you must risk leaving the show utterly dateless 3 Good luck! You might need it!

title: The Little Eggy That Could
description: In The Little Eggy That Could, you star as the Easter Egg. As the egg, you must make your way through each level while picking up all of the pieces of candy that there is to collect. After all of the candy has been collected, a Golden Egg will appear somewhere within the level. You must locate and jump into this Golden Egg in order to be teleported to the next level or world.

title: Packin' Plax
description: The goal is to group the plax together based on their colors. Once you get three or more similar plax grouped together they will be packaged up and ready to ship. The groups can be formed either vertically, horizontally, or diagonally - and you will receive more or less points depending on the size and style of package. Be careful though, because if you miss catching five plax or fill up the table without any packages then the game will end.

title: Make a Good Mega Man Level Contest Remastered
description:
The good news: A festival is being held in honor of Mega Man and his tireless heroics! The bad news: Dr. Wily shows up to ruin the fun, and basically everything at the festival tries to kill our hero... wait, didn't we go through this exact routine already?!

MaGMML1 Remastered is a full-fledged remake of the original MaGMML1, rebuilding it completely in a new game engine in an attempt to bring it up to the standards of subsequent contests.

While the entries are the same beyond engine fixes and extremely minor tweaks, the entire rest of the game has been completely revamped! The hubs, tier bosses, extras, you name it, have all been completely redone, all in a totally functional, smooth 60 FPS. Of course, the remake doesn't fix most of the problems that you might have with the entries themselves, but the playing experience is (hopefully) much improved, so new generations of people interested in the series can experience its roots without being dumped into a pit by Rush Jet!

Tons of quality life features have been added as well, be it Skip Teleporters or leaderboards inspired by MaGMML2, or new options such as being able to toggle lives on and off and being able to choose if you want to view the very outdated judge comments or instead innocently pretend MaGMML1's judge rubric didn't exist.

title: Mean City: Learn English or Die!
description:
Mean City is an interactive adventure game in which the player has 10 hours to save Harry, a television reporter you meet in the beginning of the game. Mean City is being terrorized by an evildoer, the Jinx, and you have to find out why and stop him by interacting with various characters - in english of course.

The game consists of various grammar and vocabulary related puzzles which are accompanied by real actors and video sequences which advance the story. In addition, there is an excercise book bundled with the game.

title: Flux: Spectrum
description:
Flux: Spectrum (panta rhei/tempora mutantur) is a surreal psychological horror game created in RPG Maker 2003, about a psychologist who uses a device that allows therapists to enter the mind of their clients. It is the first entry in the -UX Series.

Nima Chuutou is a police officer forced to take temporary leave because of her worsening performance following the death of her partner. An ailing alcoholic plagued by nightmares and flashbacks, she seeks psychiatric help and meets Dr. Maria Evangeline de la Cruz-Algundy, a psychologist who specializes in using a "mentally invasive" device called Panacea.

Panacea allows the therapist to enter the mind of their patient and reach a diagnosis by surveying the mind of their patient through a reconstruction of their subconscious and memories. However, therapy using mentally invasive devices is a ripe subject of controversy in the 2030s and seems to have more risks than benefits.

title: Astlibra Revision Gaiden: The Cave of Phantom Mist
description: A side story for ASTLIBRA starring a new female protagonist in a 20+ hour adventure! Take control of the baker's reclusive daughter to challenge randomly generated dungeons in a roguelike-style gameplay loop. Use all new magic attacks to beat up your enemies and relieve your stress.

title: Event Horizon XV
description: Loosely following the movie 'Even Horizon', you play as a marine sent to investigate the titular ship as it has been rediscovered around the orbit of Jupiter. As you arrive on the ship you realize that it has brought back with it the unspeakable horrors from where it had disappeared to as it digs deep into your mind, looking for your deepest darkest fears.

title: Gateway I
description: A remaster of Gateway made for The Gateway Trilogy.

title: Gateway II
description: A remaster of Gateway II made for The Gateway Trilogy.

title: Gateway III
description: Gateway III – the lengthiest installment in the Gateway series by far – is a completely new addition that loosely builds upon the previous games in surprising and discomforting ways.

title: Demonology 101
description: A small game about finding the true names of demons.

title: Unaccomplished
description: Unaccomplished is a Yume Nikki fangame. Yin Ming wakes up on his balcony in the midst of a thunderstorm. He is unable to leave his room due to it, so all he has left to do is sleep, and dream. The player explores the dream world and collects effects that change Yin Ming's form and grants him new abilities.

title: Yume Tsushin
description: Yume Tsushin is a traditional Yume Nikki fangame. The game stars Wormiko. You can explore the dream world to collect effects, or leave the room and explore the town instead.

title: Insomnis Experiment
description:
Inspired by 'The Russian Sleep Experiment' creepypasta.

'Russian researchers in the late 1940s kept five people awake for fifteen days using an experimental gas based stimulant.'

Explore the facility, find out what happened and what remains there.

Keep cutting.

The game is 10 minutes long.

title: No-good Noelle
description: Noelle and Ivy's friendship starts falling apart when only one of them gets accepted as a Snowflake Maker apprentice. Will you attempt to fix things, or move on to something even worse?

title: Ghost Six
description:
In Hazama Station there has been a strange phenomenon of people disappearing for some time.
Tsutsuji and Sumire will try to solve this paranormal phenomenon in order to repay their debts.

title: Ichigokuruiza
description: A go-shintai. Ren Kijirushi has been kidnapped and placed in charge of curing believers' illnesses by sharing his blood with them. Takumi Natsume, once in the same position as Ren and nicknamed "the child of the gods," is assigned to look after him. Through repeated rituals and exchanges, the two are...

title: Marbling Clear
description: Wata, a vampire, washes up on an island where a god is worshipped as "Mother". After drinking the "demon-sealing cursed blood" of "Mother's" trustee Momen, Wata is cursed to die if he drinks any blood other than Momen's. Wata begins his life on the island.....

title: No Salvation
description:
The kidnapped protagonist, Maya Higuchi, lives a strange communal life with Satori Nakahara, a hitman.
Maya, who was rejected by his parents and others because of his "talent" and wanted to die, finds salvation in the "violence that destroys all of his opponents" that Satori is trying to kill.

title: Shinin
description:
The protagonist continues to play mysterious games.
He doesn't know why he's playing that game or how long he's been playing, so he keeps playing...
However, the game and reality gradually begin to mix...?

title: Shirobara Gakuen Satsujin Jiken
description:
The White Rose Academy is a boarding school for young ladies.

Yuriko Nagashiro, student council president and the daughter of the school's director, and Ranko Kanzaki, a first-year student at the school, witness Sayuri Okabe's suicide.

However, Yuriko suspects that this incident wasn't a suicide.
Together with Ranko, she begins to solve the mysteries of the school.

title: Kyouki Drip
description:
The protagonist wakes up in a mysterious dormitory, having lost his memory. A place shut with iron bars, guns installed and no windows.

Reveal the "true nature" of the residents gathered at that place.

Instructions will be given by letter.
What is the "true nature" of the residents?
--And, what is your own "true nature"?

title: L.OD
description:
A 2D exploration adventure.
The main character, Yoi, receives a letter from his dead sister, Chitose, saying that she wants to tell him a secret.
In order to find out the truth, Yoyi heads to an abandoned laboratory.

title: Matar Gente Rica de Skate
description: Matar Gente Rica de Skate is a simple and short roguelike, all you have to do is kill the ten* billionaires on your list to reach zero, each stage is randomized in its enemies, instruments that will play in the background, and the seven powerups that you can pick up.

title: Project Ascension
description: Ascension is a Classless World of Warcraft Mod with over a million players since 2016. You can pick from any of the existing spells and talents from all classes, and play through the best WoW expansions: Vanilla, Burning Crusade and Wrath of the Lich King. This is World of Warcraft done your own way.

title: Buckshot Roulette
description: Buckshot Roulette is an indie tabletop horror game that reimagines Russian roulette using a pump-action shotgun instead of a revolver. The player faces off against a computer-controlled opponent called "The Dealer" across three rounds, with consumable items introduced in later rounds that add strategic depth. The game features a single-player campaign and a multiplayer mode for up to four players.

title: Jack 3 the Future
description: Jack 3 the Future is the threequel Jack To The Future, and sees the return of the personalized, home-built time machine! When a mysterious force causes Jack's YouTube account to be demonetized the moment he prepares to upload his new video, he sets off on a grand, WACKY journey across dimensions!

title: Hell Knight
description:
"Hell Knight" is a roguelike deckbuilding game!

You don't have to fight, just choose and judge!

But don't take it lightly, your decisions will either lead your knight to his death, or make him ridiculously powerful.

title: Zeal-X2
description:
Zeal-X2 is a 2.5 D platformer in which you take on the role of Redscar.
Here you can slash your way through enemies and make heads roll.

title: Goldsphere: Completion
description:
Year of 2008. After the second disaster, the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone continues to expand.. More and more people end up either dead, or missing. Scientific expeditions and military operations only result in failure. The few whom survived, often talk about these so-fantastic anomalous formations and mutated animal species.. with all sorts of amazing abilities. The term “S.T.A.L.K.E.R.” just only begins to become a thing.

18th of August, 2008. A young adventure seeker travels to the Exclusion Zone with one mission in mind.. to find the legendary "Wish Granter". However, the true purpose of his journey is known only by him…

What may await our hero on his adventures? You may only find out yourself...

title: The DJ-ROM: Da CD-Extra of Hip-Hop Music
description: The streets of Night City are full of cool sound materials! Make songs in the studio and play them in the club. This is an electric fighting space with a Hip-Hop taste! The game world realistically portrays the life of authentic DJs with 3D graphics. Hone your heart as a DJ while experiencing various events in the city of freedom, opportunity, demonization & violence!

title: The Book of Lulu
description: The Book of Lulu is an interactive multimedia book by Romain Victor-Pujebet where player can flip the pages to read through and click on various images in the book. Certain images in the book allow for slide changes or result in a small video animation, while others open in full screen mode with ability to interact with them by clicking on a certain area. Interactive images allow changes such as changing the sky, weather, season, colors and mode, while interactive videos let you interact with objects and characters which result in a short FMV sequence.

title: Dormitabis Remastered
description:
Dormitabis Remastered is a FNaF fangame that takes place shortly after FNaF3 where the good ending is not canon and therefore is not related to any FNaF games past FNaF SL.
It follows its own canon that works off of the basis of FNaF3's fire, with Springtrap dying shortly after it.
With a standard amount of deaths the game can take about 2 hours to beat in a standard session, even longer if playing casually.
to 100% is also WAY longer as there are secret areas/minigames and other challenges that give you special rewards as well.

title: Fibrilis
description: What would you do if you were forced out of your still life into a dying world of tangled patterns?

title: Everything's Fine
description:
Emily feels a lot more tired than usual. Ethan knows something's wrong, but his sister insists that everything's fine.

She says he can't go to the attic. She says that it's empty, and there's nothing interesting up there, but he knows he didn't imagine the fear in her eyes she gazed upon that locked door.

Emily's acting strange. He often hears her talking to herself in the bathroom at night, repeating over and over, that "everything's fine".

Isn't it?

title: Not Even Remotely Fair
description: Not Even Remotely Fair is a limit-removing Doom II megaWAD project lead by Peter "MegaSphere" Lawrence designed around Doom's Nightmare difficulty setting.

title: My Time at Etheria
description:
After waking up from a bizarre dream, you find yourself lost in the middle of the woods. Unfamiliar with your surroundings, you decided to make your way out of the forest...

Travel across the unfamiliar world, and prepare yourself for the troubles ahead. Will you find your way back home?

This game is based on old-school RPG game titles with a single linear story.

title: American Truck Simulator: Missouri
description: Get ready for an epic trucking journey to Missouri in American Truck Simulator! Explore vibrant cities, including the iconic Saint Louis with its stunning Gateway Arch. Missouri's landscapes are diverse and beautiful, from the rolling Ozark hills to charming small towns and vast farmlands.

title: Pseudomod
description: Adventure through sewers, creepy houses, forests, caves, mines, underground rivers, dockyard, deserts, boats, prisons, space robots. Drive and race hovercrafts and your desert buggy down the sewers and dangerous desert track. Pseudomod will give you multiple hours of quality singleplayer gameplay and enjoyment.

title: The Princess Cliche
description: The Princess Cliche is an episode for Super Mario Bros. X game and its branches. This is the second episode that was released alongside Super Mario Bros. X 1.1.0 Beta 1.

title: Synthesis
description: Synthesis is a visual novel created for Antithesis, a Persona 5 Joker x Crow roleswap fanzine. In an alternate universe where Goro Akechi leads the Phantom Thieves and Akira Kurusu/Ren Amamiya is the Detective Prince, Synthesis lets you experience Joker and Crow's friendship and rivalry from a whole new perspective.

title: Station 5
description:
You are trapped in an underground subway.
Observe your surroundings carefully and take the correct trains to reach the 'Station 5' and exit the subway.

title: Blues Brothers 2023
description: Blues Brothers 2023 exists because @msx2plus made a bunch of awesome skull from google images edits as titlepics and they expire after this year. Bullets have been replaced by Plasma, and the Plasma Rifle is now a default weapon in Slot 2

title: NaNoCollabMo: Autumn Harvest
description: 7 map WAD made to evoke the Autumn season. Fallen leaves, mushrooms, and lots of orange!

title: Hatomo Battles the Yomi Demons
description: This is just a simple 10 map episode for zdoom. the levels are inspired by the level design of doom2, so the maps are simple and linear to very linear levels.

title: Visions of Eternity
description: Visions of Eternity is an episode for Ultimate Doom. There is also a PDF booklet with additional information and trivia about the episode.

title: FNaF Ultimate Edition
description:
‎Take the coolest parts from the Five Nights at Freddy's series, put them together and boom- you've got FNaF Ultimate Edition!
With its own story (differentiating from the original series' plot) and some unique game mechanics (on top of the originals you're familiar with), this game is worth giving a try if you're looking for something in the style of Classic FNaF!

title: The Lost Key
description: The task before you is very big, but you are not one of those who give up, it is your time, get up and move and retrieve the key.

title: Return: Unknown
description: Welcome to Return: Unknown, a survival-adventure game set in a post-apocalyptic Manhattan. Once a thriving metropolis, now abandoned by civilization after the outbreak of a global virus, it offers both challenges and countless possibilities.

title: Ja'afar's nightmare
description: Ja'afar is a little kid who is been through an accident lately ... a car accident ... he survived with all his family members for sure but the accident affected him and for the first time of his life he experiences a weird but unique nightmare ... you have to reach the end of this nightmare.

title: Angry Piggies Space
description: Angry Piggies Rio is back with a brand new series! Shoot Angry Bad Piggies on targets and winn all levels! Use different elements to help the piggies reach their destination. Bad Piggies Online is free and no registration needed!

title: Point Click Killer: Act Two
description:
Detective Clarke is on the case and hunting the serial killer from the first Point Click Killer game of the series. Can you track down and catch the killer?

Point Click Killer: Act Two is a horror, point & click, gory adventure game that picks up where you left off in the first game. Good luck!

title: Lar
description: Lar is a horror-themed puzzle game currently being developed by one person using Unreal Engine 5.

title: Fetish Locator Week Three
description: The last chapter of Fetish Locator is finally here! Our girls are returning for one last ride filled with seduction and a lot of sex! Try to uncover all mysteries surrounding the Fetish Locator App. Romance more than 20 girls and discover more secrets as you shape the conclusion of your story in Fetish Locator Week 3.

title: Part Time Job
description: Part Time Job is a My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic Visual Novel developed by Yumi-And-ZB, also going by Samuel Kingsley. You play as pegasus mare Pastel Sketch, who is going through financial issues due to her artwork not earning her enough money. Looking for a part time job, she goes to the town bulletin board; among several choices she decides she wouldn't be good at, there's an ad for working at a hospital. Turns out it's a mental hospital, run by Fluttershy. Deciding she needs the rather large payment of thirty thousand bits, Pastel takes the job. She'll wish she hadn't. The game is based off of the song Wide Knowledge of the Late Madness.

title: Test Test Test
description:
Test Test Test is a retro pixel-art point-and-click puzzle adventure where you must escape a time loop as an overworked office employee.
Find clues, gather information, and solve cryptic puzzles with alternate reality game elements.
Will you be able to release yourself from the clutch of time itself? Or will you be stuck in this reality forever?

title: Goddess of Hentai
