description: Soul of Butterflies is a point-and-click adventure game with a unique worldview. Players will take on the role of Anders and explore an extremely enigmatic world. Amidst indescribable struggles and fears, they will gradually piece together the truth of this world.

title: Soul of Butterflies: The Lobby
description: "Soul of Butterflies: Incubation" is a point-and-click adventure game with a unique worldview. Players will take on the role of Anders and explore an extremely enigmatic inn as they unveil the world's hidden reality.

title: Master of Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles - Cat Family Christmas
description: Experience the pure magic of Christmas through the eyes of a lovable family of red fluffy kittens in this enchanting tale of festive joy and heartwarming discovery! 34 picture!

title: Snezhinka: Sentinel Girls 2
description: A high-tempo shooter with simple controls. Enhance your character with cards and defend various targets as an employee of a private military company.

title: Loop Frogs
description: Guide two froggy friends through a pixelated, time-warping adventure. This 2D platformer will require you to master the time loop and leap your way across 30+ levels of hazards and puzzles.

title: Mr. Mueller's Grand Experiment
description: Live as the assistant to one of history's most remarkable figures: George Mueller, a man who witnessed orphans dying young in the streets of 1830's England and decided he would care for them, no matter the cost.

title: The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest
description: After a visit to the psychologist that went horribly wrong you’re trapped in the mind of a game developer on the brink of physical and emotional burnout during the last stages of an intense project. Experience a metroidvania drenched in anxiety based on a very true story.

title: Junklands
description: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

title: Requiem Reverie
description: Requiem Reverie is an immersive cooperative fantasy RPG that invites players to embark on an epic journey through a rich and expansive world filled with mysteries. The game places a strong emphasis on teamwork and strategic party mechanics, offering a deeply engaging and social gaming experience.

title: Project Moonborn
description: Unleash werewolf fury in an ultra-violent 2D roguelike action platformer while seeking to rescue lost pups and escape interstellar prison.

title: Helix: Descent N Ascent
description: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

title: College Kings 2: Episodes 4 & 5 "Moving Out"
description: Continue the story of College Kings 2, a radically raunchy choice-driven Adult Visual Novel. The SVC administration is furious about the increasingly wild activities of the college fraternities, and the boot comes down hard in Episodes 4 & 5 "Moving Out".

title: My Confounding Cat is Criminally Cute!
description: A cute, wholesome yaoi / boys love visual novel about a grumpy wizard and... a black cat? Wait, what?

title: Edge of Soul: Ragnarok
description: Echo of Soul is a free-to-play Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game with a fast-paced action combat, various character customizations and no subscription fee required. Travel the vast open world, compete in PvP modes, and explore EoS.

title: Resident Evil 4: Gold Edition
description: The Gold Edition includes the main game, the additional story mode Separate Ways, as well as the Extra DLC Pack, and is available February 9, 2024!

title: Healthy Hero: Tower Defense
description: Healthy Hero is a Tower Defense game with roguelike elements, where the player protects a hero from attacking junk food. You need to build and upgrade defensive towers to stop the enemies. The levels become increasingly challenging with new types of junk food and waves

title: The Complex Tragedy
description: The Complex Tragedy is a single-player horror game set in a massive living complex. While exploring different areas, you will feel the fear as you uncover the creepy and deserted side of the complex. Brace yourself for spine-chilling experience within The Complex.

title: Battlefield 1942: The Complete Collection
description: Gear up and head out for the most explosive firefights online. From the opening battles of WWII to the brutal jungle conflicts of Vietnam, this is all-out war like only Battlefield can deliver.

title: Children of the Sun
description: Burning with anger, The girl wages a one-woman war against the cult, taking them down cultist by cultist, bullet by bullet, until she reaches her true target: the leader. Along the way she will unravel the dark truth about this mysterious order and the atrocities committed by them in the name of their master. In this tactical third-person puzzle-shooter you assume control of one bullet, guiding it through increasingly complex and challenging levels to kill cultists, trigger traps, and reshape the environment. Every shot counts and ruthless precision is rewarded. Taking down the cult is deeply satisfying; doing it with style even more so.

title: Akiya
description:
A wholesome game about exploring an abandoned traditional Japanese house with a new friend.

You play as a high school student, and your first summer job is to photograph an Akiya—also known as "empty house"!

Well, it looks like you've arrived... And a cute guy wants to tag along?

title: Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator
description: Hajwala isn’t typical drifting, it’s a vibe straight from the Gulf streets. Drift the Arab way, go into high speed and lose control on the highway. It’s all about sliding sideways with style on highways and open roads, showing oﬀ your skills while staying in full control. It’s loud, wild, and a lot of fun. In Highway Drifter: Hajwala Simulator you get to feel all that energy. Whether you’re cruising the desert or speeding through mountain roads, Customize everything during gameplay, your car is all about your style. Pick your favorite shade of color and choose your tint level, switch up the rims, and mix and match front and back bumpers to match your style. You can even customize your license plate to make it totally yours.

title: Fit My Cat
description: Purrfect cat organizer – fit them all

title: Them's Fightin' Herds: Nidra
description:
The 10th character to join the TFH roster is Nidra the Tapir, a dream-eating stance character with nightmare mix-ups.

This DLC includes:
• Additional playable character: “Nidra”
• New stage: Slumber Sanctuary
• Nidra Pixel Lobby avatar

Note:
• This product is included in the Season 1 Pass. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
• This item requires the base game (sold separately) to be used.

title: Them's Fightin' Herds: Baihe
description:
The 11th character is Baihe the Dragon, a fire-breathing trap zoner who can dominate her space with masterful magic management!

This DLC includes:
• Additional playable character: “Baihe”
• New stage: Smoldering Heaven's Nest
• Baihe Pixel Lobby avatar

Note:
• This product is included in the Season 1 Pass. Be careful not to make

title: SnowRunner: Year 4 Pass
description: The Year 4 Pass allows you to expand your SnowRunner experience by granting you access to four seasons of content, including new vehicles, new skins, new missions, new maps to explore and more.

title: SnowRunner: Year 1 Pass + Year 2 Pass + Year 3 Pass + Year 4 Pass
description: Upgrade your game and get ready for the ultimate off-road experience! SnowRunner’s Year 1 Pass + Year 2 Pass + Year 3 Pass + Year 4 Pass grants you access to 16 seasons of content - including 4 expansions - from the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3 and Year 4 Passes.

title: Lingjing
description: Lingjing is a fantasy themed single player game developed based on Unreal Engine 5 with an open world 3D realistic art style. The game is currently under development and only open for testing applications. In the beta version, we only offer some content for players to experience.

title: Circular Defense
description: ”Circular Defense" is a real-time tower defense game in which you intercept enemies by placing circles around them to prevent them from hitting the planet in the center of the screen. Strengthen your turrets and defend your planet from the endless enemies!

title: Chess Twist
description: A game of chess set on a procedurally generated board, where tiles can have 3 or 5 diagonals and straight lines bend around your opponent's defenses. Same rules, different battlefield. Opportunities for new strategies are hidden in plain sight. Will you see them before your opponent does?

title: Chick'n Mushroom Soup
description: Chick’n Mushroom Soup is an anime styled Visual Novel which you've been accepted into a culinary academy with sweet girls. Although you were a total asocial in the past, you now have an opportunity to change this.

title: Chompania
description: A 2D platformer that immerses you into the space adventure of Eddie, stranded on the quirky planet Chompania. It's time to jump, fight, solve, and conquer your way out of this pixelated space jam!

title: Citadelum
description: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.

title: City Defense Z
description: City Defense Z blends fast-paced survival and base-building in a roguelite experience. Strategically use cards to strengthen defenses and expand your base, then face massive zombie hordes when the night falls. Adapt every run, unlock meta upgrades, and see how long your city can survive.

title: City of Graves
description: As a soldier in a lifeless city after a disease outbreak, fight creatures and hunt for what will save the city.

title: Classic Arcade Fishing
description: A masterpiece of classic arcade fishing shooting game with many expanded ways to play! Picture upgrade, explosion rate upgrade, welfare upgrade, everything upgrade! Super high gun magnification, super many bosses, super high magnification, super explosive, and make you rich in one shot!

title: Cloaked Protocol
description: Dive into Cloaked Protocol: an electrifying retro stealth-action game. Outwit elite mercenaries with strategic stealth in a world of espionage, where every move weaves a gripping narrative.

title: Crystal Breaker
description:
Shoot the enemy at close range! Crystal Breaker is a vertically scrolling shmup that focuses on close range attack.

This game is an aggressive shmup where close range attacks and quick destruction are important for both stage clear and score attacks.

title: Crystal Heroes
description: A Fantasy RPG game using Match 3 for game mechanics instead of Dice.

title: Cubebam
description: Is an exciting 2D physics game where the player has to help grandfather in a barrel break cubes and get to the coin. The goal of the game is to use the available projectiles, which can be obtained by breaking colored cubes.

title: CubeCubeRubik
description: CubeCubeRubik is a casual Rubik's Cube game with a simple and classic gameplay. If you are interested in the Rubik's Cube, want to challenge the limits of your speed or logic, or want your children to learn about the Rubik's Cube, you might as well give it a try.

title: Cube War
description: An action game in which we try to survive by killing enemies in space.

title: Crazy module
description: This is a classic stand-alone casual puzzle game

title: Crazy Candydish
description: Crazy Candydish is a match -3 style puzzle game where colored pieces fall onscreen from 365 degrees and form shapes using 2D Physics. You must make matches and combos to earn bonus points. Earn points to move on through 75 levels.

title: Crazy Animal Choir
description: A casual game where you create music using various animal sounds. You can compose your own music, perform yourself, and manage your own choir.

title: Crayon Computer
description: Crayon Computer is a 2D physics-based open-ended programming puzzle game. (if you call that programming)

title: Crimson wind
description: Stephen, having inherited a sawmill, decides to sell it to fund a documentary about an unpunished murderer from his city. Little did he imagine where this decision would lead.

title: Crop and Claw
description: Crop and Claw is a classic-style JRPG centered around dragons in a lush realm known as the "Garden". The plantlife has gone awry, bringing a time of decline and stress across the realm. Return to the era of simple questing, dungeons, and progression.

title: Cursed Order
description: Indie story-rich RPG game in a world where humor and mystery intertwine.

title: Damn it!
description: Climb to the top with the help of marshmallows.

title: Dangerous Fight
description: Welcome to the adrenaline-pumping adventure "Dangerous Fight" - an online shooter that will take you to the heart of the action in the atmosphere of the city of Yerevan, Armenia. You will go into epic battles where the technology of the future and the cultural heritage of the ancient city mix.

title: DangoVerse
description: Play as your favorite Vtubers from DangoFam! Engage in battles, explore, and clear your way through armies of mobs.

title: Dark Lessons
description: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

title: Death Machine
description: Conquer the mechanical citadel in Death Machine - a metroidvania, with a roguelite item system. Gather items to gain strength, navigate the perilous machine world, leverage the aid of ancient demons, and seek out dangerous denizens to defeat before the forces of the machine close in on you.

title: Dear Edmund
description: Navigate a Victorian street under strict party rule. As Edmund, choose between personal gain and community health. Manage resources, upgrade your home and street, and face a dynamic environment. Your decisions will shape your destiny and the street's future.

title: Death Fighter
description: This is a simple side-scroller made by one person. It's my first game and I would really appreciate any reviews from you !

title: Death Penalty Hero
description: A fantasy role-playing game where you become an adventurer and move freely around the world, fulfilling the "righteousness" of each person's heart.

title: DarkHospital
description: Survival horror in a scary hospital

title: Decurion
description: Combine the unique abilities of Mechs and Pilots in strategic synergy. Team up with friends in local co-op to conquer dynamic levels with different geometry, shaping your strategic approach. Watch out for anomalies introducing unexpected challenges as you defend your base and strive to stay alive.

title: Deep Among the Swarm
description: Deep Among the Swarm is a challenging survival RTS roguelite about surviving against thousands of enemies. Drill ever deeper underground while fighting the endless onslaught of the Swarm. Can you save humanity?

title: Deep in the Woods
description: The Deep Forest tells a classical tale of searching for family. Players will experience the changing seasons throughout the game and explore enchanting scenes depicting each season.

title: Devil's Hideout
description: Devil's Hideout is a horror point and click adventure. Lauren learns from a mystic that her young sister is still alive, with cultists staging her death. Traveling to the hospital where her sister received care, Lauren plunges headfirst into a nightmare.

title: Devilish League
description: Swing, hit, and bounce! Blast enemies with your heavy bat in this hilarious cartoon roguelike!

title: Devastating Fog
description: Devastating Fog is a top-down survival shooter roguelike game. You play as one of the few survivors, whose goal is to reclaim the Earth from the fog. Fight enemies, craft and upgrade your weapons. Discover the deserted post-apocalyptic world where everything wants you dead.

title: DitherDream
description: A trippy little exploration game. Let the world guide you through a strange and uniquely beautiful archipelago.

title: Dive The Depths
description: Dive The Depths is an action-roguelike set beneath the ocean's surface. As a humble diver, you must navigate the world filled with bizarre sea creatures, submerged ruins, and forgotten histories. Can you conquer the depths and unravel the secrets that hidden beneath the waves?

title: Divine Twins
description: Dual roles, open world adventure，be both hero and spouse.

title: Dirty Rotten Bounders
description: An original game, combining the strategy of Reversi with all of the excitement of a fun, fast-paced, tile-flipping, arcade action game. Jump player around the boards of 9x9 tiles, destroying chasers caught on flipping tiles. 15 boards per level, 3 levels of difficulty.

title: Captain Willie
description: Ahoy there! Welcome to Captain Willie's crew! Join us on a maritime adventure as his trusty deckhand. Your job? Tend to routine ship tasks—chop potatoes, stoke the furnace, and keep the deck shipshape.

title: Pop Up Computer
description: An early, interactive CD-ROM title by Saru Brunei, who would later go on to develop titles such as Jungle Park and Cubivore. Was also slated for release on Apple's short-lived Pippin console, though it's not known if this version released.

title: Winter Fragments
description: Winter Fragments is a cute slice of life visual novel with light yuri undertones about a couple of best friends set in 2001. It’s a nostalgic, sentimental story about the joys of creating: particularly when it’s done with a dear friend.

title: Yandere no Sutoka
description: Saiko No Sutoka is a survival horror game set in Akademi High School where players must escape from a yandere character while navigating the school environment. Players search for an exit key to escape while avoiding either Ayano or Ayato, who actively hunts them throughout the building. The game features stealth mechanics including hiding in lockers, audio cues through heartbeat sounds that intensify as the pursuer approaches, and environmental hazards such as trip wires and thrown knives. If the yandere loses track of the player for an extended period, they will cut the power to darken the environment and continue their pursuit. The game combines elements of hide-and-seek gameplay with tension-building mechanics in a school setting.

title: Minecraft: Godzilla
description: It’s time to meet the king of monsters in the new Godzilla adventure world by Team-KYO and Impress. Select the Godzilla film you fancy best and engage in city-smashing fun. Play your way by escaping Godzilla’s wrath or even destroying the city as the blocky beast itself.

title: Minecraft: Jurassic World Adventures
description: Step into a modern world learning to coexist with prehistoric dinosaurs in the wild. Play as one of five iconic characters as you learn to survive encounters with apex predators while helping to protect and rescue vulnerable dinosaurs. Discover familiar locations and vast new regions as you fend off poachers, collect samples, and unlock new mysteries.

title: Overnet
description: Forge a legendary legacy in this electrifying free-to-play Collectible Card Game where you can create your own characters, craft your cards to build perfect decks and engage in epic battles as you rise to become the supreme OverKnight.

title: Dreamslayer
description: Dreamslayer is an epic fantasy first-person hack’n’zap swarm arena game with retro styling. Defend your world from a Demon invasion from beyond the stars.

title: MyGF: Another
description: A brand new game in the world of 'My GF Doesn't Know What I'm Into!' Discover new sides to the cast and enjoy the story from different perspectives.

title: DCS: P-51D Debden Eagles Campaign by Reflected Simulations
description: Some of the first American airmen to join the air war over Europe were the volunteers of the RAF's Eagle Squadrons. In 1942 they were transferred to the Mighty Eighth Air Force under the 4th Fighter Group, based in Debden, Essex.

title: Hellspresso
description: Hellspresso is a fast-paced cooking game that combines restaurant management with strategic planning and development. Serve and clean tables, design your kitchen, discover new recipes, plan your menu, switch to your secret magic kitchen, gain the trust of your customers and unlock all their secrets!

title: Mazemerizzz
description: Action! Adventure! DEATH! (Well, sometimes) Fun! Fear! Rewards! Puzzles! Traps! AND TORCHES! Jump, sprint, run and walk through various traps and obstacles. Use real time reaction to get past truly chaotic dangers. Interact with various puzzles to find the solution. Adjustable Third to First person.

title: OnePunch
description: Punch or be defeated, there can only be one outcome amidst this nonstop action! Match the timing of a string of never-ending sandbags to conquer!

title: Dungeon Slasher
description: Dungeon Slasher is a roguevania pixelated side-scrolling action game, where you battle powerful enemies and bosses in thrilling 2D combat, utilizing the weapons and skills of diverse characters.

title: Extraordinary: Monster
description: Karena received an urgent mission: to hunt down Professor Selon who killed his wife and children. However, various signs showed that the matter was not a simple murder. Karena followed the clues to the abandoned Alberto laboratory, and the case actually led to a strange crystal Block - ENP

title: Somniata
description: Uncover the mystery—turned nightmare—of a missing family in rural Massachusetts. A lone detective must survive the horror unleashed upon a family of four.

title: Nebula Flow
description: Nebula Flow is a music game where you follow the melodic trail charted by your dog across colorful pixel art landscapes. Stock up on notes to power your canine companion to the end of each song!

title: Fernbus Simulator: Altano TX
description: Experience the Altano TX with three fully functional and intricately detailed variants, each offering numerous features for a unique driving experience.

title: Fernbus Simulator: Astromega
description: The Astromega - a top class double-decker that not only shines with its impressive design, but also offers generous space and comfort for a stylish trip across Europe.

title: Fernbus Simulator: Altano TDX
description: Two particularly outstanding variants of the Altano TDX with an incomparable feature for maximum travel comfort: TDX20, TDX21!

title: Ace of Jackpot
description:
Survive in a maniac casino by throwing your chips at the enemies to get even more. Bet on the slot machines to get upgrades and satisfy your appetite for fortune in this round survivor shooter game.

Become the Jackpot Ace!

title: Ceres Fauna: Seasons of Promise
description:
A Hololive fan game featuring Ceres Fauna of Hololive EN Promise.

Play as Fauna, who, upon waking up in an unfamiliar land, must find the other Promise members and find a way home.

title: Missile Wars
description: Destroy or be destroyed. Missile Wars is a high-pressure arms race where players must defend their asteroid from enemy missile strikes while investing in crucial tech upgrades to gain the upper hand.

title: Forza Motorsport: 1985 Buick #6 Performance Motorsports Somerset Regal Trans-Am
description: Forza Motorsport 1985 Buick #6 Performance Motorsports Somerset Regal Trans-Am

title: Naraka: Bladepoint - Flying Squirrel
description: Grappling Hook Legendary Skin [Flying Squirrel]

title: Getting Canceled
description: Navigate through everyday office life at the marketing department of a mid-size soft beverage company in this visual novel.

title: Neon Auto Party
description: Build a party to auto-battle through waves of enemies in a futuristic fantasy setting. Each unit has its own deck of cards that determines their performance in battle. Find and buy items while leveling up units to take advantage of powerful synergies and reach the end of the dungeon!

title: My Sweet Floating in the Void
description: The game is a first-person puzzle adventure, with wacky and old-fashioned graphics, which will transport the player into a dreamlike, psychedelic world composed of an experimental game system that will challenge and test even the most experienced puzzle gamers in the industry.

title: Hollow: Cook Off
description: Stylish and Deadly shooterHollow: Cook Off is the mix of sidescroll shooter and stylish action.You are the quiet but skillful agent, Hollow. And you're going to infiltrate a mysterious factory.Shot, Cut, Float and make your combination.Fight quickly and glamorously but coolly.

title: Star Conflict: Baphomet. Weapons of victory
description: This pack includes:Active module “Ties of shadows”Weapon Missile module “Trinity”Unique modifier “Baphomet” shield recuperatorUnique modifier “Baphomet” pulse discharge60 monocrystalsA set of resources for 50 ores: (Vanadium + Silicon + Graphite + Osmium) + 50 Crystal shards.

title: One Military Camp: Christmas Season
description: Celebrate Christmas with our new free DLC for One Military Camp. Customize your base with armored snowmen. an inflatable Santa, Toy trains and many other decorative items. Build your camp, train your troops and carry out missions to defeat Dragan with a merry mood.

title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Hidden Giftware
description: Brace yourselves—winter has come to Byteland! Get ready to jump into a festive fiesta with 5 new winter island levels. Skate and slide your way into this new chilly chapter filled with slippery challenges all around the HUB area.

title: Oji-Mama
description: "Relying on someone else? That's just not possible." A young man, exhausted from working at a toxic company, decides to recuperate in the countryside. Supporting him is a kind and buff uncle. The uncle becomes a mama figure, healing the young man's body and soul with erotic healing powers!

title: Heretic's Fork: Inside The Fire
description: Dive 'Inside the Fire' with Disturbed: 7 Exclusive Character Variants and 4 Electrifying Tracks from 'Indestructible'!

title: Highrise City: Metro & Planes
description: Metro & Planes is the first DLC for Highrise City and builds up on the successful formula to create realistic cities with complex economy structures. It will allow you to optimize your public transport systems and to increase your trading capacities.

title: L'Île Archéo
description: Explore a strange island and discover the secret of the mysterious human civilisation. Restore artefacts and uncover the past in this serious game about ecology, archeology and what will remain after we are gone.

title: Gloaming Comedian Simulator: Scapegoath Science
description: "Scapegoath Science," the first DLC for Gloaming Comedian Simulator, plunges Barry Sazou into a comically chaotic world of the Mad Scientist. Survive another weekend in Transylvania making your way out of cheer jokes.

title: Saturn
description: Saturn is a tactical RPG set on the moons of Saturn and on Earth. The protagonist controls robots on the moons of Saturn and explores an underground city where one can find keys to the secrets of deep space.

title: Gorillaz
description: Released in 2001, this was the first album made by the band Gorillaz. In the package it was included a collection of games, wallpapers and videoclips.

title: Drop It
description: Drop It: Stack a delectable fruit platter! Combine fruits strategically for higher scores, but beware of the limited space. How many fruits can you fit before it spills out over the edge? Retry for a fresh shot at the High Score! Ready to taste victory? Drop in now and see how high you can stack!

title: Liminal Border Part II
description: Unfairly saddled with crippling debt after the events of Part I, Itsuki Ninomae and the gang turn to fellow student and daughter of a crime lord Kotoko Teshigawara for help. An intertwined web of loyalties and desire awaits as Itsuki, Kotoko and the others fight for justice.

title: Elise
description: Awakened in a bunker amidst a zombie outbreak after a car crash, guide Elise through harrowing challenges, solve puzzles, and face relentless undead hordes and uncovering the bunker's dark secrets

title: Cum Queens
description: Welcome to the captivating world of Cum Queens - an adult clicker game that will turn your life into an extraordinary journey through the galaxies of entertainment and unpredictable adventures!

title: ShitMan
description: ShitMan - joyful meat pigeon bullet screen shooting game! The game will make you feel refreshed from start to finish, fighting and brushing! Meanwhile, It is also a joyful story about sudden death and the regeneration of a pile of feces. Life is indeed a pile of shit, but please be your own ShitMan!

title: Meteora's Mystic Merge
description:
Meteora's Mystic Merge is a puzzle game based on the famous Suika game. Instead of fruits, it uses a variety of VTubers as assets. It features currently only a new game mode with a playable character (namely Meteora) who has a special ability, and a classic mode coming soon, which plays a lot like the original though with some changes.

This game is similar to the cult game "2048" as well as "Suika Game" which is a switch exclusive.

title: Making The Leap
description:
Our first attempt at what we deem impossible seldom has the desired outcome. It is only through persistent effort and support that we can make The Leap.

'Making The Leap' was first created in Dreams for the Playstation 4, and has here been lovingly recreated for PC.

title: KKHTA: Security Watch - The Second Part
description: ​The sequel to KKHTA : Security Watch.

title: Nothing Together
description:
Nothing Together is a game that requires you to do nothing. If you act in the game, it's game over. All you have to do is be idler.
Multimode has two modes, Together mode and Battle Royale. In Together mode, up to 20 people unite to do nothing. In Battle Royale, you compete to see who does the least.

title: Victor's Test Night
description:
Victor's Test Night is a first-person adventure game.
You have to explore each museum by day and by night, and find and report on anomalies not seen by day.
The game lasts 5 days, but it's actually 5 minutes and 55 seconds.

title: Parallel Experiment
description: Dive into the secrets of the Parallel Experiment in this 2-player co-op puzzle game. Join forces as two detectives to finally catch the infamous Cryptic Killer. And remember - communication is key!

title: Wage Slave TD
description:
There is no hope in the days of overtime work, but the boss is always urging you? Come to "Wage Slave TD"!

Place various wage slaves with special skills to eliminate all kinds of weird bosses. You will also encounter a variety of random events, which lead to unique attack styles.

title: Touhou Tenkarou: Frantically Forbidden Fruit
description:
Touhou Tenkarou ~ Frantically Forbidden Fruit is a fan-made Touhou Project script for the Touhou Danmakufu ph3 shooting game engine, made by Gore of Re.Phantasmagoria of Imagine Breaker.

The gameplay combines elements from Double Dealing Character and Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom, with a few significant differences. It also happens to feature elements similar to that of Wily Beast and Weakest Creature. Like LoLK, the game has two gameplay modes—Paradise and Legacy—and stages and boss fights are separated in chapters.

title: The Great Math Adventure
description: The Great Math Adventure is a educational game created by 7th Level. Anthropomorphic kid bear Lil' Howie and his friends help teach the player about counting, number patterns, fractions, time, calendar and other topics involving math through mini-games.

title: Mumei ≠ Gura
description: Can you really claim to be their fan if you can't tell them apart?

title: Opsu!
description: Opsu! is an unofficial open-source client for the rhythm game osu!, written in Java using Slick2D and LWJGL.

title: Schrodinger's Cat Experiment
description: Schrodinger's Cat Experiment is a Brazilian indie game in pixel art that combines brain-teasing puzzles with enchanting aesthetics and feline charm. Dead or alive? The cat's fate is in your hands.

title: The Spirit's Destiny
description: Four adventurers are sent to search for the lost spirits and save the world from the evil wizard Zorgal.

title: Kami no Machi
description: A PC visual novel game.

title: Guilty Loving Boxing
description: A 3D boxing game featuring female! You can also play mixed gender matches! In addition to choosing characters and rules and fighting, you can also watch CPU vs CPU or train without being counterattacked! Enjoy boxing in various costumes and situations! *Note: This is a single-player game only.

title: Titan: XCIX
description: Titan: XCIX is a first person adventure that takes place aboard the ill fated star ship of the same name. When an accident rips apart a lone ship on a routine mission, the crew find themselves fighting for survival and each other in a unique Single Player experience that's been in the making for the past two years.

title: Un-Seelie
description: Unseelie is a single player conversion for Half-Life 2 that engages the player in a third person action-adventure quest to save a magical forest overrun with evil Unseelie. Using the elemental abilities of fire and ice, the player beats back the Unseelie and their blight infestation. The player uses knowledge of the elements to pass through environmental puzzles and destroy enemies.

title: Flipside
description: "Flipside" is a 2D puzzle platformer game demo. The demo consists of about 30 levels from the 150 unique levels in the complete edition. You need to solve the puzzles by not only jumping but also flipping the entire screen, and avoid the traps by walking on walls, floors and ceilings!

title: Mega Man X8 16-bit
description:
A fan game made by AlyssonDaPaz. Bringing the original PS2 classic, MegaMan X8 back to its 16-bit roots! Play as X and blast through a familiar yet fresh experience!

Mega Man X8 16-bit is a reimagining of the PS2 original with SNES styled graphics. The aim was to demake X8 in a similar feel to the first three Mega Man X games, while trying to actually finish a low-scope fangame. After two and a half years of development, version 1.0 was released in September 7th 2024, making the game fully playable from start to finish with X, but Zero and Axl are not featured in the game in any capacity.

In addition to the 16-bit graphics, the game differs from the original game by offering slightly different level designs at times, armor effects, and boss weapons.

title: Caution Ahead: Part 1
description: This is the first installment of a three-part series featuring a hide-and-seek type horror experience, with each part consisting of three chapters.

title: Inn Tycoon
description: Inn Tycoon is a relaxing and enjoyable game, offering you the opportunity to build, design, and manage your own inn.

title: Starlit Droplet
description: A star named Seirios is on a task to free their significant other, the moon Luneth. The path, however, isn't free from obstacles...

title: City of Bones
description:
City of Bones revolves around the exploits of detective Santiago de la Cruz in a peculiar city where conspiracy theories, urban legends, and ghosts have more truth to them than he'd care to admit.

With an uncanny ability to converse with the dead and predict misfortunes, he has long since grown used to the oddities of his home. Until...

title: Plop and the Penguin
description: Go with Plop and his friends to the south pole for an exciting adventure. Help the Penguin Pinki that is being chased by criminals. Play 10 funny gnome games and return Pinki to the south pole.

title: Thanatos
description: Thanatos is a first-person psychological horror mystery game that involves finding clues, solving puzzles, and uncovering secrets to prevent a friend from taking their own life.

title: Cangaço Wargame
description:
Originally conceived as a board game, the developers realized during the development process that it was gaining many elements that are closely related to the dynamics of social games. That's precisely why the game was developed for Facebook.

In this multiplayer-focused game, you must lead a group of cangaceiros (bandits) in turn-based battles, navigating through farms, towns, and swamps of the caatinga (Brazilian northeastern region). The battles occur turn by turn, and a single combat can last from a few minutes to several weeks: you make your move and then wait for your opponent (who might be offline at the moment). There are two distinct groups in the game: the cangaceiros and the volante (police force). As you challenge and defeat your enemies, you climb the ranks, getting closer to the title of the cangaço king.

title: Age of the Ring
description:
11 unique factions full of new heroes, spells, and abilities. Hundreds of new maps. A brand-new campaign. A thoroughly reworked and expanded War of the Ring mode - and much more!

The mod aims to create an RTS experience that is faithful to the spirit of the Tolkien mythos, with diverse, engaging and balanced gameplay.

title: Krypta FM
description: Can you solve the mystery of the Beast of Gozdary?

title: Forgotten Hope 2
description:
An award-winning World War II mod for Battlefield 2, covering all aspects of land, air and sea combat, with a focus on realism and historic accuracy.

It is the sequel to Forgotten Hope, one of the most popular mods for Battlefield 1942.

As player, you can take control over an expansive number of authentic WWII equipment; from tanks such as the mighty German King Tiger, to famed aircraft like the British Spitfire, or hit the road with the Willys MB Jeep. Lay your hands on infantry weapons, such as the powerful German Panzerfaust or the fearsome American M1 Garand rifle. Fight your way through the North African deserts, the landing grounds of Normandy, the freezing Ardenne forests, and alongside your comrades in mother Russia!

title: Team Hot Wheels: Night Racer - Street Drift
Team Hot Wheels: Night Racer - Dockyard Destruction
Team Hot Wheels: Night Racer - Rubble Ruckus
Code Wizard: Java Edition
description: An educational game to learn coding in the Java programming language. Compile real code to solve puzzles while working through an RPG style game.

title: Tuiterland 3: Tuenti - La Región Renacida
description: Three years after the events of Tuiterland 3, the region of Tuenti is starting to thrive once again, but even though there's still a path to traverse. There are tons of Tuenti inhabitants with troubles, and Prota and their friends are decided to help them all!

title: I am Lost
description: Oh, you know, just casually strolling through the job market, and bam! There it was – an advertisement so captivating, I couldn't resist its siren call. It promised a future so bright I'd need sunglasses, and the paycheck? Oh, honey, it was singing a sweet serenade to my bank account. Little did I know, they forgot to spill the beans on the whole shebang! The mystery unraveling is almost as exciting as a surprise birthday party...almost.

title: Gym or Jail?
description: You are just a random guy, but not very random, who wants to lose weight and gain some muscles ... but as you already have guessed things don't go the way expected and you get everything except the muscles. Unfortunately, the situation gets worse and worse. Your decision is very important.

title: Five Nights At Shrek's Hotel 2
description:
This game is the second version of our older game 5 Nights At Shrek's Hotel.
You are just another regular customer, just like before...
You only have to stay 5 nights. you know it's going to be fine, it has always been.

title: Crosmorf Adventures
description: A platform and adventure game that guarantees a lot of fun. A story about the abomination of society told in a different and interesting way.

title: Rubber Hose Rampage
description: Rubber Hose Rampage is a classic 2D action game filled with 21 boss battles. Inspired by classical music and rubber hose animation from the 1920s and 1930s.

title: The Fortress of Doom
description: A vanilla Quake map set in an early medieval structure, the final stronghold of the forces of evil here on Earth.

title: Remix Jam
description: Remix Jam is a 30 (+start) map jam for the Copper mod (included) that takes iconic Multiplayer layouts from various games and adapts them into the Quake universe

title: Say Hello to Sunshine
description: A map with the general theme of quake areas mixed with some sand areas

title: Grand Canyon
description: Survive on your own while trying to meet your basic needs such as food, water and shelter, interact with the survivors and fulfill the tasks they give you, plan to escape from the island.

title: The Vast Silence
description: The Vast Silence is a Doom 64-themed episode for Doom 2 designed for limit removing source ports made by various members of Doomer Boards, led by Matador.

title: I Think You Should Marble
description: I think You Should Marble is collection of 10 Marble Themed maps with different color combinations and themes.

title: Colorless Poems
description:
Colorless Poems (色のない詩―ウタ―) is an exploration horror game made by Ryou Mutsumi (睦涼) in July 2020. It was translated into English by Yamikaze.

"When in doubt about where to go.
Look for the highest points.
Keep aiming for them.
Even if you're exhausted."

Colorless Poems is a story about a girl named Akari Yagura who was having amnesia as she only remembers fragments of her memories. Explore the story discovering what happened within while avoiding the monster who chasing you.

title: Solace Inc.
description: Solace Inc. is a survivors-like where you recruit your employees against endless hordes of enemies. Hack, slash, shoot, and blast away foes with the help of your recruits, and become unstoppable with endless combinations!

title: Hardcore Cottagecore
description: Mushroom meadow is being devastated by robots trying to build an Amazon warehouse! It’s time for the fungi to fight back with wild auto-firing abilities like spinning embroidery hoops and mason jar molotov cocktails! Choose a mushroom, play solo or co-cop, survive the horde and win back your turf!

title: Big 8 Solitaire
description: Big 8 Solitaire is a complete collection of the 8 most popular, best loved solitaire games ever invented. It includes mechanical, pictorial, and numeric games, as well as games that require skill and lady luck. Each game is easy to learn and can be quickly mastered, and when you win, the cards dance just for you!

title: MAngband
description: MAngband is a free online multiplayer real-time roguelike game, derived from the single player game Angband.

title: Tangaria
description: Tangaria is multiplayer roguelike game (MMO-roguelike). Tangaria combines the complexity and unpredictability of roguelike genre and social features of MMORPG: kill monsters together with your friends, chat, PvP (on demand), buy a house and open a store to trade your goods with other players… with advanced real-time gameplay – game become semi turn-based when your character is injured.

title: Project Diablo 2
description: PD2 is a mod for Diablo II: Lord of Destruction which includes many quality-of-life and balance changes, along with some new content. It aims to maintain the D2:LoD experience while improving on the game as if development never ceased.

title: Path of Diablo
description: This Diablo II community server has one main goal: Increase build diversity and replayability with as little changes to the original experience as possible. The skill tree has been rebalanced so that skills that are underpowered and rarely used are now viable, allowing you to create many more builds than before. The end game has also been revamped so that more areas are worth exploring, allowing you to experience more varied content. These modifications combine the best ideas from both Diablo II and Path of Exile, two of the best ARPGs in existence.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's 6: Freakshow
description:
It has been more than 40 years since the horrible happenings at Freddy's, Fazbear Entertainment is Trying to recover from the bad reputation, trying to do another building as their last hope to being succesfull again.
You accept the work of a security guard, by a request from an old friend, but you are not there just for that, you have a purpose, a mission, get them all in.

title: Wallace & Gromit: The Grand Tour
description: An unreleased Wallace & Gromit racing game that got reworked into the completely original Gubble Buggy Racer

title: Horde Survivor
description: Battle hordes of monsters in this top-down roguelite arena bullet hell game. Choose what character to play, what stat to gain, and which spell to learn. Every decision matters in your survival against the hordes of monsters.

title: On the Run: Rogue Heroes
description: Gain strange abilities and evade enemy forces as you uncover a conspiracy! What will you do to learn the truth? Will you fight for others or save yourself?

title: Hunky City
description: You move to a new city to live with your "former" stepfather. Work, make friends, and explore the thrilling world of romance in this captivating game. Are you ready for the excitement? Let the journey begin!

title: Milkman Mayhem
description: Mind controlled cows are headed straight for you. Scavenge, barricade, and defend as long as you can. How long will you survive the dairy onslaught?

title: Equestria at War
description: Equestria at War is a Hearts of Iron IV mod that seeks to recreate the fantastical world of Equestria from the My Little Pony franchise, dimmed with a bleaker setting rife with both nuances and its own plentiful twists, such as the notion of industrialization, far-reaching corruption and an ample amount of political intrigue.

title: Stitched Together
description: Stitched Together is an RPG adventure with a deep story, unique battle mechanics, world-defying stakes, and a whole extra dimension!

title: Strike Force Heroes: Original Flash Outfits
description: Party like it's 2012 with the original outfits from the Flash version of Strike Force Heroes!

title: SCP: Foundation Simulator
description: A 3D monster-management simulation game based in the SCP universe. Create your own site, employ workers, and keep anomalies from escaping.

title: Kukinta
description: Step into Kukinta, a unique blend of city-building and idle crafting. Assemble resources and refine them into complex goods to develop your island community. Let your strategic skills blossom. In Kukinta, every resource shapes the skyline of your serene retreat.

title: Shield knight
description: Gain glory by defeating several leaders of a kingdom in ruins using only your shield as a weapon. Talk to the few remaining inhabitants and discover what secrets this kingdom holds.

title: The Meridian Under the Heaven: Valhalla
description: Valhalla is a Yuri-themed cinematic narrative visual novel focusing on the sisterly love and transformation of Hikari and Nøva, heiresses of Norway's leading biotech giant Ravenscorp, evolving from naïveté to power, culminating in Hikari's rise as 'The Black Raven.'

title: Sail of Dreams
description: Sail the sea and pilot your own ship to battle various vessels in quest of gold and glory! Upgrade your cannons, add a piercing prow to the bow, or recruit small cats to help you crew your ship! Find the true goal of a child's mind wandering his own dreams.

title: Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts
description: In this sequel of the LGBT visual novel Reborn a Zombie, Dawn, a trans girl turned zombie, now has to confront her past. However, the Demon King is approaching and his presence will change everything.

title: Spirit Valley
description: Spirit Valley is an erotic creature collecting game. Build your dream team and solve the mystery of Spirit Valley!

title: Hyperjustice: Hyper Holidays Expansion
description: Clive Lawman is on a Christmas trip to New York but the mob has kidnapped him and have evil plans to ruin Christmas. This is a very short 3-part level expansion for Hyperjustice.

title: Flea Market Simulator '24
description: Flea Market Simulator '24 Bargain&Buy, Repair&SellTake care of antique or fake items.Adding this game to your wishlist allows me to improve my game further. If you care about my project, add it to your wishlist to improve the game together with me.

title: Project Aphotic
description: Players assume Lucien's perspective, unraveling the truth behind his coma and amnesia, while cultivating a relationship with Hugh. Throughout the game, choices shape the narrative, leading to diverse storylines and multiple endings.

title: First Gen
description: Follow the story of Markus Orwell, a First Generation soldier of the North Alliance while he tries to solve a painful crime and get his life back on track. Navigate through branching paths, multiple endings, where each decision crafts a different journey.

title: Idle Streaming Bonanza
description: In this parody of popular streamers! Play as your Favorite content creators(I use that term loosely) like Mokipane, Asmondsilver and CQX. Form a cult! Squeeze your pay piggies, start drama, appease chat and rake in the dough.

title: Christmas Fables: The Magic Snowflake DLC
description: A magical snowflake has fallen into the hands of a little troublemaker! Save Christmas and find the magic artifact!

title: MindKatt
description: Action and stealth game set in a dystopian world. Engage in strategic and challenging combat, facing off against ranged or melee opponents. Master the art of stealth and the environment to avoid detection. Levels will vary with different activities.

title: Mage Guild
description:
The player starts in their wizard tower where they can change the appearance of their mage, select their spells from their spellbook, then head out to duel other mages and learn their spells.

Customize your wizard's appearance.

Choose spells from your spellbook for effects like fireball, the ability to summon magical creatures, create a wall of electricity, teleport, push and pull your foes, protect yourself with a magical shield, and more.

Learn new spells after dueling groups of other wizards.

Mix up your spells between duels to try new strategies.

title: Tingus Goose
description: Tingus Goose is an idle game where you control a goose named Tingus that automatically moves and attacks. The goal is to collect treasure, defeat enemies, and upgrade Tingus' abilities. The game features automatic gameplay with occasional manual interventions, allowing you to let Tingus run on its own while you do other things. You can upgrade Tingus' abilities and equipment, collect treasure and resources, battle enemies and bosses, and explore different environments and levels.

title: Raldi's Crackhouse
description:
One of the Baldi's Basics mods ever made.
Can you escape Raldi's Crackhouse?
Run around the school, and collect 10 notebooks before Raldi can catch you..
Discover fan favorites such as Chipfloke, Pinto Beans, Van Man, MrBeast, and of course, Raldi himself!
Can you outsmart Raldi and the other characters and uncover all of the hidden secrets of the crackhouse?

title: Reclusion
description: The year is 2013. An unnamed protagonist, deep in debt, suffering from obesity, sociophobia, and probably other mental disorders, is locked up indefinitely in his apartment. Does he get out alive and sane? It depends only on a strange companion from the future (player) who has established a telepathic connection with him.

title: You or the Blue.
description:
The protagonist, who has lost her parents and grandmother, was taken in by her uncle, her only remaining family.
Emotionally unstable and unable to accept the death of her family, she's swept into complicated relationships with the boys she meets at the school she transfers to.

title: Twilight Survivors
description: Wield 5+ powerful Super Weapons all together! Face 300 enemies at the same time! Will you survive?

title: Neet Girl Rehabilitation Plan: Guutara-ko Saisei Kikaku
description: No matter how many times I get rejected, I will continue supporting them... Until the day they find employment!

title: Imperator with nothing to do
description: 'Imperator with nothing to do' is a classic strategy RPG that is very simple, but requires choice and focus. Experience 100% original graphics, sounds, and detailed battles for free!

title: Falling Mountains
description: This is a rouge-like deck-builder game, in this game, you can choose different talismans cards, and consumables to deal with different enemies. And if you feel tired, retire and turn some of your talismans into heirlooms, then the next generation can use them.

title: Tachie ga Hen na Pose no Renai Adventure
description: All the characters are in strange poses, but that's normal for this game. A school romance novel game set in a strange world.

title: Elder Gods Simulator
description: It is a roguelike+ simulation business game, you will play a Elder Gods attract diviners, mental patients, judges, bounty hunters, witches, princesses and other people become believers, defeat other extraordinary creatures and evil gods, recover their own strength. Note: Believers may marry.

title: Cult ni Kibishii Gal: Cult vs. Gal
description: Make mincemeat out of cults and chop heads with machetes! Old school shooter staples and gals, and a familiar difficulty level. Ye shall witness a new struggle!

title: Treasure Knight
description: Want to open a blind box? Want to DIY match equipment? Do you want to hatch phantom beast elves? Are you bored and even want to catch a big lobster? Become the Phantom Beast Knight, and you will personally compose the adventure and thrilling fantasy of the other world continent!

title: Youka and Her Summer
description: Youka woke up from her dream, but her heart was filled with unease: it was the same home as usual, but it had become incredibly strange due to the nightmare. She couldn't remember exactly what had happened, but it seemed that the reality before her wasn't so "real."

title: Idle Dungeon
description: This is a idle RPG game.In the dungeon, you can encounter various monsters and powerful bosses guarding levels. Only by defeating the boss can you enter the next 10th level. In the boss tower, you can challenge increasingly powerful bosses, obtain various materials, gems, and advanced skill books.

title: Mercenary Squad Auto Chess
description: A light Roguelike auto chess game that combines dark treasure hunting gameplay. Different professions can be paired with various skills, equipment can be collected, attributes can be refined, and powerful teams can be created by enhancing skills with runes.

title: Boyce the Voice
description: Boyce the Voice is a fast-paced rhythm game where an you play Boyce! An unlikely voice actor who is on a mission to change the world...with his voice! Embark on 6 custom designed levels where only quick thinking, wit, and speedy fingers can win the day!

title: Breakthrough Mars
description: Based on the classic brick breaker, embark yourself on a journey to Mars and fight your way destroying walls and collecting power-ups against the Martian fleet.

title: Broadside Renegades
description: Broadside Renegades combines auto-firing weapons with manual ship abilities in a rogue-like space pirate adventure. Choose your captain and upgrade your ship to steal the space kings booty. Warp ahead to stay alive, and mind your bearing.

title: HAL_Ver99
description:
"...ru."
"...Haru."
"Haru."
"Wake up soon."
"I want to see you soon."
"...Good morning, Haru"

A psychedelic yandere BL game about talking to an AI.

title: Hidamari no Sanatorium
description: Miyuu, a boy with a frail constitution, meets Sumire, a leukemic recently hospitalized due to his high fever. Feeling for Sumire, Miyuu gradually finds himself attracted to the other boy.

title: Near
description:
Shiina is an aspiring manga artist.
He's been drawing for fun for a long time, but his efforts just wouldn't pay off.
Just as he was about to stop, he remembered he had a fan.
Near, a boy so beautiful he might as well not have been real.

title: Kyouai Renka
description:
The usual morning begins.
A room in an apartment without a sense of life.
A light breakfast is served on the table.
Coffee and then scrambled eggs on bread.
A comfortable and luxurious life.
A life that is too luxurious for me.

――My life is falling.
I'm dominated by you and I can't do anything about it.

title: Samenai Akumu no Hate de Odorou.
description:
The main character, Takumu, is imprisoned in a mysterious hospital infested with strange monsters.

Takumu tries to escape, but he is always interrupted by the nurses.

Will Takumu survive safely and be able to escape from the hospital...?

title: Natsu to Hakaba to Urameshiya
description: A short midsummer BL game about being taken to the afterlife by a ghost.

title: Gangs of the street
description: Play as the ultimate gangster, align with the Montanas, Yakuza, or Bratva, and dominate **Gang City**. Every choice has a consequence. Do you have what it takes? Join the fray now! Gameplay Highlight : Rise in power, buy nightclubs, bars, homes, and legitimate businesses.

title: Forza Motorsport: 2021 Cadillac #31 Whelen Racing DPi-V.R
description: Forza Motorsport 2021 Cadillac #31 Whelen Racing DPi-V.R

title: Hanasou
description:
September 20th. Ohigan.
The main character, Kikuri, has come to visit a grave with his childhood friend, Ayame.
Kikuri had a twin brother named Kikuno.
The twin's older brother, Kikuno, died in a traffic accident during summer vacation.

A melancholic love-hate BL game where you go to visit your twin brother's grave with your childhood friend.

title: Kasumi
description:
Kasumi, who was my close friend, died more than 10 years ago after jumping off the school's rooftop. He was a lonely boy who wanted to die with me.

I broke my promise to die with him and ran away, and I'm the only one left alive.

Since then, I've dreamed of Kasumi over and over again.

―I still dream of him today.

title: Requiem for an Angel
description: -- Goodbye, my angel.

title: Manatsu no Zangai
description:
I'm about to lose consciousness.
I'm somewhere between dreams, delusions, and reality.
I don't know what is real, what is a dream, and what is a delusion.
Is the dusty classroom I'm in real?
My memory is ambiguous. Where am I now?

"Hey, are you okay?"

There was a boy calling out to me.
He was such a beautiful boy that I couldn't believe that he was real.
I didn't know if this boy was real or my delusion.

title: Meisa no Sekai
description:
--A sofa and a bed.
Next to a flat-screen TV is a decorative plant.
This room's too tidy; it doesn't feel lived in at all.

This 12 square meter apartment is everything to me. I can't get out of it.
There's a guy here; he seems like he's from another world. He's staring at me with a faint smile.

title: Bakurokei Haishinsha vs. Kuzukei Utaite vs. Menhera Stalker
description: A short dark comedy BL game.

title: Half-Life: Ultimate Attack
description: In this MOD you will not play with Gordon Freeman, Adrian Shephard or Barney Calhoun, but for David Johnson - one of black ops which all have been sent for destruction of alive essences taking place in military base "Black Mesa".

title: Bug×Bug
description:
The main character, Gumi, a small streamer, is often high thanks to drinking alcohol and taking drugs.
He makes fun of creators who were even smaller than him.
Gumi is aware that he is a total scumbag, but he just can't quit.
――There is only one person who could accept him even though he is a piece of trash.

A short BL game about two faulty vloggers.

title: Perdita
description: Perdita is an atmospheric story rich first person horror game, with focus on dynamic paranormal events, as well as traditional investigation methods. You are investigating the legend of voodoo witch Julia Brown and her husband at their old house at Manchac Swamps, Louisiana. the year is 1989. 20 years ago Julia died cursing the whole town, after her death, three hurricanes hit the area. Leaving death and destruction behind.

title: Call of Duty: Deluxe Edition
description:
The New Leader in World War II action - Now available in this Deluxe Edition Box Set.

Experience the cinematic intensity of World War II's epic battles, fighting on foot, in tanks, jeeps, motorcycles and even a bomber. Work with your squad through snow and rain, using authentic weapons including flamethrowers and deployable machine guns, or by calling in artillery strikes.

Plan your attack with the Call of Duty and United Offensive Official Strategy Guides. Relive the music with the Call of Duty official soundtrack.

title: Cavephobia
description: Cavephobia is a 90s VHS Found Footage Survival Horror title with focus on realistic situations, claustrophobia, speluncaphobia and a deep atmosphere. Inspired by cave exploration in real life and movies such as "The Descent".

title: Okiku
description: Okiku is a japanese first-person horror game inspired by the real life Okiku doll which is said to grow its own hair and teeth.

title: Cloacaphobia
description: Cloacaphobia is a 90s VHS found footage survival horror that plays on the fear of sewers, realistic situations and claustrophobic environments with a gruesome atmosphere.

title: Defile
description: Discover the story behind the blood queen and bring an end to the evil entity which now inhabits the manor.

title: Sanevol Incident 44
description: Sanevol Incident 44 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror title.

title: Hero Cummy
description:
Enter U.A High, a school for training the next generation of heroes and heroines! Though our hero didn’t enroll just to attend a few classes, a few strange secrets lie below the school’s surface- starting with the mysterious fate of your father.

Unlock the full potential of your quirk’s abilities and all of the lewd powers that come with it. Decide if you’re looking for revenge or answers as you interact with the school’s students and staff. Enjoy a variety of lewd scenes with your favorite characters, and explore a whole range of fun kinks along the way! We hope you enjoy!

title: Lakelight Elementary Incident 68
description: Lakelight Elementary Incident 68 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror title where you unveil the past and afterlife through your camera.

title: Nihil Ignis Incident 48
description: Nihil Ignis Incident 48 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror title.

title: Strongford Penitentiary Lost Tape 91
description: Strongford Penitentiary Lost Tape 91 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror and the first entry in "The Lost Tapes" Series.

title: Moundville Factory Lost Tape 89
description: Moundville Factory Lost Tape 89 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror with emphasis on atmosphere, unpredictability, realism and a non-linear design with multiple endings and outcomes.

title: Durium Hospital Lost Tape 95
description: Durium Hospital Lost Tape 95 is a realistic urban exploration VHS Found Footage horror mixed with survival horror and the third entry in "The Lost Tapes" Series.

title: Silversoul Orphanage
description: Silversoul Orphanage is a standalone realistic urban exploration simulation. A VHS Found Footage Urbex Sim horror with emphasis on atmosphere, unpredictability, realism and a non-linear design with subtle scares, focusing on the feeling of being stalked during an urban exploration.

title: Reef Light Conundrum
description:
Reef Light Conundrum is a standalone realistic urban exploration simulation mixing themes of the paranormal & lovecraftian horror.
A 90s VHS Found Footage Urbex Sim horror with emphasis on atmosphere, unpredictability, realism and a non-linear design, focusing on the feeling of exploring a old haunted ship.

title: Urbex Alone
description: A VHS Found Footage Urbex Simulation horror with emphasis on atmosphere, unpredictability, realism and a non-linear design, focusing on the feeling of providing a realistic solo urban exploration in a abandoned construction building.

title: Zorovan Powerplant
description: A VHS Found Footage Urbex Simulation horror with emphasis on atmosphere, unpredictability, realism, focusing on the feeling of providing a realistic solo urban exploration in a abandoned military owned soviet era powerplant and the feeling of being stalked by aliens.

title: Final Clue Oakloon
description: Final Clue Oakloon is a Gritty Dark VHS Urbex Homicide Detective Survival Horror with combat and emphasis on atmosphere, as well as unpredictability, realism and providing a realistic solo urban exploration in a abandoned overgrown house in the woods & the feeling of being stalked during your investigation for the truth about an old crime case, you will have to fight your way through whoever resides here in order to come to the truth and conclusion of this old case.

title: Ghost Of Wynlow
description: An urban explorer ventures out to explore and investigate the legend of the abandoned Wynlow lighthouse.

title: Don't Pee
description: An adventure game about not peeing your pants, can you survive the scary house?

title: Lingering Souls
description: Lingering Souls is a first-person psychological horror game set inside a recently deceased family relatives post-soviet era apartment.

title: Incident In Oakwood
description: An urban explorer ventures out to an abandoned cabin in the woods that was involved in an unsolved alien abduction case from the 1960s. UFO activity and sightings of extraterrestrial beings have been reported in the area of Oakwood forest dating back all the way to the 1950s.

title: Dead Faces
description: Dead Faces is a mind bending psychological horror about hallucinations and facing your past. Unravel Jack's disturbing mind, the faces from his past and the ultimate truth behind his actions. You must remember their faces.

title: Pripyat Block 1986
description: A VHS Found Footage Urbex Simulation horror with emphasis on atmosphere, unpredictability, realism and a non-linear design, focusing on the feeling of providing a realistic solo urban exploration in a abandoned apartment building.

title: Elf Kicker
description: Punch and kick Santa's elves through a winter themed backdrop with relaxing Christmas music.

title: NightFall Shade
description: 2D real-time survival action. A somber journey through lands ravaged by a long siege. Extensive and complex combat, hardcore survival and deep immersion. Heal the heart of an old castle... or share its darkness.

title: SIGame
description:
SIGame is an intellectual quiz in which everyone can test their knowledge and reaction speed and fight against opponents.

Game rules are very simple: all questions in the game are divided into themes, and each question in the theme has its own price. Each player has a personal score, which at the beginning of the game is 0. A question is presented, after which a frame appears on the screen indicating that you can press the button and answer. If the player knows the answer, he/she can press the red button. The player who presses the button earlier than others (and will not have a false start), gives an answer. If the answer is correct, the question price is added to the player's score; otherwise - the price is substracted from the score. In the latter case, other players can try their luck and press the button to answer.

The game can also have a final round in which each of the players makes a bet. A question is asked, time is given for thinking, and each of the players submits their answer to the host. After that, the correct answer is announced, and each of the players receives or loses money according to their bet.

Game winner is the player with the highest score after the last question.
