title: Lethal Love
description: Lethal Love is an immersive stealth open-world yandere game set within a sprawling school map, where players assume the role of Kyoko, a complex and deeply disturbed protagonist. In this game, players explore a meticulously crafted open world, teeming with secrets, rivalries, and forbidden desires.

title: The Journey of Piggy
description: The Journey of Piggy is a roguelike adventure game with fast-paced, shoot 'em up combat set in a beautifully hand-drawn world. Choose from a variety of weapons, cards and power-ups to create unique builds and survive until the end.

title: Ask her out
description: A perfectly healthy and adequately normal conversation amongst friends turns into something else entirely.

title: Steptile
description:
An ancient boardgame filled with steps and tiles. 20 tiny levels to solve and many, many tiles to step!

Maybe some secret stages too?

title: Doggo
description: Dog-based speed running platformer. Featuring Online Leaderboards, 20+ levels and over 35 collectable cosmetics for your dog.

title: The Fixer of the Adventurer's Guild
MX vs. ATV: Legends - 2023 Track Pass
description:
The Track Pass grants you access to 20 tracks scheduled for release in 2023!

Track Pass Details:
- 12 official nationals tracks from the 2023 AMA Pro Motocross Championship
- Throwback Track Pack with 6 completely recreated fan favourite tracks from previous MX vs ATV games
- Official compound from a famous location

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - Swerve to the Beach
description: Leader of the Mogul Embassy Swerve Strickland joins the AEW: Fight Forever roster! Swerve kicks off Season 3 along with the brand new day and evening Beach base maps PLUS two new attire customization options.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - Hayter's Gunna Game
description:
Former Women's World Champion and English wrestling legend Jamie Hayter is now part of the AEW: Fight Forever roster! The Hayter's Gunna Game DLC also features 5 new premium music tracks!

This content is part of Season Pass 3 which includes:
3 more talents added to the roster, new day and evening beach maps, 33 brand new moves, 42 new skin + attire options, and 11 new music tracks.

title: All Elite Wresting: Fight Forever - Giant Swing in the Ring
description: All Elite Wrestling and Ring of Honor star Claudio Castagnoli joins the AEW: Fight Forever roster with his famous European Uppercut. The Giant Swing in the Ring DLC also features 30 re-skin options, as well as an alternate version of Claudio's entrance music.

title: All Elite Wrestling: Fight Forever - Freebie 4 da Fans
description:
We love our loyal Fight Forever fans! Five new music tracks and 10 new attire options are our way of saying thank you!

This content is part of Season Pass 3 which includes:
3 more talents added to the roster, new day and evening beach maps, 33 brand new moves, 42 new skin + attire options, and 11 new music tracks.

title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Year 1 Pass
description: Uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization and start exploring a subterranean world with the Year 1 Pass. Gain access to exciting exclusive content through 4 major DLC releases throughout the year, along with instant access to the Cotco Canyon truck.

title: Koltera
description: Incremental Idler creature-collector, where you mine, train, breed, augment, and trade creatures, in order to increase the outputs of your operation. Collect all the creatures, called Fables, in the name of science within the region of Soltera. Discover and buy upgrades to further your output.

title: Alchemistress Vivi
description: Alchemistress Vivi is a code-breaking logic puzzle that should take approximately 20 to 25 minutes to complete. In each level, up to 6 magic items must be arranged in a certain order to cast powerful spells. Every try results in a feedback that helps the player to eventually find the right sequence. But watch out: There's only a limited number of lives available for this.

title: Gravedigger
description: Video-based puzzle adventure! Navigate tomb with compass (N/S/W/E), encounter random events (video+text). Solve traps/BOSS with QTE. Exploration drains Morality; restore at camps.

title: A Game About Flicking A Switch
description: It's you, in room, with a big switch on the wall. What more could you ask for in groundbreaking, forward reaching, out-of-this-world game design? Nothing. This is the peak of gaming.

title: Bucket Crusher: Around The World
description:
Tear down new walls in the shape of unusual things from different places and put on new funny skins!
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- cactus wall
- dinosaur egg wall
- chest wall
- balloon wall
- windmill wall
- lighthouse wall
- pyramid wall
- chimney wall
- gear skin
- rudder skin

Use your skins to completely destroy the new walls until not a single brick remains!

title: Bucket Crusher: Holiday Spirit
description:
Tear down new walls in the shape of holiday items and put on new sweet skins!
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- cookie wall
- christmas sock wall
- bells wall
- christmas tree wall
- Santa's house wall
- snowman wall
- hot chocolate wall
- gift wall
- donut skin

title: Bucket Crusher: Cool Kidz
description:
Tear down new walls in the shape of children's items and put on new toy skins!
With this DLC, you'll unlock:
- chocolate bar wall
- orange juice wall
- rubber duck wall
- teddy bear wall
- hanoi tower wall
- notebook wall
- chess tower wall
- speaker wall
- fidget spinner skin
- color pencils skin

Use your toy skins to completely destroy the new walls until not a single brick remains!

title: Membal
description:
Welcome to Membal: Your Town, Your Memory!
Immerse yourself in a charming world where city reconstruction goes hand in hand with caring for your mind. In Membal, you'll embark on a unique adventure, full of adorable fun and gratifying mental challenges.

title: Legendary Tales: Stories
description: Discover stories hidden by time.

title: Lo-Fi Haiku: Coffee and Chill
description: Take a sip of coffee and wake up your inner poet!

title: Pinball FX: System Shock Pinball
description:
Guide the Hacker through Citadel Station infested with cyborgs, mutants, and reprogrammed robots to defeat SHODAN.

Table Features:
- Jack into the Cyberspace Terminal mini-playfield for great rewards
- Watch out for the Cyborg Attack! If you take too long to shoot, your ball will be shot and jettisoned off your flipper
- Shoot with precision to 'Get a Head'. Reveal a second ball by hitting the correct one out of three severed heads
- It's a Mutant Menace! Hit all the enemies and escape by the elevator
- Brave all perils of the table to initiate self-destruct and defeat SHODAN for good

title: Pinball M: System Shock Pinball
description: Flip to the death in the depths of space. Guide the Hacker and defeat SHODAN.

title: Frenzy Blood
description: Immerse in 1930s alternative America noir VR shooter! Become a traumatized bounty hunter on the trail of insane doctor. Battle puppet villains, use realistic weapons, leverage alcohol and tobacco in this gripping adventure.

title: Secrets Under Eco
description: Explore Melior's military base in Secrets Under Eco; a 3D FPS pure metroidvania experience. Find equipment and fight enemies with unique wall-bouncing combat to escape the building and country that was once called home.

title: Supervoid
description: A fast-paced arcade runner with colourful minimalist visuals and a synthwave soundtrack.

title: Teared
description: Embark on a thrilling 3D arcade action-platformer adventure in Teared. Travel through 9 challenging levels filled with epic bosses and a variety of deadly creatures. Are you ready for this epic journey?

title: Exosky
description: ExoSky: Join a whimsical AI cat in a futuristic flight sim. Master stunts in a tech-inspired world with moddable aircraft and realistic physics. Explore beyond Earth in a blend of simulation and imagination. A pilot's dream of skill and creativity.

title: OG Puzzlers: Winter 2K23
description: OG Puzzlers: Winter 2K23 is an casual puzzel game with cute dog images. You have to assemble a single image from random generated indivdual pieces. Combine all of the smart singel frames into one big image and unlock the next level.

title: Picker Bot 42
description: Explore, discover items, find Wassie lore, upgrade PB42 to gloriously defeat mutant plants and fly back home

title: Watch The Fish
description: Keep the fish water in jar as long as possible ! Watch The Fish is an arcade game where you have to show your dexterity to manage the fish water and get the best possible score. Choose to turn the wheel of fortune at your own risk.

title: AI Roguelite 2D
description: The world's first AI-generated 2D Action RPG.

title: Eco Of The Wild Online
description: "Echo In The Wild Online": A multiplayer survival adventure with dynamic landscapes, strategic boss battles, and cooperative exploration. Teleport between untamed realms, cultivate resources, and conquer challenges in this ever-evolving world. Explore, survive, and thrive with friends!

title: Evil Holiday
description: Returning to the parental home and an ordinary holiday dinner turns into a bloody hell filled with horror and death.

title: Splurge
description: You and up to 7 of your friends must battle it out to become the ultimate splurge-lord. Fill up your tiles and splurge them in order to spread your colour and eliminate every other player. Watch out though, as after too long, the map will start to shrink. Happy splurging!

title: Flake: The Legend of Snowblind
description:
Embark on this mystical journey in the role of Flake, an incredible creature.
Will you be able to walk the thin white line between good and evil?
What will you do with your chance to save the world that is hanging on a thread?

title: Redacted: Genome
description: Redacted:Genome is a survival action horror game where the player is given the ability to swap between various arm powers and rifle barrels to fight off enemy mimics in the third or first person. Craft ammo, food, and upgrade your abilities for the greatest chance at survival.

title: Keykeeper
description: Keykeeper is an enthralling turn-based tactical roguelike, enriched with RPG elements. Embark on a journey through diverse floors and biomes, vanquish formidable foes, and level up to acquire new spells. As you delve deeper, you'll be able to loot the finest equipment to aid in your adventure.

title: Chronicle Survivors
description: Chronicle Survivors is an Unreal Engine powered gorgeous action roguelike game with difficult, short (5-12 minutes) and meaningful objectives, thoughtful progression, variety of levels, loads of unique mechanic enemies and, of course, grindy epic loot with a continuous development path.

title: From Scratch
description: From Scratch is survival game set in a huge open world of over 50 square kilometers. Fight, craft and acquire resources to survive in a world overrun by zombies and wild animals.

title: Walls of Rust
description: Take command of humanity's last Mechs with a deck of cards, and control the hex-based gameboard to stop the spreading corruption. In this turn-based strategy game, each run is one continuous battle, so make every action count.

title: Cosmic Slime Defense
description: 2D pixel art platform game in which you are in charge of eliminating alien enemies that try to conquer your planet.

title: Moto Knight
description: Moto Knight is the world's first Motocross Dungeon Crawler! Navigate your way through dozens of trap-filled stages while trying to keep your dirtbike upright.

title: My Music Oasis
description: myMO (my Music Oasis) is an immersive multiplayer game built for a community of DJs, Musicians, and Music Fans to share beats while raving in a virtual world that features player customizable Dance Clubs, DJ Controlled Lights & Awesome Visual Effects.

title: Meowphoria
description: Gather a harem of cat girls and save the world from the Singularity Dragon! It's a fun mix of metroidvania and dating sim, where every choice you make has consequences, and love is the surest step to victory!

title: Why God?
description: Climb high up the Tower of Babel by swinging and dodging all the children of the Lord to be able to ask GOD in one once and for all because he has made you so horrible in a world 2D cartoony. Explore in the most frenetic way the sad but exciting story of our little Amalgama.

title: Call Center
description: Every wonder what it's like to work at a real call center? Well, here you go I guess. Don't get this game. It's really boring. Even if there are two endings, it's not worth it.

title: RaceTrap
description: RaceTrap pits a team of drivers against a pantheon of racing gods. Play cards to sabotage the track the drivers are racing on as a god. As a driver, complete 3 laps with your life intact!

title: Kunkunkun
description: Go to the abandoned old school alone to investigate the ghost of KUNKUNKUN and be chased, how to become a real MAN? !

title: Samuza
description: Welcome to the world of SAMUZA! In this time attack obstacle course game, you play as one of the "SAMUZA" series of robots who tries to restore the lost world by finding it's allies.

title: Aperture
description: This is a first-person 3D puzzle game, inspired by modern societal and work-related mental health challenges. Players immerse themselves in the role of a person with mental illness, using "Aperture" to solve puzzles and uncover hidden memories.

title: Funny Football
description: This is a casual football game. You can control the movement of two football players by your two hands respectively at the same time which is not only definitely a big challenge but also can bring you a lot of fun, especially when you play the local PVP mode.

title: Inevitable Light
description: Survive and explore the vast and brutal desert of the INEVITABLE LIGHT. Shelter-in during sand storms, make fire during freezing nights, walk in the shade on boiling hot days, and most of all, stay away from the hyenas. Think through your next move. Resources are scarce. Death is inevitable.

title: Incorporeal
description: Incorporeal is a dungeon crawler where you play as a treasure hunter who has the ability to sever their soul from their body. Dash through traps, strike foes with your spectral form, and protect your fragile body as you fight, puzzle, and survive the catacombs to claim ancient relics.

title: Six Cabins in Serpent Ridge National Forest
description: "Six Cabins" crafts a subtle, atmospheric horror experience relying on environmental storytelling. As a lost hiker navigating an unfamiliar section of forest, you progress through the environment searching for lost keys that unlock clues to the enigmatic history of Serpent Ridge National Forest.

title: Space Nature Attack Tower Defense
description: Space Nature Attack TD is a tower defense where you can level up and customize tower stats and elements to your liking! Fend off various types of alien creatures across many different sci-fi planet themed maps, biomes, and difficulties!

title: Moon Tower: Gotta Save the Universe Real Quick
description: Climb the Moon Tower in a thrilling precision platformer where every jump is critical. Master the distinct challenges of each level on your solitary ascent. Beware: one misstep can mean significant setbacks. Tackle the climb solo or engage your Twitch chat for a unique, interactive experience.

title: Gravity Dash
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the neon-lit streets of a cyberpunk city in Gravity Dash, a 2D infinite runner that will test your reflexes and strategic skills. Immerse yourself in the retro atmosphere, accompanied by a pulsating synthwave soundtrack that sets the tone.

title: Unknown Place
description: Escape Unknown place.

title: Drifted
description: DRIFTED is a 3d horror mystery game, as you explore a mansion looking for your missing friend, you will find many secrets within as you uncover the mystery behind their disappearance. Between locked rooms and fighting monsters, who knows what you will uncover!

title: Quadrium 3
description: Quadrium 3 is a new marble match game. The aim of the game is to clear the playing field by shooting the marbles from the edges and forming groups of two to remove them from the playing field. Various obstacles such as crates, glass, fog, deflecting arrows and portals add variety to the gameplay.

title: Imperialism: Concert of Europe
description: Imperialism: Concert of Europe is a turn-based grand strategy game in which you seek to maximize the power of a major nation during the 19th century through trade, industry, research, diplomacy, colonization, and warfare.

title: Stickman World Battle
description: Stickman World Battle - new exciting and thrilling real-time strategy with famous stickman heroes!

title: Solitude
description: A survival shooter with story elements where you explore a hostile alien world after crash-landing your spaceship. Complete quests and gather the resources needed to escape.

title: Moon Wars
description: Enemies have conquered the moon and planned for destroying the entire world except them as they feel superiority over the world. Player has to go through intense space mission and destroy enemies.

title: Golf Monday
description: Partake in what seems like a normal golf tournament. But watch out! Your competitors will stop at nothing to win.

title: Silent Cause
description: Single-player mysterious horror where you are trying to find out what happened to the family. While police found no cause from outside or from within the family. While case has been closed it started drawing all sorts of people from ghost hunters to private investigators, you are one of them.

title: Little Horrors!
description: Little Horrors! is a horror themed pet sim. Raise your new friend right, or it could end up causing complete mayhem!

title: TekSkeleton
description: TekSkeleton is a hardcore platformer of the Tek line. Run, jump, kill enemies, and avoid obstacles through 5 hand-crafted levels, enjoy the atmospheric retro graphics in the dungeon style.

title: Elements For Money
description: A turn-based game about forming reactions to pay off an ever-increasing payment demand.

title: Hoversteppers: Zone 1
description: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

title: Co-omets
description: Co-omets, what does it mean? 4 player Co-op of course!

title: Fussball Manager 24
description: Mod for the FIFA Manager series by EA to get the Manager-Experience with updated squads and other new additions.

title: Kiteretsu Soudan Dial
description: Kiteretsu Soudan Dial is an adventure game on PC. You have to take a call from the counselor and decide whether the content of the consultation is a spiritual mystery or not. The game has a time limit and you need to fill the quota within the time.

title: NonStories: Eien no Hakoniwa
description:
This is an event-based RPG.
It is a dark fantasy RPG with the content of an ensemble drama through conversation.
In short, it is an orthodox RPG in which everyone defeats the enemies that stand in their way while advancing through the events.
This is the first full-length RPG with an emphasis on scenarios in our game.

The difficulty level is high, and it is an unreasonable game in its own way.
We do not expect everyone to clear the game at all.
However, if you can complete a typical RPG just to reach one ending, I think you can go for it.

There are many long events, so it is not for those who want to operate quickly.
It is for those who want to proceed slowly and steadily. It is also for those who are not satisfied with a half-lengthy story.
However, I think it is not suitable for perfectionists.

title: Nuclear Fission Simulator
description: Simulates the fission of Uranium 235 (U235) atoms.

title: Blasted Lands
description: A mod for Half-Life 2: Episode 2 about the story of Thomas, a man who owns data about the VAULT project. He will have to contact the Resistance and transmit data before it's too late...

title: False Destination
description: False Destination is part of a larger unfinished mod that was supposed to tell the story of Gordon Freeman found himself in the wrong place at the wrong time.

title: Apex Legends: Breakout
description: The Games are going into overdrive, legends. Drop hotter and hit different with Legend Upgrades—a new system that puts the meta in your hands by unlocking enhancements for armor and abilities. Each match is a fresh start and there’s no better time than now to try new strats on for size. Ranked returns reloaded and ready, tuned to a high-risk high-reward system that incentivizes combat through each split—yup, splits are back. Plus, make your Thunderdome debut in Mixtape, the Frontier’s deadliest entertainment venue. And that’s not all—Performance Mode, Breakout Rewards, a 5th Anniversary Collection Event, and even more. We’re bringing the noise for a fantastic 5th Anniversary season.

title: Inkidoki And Phoenix
description: Enjoy beautiful pictures, bright and exciting levels, and fun music!

title: Nip For Speed
description: In the chilly night, emerging from a haze, you're in a vintage car hurtling down an otherworldly highway, driven by a cat. Cigarettes, moonlight and the open road, what mysteries lies ahead?

title: 1px
description: 1px is a minimalist game with a focus on speedrunning.

title: Vinceworld
description: Vinceworld is a 1998 compilation of 30 experimental animations and interactive quizzes by Vince Collins.

title: Go to Bed
description:
A short horror game about going to bed.
Can you successfully pass each situation?

title: Control the Body
description:
A game in which one is tasked to control a body.

Master the unorthodox movement system and collect as many balls as you can.

title: Lost and Foundry
description:
Take a trip to a place thought long lost...

Lost and Foundry is made out of my strong desire to make an Arcane Dimensions map and features. It features around 90 enemies and should only take 5-15 minutes to beat. I really wanted to understand the privatives that make up a typical map and be able to re-create them and make use of them multiple times properly in a way that didn't feel 'rehashy'. While Lost and Foundry isn't my first Quake map thanks to the Reload Jam, it was my first idea that I reworked and scrapped until around 2 months ago. I'm glad I persisted if not for the learning experience it gave me as I felt I learned a lot of Arcane Dimensions quirks and have a better appreciation for some of the iconic maps made in it. Feel free to message me any agregious errors that may softlock the player or break events. Not made or tested for any multiplayer but does have spawns.

title: Grejsimojs
description: An anachronistic 90s-style Episode 2 Replacement.

title: None Like It Hot!
description: An underground geothermal base, mixed with cavernous/hellish touches. A fairly tight and claustrophobic level, but with some open exploration and non linearity mixed in as well.

title: Daylight District
description: Daylight District is a Vanilla-Compatible episode for Doom 2 featuring remixed textures from Moonlit District.

title: Crumpets 2
description: Crumpets is a set of six, Boom-compatible maps released by Zachary Stephens (Ribbiks) in 2024.

title: Final Desolation
description:
A 100% vanilla 8 level DOOM wad, dedicated to Cacodoomonic's beloved late doggie Layla and their beloved late mother, both of which loved DOOM, and often used to watch them playing it. They both passed away, their dog on August 3rd 2023 and their mother September 27th 2023. This game is dedicated to them both and may their memory live on forever in this mod.

The wad is an 8 level chapter starring Joan Dark as she fights against the forces of Hell as it invades the UAC bases and gradually takes over. A powerful demon, code-named only DESOLATION, has risen from the depths of Hell and brought with it an army of darkness that is utterly relentless. DoomGuy isn't around. Nobody is around except the demonically possessed corpses of former fellow UAC military... so it's up to Joan Dark to deal with this on her own.

title: PhoboChromaPhobia
description:
PhoboChromaPhobia is an 11-map set for G/ZDoom.
Strange dreams are being reported by low-level personnel over at the UAC's Department of Biochemical Kaleidoscopetry. Better head to Phobos and get to the bottom of this disturbingly... colorful... evil. But is your mind ready for it?

title: The Mystery of Mount Fang
description: This is a vanilla-compatible four map mini WAD titled "The Mystery of Mount Fang". After enjoying your "vacation", you're hired by an anonymous benefactor to go hiking in Mount Fang, a huge mountain located in Hell. Your mission: To gather information and clues about about a long extinct civilisation that apparently worshipped a guardian spirit taking on the appearance of a huge shark. But you have a suspicion that the thing who hired you knows more about this place than they let on...

title: The Cursed Legacy
description: The Cursed Legacy is an action/exploration game based on “die and retry” and made with love and passion to pay tribute to the games of the 90s. It also offers mini games that give this work an infinite lifespan.

title: Reimei no Yu
description:
Reimei no Yu is a simulation-adventure game on PC.
You are an employee of the hotel and have to look around the room every morning to see if anything is wrong.

title: Drop Mahjong Tiles
description:
Drop Mahjong Tiles is a puzzle game on PC.

The actual mahjong score will be the score. The falling mahjong tiles (hai) are completely random, and like mahjong, there are only four identical tiles. It is not a competitive style and there is no time limit, so you can enjoy it at your own pace while thinking carefully.

title: Hello Neighbor 3
description: Hello Neighbor 3 is an open-world, system-driven stealth sandbox game set in the half-abandoned, real-time simulated town of Raven Brooks. Players investigate mysteries, interact with dynamic residents, and uncover secrets in a world where characters continue their lives independently of the player's actions.

title: Fieldwork
description: A Text-Adventure about you in a forest

title: Opening Night
description: A mystery at the comedy club

title: Carnival of Shadows
description: Carnival of Shadows is an English carnival-themed romance visual novel.

title: La maison perdue de l’oncle Ernest
description: The player has found an album that narrates the life of Uncle Ernest in a mysterious countryside house. He explores its pages to uncover secrets, navigating between them by clicking on bookmarks, all while having the option to keep with him the items he finds useful to solve the puzzles he encounters.

title: Enchant Farm
description: A highly customizable, exploration-focused game with countless secrets to uncover, bosses to defeat, and allies to recruit. ENCHANT FARM is one of the earliest and best JRPG adaptations of the "Souls-like" formula with a pure gameplay focus and surprising mechanical depth.

title: Sarissa and the Legendary Sword
description: Sarissa and the Legendary Sword is a Brazilian turn-based RPG with a simple and beautiful story. In it, you will follow friends Sarissa, Dandara, Elaine, and Patricia, as they go on an adventurous journey, where love friendship, and a fated destiny will change their lives forever.

title: Caiobá
description: A short story, inspired by family trips I took to Matinhos-PR in my childhood. My first game made with lots of love and care is GameMaker!

title: Saga of Song
description: Saga of Song is a fast-paced single-screen Platformer and a continuation of the Legend of Song. The game is filled with Imagination, complete with competitive online hi-scores and controller support, and fraught with plenty of flavor and danger for you to enjoy! Each randomly generated game consists of 9 Stages which contain treasure and stars to collect in order to maintain the Song and (completely) clear (3x) in order to progress.

title: Abyssal Blood
description: Abyssal Blood is an Action Rogue-like/Survivors-like where you can dual-wield many types of different weapons at the same time. Play as Lucy, the daughter of Lucifer, who must eliminate all outlaw souls and demons from hell.

title: My Uncle's Story
description:
Tired of life you can only think of getting out and making it all stop.

Thus, one day you found an adventuring magazine with survival tips and decided to run from it all. One day after work, determined to full fill this dream, you set out to build your new home in the middle of the Forest.

With only an handful of tools in your bag and an old truck, you begin building your house, log by log.

What could possibly go wrong...

title: 100 Romantic Cats
description: 100 Romantic Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Lovely themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of romantic places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: Quando fuori piove
description:
Short game where you take control of two characters at the same time: a cop and a sniper. It's your job to stop the demonic activity in a palace.

Made in two weeks for the "Game Maker Italia 2018 Contest".

title: Pepe Chatters
description: Pepe Chatters is an exciting game in which the player has to help the cute frog Pepe solve riddles and puzzles to save his friends from the clutches of an evil sorcerer. With the help of clever jokes and a vivid sense of humor, Pepe will explore different levels, meet interesting characters and collect unique items to solve problems. Immerse yourself in Pepe's magical world and help him bring peace and tranquility back to his home!

title: Dengenki Days
description: Juno's rent money has gone missing! The end of the month draws near- what is an attractive and spunky girl to do in a situation like this? Join Juno and her friends as they try to earn some quick cash!

title: Budni
description: short "i wanna be the guy" fangame

title: BAS
description: Experience a nostalgic throwback with this Pico-8 demake of the classic iOS game Birds and Saws. Dive into the retro charm and challenge yourself as you guide a bird, skillfully avoiding menacing circular saws to rack up high scores.

title: Thome Wake
description: An indie horror first-person game where you are in control of a streamer who learns from his viewers about Pisadeira, a demon/monster from Brazilian folklore. In disbelief, when he sleeps, Pisadeira doesn't allow him to wake up, leaving him stuck in his nightmare, and he has to figure out a way to leave, and finally wake up

title: Frogapult
description: Watch out for the piranhas, gators, spikes and birds as you catapult Kalvin Kroaker through the dangers of the swamp so he can pursue a life of worldly adventure.

title: Fallen Slayers
description: Embrace darkness, bargain with the dark gods and make unique pacts for incredible powers and skills. Combat humanity's armies and bring about the apocalypse in this dark fantasy bullet heaven action RPG. Become the ultimate Fallen Slayer and leave no Survivors.

title: HomeNaut
description: HomeNaut is a puzzle platformer in which you spin the direction of gravity.

title: SherloCat Holmes Nonogram
description: SherloCat Holmes combines Picross with a captivating plot. With the charming detective cat, face various nonograms. Enjoy captivating music and design as you unravel mysteries and encounter Sherlock Holmes.

title: Defender Bros
description: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Tower Defense roguelike game where you play as a soldier defending your base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase you survivability, then after each run buy perks and become even stronger.

title: Kind Heart Survivors
description: In the game Kind Heart Survivors, you are challenged to survive on an unknown planet, build your base, and face unprecedented challenges. Are you ready for this survival adventure?

title: Siege 'n Sow
description: Unleash strategic mastery in this minimalist real-time strategy game. Micromanage units, expand territory, and fend off night attacks. Harvest resources, build structures, and command diverse units to survive relentless waves. Will you triumph or succumb to the shadows?

title: Liquidum
description: Liquidum is a water-themed logic puzzle game, where you strategically fill interconnected aquariums across six challenging sections with unique mechanics.

title: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
description: Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in repurposed Parking Garages in big cities across North America with tight arcade racing controls. A hybrid of Rally and circuit racing, from rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track.

title: Moyashi Monogatari
description:
Moyashi Monogatari is a jump-and-shoot action game in which players explore Gensoukyou to reach the ending.

This game is based on the Touhou Project and pays homage to Cave Story and other titles.

The English version of this game was translated by HakanaiBlue.

title: Abdogtion
description: Some creepy presence lurks deep in the snowy mountains. Locals have been experiencing a series of strange abductions, but none of them were brave enough to do anything. Until the day our main protagonist lost his dog. Powered by little more than his fists, he's determined to break through the frozen wastes into the heart of the forest just to get his best friend back.

title: Five Nights at Billy's
description: Billy and Van have had a glitch in their programing. It's up to you to make it through five nights and not let them get you.

title: Sadey's Sail
description: A casual resource management game about Captain Sadey, her trusty ship, and her rapscallion crew sailing the high seas in search of fortune and adventure!

title: Buckshot With Friends
description: Tabletop horror game where you take turns firing a shotgun. The game can be played with friends or a dealer, creating an intense, suspense-filled atmosphere. Russian Roulette reimagined.

title: Pet Run/Stop
description: Tiny petscii arcadey shooty

title: XCOM: Long War
description: XCOM: Long War is a fan-made partial conversion mod for XCOM: Enemy Unknown and its expansion, XCOM: Enemy Within. Almost every aspect of the original game is altered, creating a longer, more complex campaign that presents players with more strategic choices and customization options. Long War adds a significant number of new soldier classes, abilities, weapons, armors, and usable items, and also introduces new features, including soldier fatigue and improvements to alien units over the course of the game.

title: Silent Breath
description: Silent Breath is a horror experience powered by Unreal Engine 5. Featuring photorealistic graphics, fully dynamic scares and microphone detection.

title: No One Is Watching You
description: Point-and-Click-Adventure about the intrusiveness of being watched in your own Home

title: PSP1G: The Incident 2
description: A prequel to PSP1G: The Incident.

title: Lights Off: Director's Cut
description: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed. This time extended, remastered, and re-imagined.

title: Roofcats Band: Suika Style
description: What do cats do on the roof? They play jazz, rock, metal and more! In this Suika-like game, you must match the cats to make new musicians appear, all while avoiding overflow and dealing with a crazy dog that shows up to mess things up. Will you be able to hear a killer guitar solo on the last cat?

title: Love Criminals
description: Love Criminals is a visual novel game that spans romance, fantasy, drama, and science fiction that immerses players in the tale of Hinode, navigating a dilemma involving mysterious girls in his uncle's manor. The narrative adds depth, capturing intrigue surrounding Hinode's encounters with potential cousins or impostors.

title: Meowsterpiece Museum
description: Great painters love cats and hid them in their masterpieces. Your mission is to find them and make the paintings even more beautiful.

title: Fire Race
description: Employ your drifting skills and power-ups to gain an edge, while dodging obstacles strewn across your path on the way to the podium.

title: Wathan Games
description: "Wathan Games" is designed to build bridges between streamers and their viewers, turning every game into an opportunity to strengthen community bonds.

title: The Shell Part II: Purgatorio
description: Detective Reiji Tokisaka is back to face down a mystery that spans decades if not centuries. With the aftermath of his last case weighing on his soul and a long-silent cult resurgent, can he solve the crime—or will it become his curse?

title: Braccobaldo Show
description: Play as Zio Sam and his friends, hired by a mafia boss to eliminate his main competitor, Ash and his Pokémon.

title: Kozyrev Horrors
description: Step into the Kozyrev Mirror to unlock your Extra Sensory Perception. Beware: dread and horror await. Investigate to find an escape from this liminal space. Are you truly alone? A short and chilling singleplayer horror game, inspired by the Kozyrev Mirror experiments.

title: Invisible Places: Pixel Art Jigsaw Puzzle
description: Invisible Places is a minimalist jigsaw puzzle game that mixes GIF Pixel Art and photographs instead of static images.

title: Dungeons & Dining Tables
description: Dungeons and Dining Tables is a Cosy-RPG where you delve dungeons to collect rare furniture to decorate your house! The comfier your house. The better your stats!

title: Half-Life 2: Very Hard Mod
description: A very hard mod for Half-Life 2: Episode 2.

title: Fred Durst Companion
description: Adds Fred Durst as a playable companion to New Vegas, including his unique loadout, dialogue, combat style and audio tracks from Limp Bizkit songs.

title: Guano
description: Play as a delightfully dumb seagull, find food and complete quests to help free the Grand Masters and gain their powers. Harrass humans and free the Pohemeda Islands from the evil Food Inc. with your powerful poop and loud screams!

title: Super Extra Team Dungeon Game
description:
Super Extra Team Dungeon Game is not just a game, but a interactive experience for communities. Get ready to explore the depths of the dungeon, collect treasure and level up with your team.

The spiritual successor to Super Extra Console Dungeon Game, where you can dive deep into the abyss of the dungeon with your stream viewers as your battle party! Awesome pixel art graphics, multiple classes, over 50 monsters, exciting boss fights and more!!!

Now with Discord support! That is right you can connect to your discord server and play with your friends! Plus we support Twitch chat integration for our streamer friends out there.

You can play with the keyboard, controller or the mouse, so get ready and beat those monsters back to oblivion with your community!!!

title: Beast: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
description: Immerse yourself in the cosmic adventure of BEAST! A unique 3V3 online shooter designed for all ages. BEAST combines charm and excitement with intuitive controls.

title: Pang Pang Terrible
description: A online MMO FPS/proto-Hero Shooter made available by OnGame Brasil in 2005 on Brazil. Unlike other typical military shooting games of the time, it allows users to raise their own characters as they like. And it features bright and unique cartoon characters without any dark or gloomy mood. There's various game modes: Snowfight, Survival/Team Battle, Clan Battle, Pang Gold Battle, Boss Battle, Territory Battle, and Flag Battle. It also has leveling up characters, acquiring items, and shop functions. Deviating from the previous Wear & Tear character system of FPS into a new upbringing & character system. This game started in Korea and was planned for English in 2008 but never opened. The game is shut down now.

title: Jomey
description: A game about Jomey, a little green character with a dream so grand it could span the entire sky. Help him take a school project further than he could ever imagine by wielding all kinds of sweet treats against his enemies and building an UNSTOPPABLE team of WINNERS.

title: F1 24
description: Get ready to ignite your passion for racing and get closer to the grid like never before with EA SPORTS F1 24, the official videogame of the 2024 FIA Formula One World Championship

description: Meet Leo, the courageous firefighter cat, and help him on his exciting adventure as a junior recruit at the fire station! Take on missions that get trickier each time and climb the ranks with the guidance of Commander Nox. Don't worry, you're not alone!

title: Eggconsole: Hydlide 3 - PC-8801mkIISR
description:
The concluding chapter of the Hydlide series. Can you, as an adventurer, once again save Fairyland? This is the third installment in the iconic Japanese action RPG series, "Hydlide." and the player once again rises to the occasion to save Fairyland from a new crisis.

In addition to the graphics and sound inherited from the previous title as a sequel to the series, this ambitious work incorporates a moderate amount of various elements, such as the ability to choose a class, the concept of time, the need to eat during adventures, and the need to manage luggage due to the weight of items to be carried.

It can be said that this game title not only appealed to fans of the Hydlide series but also left a lasting impression on numerous gaming enthusiasts.

title: Tiger Heli
description: The NES port of Tiger Heli, one of the first games developed by Toaplan and published by Taito Corporation in 1985. It is a predecessor to Twin Cobra. The player controls a helicopter named Tiger Heli taking out various enemies along the way.

title: Midnight Monitor: Aldercourt
description: Lost in a series of endless train station hallways, find your way to the exit Platform in this First-Person Anomaly Spotting game set in the Midnight Monitor universe. Watch out for anomalies - If you see any, turn back immediately! Can you find your way out of Aldercourt Station?

title: Broken Thunder
description: Broken Thunder is a doujin game released in 2007 as a tribute to the Thunder Force series. It was released only in Japan but was quickly pulled from store shelves after negative feedback.

title: Starground
description: Starground is a top-down automation and roguelite experience. Enjoy a truly flexible experience. All progression trees are completely independent from each other. Spend all your time automating, dungeoning, or maybe a bit of both. There's no right way to play the game, and any path you take will let you win. If you want to play together, invite your friends to work on the same things, or divide and conquer each part of the game.

title: City 20
description: Embark on a dystopian-tinged survival sandbox adventure where the world dynamically responds to your actions. Craft your own narrative through a series of choices, navigating harsh environmental conditions and organized factions, and delving into unsolved mysteries.

title: KKHTA: Security Watch - Part 3
description: The third KKHTA : Security Watch game.

title: Temtem: Swarm
description:
Dive in solo or team up with other players online to face relentless Swarms! Level up fast, and unleash ridiculous synergies in a vibrant world full of familiar creatures and flashy upgrades. Temtem: Swarm blends the chaotic fun of survivor-likes with Temtem’s signature strategy.

Each hand-crafted stage throws tougher challenges your way. Test your timing and teamwork against mini-bosses, massive Tems like Tyranak and Galios, and their screen-filling attacks! Use matchmaking or bring friends and coordinate Gears, Traits, and Ultimates to wipe the map clean. Or don't coordinate at all and just vibe through the chaos, we won’t judge.

Defeat enemies to level up, unlock wild new abilities, and evolve your Tems mid-run to turn the tide. Even if you go down, Ghost Mode lets you support the squad until they can revive you. Collect and master unique Tems, their Luma and Umbra variants, and pack every run with fresh combos, evolving strategies, and just the right amount of bullet heaven mayhem!

title: SolForge Fusion
description: SolForge Fusion is a card-battling game where players tactically deploy creatures and cast potent spells to outmaneuver their adversaries—each card played levels up, amplifying its power!

title: Truxton Extreme
description: Truxton Extreme, which inherits the DNA from legendary arcade masterpiece Truxton, is a collaboration with manga artist and Toaplan alumni Junya Inoue.

title: Counter-Strike: Source Offensive
description:
Ever wanted to play CS:S just like CS:GO but tired of simple model-changing mods? Then this mod is for you! This is a mod for Counter-Strike: Source, which brings a lot of gameplay features from CS:GO into CS:S, such as:

All weapons from CS:GO (really, all of them!)
All player factions from CS:GO
Panorama-like HUD
Even all agents from CS:GO! (you can switch them in-game whenever you want)
Loadout system (for example, you can use either P2000 or USP-S, depending on what you prefer!)
Gloves that you can also change in-game!
Complete CS:GO shooting mechanics (spray patterns, etc)
New gamemodes: Deathmatch (normal and FFA), Arms Race, Flying Scoutsman, Wingman
CS:GO shaders: Character, WeaponDecal, CustomWeapon and improved phong shading for VertexLitGeneric
CS:GO postprocessing
VScripts
Molotov & Decoy grenades
Playing as bots when dead
CS:GO player animations (v0.10 and above: from the current CS:GO build; below v0.10: from an old CS:GO build)
Ironsights
New cash award system (award for defusing/planting the bomb, different kill rewards for different weapons)
All CS:GO radio commands
CS:GO viewbob
Weapon inspection
New sounds from CS:GO (footsteps, hit sounds, etc)
Unique hands viewmodel for each faction
Unique voice for each faction (bots included)
Carrying hostages just like in CS:GO
Different grenade throw ranges
CS:GO C4 logic (radio message 4 seconds before explosion; it will explode 1 second after going off just like in CS:GO)
Unique voice lines for each grenade throw
English and Russian translations

title: Just Plumbers in Hallowville
description: Just Plumbers in Hallowville is a cooperative horror game where players must control two plumbers to fix pipes, running against the clock. All while trying to survive encounters with their peculiar customers.

title: Count 427
description:
Count 427 is a horror game with theme of the examine of traffic volume.
You sit on a chair on road as a traffic volume examiner and work. If you press a button when a car passes, you will have an unusual experience. If you find something wrong, take a picture.

title: Trepang2: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2. Unleash hell on your enemies in this gory action-packed FPS set in the future and stop at nothing to get your revenge.

The Deluxe Edition includes:

- Trepang2 Full Game
- Season Pass including Survival Mode DLC (Available Now) and Story DLC coming soon.

title: Chiralmori
description: This is a fan disc of the Nitro+ Chiral characters, featuring 3 mini games. Various characters from Togainu no Chi and Lamento -Beyond the Void- are included.

title: Merry Go Round
description: A cyberpunk visual novel released in 1996.

title: The Last Sorrow
description:
"Wake up, Young Sorrow..."

You are the Last of the Sorrow, a small group of humans living on the brink of extinction in a harsh and dangerous world that your kind once ruled over.

Fight your way out of the Ancient Fortress in which you have been held prisoner for so long. Escape the Prison and find the other Sorrows...

"There is much to do..."

title: Yumpr
description: Yumpr has crashed in hostile enviroment! Filled up with dangerous creatures and obstacles. Help him survive this crazy world!

title: Zahak
description: Zahak is a roguelike action RPG set in the captivating world of Persian mythology. Battle relentless waves of enemies and navigate the magical landscapes of Mount Damavand. Unleash the ancient power within your cursed bloodline to challenge the dark legacy of the Serpent King.

title: ZiDouQianWen
description: I am a destiny question and answer game based on Zi Wei Dou Shu, a Chinese astrology system. Come and explore the mysteries of destiny with me!

title: Zero Hero
description: Zero hero is an endless roguelike, each wave of enemies and unique combinations. Collect Waboshi to buy new weapons and upgrades outside the game and get further and further in the challenges with the number of kills and waves. Challenge yourself with new weapons, new powers and challenges!

title: Zomb Bomb
description: A fast pace retro arcade shooter. Fight waves of zombies and dragons with a great gun collection. Battle five wild bosses all while trying to keep the high score.

title: Zombies!!! Board Game
description: Zombies!!! puts you in the middle of the action in this video game adaptation of the hit board game. In order to escape the ever advancing zombie horde, players must use a combination of wits and brawn to be the first to the heliport and certain escape.

title: Wizard War Online
description: Wizard War Online offers a P2P game mode and a game mechanic you are not used to. While flying with the sweeper, you will experience a different flight experience thanks to the customizable maneuver settings. Make strategic moves and pay attention to timing while fighting your enemies.

title: Wizarducks and the Lost Hat
description: Have daily adventures in dungeons and exploring unmapped areas, some far away, some hidden in your own home. Cast spells to fight enemies and to solve puzzles blocking your way. Befriend the villagers, help them decorate the town. Oh, and pet your dog, he likes it.

title: Wizard Realm
description: Wizard Realm is a dynamic game with rogue-like elements set in a fantastic 3D world. It enables players to develop various battle strategies using a multitude of magical skills to survive. It enriched with an advanced item system.

title: W.I.T.S: Initiation
description: A puzzle game where you are the newest recruit to a government agency dedicated to stopping cyber crimes. You must prove yourself and level up in the system by solving puzzles, at the same time there is a mystery to uncover at the agency. Who can you trust?

title: With in the Obscurity
description: A first-person perspective mystery puzzle-solving game where players immerse themselves in the role of characters involved in each episode's abnormal event to uncover the truth. The plan is to release 2 episodes per month, totaling 6 episodes per season.

title: Wizzerd Quest
description: Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full split-screen co-op. Its aesthetic is straight out of the mid 1990's, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. Play the entire game for free with zero microtransactions or DRM!

title: Wonderway
description: Wonderway is a puzzle game where the direction of gravity can be changed. Get to the goal by moving and manipulating items which interact with gravity.

title: Magic Card: CZ12
description: This is a very casual strategy card game that is very easy and simple. The goal is to win more coins and become the richest man in the world. The original intention of the game is to activate the brain and turn the tide against the wind.

title: Woodsy Whatnots
description: Quest across a mysterious wooded kingdom, full of wacky creatures, and spin-smash your way through even wackier monsters! Meet colourful companions in this Party-Based RPG, and use their abilities to face villainous overlords in the name of adventure.

title: Wiblu
description: Wiblu: The Search for the Fire Tea, is a captivating video game with German mythology, following Wiblu's quest to find the legendary Fire Tea to save her sick grandmother.

title: Wildlife Rescue Simulator
description: Get to the chopper and fly to isolated places to rescue terrified animals from man made disasters. Take photos of your adventures and share it with your loyal supporters to get donations. Upgrade your equipment in order to rescue even more animals.

title: Willy's Wonderland: The Game
description: Willy’s Wonderland: The Game is a 2.5D beat ‘em up game based on the cult film of the same name, in which a group of Animatronics come to life and slaughter people who dare visit Willy’s Wonderland.

title: Winter Night
description: "Winter Night" presents a story inspired by beliefs in Thailand. Players will experience the atmosphere of an ancient, mysterious mansion.presented through 2D PixelArt.

title: West Town Defense
description: Gunslingers and bandits are storming the town! You must stop the crimes and rescue the town! This is a tough mission Sheriff, be careful. A classic, wave based survival game.

title: Where Is George
description: George is a sneaky little cat that loves to hide. Can you find him? In this free to play game you need to find 100 cats in beautiful hand drawn levels. Are you able to find them all?

title: White Cat Town Mystery
description: White Cat Town Mystery is a visual novel/adventure game about an anthropomorphic cat named Lumi. Help him explore atmospheric and magical town, meet old friends again, make hard choices, and go through supernatural challenges. What you choose decides the fate of the town—and Lumi himself!

title: Whispers in the Void
description: The main hero John Eikts wakes up in a mysterious room for supernatural creatures. Anomalies escape, wreaking havoc. Eikts must navigate the chaos while uncovering his dark past. As he approaches freedom, a shocking twist reveals that he is not a victim, but one of them.

title: Whisper Of The Curse
description: "Whisper of the Curse" is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror game where you and your team will perform various rituals and spells to eliminate the curse and fend off cursed entities. At the same time, you'll need to avoid being hunted by these malevolent entities.

title: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
description: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

title: Whispers of Prague: The Executioner's Last Cut
description: Classic first-person point-and-click adventure game set in contemporary Prague. As a programmer and treasure hunter, you embark on a long journey to uncover the secrets of the infamous Executioner. Your task will be complicated by a sect of fanatic cultists and your own unexplained heritage.

title: The Twilight Witch
description: The Twilight Witch is a 2D pixel art RPG where you play as Mael, a young man from the village of New Larton. After your home-town is attacked and ravaged by a mysterious figure, you venture forth to tell of what happened and maybe, just maybe, find a way to stop the hooded aggressor…

title: Never wake up
description: psychological survival horror

title: Echolight
description: Echolight ist ein actionbasiertes Roguelike-Spiel, in welchem du die Welt vor dem Chaos gefährlicher Monster, mit Hilfe der Waffen der Götter des Tages und der Nacht retten musst.

title: Palm Sugar: A Village Story
description: Embark on a pixel RPG journey in 'పల్లెటూరు - PalmSugar.' Battle drug lords, wield unique weapons, and immerse yourself in South Indian culture. Telugu & English localization. Will you save the village?

title: Dwarfs Delight
description: Join the adventure of Dwarfs Delight, an explosive multiplayer game where dwarves battle in a tavern for glory and beer! Face off against your friends in this couch game, where every mug counts. Get ready for laughter and unforgettable moments. Ideal for nights with friends!

title: Panda
description: A 2D momentum based platformer.

title: Shotengai 10
description: Suddenly, I realized that I was in a Japanese shopping district that I was unfamiliar with. An unusual shopping street where even if you proceed blindly, you will end up returning to the entrance. Let's exit from this shopping street by relying on the hints left behind.

title: Shoomer Booter
description: An unexpected find at an antique shop, a soy boy stumbles upon an ancient beard ointment. Each night, he slips into a dream where he embodies a Sumerian warrior, tracing his lineage to Gibil. In this fantastical realm, he courageously confronts demons that lurk within the mystical attics of Irkalla.

title: Plants in Rush
description: Plants in rush is a multiplayer and single player game. Its fun, fast paced, and simple. You have to chose between 4 fruits throw projectiles spawn lasers turrets and more! it has 3 modes deathmatch team deathmatch and soccer!

title: Artificial Life Simulator
description: Artificial Life Simulator is a relaxing and colorful simulation game where you create artificial life forms based on particle interactions. The particles interact with each other through forces, resulting in unique emergent behaviors.

title: Legend of the Nine Colored Deer
description: "Legend of the Nine-Colored Deer" is an adventurous third-person puzzle game filled with Chinese mythology. Seeking the trail of the Nine-Colored Deer, solving puzzles, and unraveling the legend's mysteries. Explore a charming and fantastical world of adventure.

title: Tomorrow's Love Puzzle
description: Play as 'Ming Tian' in a romantic game, where you meet six unique women. From dominant to innocent, mysterious, dignified, cheerful, to clingy, your choices determine Ming Tian's love story. Who will he choose? You decide.

title: Feeling Death
description: A Game Where You're Killed for Becoming a Couple.

title: Trap for the Heir
description: Gwen is an experienced werewolf mercenary. One day, she comes across a simple and very monetary order. But who is her mysterious customer? And will it be so easy to get to destination alive? New friends, old enemies and maybe a meeting with love...

title: Quallet
description: Quallet is a game where you are a criminal in the land of Qualle, but be careful to not get caught by the police of Qualle!

title: Node: The Last Favor of the Antarii
description: NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is a 2.5D puzzle platformer about a robot navigating a Cold War nuclear complex. Execute timeline-based commands to control NODE. Unravel mysteries, explore the unknown. Your commands decide the outcome.

title: Full-Scale Invasion
description: Full-Scale Invasion is an armchair general RTS that puts the player directly in the battle as they command ground-to-space armies from the bridge of their very own capital ship.

title: Save the Villainess
description: What if you woke up as a villainess in a romance novel where someone wants you dead? Guide your villainess by solving mysteries and making choices that lead you closer to romance, revenge… or death. In this mystery/horror otome isekai game, can you Save the Villainess?

title: Édgimon
description: Catch wild Égdimon, dig, build, craft, and explore an infinite world, in this open-world creature-taming and role-playing game.

title: Mechanophagia
description: Mechanophagia is a challenging bullet hell shooter with roguelite elements, set in a dark and gritty sci-fi world. Blast through waves of fleshy aberrations and defeat monstrous bosses. Can you outmaneuver the relentless enemy onslaught and save the robots from their inevitable extinction?

title: Out Of Mind
description: Out Of Mind merges psychological thriller and puzzle genres, allowing players to confront their fears. Get lost in labyrinthine environments, solve mysterious puzzles, and unveil dark secrets. The game stands out with atmospheric design and a unique storyline.

title: Ukraine War 2022
description: Ukraine War 2022 is a real-time, tactical land and air warfare simulation game focusing on the ongoing war between Ukraine and Russia.

title: Surveillance Simulator
description: Using surveillance equipment to complete a series of tasks, or lighting up a cigarette and gazing at the real-time footage from various cameras on the screen.

title: Mr. Akun's Jump
description: This game is a casual adventure game where players use the mouse to click on Akun to generate a parabola, allowing him to jump from one platform to another. The goal is to guide him to the highest peak to retrieve the lost basketball!

title: The Last Rose
description: Kuri Rose was dead, until she wasn't. Now she stands in defiance to a world that is slowly disappearing in this apocalypse adventure visual novel.

title: Njuma
description: Njuma is a 2D narrative driven pixel game with multiple endings. Be the difference your family needs as they draw their final breath.

title: Kuudere Funk
description: With the city overrun with supernatural beings and occurrences, it is up to two women to restore the city to its former state. In order to accomplish such a task, sexual rituals must be performed by these women at the shrines scattered throughout the city…

title: Tiny Battles
description: Tiny Battles is a tactical action auto-battler where battles take place automatically in the arena.

title: Tale of the Seas
description: It is a classic gem elimination game, a gem exchange elimination game that exercises eyesight.

title: Stack Slayer
description: Stack Slayer is defense builder where you stack cards to harvest material, craft equipment, build structures, and upgrade structures for fighting and protect ancient core from the invade monster.

title: Starters Orders Touch Horse Racing
description: Starters Orders Touch now on desktop from ! A brand new GUI and improved game play and the most advanced simulation engine to date cement Starters Orders as the No.1. horse racing management series. Available here on Steam once out of beta.

title: Rockit!
description: Rockit! is a difficult arcade game about trying to not crash rockets. Duck and weave around progressively challenging obstacles to be crowned the ultimate rocket pilot.

title: Gun Gladiator
description: Brutally defeat your enemies, upgrade your equipment, influence the crowd, master the arena and become the new champion in a gory and fast-paced retro FPS set in a post-apocalyptic world.

title: HamSumo
description: BONK YOUR FRIENDS in this action-packed, roly-poly, multiplayer action game! Choose your favorite hamster to duke it out with your friends in the most adorable (and explosive!) PvP arena! Unleash unique and powerful Star Moves to blast away the competition!

title: F.I.T.
description: Challenge your spatial awareness and reflexes in F.I.T. An addictive puzzle game where you are the master of your own geometric shape, and must skillfully fit into falling blocks of various sizes and shapes to survive and thrive in this captivating arcade style game to achieve the highest score!

title: Dragon of Steelthorne
description: Rule a mighty city, fight battles and go on adventures as the Ardent or Ardessa of the city of Lake Steelthorne. Find love, power, and a secret that could change the world.

title: Prank Heart
description: Phantom Theif vs. Detective slapstick online battle action!!! Enjoy lively and funny PvP with multiple items such as Rocket launcher, Invisibility cloak, Bananas, Soccer ball bomb!

title: Legend Of Apophyxis
description: Embark on an epic journey filled with mystical enemies and powerful allies in this action-packed game. Harness your strength, defeat foes, and rise as the true hero of Myrr

title: The Bit's Escape
description: Bit's is a small machine built in a underground factory, his dream is to escape and discover life beyond what is below the earth.

title: Lexicon
description: Lexicon is a word based puzzle game wrapped inside a strange abandoned computer system. You explore forgotten terminals, sift through corrupted files, and solve linguistic challenges that twist familiar rules into something unsettling. Every puzzle reveals a fragment of a larger story that hides beneath the interface, waiting for you to notice the patterns that are not supposed to be there.

title: Fire and Rescue
description: Fires have broken out all over the city! Use your portable water tank to extinguish raging fires and carry innocent civilians to safety. Play by yourself or simultaneously with a friend to see who is the best fire-fighter in FIRE AND RESCUE!

title: Commandos Pro Simulator
description: Superfast action-packed shooter to play in single mode or multiplayer with your friends! Play from first person view or switch to third view at anytime during this hardcore game. Select to play for special commandos forces or for bad terrorists criminals. No time - start shooting left and right!

title: Pigeon's Mission
description: Enjoy a whimsical pixel-art adventure crafted from a 6-year-old's art & vision. Navigate Pepper Pines as Archie, a pigeon with clever attacks & CRAZY power-ups, on a dangerous quest to save his parents. Experience a blend of nostalgia & fresh, fun gameplay in a world ruled by imagination & wonder.

title: The house of the missing hands
description: A first person flat/VR survival horror game where you have to escape the dark farm where you are being kept against your will after finding out the package you were delivering contained a human hand. Use stealth to avoid The hand collector while unraveling the reason he collects hands.

title: Pay Me In Colors
description: Pay Me In Colors is a 2D platformer game with multiple mechanics, six different worlds and over 40 challenging levels. Face meteors, gravity changing, spikes falling and missiles coming in your direction while you try to recover the colors back to your world. A game inspired by the classics of the past.

title: Easy puzzle: Streets
description: Is a logic game in which the goal of the game is to rearrange the tiles to get the final picture

title: Hyperspace Deck Command
description: Hyperspace Deck Command is a sci-fi card-battler roguelite. Deploy spaceships that operate on individual turn timers, combine a wide variety of cards into powerful decks and use dual-use status effects to defeat the hegemonising swarm intelligence.

title: The Return of the King
description: This game tests hands-on ability and brain thinking.

title: Forge Front
description: Defend magical orbs from goblin invaders in 'Forge Front.' Build and upgrade structures strategically across diverse landscapes in this FPS tower defense adventure!

title: Dino Dino
description: Playfully extend your knowledge about dinosaurs in a collection of mini games. Created in cooperation with the German Paleontological Society, featuring voice recordings and hand-drawn illustrations, Dino Dino sets out to awaken your kids's interest in complex topics while being a lot of fun.

title: Red Snow
description: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

title: Node Farm
description: Node Farm is a game about building a fully automated farm using nodes. Connect nodes, harvest and sell veggies, buy new islands, discover new nodes, and automate the process - all in a cozy farm simulation formula!

title: Realms of Arcana
description: Realms of Arcana is an engaging RPG set in a mysterious world shaped by the legacy of a fallen empire, featuring deep exploration, crafting, strategic combat with melee, magic, stealth, and a storyline where every choice impacts the game's rich narrative.

title: BoboInvasion
description: BoboInvasion is a classic spaceshooter game. Face waves of aliens with increasing difficulty, dodge their attacks, and choose a ship upgrade that suits your style to win

title: Deep Scanner
description: Due to your debts, you have been sent to the BAORA9 production facility. A quiet place, if it weren't for the raids by local creatures. Will you be able to complete your work and leave BAORA9 safe and sound?

title: Mushroom Moonrise
description: Mushroom Moonrise, it's a delightful blend of strategy, art, and serenity. Inspired by the theme 'It's Spreading!', it transforms the subtle art of mushroom growth into an enthralling strategic conquest.

title: Scape
description: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

title: Puzzle Journey
description:
"Wild Waters and Earthy Wonders: A Matching Adventure"

Explore the captivating world of land and sea creatures in this thrilling card matching game.
Test your memory and observation skills as you uncover pairs of enchanting images depicting animals from both the wild waters and the earthy wonders.
With four challenging difficulty modes, embark on an adventure filled with fun and discovery.
Match, explore, and win as you unravel the mysteries behind each card.

title: Traveler's Refrain
description: Wield your magical instrument and defy the mecha-goddesses of fate in this Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG. Explore a forbidden forest as Traveler, and help him reunite with his long lost love as you fight through abominations and solve mysterious puzzles, all while an ancient conflict unfolds.

title: Iron Line
description: Iron Line is a tower defense game where you are one of a few, train conductors capable of traversing on the Iron Line. Will you survive the onslaught, or get an express ticket to the afterlife?

title: Warfare Legacy Collection
description: Warfare 1917 and Warfare 1944, updated for modern hardware, join forces in Warfare Legacy Collection. Experience the intense tug-of-war of WW1 and WW2 and engage in strategic battles that defined an era. Command waves of troops, unleash tactical prowess, and even customize your own battlefields!

title: Plague Doctor
description: Plague Doctor is a Gritty, Dark and Gory replication of the Medieval Black Plague. You play as a somewhat anti-villain, a plague doctor. Immerse yourself like never before in an open world Medieval Kingdom - Riddled with the plague.

title: Legends of the Round Table
description: Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom to make the flower of chivalry blossom again.

title: Cura
description: This game is a 3D puzzle game where you control the box-shaped character ``CURA'' to conquer stages and reach the goal.

title: TDS
description: TDS - Tower ▪ Defense ▪ Strategy. Control Vessels. Utilize their uniquely deep, yet simple set of towers. Create an everchanging defense. Protect your Basin at all costs. A Tower Defense, Real-Time Strategy Hybrid

title: Slime, Fire and Soul
description: You enter the DUNGEON and try to get as far as possible.

title: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball
description: Dudelings: Arcade Sportsball is a fast-paced sportslike. A cross between Pong and Foosball, this title brings high-energy local mutiplayer fun to the table!

title: Gravity Pro
description: In this arcade game, use your paddle to strike the ball and shatter bricks. Gravity and physics are both your allies and challenges. Master skill and precision to navigate dynamic levels and get high scores. Every hit, every angle, and every rebound plays a crucial role in determining your success.

title: The August Before
description: The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!

title: Voidsayer
description: The world has fallen into darkness, cursed by the Abyss. You are one of the many hapless survivors at risk of being consumed. Unlike others, you have a chance to fight back. Voidsayer is a dark monster tamer jRPG. Assemble your monster team, take on eldritch horrors, and return hope to the world.

title: Superstore Simulator
description: Develop your store, order goods, and sell, sell, sell. Hire employees and take care of customers. Enjoy a rather humorous approach to trading and running a store where you can look forward to hours upon hours of great entertainment.

title: Octameta
description: A 3D-styled puzzle-solving burning brain indie game, using the Pocket Cube to restore objects. A story about AI's journey to recreate the history of human science

title: Time Machine Bronzeville
description: A storytelling game that explores the stories, cityscape, and legend and lore of Chicago's South Side ca. 1940. Encounter both heroes and scoundrels in 3D interactive scenes that transport the visitor into detailed recreations of this vanished community as it was between the World Wars.

title: The Quantum Conflict
description: Jump into action-packed space dogfights with up to 8 players (or AI's) locally or over Remote-Play-Together. Use outlandish sci-fi weapons, including the wormhole maker and time altering munitions while avoiding asteroids, wormholes, planet gravity, and other hazards.

title: CapitalismCraft
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of capitalism! Exploit your workers to earn money! Hire managers to crush their spirits and drive them harder, then fire them once you’ve achieved your ends! Be agile, ruthless, merciless, become the richest CEO in the world, winning in rapid clicker management!

title: Shlemo
description: Action-packed stories of 3 different guys who kill people to get to a briefcase with supposed wealth. The question is which of them will get it, will it solve their problems, which of them will die and what is in the briefcase?

title: Gun vs. Zombies
description: Gun vs. Zombies is a thrilling showdown where precision meets undead mayhem. Take control of a dynamic gun affected by physics as you fend off waves of zombies hungry for a brain feast. Compete against others on the global leaderboard by showcasing your shooting skills.

title: Moyu world
description: This is an exciting game with very simple rules and high degrees of freedom.

title: Eye of death
description: This is a parkour game.

title: Greedshot
description: Greedshot is a first-person rogue-lite shooter with procedurally generated locations. Play alone or with friends in co-op mode, facing merciless enemies and environments

title: Strange Hunting Grounds
description: A casual hack and slash game that conquers hell by creating a powerful expedition through a variety of skill & weapon combinations

title: FawnRun
description: The only level 2D casual mini-game there is please keep moving.

title: Mysterious prophecy
description: This is a parkour game that is not just about running, but about climbing, jumping, and crossing all obstacles, constantly running forward.

title: Enci's Solution
description: “Enci’s Solution” tells the story of Ji’we who leaves his home behind to go on a journey to the surface of planet Regalia. Living underground his whole life- with the help of Enci and other characters he meets on his way, Ji’we uncovers challenges in a world governed by an AI.

title: Poroto
description: Poroto is a chaotic arcade adventure - blast red pegs in action-packed platforming! Jump and run across vibrant levels, strategically bouncing and shooting to eliminate all the red chaos. Pinball-style mechanics, bite-sized levels, and a pumping soundtrack make this an unforgettable experience.

title: Don't Be Afraid 2
description: Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

title: Golf with Guns
description: Mini golf with a twist... GUNS! Shoot your own golf ball to move it closer to the hole or shoot an opponent's ball to mess them up. Compete with friends and/or randoms to shoot the lowest score. Enjoy playing your own custom maps or ones made by the community on the Workshop.

title: Rock Tetrus
description: Place the rocks, make a solid line, make the line crumble and fall! There are an infinite amount of strategies! Made by 1 person, inspired by a fake mobile game ad. Enjoy!

title: Welcome to Ukraine
description: A puzzle game through which you will discover Ukraine.

title: Timber
description: Build and manage your industrial empire unlike ever before. Dive into Timber: where strategic resource management meets city-building excitement.
